The terrain is painted with muted green, gray, and tan with a fence in the lower left corner and a rock formation rising in the middle of the landscape. Distant hills studded with trees and a few structures span the high horizon, which comes three-quarters of the way up the composition. A thick band of charcoal-gray clouds descends on the slate-blue sky above.
creator: Benvenuto di Giovanni
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Kneeling Angel
title: Kneeling Angel
assistive_text: The image shows a sculpture of an angel. The angel has human-like features, wings, and attire. The sculpture depicts the angel kneeling with hands clasped together. The material appears to be a light-colored stone, possibly marble, with a smooth, polished finish highlighting details such as curls in its hair, folds in its clothing, and feathered texture of the wings. The sculpture is detailed and realistic, showcasing an aura of grace and serenity. It is in profile view, emphasizing its posture and expression.
creator: Workshop of Giovanni Antonio Amadeo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Lady
title: A Lady
assistive_text: The sculpture is a bust of a woman, focusing on her head and shoulders. She has a high forehead with slightly curling hair pulled back under a smooth cap. Her face includes thin eyebrows, a long nose, a slightly cleft chin, and lips set in a neutral expression. Her eyes are blank, without a visible pupil or iris. Her clothing appears to be an intricately detailed dress, featuring floral patterns and slightly puffed sleeves. The sculpture is carved from a smooth, light-colored material.
creator: Circle of Andrea del Verrocchio
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Madonna and Child with Saints and Donors
title: Madonna and Child with Saints and Donors
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts a central seated figure with a child on their lap, surrounded by various standing and kneeling figures on either side. The central figure is dressed in a draped garment, and holding a small child as they sit on a throne-like chair. The figures surrounding this central pair are in various poses, some holding books, others with hands in a gesture of discussion or holding their attire, and two figures at the forefront are kneeling. The piece is carved from a pale colored material, exhibiting fine details in the folds of clothing and facial features. The sculpture has a relief style with multiple figures conveying a narrative scene, crafted with meticulous attention to period attire and accoutrements.
creator: Probably Gasparo Cairano
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Scenes from a Legend
title: Scenes from a Legend
assistive_text: This painting depicts a long, horizontal landscape viewed from an elevated angle. On the left, by a group of green trees and bushes, several people stand around one person who is on the back of a white horse. They wear garments in shades of light red, dark green, and pale yellow. In the distance behind them, a gray castle is visible, and farther away boats sail across green water near tree-covered hills. In the center of the painting is a collection of massive gray rocks. A small yellow tent is at the bottom of the rocks, with a group of small people sitting or standing around it. To the right of them, two deer drink from a small blue pool while a person in a gray shirt rests nearby, wrapped in a green cloth. On the right side of the painting, people walk down a long path that ends in a large gray castle or city in the top right corner. Some of the people hold long poles or weapons. The color palette is mostly earthy browns and greens, with dark green trees filling much of the background. The sky is visible in the left and right sections of the painting; it is a greenish blue near the top that fades into a light pink when it meets the distant green hills.
creator: Giovanni Larciani (Master of the Kress Landscapes)
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Library, San Lorenzo
title: Library, San Lorenzo
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an architectural facade. It showcases a building's facade with ornate architectural elements such as pilasters, niches, and decorative panels. The structure features a set of stairs leading up to a central entrance framed by columns and a pediment. Symmetrical windows and circular motifs further embellish the design, reflecting classical architectural styles. The drawing shows precise linework and annotations at the bottom right corner providing additional information.
creator: John Russell Pope
credit_line: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Il Marzocco, Donatello
title: Il Marzocco, Donatello
assistive_text: This is an image of two stone pillars with lion sculptures at the top. The pillars feature detailed carvings and the lion sculptures are seated, one holding a shield with an emblem. The pillars have classical motifs and floral patterns. The background is plain, accentuating the architecture and stone textures.
creator: John Russell Pope
credit_line: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Palazzo Communale, Bologna
title: Palazzo Communale, Bologna
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an architectural facade. The drawing depicts the detailed design and structure of a building facade, showing intricate architectural details typical of a classical style. The facade features multiple stories with large arches on the lower level and decorative columns framing both the arches and upper windows. The drawing includes detailed representations of columns, entablatures, and a style of ornamentation. Additionally, there is a clear attention to symmetry and proportion, with the use of arcs and circular motifs. The drawing appears to be a technical blueprint or an architectural study, which could have been used for planning or educational purposes.
creator: John Russell Pope
credit_line: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: John Randolph
title: John Randolph
assistive_text: The image shows an elderly man seated, looking directly at the viewer. He has a gentle expression with deep-set eyes and gray hair combed back over his ears. He is wearing formal dark clothing with a white shirt and a blue cravat. There are no visible accessories. The background is a simple dark color.
creator: Chester Harding
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Alexander Hamilton
title: Alexander Hamilton
assistive_text: Shown from the chest up, a pale-skinned, clean-shaven man wearing black looks off to our left against a dark brown background in this vertical portrait painting. His shoulders are angled to our left and he gazes off with steady, dark eyes. He has low, dark brows, a bumped nose, a strong jaw, a pointed chin, and his lips curl in a slight smile. His gray hair is brushed back from his forehead and gathered loosely at the nape of his neck. The sideburn we can see is a row of gray curls angling down over the ear. A cream-white ascot is tied in a bow around his neck and tucked into the collar of his black coat. His left arm, closer to us, is by his side and his other arm is held out so it angles into the lower left corner. Light from our left creates an amber glow around his face on the otherwise dark background.
creator: John Trumbull
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Colonel Guy Johnson and Karonghyontye (Captain David Hill)
title: Colonel Guy Johnson and Karonghyontye (Captain David Hill)
assistive_text: A man with pale white skin sits and a man with light brown skin stands in front of a cave-like, rocky outcropping in this vertical portrait painting. The light-skinned man closer to us has dark brown hair, and the light falls more strongly on him. He sits propped on or against a rock with his body angled to our left, and he looks off into the distance in that direction. He wears a scarlet-red overcoat, a white waistcoat, and moccasins. What appears to be an animal skin painted on the underside with red, tan, and black geometric patterns is tied around his chest and falls over his left arm, on our right. With that hand, he holds a musket like a walking stick. He also holds a black cap ornamented with beads and feathers on his other knee. The man with brown skin stands in shadow behind the other man, to our left. His body faces us, and he looks at the seated man. A dark cloak encircles his shoulders and is gathered around his waist. A strap crosses his bare chest and the strap, bracelets, and a feathered headdress seem to be beaded. Large gold rings curve from his earlobes up over his ears. A puff of smoke emerges from the top of the long, painted stick he holds, suggesting it is a pipe. He holds his left hand, on our right, at his chest, and points subtly to our left, perhaps to the landscape seen through a break in the rocky outcropping. There, in front of a waterfall in the distance, a small group of people with light brown skin gather around a camp fire in front of a tent-like structure.
creator: Benjamin West
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cherubs Playing with a Lyre
title: Cherubs Playing with a Lyre
assistive_text: This is a large fountain featuring two cherubic children with curly hair. They sit on opposite sides of a solid harp-shaped object, holding it with their hands. The object has two small goat heads on its top corners and a small face on the bottom with rays emanating from it. The cherubs and the object sit on carved leaves on top of a round scalloped platform, under which is the column-shaped base of the fountain. Around this base is a shallow pool of water. The sculpture is mainly a light gray color with rusty red and yellow discoloration in some areas. The cherubs' wings are golden. Surrounding the sculpture are white lilies, and the background shows classical architecture with grand columns and draped curtains.
creator: Pierre Legros I
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Bacchanal with a Wine Vat
title: Bacchanal with a Wine Vat
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a Bacchanalian scene with classical figures and a grapevine. It depicts a group of muscular figures engaged in a celebration around a barrel beneath a fruiting grapevine. Various poses are shown, with some figures holding or pouring liquids, while others interact with the grapes on the vine. The artwork features detailed anatomical rendering of the figures, intricate design of foliage and textures of materials like the wood of the barrel and the stone floor. Playful putti contribute to the lively and festive atmosphere. The composition is dense and dynamic, capturing the spirit of revelry and indulgence.
creator: Andrea Mantegna
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Four Dancing Muses
title: Four Dancing Muses
assistive_text: This is a drawing of four figures in flowing garments dancing or moving rhythmically. The figures are depicted with detailed drapery and elegant postures. They are intertwined through their gestures and clothes, creating a sense of unity and harmony within the composition. The drawing is executed with delicate line work, showcasing the play of light and shadow across the figures, giving them a three-dimensional quality. Each figure's garment billows in a natural rhythm, contributing to the overall dynamic yet serene scene captured in the image.
creator: Workshop of Andrea Mantegna
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Nereid Ridden by Two Children
title: Nereid Ridden by Two Children
assistive_text: This is an elaborate ornamental design featuring a vertical composition with classical elements including urns, acanthus leaves, volutes, cherubs, lion-like figures, and mythological creatures. The top section resembles an ornate vase or candelabrum surrounded by swirling patterns, while the bottom features a central motif of classical figures. The drawing is reminiscent of Renaissance-style decorative designs, characterized by fine line work and symmetrical detail.
creator: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Satyr Family
title: Satyr Family
assistive_text: The image shows two figures in an outdoor setting. To the left, a figure with the characteristics of a satyr is standing playing a pipe. The figure has pointed ears, curly hair, and is unclothed. To the right, a seated woman holds a slender branch. She has long hair, styled with a head covering, and finely detailed facial features with a calm expression. She wears flowing garments. The background features a rustic landscape with trees, one small mythical creature, and an animal next to a dish. The name "Benedeto Montagna" is inscribed above the woman.
creator: Benedetto Montagna
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Old Woman with a Distaff
title: Old Woman with a Distaff
assistive_text: The image shows a person standing indoors and engaging in an activity. The person's face is partially obscured, with a possible profile and a focused gaze downward. They are wearing a wrap, a long robe, and shoes. The person holds a spindle and distaff for spinning yarn. In the background, there is a fireplace mantel with a pitcher and dish on the left, and some tools and a picture frame against the wall on the right.
creator: Enea Vico after Parmigianino
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Last Supper
title: The Last Supper
assistive_text: The image shows a group of men gathered around a long table. The central figure has an aura-like burst behind his head and is seated with others leaning towards him or gesturing. The men have long hair and beards, and wear long robes. One individual is pouring liquid from a pitcher into a cup, while another leans forward. On the table is a plate with food and a cup. The background shows an arched and vaulted ceiling with a stone or brick walls. The style of the image is monochromatic and engraved.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple
title: The Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with multiple figures in elaborate attire. The drawing features grand arches, columns, and canopied structures. In the foreground, there is a table with coins, a basket of fruit, and a sleeping animal at the base of the columns. The figures are engaged in various activities across different levels of the architecture, with some standing on a balcony. The background opens to a landscape view, adding depth to the composition. The line work and stylized depiction suggest a meticulous and narrative-driven composition typical of works during the Northern Renaissance.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Betrothal of the Virgin
title: The Betrothal of the Virgin
assistive_text: The image depicts a group scene inside an ornate architectural setting. The scene shows a gathering of figures in flowing robes under an intricately decorated archway with detailed carvings. Columns and arches suggest a grand architectural backdrop. The style resembles Albrecht Dürer, showcasing attention to detail and mastery of line work. The figures display expressions and gestures that contribute to the narrative.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Circumcision
title: The Circumcision
assistive_text: The image shows a group of figures in an intricate architectural setting. The drawing captures a detailed interior with gothic arches, a round opening above a doorway, and robed individuals gathered around the central area. The linear style emphasizes the patterns of the clothing and architectural details, such as the tracery work around the archway. The figures, of different ages, are holding objects and standing closely together. The scene is depicted in a detailed black and white linework style.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ Taking Leave from His Mother
title: Christ Taking Leave from His Mother
assistive_text: The image shows four people gathered outdoors. On the right, a standing individual with long wavy hair and a beard is gesturing. In the center, a seated person is looking upwards, wearing a detailed gown and a bonnet-like head covering. Next to them stands another person in a long dress and headgear, also looking in the same direction. Behind them, a third figure wears a long robe and a distinctive headpiece. The group is under a wooden structure with a large tree to the right. In the background is a cityscape with castle-like buildings and mountains, and a partially cloudy sky.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Holy Family with Two Music-Making Angels
title: The Holy Family with Two Music-Making Angels
assistive_text: The image is a woodcut artwork depicting eight people gathered closely together outdoors amongst trees. In the center, a seated woman holds a swaddled infant, while another woman next to her tends to the child. Surrounding them are bearded men in robes and head coverings of the era. Some individuals are standing, while others lean in towards the central figures, gesturing with their hands. Two small children play at their feet. The scene is set against a backdrop of trees with intricate bark, foliage, and a rolling hill in the distance. The number "1511" is inscribed at the top. The composition is detailed with cross-hatching and line work for texture and depth.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Nativity
title: The Nativity
assistive_text: The image shows a woman seated gracefully, with a man standing beside her and an infant lying on the ground. The woman has long wavy hair, wearing a flowing robe, directing her gaze down towards the infant. The man stands slightly behind her with a gentle expression and a beard, holding a lantern in one hand and a staff in the other. The background features partially crumbling architecture with intricate arches, while the floor is stone with vegetation between the cracks. In the foreground, the infant lies on a cloth with a cow and a donkey nearby. Above, there are figures resembling angels within the roof's arches. The background displays a landscape with mountains and a small figure walking away.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ before Annas
title: Christ before Annas
assistive_text: The image shows multiple figures in a scene. In the center, a figure stands surrounded by others, with long hair, a robe, and bound wrists. The figure has a serene face with a mustache and a goatee, looking downwards. Around him are men in varied positions—one seated, others standing or leaning. The men have different expressions. One man holds a lantern and sticks. The figures wear historical or biblical-style clothing, including a turban and staff. A dog sits near the seated man. The background features arched structures suggesting an interior space, possibly a hall. The scene is intricately detailed in an engraving or historical drawing style.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ before Pilate
title: Christ before Pilate
assistive_text: The image shows a group of full-body figures engaged in different scenes. In the center, a man wearing a robe and a pointed hat sits with a dramatic expression. Another figure pours water over his hands. Other figures around them wear various attires, from armor to elegant robes. Many have distinct facial features like pointed beards or flowing hair. One man wears a crown of thorns and has a serene expression. There is a chair-like structure with ornate posts and cherubic figures carved on top. Two dogs are at the bottom, one shaggy and the other lithe. The background shows a mountainous or rocky landscape.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ecce Homo
title: Ecce Homo
assistive_text: This is an image of a group of people in an architectural setting with a small dog at the foot of the scene. The composition features individuals surrounding a central figure in an archway. The central figure is draped in flowing garments. The surrounding figures exhibit emotional expressions and gestures. One person gestures towards the central figure in a possible moment of confrontation or proclamation. In the background, architectural elements with detailed stonework and archways are visible. A small dog is at the bottom of the scene, looking upwards. The hatching and line work create texture and depth, typical of traditional engraving techniques. The absence of color emphasizes the details in the figures' clothing and architecture.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: God Appearing to Noah
title: God Appearing to Noah
assistive_text: The image depicts a scene with multiple figures. A bearded man is shown floating or being carried by cherubic figures. He has a full head of hair and a long beard, and his expression is intent as he points with one hand and stretches the other towards a door. He is dressed in a long robe. Beside him, three cherubic figures assist him in the air. Below, another man kneels with a child clinging to him; this man also has a beard and is clothed in a similar long robe. To the right, a woman stands holding a child; she is wearing a long dress with her hair tied back, and behind her, another child peeks from inside the doorway. The setting includes a sturdy wooden door and a ground covered with grass and a few small plants.
creator: Marcantonio Raimondi after Raphael
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Dido
title: Dido
assistive_text: The image depicts a woman standing near a tree with her right leg crossed in front of the left and her body slightly turned to the right. Her left arm is extended outward while her right arm is bent at the elbow, holding a long nail or spike and a hammer. She has classical facial features and her hair is partially covered with a headscarf. She wears draped, classical-style clothing, and there is a sign with Greek writing at her feet. In the background are trees, rolling hills, a village with buildings, and a castle-like structure. Smoke rises from a fire burning on the ground to her right.
creator: Marcantonio Raimondi after Raphael
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Orpheus and Eurydice
title: Orpheus and Eurydice
assistive_text: The image shows two figures in full-body length. On the left is a bearded person standing, playing a stringed instrument resembling a lyre. They have curly hair and are adorned with what appears to be a wreath made of leaves on their head. The person on the right is a woman with wavy hair, styled in a way that a portion is gathered at the back of her head, while a section falls over her shoulder. She is in a contrapposto position, slightly turned towards the left person and looking away. She is partially draped with a cloth around her lower body and across her shoulder. Both figures are barefoot, standing on a natural landscape that consists of grass and small rocks. In the background, there's a textured cliff or rock face on the right, and the top is covered with what seems to be overgrown moss or grass.
creator: Marcantonio Raimondi
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Poetry
title: Poetry
assistive_text: The image depicts a central figure surrounded by clouds, flanked by two smaller winged figures. The central figure is seated with her right arm resting on a book and her left arm holding a curved object. She has a serene expression with downcast eyes, and her hair is styled simply with a laurel wreath. She wears a flowing dress and has large wings. The cherub on her left holds a scroll, while the other cherub on her right grasps an object resembling a ribbon. The background is filled with clouds.
creator: Marcantonio Raimondi after Raphael
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ before Caiaphas
title: Christ before Caiaphas
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding a seated figure in an interior setting. The composition features detailed clothing, armor, expressions, and weapons like spears and a spiked mace. The seated figure appears to be in a position of authority, with a lion and a fantastical creature beneath the throne. A decorative curtain drapes the top right corner, adding to the interior's ornate setting. Strong lines and detailed shading provide depth and texture to the drawing.
creator: Lucas Cranach the Elder
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Bookplate of Scheurl and Tucher
title: Bookplate of Scheurl and Tucher
assistive_text: The image is an illustration of a woman standing upright. She has a calm expression, delicate facial features, and wavy hair with feathers. She wears a long gown with patterns and puffed sleeves. There are decorative symbols around her, including crests with intricate designs and a goat-like creature. The background is plain, and there is an inscription above her in a classical font.
creator: Lucas Cranach the Elder
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Bewitched Groom
title: The Bewitched Groom
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a man lying down with a horse observed above. The bottom portion shows a man dressed in ornate clothing, lying down with one arm extended holding a book or document. Above him, a detailed portrayal of a horse in a stable setting is separated by what appears to be a structural support or partition. The horse is depicted in a three-quarter view, showcasing its muscular form. The scene is composed with an emphasis on line work and hatching effects to give depth and texture.
creator: Hans Baldung Grien
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jael and Sisera
title: Jael and Sisera
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a conflict between a mounted figure and a figure on the ground. The image is in a woodcut style, with intricate lines creating depth. In the foreground, a figure in armor, possibly a knight, stands next to a figure on the ground. The ground figure appears defeated, with one leg bent and arms splayed out. In the background, a large tree and dense foliage are visible. Architectural elements like an archway suggest a medieval setting. The scene suggests a narrative moment frozen in time, evoking themes of heroism and confrontation.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Annunciation to Joachim
title: Annunciation to Joachim
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a person receiving something from a cloud-like figure in the sky. The drawing features a bearded figure with flowing robes, reaching upwards with arms extended towards a figure descending from above on a cloud. The celestial figure appears to be lowering or dropping something. The scene is set outdoors, with a flock of sheep visible in the background. The artwork displays intricate cross-hatching and line work typical of early printmaking styles.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Entry into Jerusalem
title: The Entry into Jerusalem
assistive_text: This is a print featuring a man on a donkey beneath an archway. The man has a beard, and his head is surrounded by rays of light. He is barefoot and he is holding the reigns of the donkey, which has long ears. Around this central man are more people holding what look like tall palm fronds. One person appears to be bowing down before the man on the donkey, placing cloth on the ground. The background features the stone archway, and on the right is a sky with stylized clouds.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ on the Mount of Olives
title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a figure kneeling in prayer with celestial imagery. The drawing shows a figure in long robes, kneeling in the foreground amidst rocky terrain. Several figures are resting or sleeping on the ground to the figure's right. Above the kneeling figure, in the upper left of the image, a cloud formation can be seen, within which an expressive face is depicted. In the background, there are detailed trees and a rising or setting moon. The lines are fine and intricate, typical of a woodcut or engraving.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Descent from the Cross
title: The Descent from the Cross
assistive_text: This is a drawing of several figures interacting with a large wooden structure. The drawing is a woodcut or engraving, characterized by bold lines and high contrast typical of this style. It shows individuals on a ladder and engaging with the wooden beams. The figures appear to be in robes and sandals. The background features a landscape with distant hills and possibly a small settlement or gathering. The composition focuses on the texture of fabrics and the structure of the wooden beams.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Virgin and Child on a Crescent
title: The Virgin and Child on a Crescent
assistive_text: The image shows a woman standing upright, holding a child in her arms. The child has a serene expression, and both have halos around their heads. The woman's hair flows down in loose waves, and she is dressed in garments that drape elegantly. Around them are cherubs or angels, some holding a crown above the woman's head. The background is filled with clouds, giving the scene a heavenly or supernatural atmosphere, with the figures surrounded by radiant lines.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Poet Virgil Suspended in a Basket
title: The Poet Virgil Suspended in a Basket
assistive_text: This print depicts a group of people gathered outside a building, looking upward. At the top of the print, a man appears to sit in a basket that hangs from the side of the building. This man wears a round cap or turban and robes with wide sleeves and a puffed neckline. The people in the crowd below look up towards the basket, some pointing towards it. The crowd includes men and women in long robes, tunics, or dresses. Many of them wear different kinds of caps, and some have swords attached to their sides. On the left, there is also a child in the crowd, looking towards a woman next to him. In the center, a small dog is sniffing the rocky ground. The surroundings include more buildings on the right, including a church steeple, visible against a sky with birds in flight.
creator: Lucas van Leyden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Piera del Bando. V.
title: La Piera del Bando. V.
assistive_text: The image is an etching of a city scene, showing a grand building on the left side, likely the Doge's Palace in Venice. The view is slightly elevated, displaying the building's decorative facade with arched windows and intricate designs. Figures are gathered beneath. In the background, ornate pillars, sculptures, a cityscape, and ship masts are visible. The etching technique is precise, using linear strokes to capture architectural details and historical clothing. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of grey defining depth and detail.
creator: Canaletto
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Equestrian Monument
title: The Equestrian Monument
assistive_text: The image displays a black and white etched scene showing various architectural elements. A large building with columns, arches, a balcony, and draped fabric is on the left side. In the background, there are other structures, including a tower with a statue of a horse and rider on top. This tower appears to be part of a larger wall or fortification that extends across the image. The artwork features detailed line work that creates depth and texture, capturing the intricate architecture and providing movement with flowing lines in the sky and ground. The absence of color emphasizes the details, light, and shadow created by the density of the lines.
creator: Canaletto
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Landscape with Tower and Two Ruined Pillars
title: Landscape with Tower and Two Ruined Pillars
assistive_text: The image shows a scene from an elevated perspective, displaying buildings and landscape. The horizon is low, marked by various buildings including a tower and houses. A church with a spire is also visible. The etching style uses detailed lines to depict buildings, vegetation, and the sky. The monochrome color palette is black and white, with contrast used to create depth. A woman walks with a dog on a path, leading to buildings, a hill with figures, and ancient ruins. Clouds are sketched in the sky.
creator: Canaletto
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Wagon Passing Over a Bridge
title: The Wagon Passing Over a Bridge
assistive_text: The image shows an arched bridge crossing a river, with a horse-drawn carriage and two figures moving across it. On one end of the bridge, there is a small building. The scene is depicted in an etching style with detailed linework, a monochromatic color palette, and various structures in the distance.
creator: Canaletto
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Vision of Eliphaz
title: The Vision of Eliphaz
assistive_text: The image shows an ethereal figure surrounded by light appearing before several seated figures. The central figure is illuminated with an aura or halo, while the seated figures below look up in wonder. The border contains text, and the artwork features intricate line work and shading, creating an otherworldly atmosphere.
creator: William Blake
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Job Rebuked by His Friends
title: Job Rebuked by His Friends
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene depicting four figures in a dramatic moment. The central scene shows one seated figure and others gathered around, expressing emotions through gestures and facial expressions. The background features rolling hills against a dark sky. Above and below the central image are lines of text in an ornate script. The text reflects on themes of suffering, faith, and judgment. The border of the drawing includes artistic flourishes and two small illustrative creatures—a bird with a branch and an owl. The style is reminiscent of William Blake.
creator: William Blake
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Adoration of the Lamb
title: The Adoration of the Lamb
assistive_text: The image depicts multiple figures surrounding a central lamb. The drawing is highly detailed, featuring various figures gathered around a radiant circular motif containing the lamb. Around the lamb are different creatures and numerous figures. Some figures are crowned, while others hold palm fronds. In the lower segment, there are figures on clouds, suggesting a spiritual atmosphere. The drawing is rich in linework and symbolism, typical of intricate religious iconography from medieval or renaissance engravings.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Holy Family with Two Angels in a Vaulted Hall
title: The Holy Family with Two Angels in a Vaulted Hall
assistive_text: The image is a detailed woodcut showing a scene with several figures. In the center foreground, a seated woman is depicted in full-length with her head slightly tilted down, holding a child on her lap. The child is facing forward and reaching out towards another figure. Both the woman and child have gentle facial features, and the woman's hair is covered by a draped headpiece. Around them are two angels with large wings, standing on either side, and a bearded man standing to the right, observing the scene with a gentle gesture toward them. The figures wear flowing gowns. Behind them is an archway with a round, recessed detail in the center. In the upper corners of the arch are figures resembling mythological characters.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Louis XIV
title: Louis XIV
assistive_text: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a person. The person is in a front-facing position, with the body slightly turned to the side. They have long, curly hair that cascades past the shoulders and frames their face. The facial features include a straight nose, full lips, and eyes that gaze slightly to the side. The person is dressed in ornate clothing, featuring a lace collar and a garment that includes armor on one shoulder. The background is a simple, textured oval space, within which the person is contained. There is a decorative border with inscriptions surrounding the portrait.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit_line: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jason
title: Jason
assistive_text: The print displays a natural setting filled with fallen trees and leaves. Closest to us, to the right of center, a person is climbing over a large fallen tree trunk. The person faces away from us, and they are wearing armor and a helmet. They look out over the tree trunk toward an arch that is visible in the center of the print. The arch appears to be too small to be a bridge, and its purpose or function is unclear. In the bottom right corner, behind the person, the skeleton of a large animal is visible. The rest of the background is a jumble of tree limbs, leaves, and shadows, with a large hill reaching up in the top right. The background of the print is beige paper.
creator: Joseph Mallord William Turner
credit_line: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Bridge in Middle Distance
title: The Bridge in Middle Distance
assistive_text: This image shows a pastoral landscape with a wide expanse of land seen from an elevated point. The horizon is high in the composition. In the distance, a bridge with several arches spans a river. The brushstrokes capture the texture of the foliage with a light touch. The color palette consists of sepia tones. Three figures are seated on the ground, appearing to be engaged in conversation. Tall, slender trees frame the view. Soft clouds are scattered across the sky in the background.
creator: Joseph Mallord William Turner and Charles Turner
credit_line: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Junction of Severn and Wye
title: Junction of Severn and Wye
assistive_text: The image displays a landscape scene seen from an elevated point. The horizon stretches across the center of the composition with distant landforms meeting a calm expanse of water or sky. The brushstrokes exhibit a detailed and meticulous technique, conveying textures of trees and foliage. The color palette is a warm sepia tone. Closest to us, a figure is seated on the ground surrounded by trees and shrubs. Remnants of structures can be seen to the right, partially hidden among trees.
creator: Joseph Mallord William Turner
credit_line: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Isleworth
title: Isleworth
assistive_text: The image shows a landscape with ancient architecture, tree-lined pathways, and a body of water reflecting trees. The scene is depicted in a sepia tone, with detailed brushstrokes for the trees and classical columns. The sky has wispy clouds.
creator: Joseph Mallord William Turner and Henry Edward Dawe
credit_line: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Isis
title: Isis
assistive_text: The image shows a scene with a horizon near the center of the composition. Distant hills with rolling terrain are visible under a sky filled with swirling clouds. A large bridge with arches appears on the horizon, and lush foliage and various plants are in the foreground. A bird is perched on a fallen architectural piece. In the background, a classical rotunda is partly hidden by dense trees, suggesting a cultivated setting. The artwork features soft, intricate brush-like strokes blending the elements together. The color palette is warm with sepia tones, creating an antique aesthetic.
creator: Joseph Mallord William Turner and William Say
credit_line: Gift of Miss Ellen T. Bullard
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Dominican Preaching
title: A Dominican Preaching
assistive_text: A person wearing a black hood and cloak over a white long-sleeved garment stands in a wooden box, a pulpit, and speaks to a crowd gathered below in this vertical painting. The people all have pale skin tinged with green and pink cheeks. The preacher stands along the right side of the painting, his mouth open and both hands held up. He faces our left almost in profile, and his forehead, eyes, and mouth are deeply lined. Seventeen men and women sit or stand across the front of the crowd or at the far side of it. They wear garments in rose pink, fog gray, sapphire blue, vivid red, or black. Five of them sit along a wooden rail or bench closest to us with their backs facing out. Between this and the standing people on the far side of the crowd are dozens of heads, mostly covered with white cloths though a few have blond hair. Buildings in gray, pale pink, or white stone fill the background except for a few patches of sky, which are shiny gold. The torso of a person holding an open book floats high above the crowd, cut off by the top edge of the painting. The person wears a dark blue robe over a pink garment and is surrounded by a ring made of the red wings of winged, blond baby heads with gold halos. Gold rays radiate out from the ring.
creator: Agnolo degli Erri
credit_line: Gift of Frieda Schiff Warburg in memory of her husband, Felix M. Warburg
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Samson and Delilah
title: Samson and Delilah
assistive_text: This print shows two figures in an outdoor setting. In the center, a woman sits or kneels on grass, wearing a long dress with a low neckline and draped sleeves. Her curly hair is partially styled into an updo, with some stands falling around her face and down her back. She looks downward at the man who sits at her feet. He has a full, white beard and curly hair, a handful of which he holds up in one hand. The woman holds a pair of shears to the strands of hair, appearing to cut them. Part of his hair has already been cut short. The man is wearing a ruffled tunic with thin trousers and sturdy boots. He looks down at the ground. On the ground in the bottom left corner, there is a bottle, cup, and stacked plates with food scraps and a small knife. In the top left is a brick wall with an arched opening, and on the right are some tall, leafy trees in front of a cloudy sky.
creator: Hans Burgkmair I
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Antoine Barillon
title: Antoine Barillon
assistive_text: This image features a man in a portrait. He is seated, looking straight at the viewer, with a neutral expression. The man has mid-length, wavy hair and a mustache and goatee. He wears a formal robe with a large, flat, white collar. The portrait is set within an oval frame and includes the man's coat of arms below. The background has detailed shading inside the oval and a plain area outside. The border of the oval contains inscriptions likely denoting the man's name and titles.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Galileo Galilei
title: Galileo Galilei
assistive_text: The image depicts a portrait of a man in an oval frame. He is centered and slightly turned to his left, with a serious expression. The man has distinct facial features including a high hairline, bushy eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a long beard, and a mustache. His hair is short and combed back. He is wearing a high-collared shirt under a dark, buttoned robe with draped sleeves. The background is plain with subtle shading, enhancing the three-dimensional effect of the portrait.
creator: Ottavio Leoni
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Giovanni Marino
title: Giovanni Marino
assistive_text: The image displays a portrait of a man from the chest upwards. He faces slightly left but looks directly at the viewer. The man has distinct facial features with a broad forehead, deep-set eyes, a prominent moustache, a pointed goatee, and loose wavy hair falling just above his shoulders. He wears a dark garment with an intricate lace collar, a cross pendant on a chain around his neck, and the portrait is framed within an oval border. The background is etched and textured, highlighting the subject within the oval. Decorative text is presented at the top for the subject's identity and artwork information around the borders.
creator: Ottavio Leoni
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Thomas Stilianus
title: Thomas Stilianus
assistive_text: The image shows a man portrayed from the chest up. He faces slightly to his left, with a direct gaze towards the viewer. The man features a large forehead, high hairline, prominent cheekbones, and a mustache with a small beard underneath. His hair is sparse at the top and more pronounced around the sides. He wears a formal outfit with a collared shirt under a garment with studs and a large button. A cross-like pendant hangs from his neck. The portrait is surrounded by a textured oval frame with inscriptions outside the oval.
creator: Ottavio Leoni
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Simon Vouet
title: Simon Vouet
assistive_text: The image shows a man with a pointed beard and mustache, wavy hair that falls to his collar, and a neutral expression. He is wearing period-appropriate attire with a high, frilled collar and a buttoned coat. The background is a shaded gradient within a rectangular frame with an octagonal outline. Text around the edges includes the name "Simon Vouet" and additional writings in Latin.
creator: Ottavio Leoni
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Youth, Sage, and Attendant with Horse
title: Youth, Sage, and Attendant with Horse
assistive_text: Three figures and a horse are depicted in this image. Two men are central, with one riding the horse in front of the other man, who is on foot. The rider wears a cloak and has curly hair, a strong nose, and a pronounced chin. The second man wears similar clothing, a full beard, and a head covering partially obscured by the horse's mane. The third man is crouched by the horse's shoulder, with short hair, a tunic, and boots. A staff or spear and a glove lie on the ground in the foreground. In the background, a barren branch extends from the right with an owl perched on it. The background is minimally detailed with a faint suggestion of landscape in the distance.
creator: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Three Soldiers and a Youth
title: Three Soldiers and a Youth
assistive_text: This print shows an outdoor scene with three soldiers and a fourth person lying on their stomach. The soldiers are equipped with armor and long weapons, and two of them are talking to each other, their faces obscured, while the third looks directly at us. Another person lies on the ground on the right, wearing casual clothing and observing the soldiers. The setting is an open land with distant hills, and thin lines hint at trees. It is signed "Tiepolo" on the left. It is monochromatic, with dark lines on brown paper.
creator: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Soldier Seated on a Tomb with Surrounding Figures
title: Soldier Seated on a Tomb with Surrounding Figures
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene set in ancient times. The composition features figures in dramatic poses, with one central figure seated on a stone bench while others gather around, potentially conversing or witnessing an event. To the right, there is a structure or ruin with a weathered column or large stone. The scene is detailed, showing folds in drapery, textures of stone, and intricate hairstyles of the figures. The line work by the artist is expressive and dynamic, conveying movement and emotion.
creator: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Woman, Satyr Child, and Goat in a Landscape
title: Woman, Satyr Child, and Goat in a Landscape
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with animals and nature. The drawing features a lounging figure, an animal, and a landscape. To the left, a goat with horns is standing and stretching its left leg. In the center, a figure is resting under a tree, with fabric draped around. Surrounding the figures, foliage and trees add depth to the scene. The background shows an expansive landscape with fields, plains, and distant mountains. The line work and stylized forms suggest movement and harmony. The drawing captures pastoral serenity and is detailed and artistic.
creator: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Women and Men Regarding a Burning Pyre of Bones
title: Women and Men Regarding a Burning Pyre of Bones
assistive_text: This is a print of a group of people looking at a pile of objects in an outdoor setting. The five people are all gathered together in the center of the print, looking to the right, four of them crouching on a tall ledge and the other person kneeling by a large stone. They are all looking towards a pile of objects in the lower right corner that appears to include several bones and the skull of an animal, as well as other unidentifiable shapes. On the left are several vases and a pile of cloth or fabric at the base of a tall column. There are several tall trees in the background on the right, and the sky above is mostly empty except for a few feathery lines that suggest clouds.
creator: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Flight with the Holy Family at the Right
title: The Flight with the Holy Family at the Right
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene featuring figures and a herd of sheep. A group of figures is depicted on the left-hand side, with some of them reclining on fluffy, cloud-like structures. To the right, the drawing features a herd of sheep being tended to by a figure, who is partially obscured by the tree; nearby, another scene shows a person riding a donkey while another walks beside the animal, using a staff for support. The landscape is characterized by gentle undulations and distant architectural structures, evoking a sense of tranquility, with fine detailing enhancing the textures of fur, fabric, foliage, and clouds.
creator: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Flight with the Holy Family at the Left
title: The Flight with the Holy Family at the Left
assistive_text: The image shows a scene with three figures and a donkey facing away from the viewer. In the background, there is a low horizon with a sky, birds, clouds, and trees on the right. The artwork is created using a detailed pen or engraving style, emphasizing textures and contrasts. The overall color scheme is monochrome, highlighting the whites of garments and dark lines defining shapes and shadows. Buildings and architectural elements are faintly visible in the distance.
creator: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Flight, Holy Family at the Right, Joseph Looking to the Left
title: The Flight, Holy Family at the Right, Joseph Looking to the Left
assistive_text: The image depicts a landscape with figures and animals moving across a natural setting. A draped figure, an animal, and another figure with a basket are on the right side, while a partially visible figure peers out from behind a tree on the left. Two goats stand on a rise, and birds fly in the cloudy sky. The etching technique uses fine lines to create detail, and the monochromatic color scheme gives a classic look.
creator: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Rest on the Flight, with Adoring Angels
title: The Rest on the Flight, with Adoring Angels
assistive_text: This is a drawing showing figures gathered under a palm tree. One figure is seated holding a child, while others and a donkey surround them. Several winged figures are present to the side. The drawing features detailed line work depicting the angels' wings, foliage, and clothing textures. The composition balances the earthly elements of the tree with the divine aspect of the angels.
creator: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Holy Family Disembarking
title: The Holy Family Disembarking
assistive_text: The image shows a group of figures traveling near a body of water with a donkey, a boat, and an angelic figure in the foreground. Trees and a distant horizon line create depth, while birds fly in the sky. The use of hatchings and fine lines adds texture to the scene, conveying a narrative moment with dynamic energy and detail.
creator: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Rest on the Flight with Joseph in Adoration
title: The Rest on the Flight with Joseph in Adoration
assistive_text: This is a print of a scene beneath a canopy of trees. In the center, a child sits on the lap of a woman reclining under a tree. Both of them have halos of light around their heads. A third person with a halo is standing on the left, and he approaches the woman and child with his arm outstretched. This central group of people is surrounded by winged angels on either side of the tree. A donkey sits below the tree in the bottom right corner of the print. Rays of light shine down on the scene from the top-left corner.
creator: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Flight with Obelisk at the Left
title: The Flight with Obelisk at the Left
assistive_text: This print depicts three human figures and a donkey. Near the bottom right corner, one person is sitting on the donkey, their back to us. They are covered with draped white cloth and have a halo around their head. They appear to hold a small bundle on their lap. An angel stands in front of this person, its long wings raised. On the left, another person is walking in front, holding the donkey's reins as it walks over a small hill. This person also has their back to us and wears a loose-fitting cloth tunic while holding a long staff. A halo is in the sky over their balding head. On the far left is a tall stone tower with birds flying around it. Cherubs are flying above the figure on the donkey, surrounded by clouds and rays of light in the otherwise empty sky.
creator: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Episode of the Falling Idol
title: The Episode of the Falling Idol
assistive_text: This print shows a detailed wooded landscape. On the left, there is a headless female statue in a draped garment, standing on a pedestal near a with path through the dense trees. On the right, a man with a staff leads a donkey carrying a woman with a child along the path. The man looks back over his shoulder toward the statue. In gaps through the trees, patches of white sky can be seen.
creator: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Rest on the Flight, with Holy Family under a Tree
title: The Rest on the Flight, with Holy Family under a Tree
assistive_text: This is an etching depicting a scene with people under a leafy canopy. The central group includes two reclining adults, a man and a woman, both wearing draped clothing. A child rests on the lap of the woman and has a halo of light around their head. They rest under large trees and are surrounded by branches and logs. To the left of the group, a donkey sits on the ground. Above the donkey, there is an opening in the foliage, showing a distant cliff or rock face. The color scheme is monochrome, with dark lines on off-white paper.
creator: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Madonna and Child at Left, with a File of Angels
title: The Madonna and Child at Left, with a File of Angels
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a man leading a donkey across a rocky landscape. Tall trees with dense foliage provide a backdrop. Additional figures in flowing robes are on the left. Birds are flying in the sky above, with clouds framing the upper portion of the image. The drawing is detailed with a linear style and cross-hatching emphasizing contours and textures.
creator: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Flight, with Madonna at Right Supported by Angels
title: The Flight, with Madonna at Right Supported by Angels
assistive_text: The image features a detailed etching showing a man riding a donkey on a rocky path. In the distance, a coastal landscape with buildings is visible. The sky is lightly sketched with birds flying. On the right, two winged figures accompany a person in a robe. Fine lines and cross-hatching are used for texture. The color palette is monochromatic with dark strokes on light paper. The top right corner shows foliage.
creator: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Holy Family Arriving at a City Gate
title: The Holy Family Arriving at a City Gate
assistive_text: This print shows a scene under a stone archway involving animals and various people. On the right, a dense group of people stand on a bridge that passes under a tall stone archway. Many of the people are draped in fabric with hoods or head coverings, and many carry objects like baskets or jugs. A lantern hangs from the ceiling of the archway, and there is a large column to its left. On the left side of the print, a group with a donkey approaches the large crowd, heading towards the archway. We see the donkey from the side, and it appears to have a large bundle strapped to it. A person shrouded in a white cloth sits atop the donkey. This person’s face is partially visible facing the left, and white rays form a halo around their head. They appear to hold a small child close to them, and the child also has a halo. Standing slightly behind them and to the left, an old man walks beside the donkey, with a white beard and bald head. He holds a long staff and has a halo. In the top left corner, a small area of sky is visible, with some clouds and a few birds flying overhead.
creator: Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mask of Katherine Seney Simpson (Mrs. John W. Simpson)
title: Mask of Katherine Seney Simpson (Mrs. John W. Simpson)
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts the face of a man with realistic and detailed features: prominent eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a straight nose, and slightly pursed lips. The sculpture is made from a light gray material, likely plaster or a similar substance, giving it a smooth surface. The head is truncated above the forehead and at the neck, with textured hair suggesting short waves. The sculpture appears to be a classical bust, focusing on the facial features and expression.
creator: Auguste Rodin
credit_line: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Head of a Woman
title: Head of a Woman
assistive_text: The sculpture is a head of a human with detailed facial features such as eyes, nose, and lips. It is a muted gray color with a slightly uneven, weathered texture, indicating a stone-like material. The head is slightly angled, and the expression is neutral with closed lips and eyes. The surface shows roughness and imperfections, contributing to an organic and natural appearance.
creator: Auguste Rodin
credit_line: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Satyrs at Play
title: Satyrs at Play
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts a seated female figure holding a bunch of grapes, accompanied by a small child-like figure holding a staff with an orb at the top. The woman has long, flowing hair and appears to be adorned with a band on her upper arm. The child, perched on the woman's knee, has curly hair and an innocent expression. They both appear intertwined with foliage and flowing drapery that cascades down from the female figure's form. The sculpture is a roundel, carved in bas-relief, and is made from a warm, terracotta-colored material. The sculpture presents itself as a finely detailed and harmonious composition with a soft and gentle aesthetic.
creator: Style of Clodion
credit_line: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Figure Facing Forward
title: Figure Facing Forward
assistive_text: This painting is a sketch of a human figure in motion. The person stands, facing us, with one foot in front of the other and their arms outstretched. Their hand on the left curves downward, while their hand on the right curves up in an impossible position. Their head is turned down and to the left, and they look downward with a neutral expression. They appear to have some kind of cloth around their head, or some sort of hat with a long feather. On their left side are several curving gray lines, perhaps indicating movement or shadow. Their body has been painted in light brown, and the background is plain paper.
creator: Auguste Rodin
medium: graphite and watercolor on wove paper
credit_line: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Dancing Figure
title: Dancing Figure
assistive_text: A woman stands balanced on one foot and reaches overhead and holds the other foot with at least one arm in this vertical drawing on now-yellowed paper. The person is outlined in graphite and filled in loosely with a peach color. The head is sketched as a round circle with a few sweeping lines suggesting tendrils of hair. Graphite writing in the lower right corner reads, “homage a Madame K. Simpson A. Rodin 11 octobre 1905.”
creator: Auguste Rodin
credit_line: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Buste de Bellone
title: Buste de Bellone
assistive_text: The image portrays an illustration of a person from the chest up, turned slightly to the viewer's left. The person is wearing a helmet with a crest, and long, wavy hair flows out from underneath. The facial features are detailed with a pronounced nose and deep-set eyes, conveying a serious expression. The clothing suggests armor or draped cloth. The background is a plain canvas with no additional objects. On the right side, there is a handwritten inscription in cursive script.
creator: Auguste Rodin
credit_line: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Les Voisins de Campagne (Country Neighbors)
title: Les Voisins de Campagne (Country Neighbors)
assistive_text: The image shows a street scene with two figures walking in the rain, one holding an umbrella over themselves and a child. A small dog walks beside them. In the background is a house with trees lining the path leading to it, beyond a wrought-iron fence. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic palette of sepia and charcoal, with detailed, cross-hatched brushstrokes creating a textured and dynamic atmosphere. The composition is framed by decorative elements on the border.
creator: Félix-Hilaire Buhot
medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint in black on vellum
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Kneeling in an Armchair
title: Kneeling in an Armchair
assistive_text: The image shows a young girl sitting or leaning with one arm on the back of a chair or sofa. She is angled slightly to the side, with her head turned towards the viewer. The girl has a serene expression on her face and medium-length, wavy hair. She appears to be wearing a light fabric garment, perhaps a nightgown or dress, loosely draped over her shoulders. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, with subtle lines indicating a wall or drapery texture. The focus is on the girl's posture, light, and shadows.
creator: Mary Cassatt
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Challow Farm
title: Challow Farm
assistive_text: The image is an etching showing a rural landscape from an eye-level perspective. The horizon is in the middle, obscured by dense foliage. To the left are trees and a cottage, and a donkey stands in the center. The sketch-like style features defined lines showing tree and foliage details. The monochrome color palette creates contrast for visual depth and texture in the landscape.
creator: Francis Seymour Haden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Towing Path
title: The Towing Path
assistive_text: The image shows a serene riverside scene with a high horizon, distant landscape, clear sky, trees, bushes, a woman in a long garment holding up her skirt, and a small dog. The etching is composed of fine lines, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with black lines on beige paper.
creator: Francis Seymour Haden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jane Browne
title: Jane Browne
assistive_text: Shown from the waist up, a pale-skinned woman wearing a satin or silk shell-pink gown and a greenish-yellow cloak looks at us, slightly smiling, through an oval opening in this vertical portrait painting. Her shoulders angle slightly to our left, and her oval-shaped face turns slightly to the right. She cuts her dark gray eyes cut to the side to look at us from under arched brows. Her nose drops a little at the end, and her thin, pink lips are closed. Her dark brown hair is pulled up and woven with dark pearls reaching back from the temples. Curls fall down her back, and one rests over her left shoulder, to our right. The tightly fitting bodice has low curved neckline lined with lace. Short sleeves embellished with pewter-gray buttons or bosses overlap longer white sleeves. The bodice is open down the front to show the white undergarment and is tied with two pale yellow bows, one over the other. The cloak falls heavily in deep folds from her shoulders and is held in place with a strip of fabric lined at intervals with pairs of dark silver beads. The ribbon is affixed to the cloak with a red brooch at the woman’s right shoulder, to our left, and it stretches down and across her body. She stands in front of a dark blue, cloudy sky. The painted frame through which she looks is camel brown. The artist signed the front-facing, beveled edge of the oval frame: “I.S. Copley. Pinx. 1756.”
creator: John Singleton Copley
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Augustus Fielding Hawkins
title: Augustus Fielding Hawkins
assistive_text: The image shows the upper half of a man's body in a formal, seated pose. He is facing slightly to his right, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has short, dark brown hair, a smooth complexion, well-defined eyebrows, and a serious expression. He is dressed in a dark jacket with gold buttons, over a high-collared white shirt with a ruffled front. The background is a dark, neutral color.
creator: Matthew Harris Jouett
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mrs. William Hartigan
title: Mrs. William Hartigan
assistive_text: This painting shows an upper body portrait of a woman with her body slightly turned to the right and her head facing us. She has light-colored skin, rosy cheeks, green eyes, and pink lips set in a neutral expression. Her curly gray hair is tied with a light pink ribbon. She wears a dark dress with a low neckline lined with lace and a pink bow at the center, and a light orange-pink sash around her waist. Behind her is a dark red curtain on the left, and a blue sky on the right, covered in brown and gray clouds. The portrait is enclosed in an oval which is set against a dark brown background.
creator: Carl Fredrik von Breda
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Stephen Van Rensselaer III
title: Stephen Van Rensselaer III
assistive_text: This painting is a portrait of a man. He is seated on a red cushioned chair, turned slightly to the left, facing us. He has a pale complexion and a neutral expression, with dark eyebrows, rosy cheeks, and thin lips. His hair is gray, with curls falling to the sides around his ears. He is dressed in formal attire, wearing a dark red, double-breasted coat with large golden button and a white cravat around his neck. The man holds a pair of tan gloves in his left hand, and in front of him is a piece of red furniture covered with a red cloth. The background is a muted brown gradient.
creator: Gilbert Stuart
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Edward Stow
title: Edward Stow
assistive_text: This painting is a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is seated with his body facing slightly to the right and his head turned toward us. The man has a fair complexion with rosy cheeks and a neutral expression. He has short, curly brown hair, pale eyebrows, a long, straight nose, and a weak chin. He is wearing a dark navy coat with gold buttons, a high-collared white shirt, and a white cravat. The man sits in a red cushioned chair, and in front of him is a red desk or writing surface. His right hand rests on the surface on top of a sheet of white paper, holding a white feather quill pen. In the background, there seems to be a gray column behind him, framed on either side by red curtains, and in the bottom left corner a hint of a cloudy blue sky and green foliage are visible.
creator: Gilbert Stuart
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: William Thornton
title: William Thornton
assistive_text: This painting is a portrait of a seated man. His body is facing the right with his head turned to us, a neutral expression on his face. The man has pale skin, rosy cheeks, bright blue eyes, thin lips, and gray hair that curls around his ears. He is dressed formally in a dark red coat with gold buttons and a white cravat at his neck, sitting in a red upholstered chair, holding a book in his right hand. The background consists of red drapery on one side and blue and yellow hues on the other, suggesting a cloudy sky.
creator: Gilbert Stuart
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Luke White
title: Luke White
assistive_text: This painting is an oval portrait of a man from the waist up. His head is turned to the left, and his arms are crossed. He has pale skin and rosy cheeks, dark eyebrows, a long nose, and pink lips in a neutral expression. His gray hair is styled into curls around his ears. He is wearing a black or dark blue coat with large gold buttons over a yellow shirt with a ruffled white collar. Behind him is a warm, muted brown shade, with draped red fabric on the left. Outside of the oval portrait is a brown background.
creator: Gilbert Stuart
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ann Biddle Hopkinson (Mrs. Francis Hopkinson)
title: Ann Biddle Hopkinson (Mrs. Francis Hopkinson)
assistive_text: This painting depicts a woman from the shoulders up, her head turned to face us. She has light skin, large eyes, a long nose, and rosy cheeks. Her lips are red and set in a neutral expression. Her brown hair is styled in curls under a large black hat with white feathers. She wears a garment with a sheer collar, a jeweled brooch, and white fur around her shoulders. The background is a dark, muted gradient of brown tones, with some dark blue and dark red, fading to cream at the bottom of the painting.
creator: Thomas Sully
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Francis Hopkinson
title: Francis Hopkinson
assistive_text: This painting is a portrait showing the upper torso and head of a man turned slightly to the right. The man is looking at us with a neutral expression. His facial features include pale skin, a high forehead, dark eyebrows, and dark hair styled with waves and curls around his temples. He is wearing a black coat over a white shirt. The shirt is adorned with a white cravat wrapped around his neck, visible above the coat's collar. The background is a brown shade, and the painting is marked with the initials "TS" and "1834" at the bottom left corner.
creator: Thomas Sully
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Andrew Jackson
title: Andrew Jackson
assistive_text: The head and shoulders of a man with light skin and gray hair nearly fills this vertical portrait painting. Shown against a peanut-brown background, the man’s shoulders are angled to our left, and he looks off to our right with blue eyes. His gray hair curls around his forehead and over his ears. His bushy gray eyebrows gather over a furrowed brow, and sideburns grow down past his earlobes. His long, straight, slightly hooked nose and high cheekbones are set into his long, oval-shaped face. His pink lips are closed over a rounded chin, which is framed by vertical wrinkles. The white edge of a collar peeks above the high neck of a velvety black garment with wide lapels. The area beneath the man’s shoulders is a dark ivory color, perhaps indicating that this painting is unfinished.
creator: Thomas Sully
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Abraham Kintzing
title: Abraham Kintzing
assistive_text: This painting is a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is facing us, with pale skin, thin lips, rosy cheeks, light green eyes, and gray hair styled into curls around his ears. He has a neutral expression. The man is wearing a dark coat with gold buttons on the front, with a pale-yellow shirt underneath and a white cravat around his neck. The background is a dark and indistinct brown color.
creator: Thomas Sully
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Robert G. L. De Peyster
title: Robert G. L. De Peyster
assistive_text: This image depicts a man from the waist up. He is seated, slightly turned to his right, while facing the viewer. The man has a composed expression, prominent cheekbones, and a slightly pointed nose. His dark brown hair is styled in a classic early 19th-century manner, with curls around the sides and forehead. He is dressed in a dark blue coat with gold buttons, a yellow waistcoat, a high-collared white shirt, and a decorative pin. In his right hand, he holds a piece of folded paper with writing on it. The background is an indistinct swirl of darker colors.
creator: Samuel Lovett Waldo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Gentleman of the Morris Family
title: A Gentleman of the Morris Family
assistive_text: The image displays a painted portrait of an individual, showing the upper half of the body prominently. The person is positioned facing slightly toward the viewer's left with their gaze directed forward. They have defined facial features with a smooth complexion and medium-length, curly brown hair that frames their face. The attire consists of an elegant coat with distinct buttons and a high-collared shirt underneath. There is a subtle shine and texture to the clothing. There are no visible jewelry pieces, and the person is not holding any objects. The background is a dark, neutral color, contrasting with the lighter tones of the person's skin and clothing.
creator: John Wollaston
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Feast of the Gods
title: The Feast of the Gods
assistive_text: Six women, eight men, two satyrs, and one child gather in pairs and trios in a loose row that spans the width of this nearly square painting. They are set within a landscape with craggy rocks, cliffs, and trees. Most of the people face us, and the men, women, and child have pale skin. The two satyrs have men’s torsos and furry goat’s legs, and they have darker, olive complexions. Most of the men wear voluminous, knee-length togas wrapped in short robes in shades of white, topaz blue, grass green, coral orange, or rose pink. Most of the women wear long, dress-like garments in tones of shell pink, apricot orange, or lapis blue over white sleeves. For all but one woman, their garments have fallen off one shoulder to reveal a round, firm breast. Several objects are strewn on the rocky, dirt ground in front of the group, including a wide, wooden bucket with a piece of paper affixed to its front to our right, a glass goblet, a pitchfork, a large blue and white ceramic dish filled with grapes and small yellow fruits, and an overturned cup near the center. Cliff-like, craggy rocks rise steeply behind the group to our left, filling much of the sky opposite a tall grove of leafy, dark green trees to our right. A few puffy white clouds float across the vivid blue sky. The slip of paper on the barrel has been inscribed, “joannes bellinus venetus p MDXIIII.”
creator: Giovanni Bellini and Titian
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: View near Epernon
title: View near Epernon
assistive_text: A person at the center of this loosely painted horizontal landscape rides a dark horse across a field as a man to the left works the field behind a horse-drawn plow. The field is carpeted with muted and gold-shaded green, and a grove of trees in the right third of the composition are painted in fern, olive, and dark green. A patch of darker green near us and to left of center is dotted with red and yellow to suggest flowers. The men and horses are small in relation to the composition. The people have brown skin and are painted with a few strokes in dark gray and muted green for the man behind the plow to the left and pale yellow and white and a red cap for the person on horseback. A band of houses with tan or light yellow walls and gray or terracotta red roofs line the far side of the field to the left, and an arched bridge crosses what appears to be a shallow, grassy ravine near the center. The horizon comes about a third of the way up this composition and a few smoke-gray clouds line the upper edge of the otherwise milk-white sky. The artist signed the lower left corner, “COROT.”
creator: Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Lady and Gentleman on Horseback
title: Lady and Gentleman on Horseback
assistive_text: An elegantly dressed man and woman ride horses toward us and to our right in a landscape with low, rolling hills, stone buildings, and trees in this horizontal painting. The two horses and riders take up the right half of the composition. Both people have pale skin and look at us. The woman has a high forehead, a straight nose, a round face, and curly blond hair falling to her shoulders. She wears a sapphire-blue dress with slashed sleeves to reveal a white garment beneath. Her hat is adorned with blue and white feathers, and she wears a string of pearls around her neck.
