The legs of her white horse darken to black below the knees, and the bridle is tied with blue bows near the horse’s ears. The sidesaddle sits on a woven, rug-like blanket. Next to her, to our right, the man rides a larger chestnut-brown horse with a white triangle between its eyes. The man looks at us out of the corners of his dark eyes under gathered brows. He has a long, straight nose and is cleanshaven, though a hint of a five o’clock shadow slightly darkens his cleft chin. His light brown hair falls in curls down past his shoulders, and he wears a dark brown coat with voluminous white fabric rippling out above tan-colored gloves. He holds a riding crop in his right hand, on our left, resting against his hip. Near the white horse’s feet, to our left, a dark brown dog with a white nose sniffs at a plant. Behind it, another reddish-brown dog sniffs the ground near the horse’s back hoof. A third dog stands beyond, partially obscured by bushes and plants growing in the lower left corner of the canvas. A man wearing a tall black, wide-brimmed hat and carrying a long staff leads two slender dogs resembling grayhounds on leashes along the path, a little behind the riders. Two more elegantly dressed men ride horses toward us father back on the path. Sand-colored stone buildings, hazy in the distance, are clustered around a squared tower, possibly a bell tower, to our left. The land dips gently to the horizon line in the deep distance. The riders are silhouetted against a swirling slate-blue cloud that fills most of the sky in the top two-thirds of the painting. The sky clears to pale blue to our left and then warms to golden yellow along the horizon, beyond the buildings. The artist signed the painting near the lower left corner: “A. Cuijp.”
creator: Aelbert Cuyp
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Horsemen and Herdsmen with Cattle
title: Horsemen and Herdsmen with Cattle
assistive_text: Golden sunlight pours across a landscape with three people on horseback and two more people near a flock of sheep, a cow, and a mule in this horizontal painting. The people all have pale, peachy skin. The horizon is about a third of the way up the composition and is lined with towers on distant, hazy, pale yellow hills. Two of the horses are to the right of center, both facing us. The horse on the left is white, and the rider wears an azure-blue tunic and red brimless cap. The other horse is brown with a white blaze, and its rider wears a red tunic and black cap. That second rider points with a whip to the sitting and standing people near the sheep, to the right. Those two people wear brown jackets, and the standing man has a mustache. The seated person rests a long staff over one shoulder. About half of the nine sheep there lie on the ground, and the others stand. The cow dips her head down to the sheep, and the splay-footed donkey has baskets hung to each side. This grouping is in front of a copse of tall trees that nearly reach the top edge of the composition. The third rider is to our left and a short distance away. That dark brown horse gallops to our right. A short distance away, another herdsman along the left edge of the composition wears a red tunic and brown pants, and he rests a long staff on one shoulder. One cow stands and one lies down next to that herdsman. Sunlight rakes across twigs, leafy plants, scrubby growth, and rocks in the foreground, closest to us. Sailboats float on the waterways that stretch horizontally across the painting in the distance, and the land separating those bodies of water is dotted with spires, windmills, towers, and other structures. A dozen dark birds fly high in the sky, which takes up the top two-thirds of the picture. A bank of iridescent yellow and pearly white clouds trundle across the pale blue sky. The artist signed the painting in the lower right corner, “A.cuijp.”
creator: Aelbert Cuyp
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Races
title: The Races
assistive_text: Six jockeys wearing colorful silks sit astride brown and black horses on a grassy field in this horizontal painting. Two more riders wearing top hats sit a bit farther back from the group, and two horses run on a grass track behind that. Five of the jockeys are together in the lower left quadrant. From left to right, they wear a black jersey with white sleeves, pink with black sleeves, black with sky-blue sleeves, emerald green, and canary yellow. The sixth jockey approaches from the right and wears white. The horizon comes about a third of the way up the composition, and the lawn is painted with blended strokes of spruce green and tawny brown. Three smokestacks belching smoke line the horizon, and three towers, two with spires, presumably represent a church in the deep distance to the left. Strokes of ochre yellow, beige, cream white, and brown represent houses clustered along the horizon. Lilac-purple-tinged clouds sweep across the watery blue sky above. The landscape is loosely painted with visible or blended strokes. The artist signed the lower right corner, “Degas.”
creator: Edgar Degas
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Before the Ballet
title: Before the Ballet
assistive_text: In a dance studio, two ballerinas wearing knee-length tutus and ballet slippers sit on a bench and stretch to our right while four more pose at the back of the space, to our left, in this long, horizontal painting. The scene and dancers are loosely painted so many features are indistinct. All the women have light skin and dark brown hair. Each pale, robins’ egg-blue costume has a low-cut, tightly fitting, sleeveless bodice and a full skirt. Dabs of off white, teal, and blue suggest flowers lining the deep U of the neckline at the front and down the back of each bodice. Closest to us and nearly brushing the edges of the lower right corner of the canvas, one dancer sits on the end of a wooden bench and leans down between her legs, her feet widely planted. She rests her torso on an elbow folded onto one knee as she reaches for her left foot, farther from us, with her other hand. Her hair is pulled up and her face, looking downward, is deep in shadow. Sitting behind her on the bench, to our left, a second dancer lifts her right leg, toe pointing, as she pulls on her pale pink tights. Her other leg stretches straight, pointed toe brushing the floor, in front of her. This woman’s hair hangs loose around her shoulders. The pair is brightly lit from a source to our right, and an arched area of electric blue and mustard yellow behind them is difficult to interpret. The floor, which takes up about two-thirds of the composition, is painted with dabs of teal blue, pale fuchsia pink, and caramel brown. It leads us back to the upper left corner of the painting where four more four ballerinas stand in a line. The pair to our left stands with their backs to us, facing the wall with their right legs raised to shoulder height, toes pointed. The pair to our right faces us. They also stand with their right legs raised, creating a wide angle with their standing legs. All four ballerinas bend their arms gently at the elbow, and some tip their heads toward the raised legs. The rightmost dancer is illuminated by a pair of French doors at the back corner, at the top center of the painting. The wall behind the bench is streaked with mint green over honey brown, and the wall at the back of the room is leather brown. The visible, soft brushstrokes give the image a blurred, ethereal appearance in the dimmed studio. The artist signed the painting in the lower left corner, “Degas.”
creator: Edgar Degas
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Raising of Lazarus
title: The Raising of Lazarus
assistive_text: This is a painting of a group of people gathered around a cave-like structure in a hilly landscape. The people have light skin and wear ornate and flowing robes in shades of pink, teal, and gold, and they are gathered closely together, some gesturing towards the cave. At the mouth of the cave, a man wrapped in strips of off-white cloth stands, looking out at the crowd. Two other men stand next to him, appearing to remove his cloth wrappings. To the right, in the center of the image, a man with long golden hair faces the cave and raises one arm. He wears blue and gold robes over a white garment, and his other hand holds a golden book. There is a halo behind his head. Behind him are ten other men of varying ages wearing colorful robes who also have halos. In the background are hills, greenery, and a sprawling city of white buildings with red roofs that extend towards the horizon. Tall palm trees punctuate the landscape, and the sky above is light blue with pink clouds.
creator: Benozzo Gozzoli
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hut among Trees
title: Hut among Trees
assistive_text: A dilapidated cottage nestles among leafy trees next to a winding dirt road in this square landscape painting. The dirt road runs from the bottom center of the painting into the distance. The cottage sits to the right of the road, encircled by a low, rustic fence. There are holes in the roof, and the whole building leans a bit to our left. The wall we can see has areas of gray, mustard yellow, and brick red, and some panels and windows are missing. Other windows have diamond-shaped panes. Gnarled sage and olive-green trees and scrubby dark green underbrush surround the hut and grow on the other side of the road, to our left. Trees on the far side of the cottage form a line between it and a spring-green lawn that leads back to a butter-yellow house. A woman and child stand in the road facing us as a thin, light brown dog scampers in our direction. The woman holds a rust-orange bundle in her arms. Further up the road, a man on horseback rides away from the woman and child toward the yellow house. Dark gray and white clouds drift in a powder-blue sky overhead.
creator: Meindert Hobbema
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Village near a Pool
title: Village near a Pool
assistive_text: This painting shows a landscape with several buildings near a body of water. Closest to us, near the bottom right corner, a person in red leans over a wooden fence to cast a fishing rod into the water. The fence is surrounded by tall grass and bushes with small pink flowers. On the right, a path leads up towards the buildings. Two people and several dogs walk along the path towards us and away from the buildings, emerging from some tall dark trees. One person rides a white horse, while the other appears to hold a stick with several birds sitting on it, and offers a bird up to the rider. These people are in shadow and their details are hard to discern. Beyond them, the path curves by two large, white buildings with pointed red roofs. As the path curves to the left in the distance, it passes through a grassy plain near the edge of the water. More people can be seen, one walking along the path and two sitting by rocks near the water. The path leads towards a small village to the left of center. The village has more cottages and a church with a steeple in the distance. The sky above the scene is light blue-gray with fluffy white clouds, and the color palette includes dark greens, browns, and grays.
creator: Meindert Hobbema
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Woman and Child in a Courtyard
title: Woman and Child in a Courtyard
assistive_text: A woman and child stand in an enclosed courtyard in this vertical painting. A two-story house rises along the left edge of the painting, and three more people gather at a table set within an enclosure at the far side of the courtyard to our right. All the people have pale skin. At the center of the composition, the woman holds a wide basket propped against a hip with one hand and a white pitcher down by her side with the other. Her hair is covered by a flat black cap that comes to a point high on the forehead. Her brown jacket is worn over a white shirt, which is visible at the neckline. A white apron is gathered and tied up over her long red skirt. She looks down, smiling, at the child at her side, to our right. The child wears a white cap over blond hair, a long brown garment with a wide, white collar, and a white apron. Holding a bird cage with both hands, the child looks off to our left. The courtyard is paved with tan bricks, but a slender tree, the same height as the woman, grows among the pavers in the bottom right of the composition. The corner of the house has a pink rose growing up a trellis, also the same height as the woman, on the side facing the pair. A wooden bucket and clay pot sit at the front corner of the house next to a wider basin on our side. A broom inside the basin leans against the brick wall below a black metal pump with a spout and long handle. Shadows cast by rooflines behind us fall on the second story of the house, which is clad in horizontal wood boards. A flight of stairs past the back corner of the house leads through an open door, which is set into a wall that encloses the far side of the courtyard. A structure with a narrow triangular pediment supported by pairs of pink columns covers a small dining area. Two men and a woman sit with a white pitcher and some food on the table, which is indistinct in the shadows. Across the table from us, the woman wears a black dress with a wide white collar, and she holds a flaring glass with red wine. The two men sitting with their backs angled to us wear tall, wide-brimmed black hats and black suits. The one closer to us holds a long-stemmed white clay pipe to his lips. Deep green canopies of trees peek over the far side of the wall, and the sky above has thin white clouds against a blue sky.
creator: Pieter de Hooch
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Portrait of Lorenzo di Credi
title: Portrait of Lorenzo di Credi
assistive_text: Shown from the chest up, a pale-skinned man with a narrow face looks at us from in front of a distant landscape in this vertical portrait painting. His body and face are angled to our left, so he looks at us from the corners of his brown eyes. He has dark, low brows, a straight nose, high cheekbones, and his rose-pink lips turn slightly down at the corners. Chestnut-brown waves fall over his ears and down the back of his neck from under a tall, brimless, rounded, black cap. His black robe has a high neck lined with a white undergarment. Far behind him, a grassy hill leads up to steep, rocky outcroppings, with those to our right dotted with trees. The land rolls into the distance to meet mountains, hazy blue along the horizon, which comes halfway up this composition. The clear sky above deepens from pale blue along the mountains to slate blue across the top.
creator: Pietro Perugino
medium: oil on panel transferred to canvas
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Satyr and the Peasant
title: The Satyr and the Peasant
assistive_text: Shown from the about the thighs up, a man, a woman holding a swaddled baby, and a satyr, which has a man’s torso and goat’s legs, sit and stand around a table in a deeply shadowed room, filling this horizontal painting. All the people have light skin and dark hair, and are lit dramatically from our left. To our left, the bare-chested satyr faces our right in profile as he leans toward the table, looking up at the woman. He wears a crown of leaves and has a dark goatee. Almost lost in shadow, a sable-brown horn juts up from his temple. Light falls across his bare shoulders, and his hands and neck are ruddy. Another ring of leaves encircles his waist over the silvery-gray fur of his goat’s legs. He holds his left hand, farther from us, in front of his chest with his open palm facing the couple to our right. His other hand rests at the top of a wooden staff behind his right hip, closer to us. The staff disappears behind a wood plank resting across at least one barrel, which presumably acts as the bench on which he sits on or hovers slightly over. The second man sits at the table to our right, his back mostly to us as he looks over his left shoulder, up toward the satyr, with his face in profile. One brow is cocked over the dark eye we can see, and he has a prominent nose and a mustache. He wears a loose-fitting, long-sleeved, white garment tied around the waist. He blows across a soup spoon held to his lips, his cheeks puffed. He leans on his other arm, which rests on the tabletop near a blue bowl. Across the table, behind the seated man, a woman looks back at the satyr from the corners of her eyes, her coral-red lips curled up in a smile. Her body faces our left and she tilts her head to her left, our right, as she turns her face down toward that shoulder. Her dark brown hair is pulled up and back, and she wears an olive-green wrap over a white shirt. The baby she holds leans away from her chest to twist and look back at the satyr as well. A few details eventually emerge from the deeply shadowed background, including a fourth person tucked into the lower left corner, who looks back over a shoulder at us or the group. Light rims the corner of a window cut from a stone wall, and a few ceramic dishes and cups line two shelves to our right behind the woman.
creator: Johann Liss
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Two Women at a Window
title: Two Women at a Window
assistive_text: Two women with pale skin look out at us from the other side of a rectangular window opening with a shadowy interior behind them in this vertical painting. On our right, in the lower third of the composition, one young woman leans toward us over her left arm, which rests along the window ledge. She bends her right arm and props her chin on her fist. She looks at us with dark brown eyes under dark brows. She has shiny chestnut-brown hair with a strawberry-red bow on the right side of her head, to our left. She has a straight nose, and her full pink lips curve up in a smile. She wears a gossamer-white dress with a wide neckline trimmed in dark gray, with another red bow on the front of her chest. Her voluminous sleeves are pushed back to her elbows. To our left, a second woman peeks around a partially opened shutter. She is slightly older, and she stands next to the first woman with her body facing us. She tilts her head and also gazes at us with dark eyes under dark brown brows. She has dark brown hair covered by an oyster-white shawl. She holds the shawl up with her right hand to cover the bottom half of her face. Her mouth is hidden but her eyes crinkle as if in a smile. Her left arm bends at the elbow as she grasps the open shutter. She also wears a white shirt pushed back to her elbows, and a rose-pink skirt. The frame of the window runs parallel to the sides and bottom of the canvas. The room behind them is black in shadow.
creator: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Cottage Dooryard
title: The Cottage Dooryard
assistive_text: A man, woman, several children, a dog, and a chicken work and play outside a two-story, partially vine-covered, brown brick house in this vertical painting. All the people have peachy, light skin. We look slightly down onto a courtyard enclosed by the house to our right and a wall along the back of the yard, a short distance from us. To our right and closest to us, laundry dries on a line over a pile of branches, cast off bricks, and a wooden shovel near the lower right corner. A young girl wearing a white bonnet, a royal-blue shirt, and a long, harvest-yellow skirt sits on the dirt ground, leaning toward a little boy holding the paws of a black and white dog that stands on its hind legs. A broom leans against a fenced-in chicken coop behind the boy, and a bunch of carrots rests on the flat roof of the coop. Beyond the children, a woman sits hunched on a rushed chair, cleaning mussels taken from a wooden bucket and placed in an earthenware dish. A bearded man leans in the open doorway in the courtyard wall looking at the woman and a young girl helps a toddler stand nearby, as a chicken pecks at the ground. The roof slouches atop the brick house along the top edge of the canvas to our right, and the peak of another roof and trees rise above the courtyard wall. Fluffy white clouds float across the bright blue sky in the upper right corner. The artist signed and dated the work in dark paint in the lower center: “Av. Ostade 1673.”
creator: Adriaen van Ostade
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Portrait of a Gentleman with a Tall Hat and Gloves
title: Portrait of a Gentleman with a Tall Hat and Gloves
assistive_text: Shown from the hips up, a man with pale, peachy skin, dressed in a black suit and tall hat, looks at us from in front of a dark brown background in this vertical portrait painting. The man’s body is angled to our right, almost in profile, but he turns his head to look at us from the corners of his eyes under lifted brows. He has rounded nose, a thin mustache over wide, pink lips, and a deep cleft in his chin. His face is fleshy under his eyes and along his jawline, and he has a slight double chin. The wide brim of his tall black hat casts a shadow across his eyes. Shoulder-length, brown, curly hair falls on a wide, lace-edged bright white collar, which lies flat across his chest and shoulders. Light glints off his black jacket, suggesting a sheen. Wide white, disk-like cuffs encircle his wrists over puffs of voluminous white sleeves that gather on his forearms. A black, velvety cape drapes from the shoulder closer to us and down across his waist. He points to our right with his right arm, closer to us. The fawn-brown glove or pair of gloves he holds in his other hand by his far hip is cut off by the bottom edge of the canvas.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
medium: oil on canvas transferred to canvas
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Portrait of a Man in a Tall Hat
title: Portrait of a Man in a Tall Hat
assistive_text: Shown from about the knees up, a man with peachy skin, wearing a voluminous black cloak and a tall, brimmed hat, looks directly at us in this vertical portrait painting. His body is angled to our left and he turns his face to look at us with brown eyes. He has a wispy, brown mustache over his pale pink lips, which are closed. He has a slight double chin and his reddish-brown hair falls to his shoulders. His wide, brimmed hat has a tall crown, which tapers a bit near the top. His black cloak falls over his arms and body, and has a wide, flat, white collar. Two white tassels hang below the split down the front of the collar. His left hand, to our right, is braced against the arm of a chair, and he rests his hand around the wooden end of the chair's arm. The wall behind him is brick-red with a coffee-brown rectangle to our left. Two vertical, fawn-brown stripes run down the red wall to our right, behind the man. Brushstrokes are visible in some areas, as in the man’s face, and a network of cracks runs across the surface of the canvas.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Portrait of Rembrandt
title: Portrait of Rembrandt
assistive_text: Shown from the waist up, a man dressed in fine clothing looks out at us from against a deeply shadowed background in this vertical portrait painting. The man’s pale, peachy skin has a warm undertone that glows in a stark light source from our left. His body and face are angled to our right, and he cuts his dark eyes back to look at us under raised brows. He has a rounded, bulbous nose, and a wispy golden-brown goatee frames his closed pink lips. Shadows on his cheeks and jowls suggest soft flesh and a five o’clock shadow. Wiry brown hair curls out over his temples and down to the nape of his neck beneath a green, gold, orange, and burgundy-red skullcap. A soft brown beret rests on top of his skullcap tipped at an angle away from us. A teardrop-shaped pearl earring hangs from a gold setting in the ear we can see. He wears a cream-white tunic with gold and brown detailing along the hemlines. Over that is a dark brown, vest-like garment. The sleeves are slashed so the outer fabric is eggplant purple, and the inner slashes are golden yellow. A red cloth drapes over his left arm, farther from us, and that hand rests on a gold, spiraling shaft. A dark sash may be tied around his waist, and it seems that his other hand rests against his hip, to our left. The lower half of his chest and the background fall into deep shadow, though, so some the details there are difficult to make out. The painting is signed and dated in dark letters in a shaded area, so is nearly invisible in the lower center right; it reads, “Rembrandt f. 1650.”
creator: Rembrandt Workshop
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Miss Nelly O'Brien
title: Miss Nelly O'Brien
assistive_text: Shown from the lap up and shaded entirely in tones of golden yellow, laurel green, and black, a pale-skinned woman cradles a small, furry dog in her arms in this vertical portrait. The woman’s body is squared toward us, and she looks directly out with slate-blue eyes. She has an oval face with a delicate nose, long chin, and her pale pink lips are closed in a slight smile. Her brown hair is pulled back under a tan-colored hat lined on the underside with translucent cloth and on the top with sage-green ribbons or ruffles. A choker of thumbnail-sized pearls encircles her neck. Her dress has a deep V in the front and the elbow-length sleeves end with layers of lacy ruffles. Curving black lines suggest a pattern on sheer black fabric that covers pale yellow and frosty green stripes of the bodice. The dog has long, light-colored fur and a dark, bead-like nose and eyes. Vines grow up and from the top of a stone column in the background to the right, and the rest of the shallow space is filled with shrubs and plants. A bright yellow spot near the top left corner suggests a strong light source coming from that area, which casts her face in a diffuse shadow under the hat’s brim.
creator: after Sir Joshua Reynolds
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Forest Scene
title: Forest Scene
assistive_text: A broken white and gray birch tree trunk has fallen across a rocky, shallow waterfall at the edge of a dense, deeply shadowed forest in this horizontal landscape painting. The narrow stream winds toward us from the forest to splash into a rocky pool that nearly spans the width of the painting along the bottom edge. The tree trunk angles from our right down into the pool, having lost most of its branches. Broken off near the base, the gnarled roots of the tree dig into a rocky outcropping along the right edge of the composition. Farther back and tiny in scale, two people walk along the stream. One person wears a black dress and white cap, and carries a basket, and the other person wears a light, brimmed hat, a ruby-red shirt, and dark pants. Under the trees beyond, four sheep graze in a meadow. The bushes, vegetation, and trees of the forest spring up beyond the sheep, painted with tones of sage, moss, olive, and dark pine green. A grove of trees to our right in the middle distance, including one white birch trunk, nearly reaches the top edge of the canvas. Steel-gray bottomed clouds with white, fluffy tops create a diagonal line across the tree tops. A wedge of pale blue sky is exposed in the upper left corner. A few dark birds fly high in the sky. The artist signed the painting in the lower right, “J v Ruisdael.”
creator: Jacob van Ruisdael
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Dancing Couple
title: The Dancing Couple
assistive_text: More than a dozen light-skinned men, women, and children eat, drink, talk, and make music around a dancing couple under an arbor in this horizontal painting. Most of the people are dressed in muted tones of green, gray, and black. The patio-like space is enclosed by a railing along the back and a half wall to our right. Sage-green vines and leaves covering the roof-like trellis hang down. Ten men and women sit or stand closely around a long table along the left, next to the exterior wall of a red brick building. A woman sitting in a wooden chair at the end of the table closest to us wears a flax-yellow gown with a wide white collar and a starched white cap. She smiles up at the child she braces in her lap. The child stands and holds a toy in both hands and looks over one shoulder to our right. The child wears a carrot-orange gown with a white pinafore. Two men lean out of open windows at the far end of the brick building, and the people along the table drink, smile, or look on as a man in the center leads a woman by the hand to an open spot under the arbor. He wears a charcoal-gray suit, and a muted pink cap is pulled low over his eyes. He has a long, hooked nose, and light glints off teeth in his smiling mouth. The woman is pulled behind the man, so she stands flat-footed to our left of him. She faces our right but turns to looks at us from the corners of her dark eyes. Her light brown hair is gathered at the back of her head under a pearl-lined covering. She wears a dusty rose-pink gown with a sheer black shawl around her shoulders and white apron at her waist. Beyond the back rail, a man smiles widely as he balances a covered basket containing a gray chicken with one hand on his head. Nearby, a boy on our side of the rail talks with a little girl across the railing, who smiles back. Two men and a woman wearing a black head covering talk a short distance away. Close to us, a man, woman, and child in the lower right corner sit near two young men perched on the half wall, one playing a violin and the other a flute. A gleaming pewter ewer, a wooden barrel with a square opening, a white pipe, a terracotta bowl, broken eggs, a spoon, and an overturned pail of flowers lie scattered across the foreground of the patio. The artist signed and dated the lower left, “JSteen. 1663,” with the J and S overlapping.
creator: Jan Steen
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Emilia di Spilimbergo
title: Emilia di Spilimbergo
assistive_text: Shown from the knees up, a pale-skinned woman wearing rust-red gown under a sumptuous coat stands near a window, through which a sinking ship is shown in this vertical portrait painting. The woman’s body and head are angled to our right as she looks out at us with dark gray eyes. She has a nose with a rounded tip, a thin upper and full lower lip, and a slight double chin. Her red hair is pulled back and a braid wrapped around the back of her head. She wears a pearl and gemstone earring in the ear we see and a short, white pearl necklace. The bodice of her dress has a square neckline with black lines creating a vegetal pattern on the white fabric. That fabric continues up the sides of her chest and around her neck so a ruffle along the top flares out from her chin line. Letters along the inner edge of the fabric read “AV” to the left and “DIM+T” to the right. A gold jeweled belt encircles her waist, and one end hangs down the front of her long skirt, which is painted with a sheen suggesting velvet. The woman’s jacket is sand-brown, and it falls straight and heavy from her shoulders. The sides of the front opening, sleeves, and shoulders are decorated with knotted designs in brick red. Lace peeks out of each cuff, and the woman holds the coat belt loosely in her right hand, to our left. The wall behind her is dark stone, and her other hand rests on a stone ledge in front of the window. Through the opening is a stormy sky, choppy sea, and a masted ship listing hard to our left.
creator: Assistant of Titian, possibly begun by Gian Paolo Pace
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Junction of the Thames and the Medway
title: The Junction of the Thames and the Medway
assistive_text: We look across churning waves at four sailing ships and a wooden rowboat with four men aboard in this horizontal painting. Dark, iron-gray and tawny-brown clouds approaching from the right fill the top two-thirds of the composition. The water closest to us roils with steel gray and tan, which deepens to charcoal gray as it recedes toward low hills in the distant background. In the lower left corner of the painting, a wooden container bobs in the waves, and a white bird flies low over the water nearby. Two ships to the left of center head directly toward us, leaning steeply to our left with their beige sails taut with wind. Two men, tiny in scale, stand on the deck of the ship to our left. To our right, two ships with butter-yellow and peach sails cut through the water. Three men stand on the deck of the ship in the front, pulling on the rigging. Closest to us and to the right of center, the rowboat crests a wave, tilting forward so we look into the long side of the boat and see the four men there. Near the stern, one man hangs over the side while another holds onto him. Two men sit to the right, one facing us while the other faces away. Sunlight streaks down through a break in the storm clouds to fall on a ship with furled sails in the distance at the center of the composition. This and two additional ships near the distant shoreline are silhouetted against bands of white clouds around blue sky, beyond the bank of dark gray clouds closer to us.
creator: Joseph Mallord William Turner
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Giovanni Vincenzo Imperiale
title: Giovanni Vincenzo Imperiale
assistive_text: Shown from the knees up, a pale-skinned man wears a tall, black hat, wide white ruffs at the neck and cuffs, and a voluminous black garment in this vertical portrait painting. The dark costume nearly blends into the brown background in some places, so details are difficult to make out. The man sits in a chair so his body and knees are angled to our left. His face is also turned in that direction, but he looks at us from the corners of his brown eyes under dark, heavy brows. He has a thin face with a long, bumped nose. His brown mustache flicks up at the outer ends, and a thin line of hair down his chin creates his beard. His black hat has a high, rounded top and is draped with black fabric and a rosette. The ruffs at his neck and cuffs are pleated into tall, narrow figure eights. His black garment appears to puff widely at the shoulders and fold back over his lap. He wears a ring on the pinky finger of his left hand, which holds a piece of paper. The other hand hangs limp from where his arm rests on the chair, which appears to be upholstered in dark maroon-red fabric and is topped at the back with gold finials. A square window pierces the brown wall behind the man in the top left quadrant of the canvas. A few gold lines glint on the fringed brown curtain pulled up over the window, which opens onto a dark, perhaps nighttime landscape. A coat of arms hangs on the wall behind the chair, to our right of the man’s head. A shield is vertically striped with white to either side of a red stripe with a bird of prey silhouetted in black beneath a gold crown. Gold lettering on the wall below reads, “IO: VINSS: IMPS. ANN: SAL: 1626 AET: SVAE: 44.”
creator: Sir Anthony van Dyck
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Filippo Cattaneo
title: Filippo Cattaneo
assistive_text: A young boy with pale skin and short brown hair, wearing a black and gold jerkin and breeches, white lace collar, and buttercup-yellow stockings, stands facing us with a dog at his heels in this vertical portrait painting. The boy is brightly lit so the area around and behind him are deep in shadow. His body is angled slightly to our right but he turns to look at us with green eyes under faint brows. He has a round face, a short nose, and the corners of his closed, coral-pink lips turn slightly up. His hair is parted in the middle and bangs sweep to each side of his forehead. He stands with his left fist resting on his hip so his elbow juts out. His other arm rests by his side and he holds the dog’s chain-link leash in that hand. The boy's right foot, on our left, points toward us. His close-fitting, belted jacket, breeches, and hip-length cape are embroidered with gold on black. He has a delicate lace collar at his neck, bright yellow stockings on his calves, and brown, round-toed shoes. The chain he holds connects to the collar on the brown and white dog, which could be a puppy. The dog’s collar is lined with large brass bosses like a row of buttons. The dog stands or sits with its front legs straight, and his back end is hidden by the boy’s legs. The background behind the boy is chestnut brown and the room seems to have a wooden floor. The painting is inscribed in black paint near the upper left corner: “Ao 1623 AET. 4. 7.”
creator: Sir Anthony van Dyck
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Girl with a Flute
title: Girl with a Flute
assistive_text: Shown from the waist up, a young woman sits on the other side of the edge of a table, leaning toward us on one elbow in this vertical painting. She looks at us with dark brown eyes under faint, arched brows. She has pale skin with flushed cheeks, a long, rounded nose, and her ruby-red lips are parted. Her brown hair is tucked into a wide, conical hat with gray, pale yellow, and ash-brown vertical stripes. Light falls across her face from our right, so the hat casts a shadow over her eyes and on the far cheek, to our left. Light glints off of two teardrop-shaped pearl earrings. Her muted blue bodice has a few touches of topaz and sky blue create a brocade-like floral pattern. The bodice is trimmed with a wide band of white fur down the front and around the cuffs, which come down just beyond her elbows. A white kerchief tucked into the bodice covers her shoulders. She leans onto her left forearm, to our right, and that arm is close and parallel to the bottom edge of the composition. In that hand she holds a golden flute like a pencil, and her other hand rests against the edge of the table. She leans to our right so we can see the gold lion's head finial at the top of her wooden chair. The area behind her is painted with patches of harvest yellow, fawn brown, muted brick red, and parchment white to create a loosely patterned drapery that fills the background.
creator: Studio of Johannes Vermeer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Man in Armor
title: A Man in Armor
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts a bust of a person with a serene expression and shoulder-length wavy hair. The character is adorned with intricately detailed armor, which features a central motif of a grotesque face surrounded by floral patterns in gold. The armor is primarily a dark, muted hue, accented with red sleeves that resemble fabric folds, and two horse-like figures on the shoulders. The sculpture is created from what appears to be a painted, textured material, providing a realistic yet stylized representation of a historical or mythological figure. The face contrasts with the darker tones of the armor, enhancing the lifelike appearance of the sculpture.
creator: Vincenzo Onofri
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Bacchanal
title: Bacchanal
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts a central female figure partially draped, elevated, and supported by two male figures with goat-like legs and horns. The subject matter is presented in a round medallion format made from white marble. The intricate detailing of the figures, with carefully carved hair and musculature, gives a sense of realism. The medallion is encased in a round, ornate frame with a gold and embellished border and mounted on a simple wooden stand. This composition creates a bas-relief effect, with the figures standing out against a marble background, offering a three-dimensional visual experience from the front perspective.
creator: French 19th Century, after Jean Honoré Fragonard
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Louis II de Bourbon, Prince de Condé
title: Louis II de Bourbon, Prince de Condé
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts the head and torso of a person with long hair wearing elaborate attire. The person wears a cloth that drapes across their shoulders and chest, below which appears to be armor carved with animal and floral designs. The subject's long, flowing hair is intricately carved, cascading down over their shoulders in waves. They look to the left, highlighting their prominent nose, and have a small moustache above their closed lips. The material is very dark brown, almost appearing black, and reflects the light.
creator: after  Antoine Coysevox
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Young Lady
title: A Young Lady
assistive_text: The sculpture is a bust of a female figure with a serene expression. Her hair is styled in an elaborate fashion, with two distinct rounded sections on either side of her head. The sculpture is made from marble. The figure is depicted from the shoulders upwards, with the surface below the neckline appearing rougher and less polished than the smooth finish of the face and hair. The sculpture is slightly smaller than life-sized when compared to a human.
creator: Probably Florentine 15th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cupid (?)
title: Cupid (?)
assistive_text: The sculpture is a bust depicting a young child with short, curly hair. The child is shown with their head tilted slightly forward and to the right, a smile on their face. The child has a piece of cloth partially covering their chest, supported by a strap that hangs over their shoulder. The statue is crafted in a dark material, and it is mounted on a small pedestal.
creator: Attributed to Lucas Faydherbe
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Brunaccino Rinaldi
title: Brunaccino Rinaldi
assistive_text: The sculpture is a bust of an older male figure. He has a prominent mustache and short, curly hair. His expression is stern, with deeply furrowed brows and a strong jawline. The sculpture is made of bronze with a dark patina and slight greenish undertones. It rests on a rectangular base with an engraved inscription in a classical style. The base is made from the same bronze material as the bust. The overall presentation is sophisticated and solemn, highlighting the detailed craftsmanship of the sculptor.
creator: Florentine 16th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Rearing Horse
title: Rearing Horse
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts a horse in a dynamic stance, facing the left with both front legs raised. It is made of dark metal with a smooth surface and some textured areas. The horse is sculpted realistically, with defined anatomical features including a short mane, a tail, and a partially open mouth.
creator: Italian 18th or 19th Century, after the Antique
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Alexandre Brongniart
title: Alexandre Brongniart
assistive_text: The sculpture shows the bust of a young child with curly hair, smooth skin, and a soft expression. The child wears a garment with a ruffled collar and two buttons going down the front. They look towards the left with wide, inquisitive eyes, and have a small dimple in their cheek next to their small mouth. The sculpture is made of white marble and sits on a dark, glossy round base.
creator: Jean-Antoine Houdon
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Louise Brongniart
title: Louise Brongniart
assistive_text: The sculpture is a bust of a young girl with her hair styled in a bun with a simple headband. We see her from the chest up, and her torso faces us while her head looks over her shoulder to the left. The girl's expression is neutral, and she has round cheeks, a small nose, faint eyebrows, and a small chin. The material of the sculpture is a light pink-tan color, and it is mounted on a worn wooden pedestal.
creator: Imitator of Jean-Antoine Houdon
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Voltaire
title: Voltaire
assistive_text: The head, shoulders, and upper chest of a man wearing a curly wig are carved from white marble in this freestanding portrait sculpture. In this photograph, the man’s body and face are squared to us but his eyes cut to our right. His high forehead is lined, and there are crow’s feet around his eyes and wrinkles down the sides of his mouth. His thin lips are pulled up in a slight smile. The hair of his wig is brushed back, and it falls in tiers of dense curls to his shoulders. A white cloth is tied around his sinewy neck, and ruffles peek from the opening of his buttoned vest under his coat. The bust is curved along the bottom edge and sits on a round, stone pedestal. The sculpture is photographed against a gray background.
creator: Jean-Antoine Houdon
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Companion of Diana
title: A Companion of Diana
assistive_text: Carved from white marble, a young woman holds a short spear by one side and looks down toward a dog standing by her other side in this free-standing sculpture. Her body faces us in this photograph, and her head is tipped forward and to our right. She has a straight, delicate nose, and her thin lips are parted, possibly in a slight smile. Her wavy hair is held back under a band with an ornament on the crown, and a long curl falls behind one shoulder. Her knee-length garment exposes one firm breast and half of the other. The drapery clings tightly to her body and legs so the folds accentuate her curves. A longer garment falls from her waist, behind her legs, to pool at her sandaled feet. She stands with her weight mostly on her left leg, to our right, and the other knee bent. She holds the shaft of the spear with her right hand, to our left. Her other arm is drawn across her body at waist level. With that hand, she loosely holds the dog’s leash, which then falls across her thighs to the dog, sitting at her feet to our right. The short haired, thin, muscular hound is seated so its chest squares toward us. It twists its head up to look at the woman, its nose pressed along her leg. Its mouth is open, and the tongue curls out over sharp teeth. The dog wears a snug, buckled collar. The woman and dog stand on a square platform of white marble resting on a slab veined with charcoal gray and black, against a smoke-gray wall.
creator: Jean-Louis Lemoyne
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Jurist
title: A Jurist
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts a male figure with detailed facial features and a long, curly beard wearing a Renaissance-style garment featuring puffed sleeves and a buttoned front. The sculpture has a dark hue, appearing to be made of a bronze or dark patinated material. The figure has a strong, dignified expression and is presented on a decorative pedestal that is also dark. The sculpture captures intricate details like the beard texture and clothing folds, giving it a realistic and imposing presence.
creator: Paduan 16th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Vittorino de' Rambaldoni da Feltre, 1379-1446, Humanist [obverse]
title: Vittorino de' Rambaldoni da Feltre, 1379-1446, Humanist [obverse]
assistive_text: This is a round medal depicting the profile of a man wearing a distinctive hat and robe. The sculpture is crafted in a dark brown material, likely bronze. The man faces left with a calm expression, a prominent nose, a flat-topped hat with a band, and a simple collar on his robe. The edge of the medal is inscribed with the text “VICTORINVS FELTRENSIS SVM/MVS.” The front has a small hole near the top edge.
creator: Pisanello
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Pelican in Her Piety [reverse]
title: Pelican in Her Piety [reverse]
assistive_text: The sculpture is a bronze-like circular medal with an engraved design of a pelican feeding its young, a traditional motif. Surrounding the central image are inscriptions in Latin, reading "OMNIS.HVMANITATIS.PATER.MATHEMATICYS.PICTO.ET. PISANI. OPVS" around the circumference. The medal has a metallic brown color with a slight patina, a smooth and slightly worn texture, and a small hole near the edge. The design centers on the relief of the pelican, with the surrounding text adding a decorative and informative element.
creator: Pisanello
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Diva Faustina [obverse]
title: Diva Faustina [obverse]
assistive_text: The sculpture is a portrait medallion depicting a woman with long flowing hair, draped in a garment that exposes her shoulders and part of her chest. Her face is turned slightly to the side with a contemplative expression. The medallion is circular and features the inscription "DIVA FAVSTINA" around the edges. The sculpture appears to be made of a bronze material, giving it a dark golden color with a weathered, antique finish. The overall appearance is that of a classical bust, with the woman emerging in relief from the flat circular medallion, showing attention to detail in her facial features and hair. The piece has a three-dimensional quality, highlighting the engraving and casting skill used to create the lifelike representation.
creator: Moderno
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Triumph, with Hunting Scenes
title: A Triumph, with Hunting Scenes
assistive_text: This is a round medallion featuring many people carved in relief. At the center, two people ride on horseback, surrounded by a crowd of people in helmets holding long staff-like objects. The center portion is inscribed with the words "SENATS POPI." Surrounding this central image is a ring of other images going around the exterior of the medallion, including more people on horseback and animals such as dogs, deer, and larger bear-like creatures. The sculpture is crafted from a brown material with an aged, greenish-brown patina. Many of the details are obscured by discoloration. There is a small metal loop at the top.
creator: Mantuan 16th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Prometheus
title: Prometheus
assistive_text: This oval sculpture depicts a relief carving of a person who appears to be lying on the ground with a large bird hovering above them. The bird is positioned centrally within the sculpture, its wings outstretched, showing its feathers in detail. The person beneath the bird is in a reclined position, with their limbs extended and head turned toward one side, conveying a sense of motion or struggle. They appear to be confined within a ring of stones with their feet and hands tied to large rocks. The sculpture is crafted from a reddish-brown material with hints of an aged patina visible in some areas.
creator: Giovanni Bernardi
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sword Pommel with inset plaquette of Ariadne [affixed reverse of pommel]
title: Sword Pommel with inset plaquette of Ariadne [affixed reverse of pommel]
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts a circular scene with small, intricately detailed human figures engaged in a dynamic dance or ritual. The figures surround a central figure holding a staff. The sculpture is made from bronze, giving it a warm, golden-brown color with an aged patina. The figures are depicted in relief with detailed craftsmanship, standing out from the surface. The circular shape is set within an ornate frame with curving edges, enhancing its decorative appeal.
creator: Master IO.F.F.
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Judgment of Paris
title: Judgment of Paris
assistive_text: This is a circular medallion depicting a scene with four people in a relief carving. On the left, a seated man looks up at three women standing to the right. The women appear to be engaged in conversation or a presentation, with one of them holding a staff and shield. Above the group, there is a small, winged child flying over the scene. In the background are the leaves of a tall tree. The medallion appears gold, with several areas of dark brown patina obscuring many details.
creator: Master IO.F.F.
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Entombment
title: The Entombment
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts a group of figures gathered around a central figure. The central figure is reclining in a seated position. The surrounding figures have their heads inclined towards the central figure, creating a sense of interaction. The figures are draped in robes, suggesting dignity and solemnity. The relief sculpture appears to be made of bronze, with a dark golden-brown color and areas of verdigris patina. The sculpture is square with small circular holes at each corner and center of the sides. The relief work is shallow, with the figures subtly emerging from the flat background. The surface shows signs of age and wear, adding texture and visual interest.
creator: Paduan 15th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Augustus and the Sibyl
title: Augustus and the Sibyl
assistive_text: This is a square plate carved in relief, depicting multiple people gathered in a group. In the center, a person kneels, looking up at a person on the right. The person next to them is standing, gesturing upwards to the top right corner, where swirling clouds and small cherubs seem to appear in the sky. Some of the other people in the crowd look up as well. The people all appear to wear draped robes. One person on the left tends to two horses. There are architectural elements in the background, including columns topped with statues. The sculpture is primarily a dark, metallic color, with some light brown areas.
creator: Andrea Briosco, called Riccio
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Combat at a City Gate
title: Combat at a City Gate
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts a battle scene with numerous figures, including humans and horses, engaged in combat. The figures are in various poses, some mounted on rearing horses or in motion. The sculpture is cast in metal, likely bronze, with a dark brown hue and subtle color variations due to patina. In the background, there is an architectural setting with arches, towers, and a distant cityscape. The relief is moderately high, creating a dynamic scene with a sense of depth and movement.
creator: Andrea Briosco, called Riccio
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Horseman and Foot-Soldier
title: Horseman and Foot-Soldier
assistive_text: The sculpture is a rectangular relief depicting a warrior in armor on top of a rearing horse. The warrior holds a weapon above their head while the horse opens its mouth and lifts its front legs off the ground. Below the horse, another armored figure is shown lying on the ground, partially hidden under the horse's hooves. The relief is carved from bronze-colored material. There are four small holes in the corners of the sculpture.
creator: Andrea Briosco, called Riccio
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Aquamanile in the Form of a Horseman
title: Aquamanile in the Form of a Horseman
assistive_text: This free-standing bronze sculpture shows the rounded, stylized forms of a person with long limbs riding astride a horse with noticeably short legs. The horse and rider are angled to our right in this photograph. The dark brown bronze gleams white where the light catches the smooth surfaces, and some areas are a burnished gold color. The horse looks ahead with large eyes. It has short ears, and its mouth is parted. The person riding the horse holds the reins with the right hand, closer to us. The reins wrap halfway around the horse’s neck and are then broken off. The cleanshaven rider has a heavy brow ridge and a long, straight nose. He wears a flat-topped cap and a robe that reaches to his ankles. The pointed toes of his shoe pokes through the small stirrup we can see. A rounded handle connects the rider’s upper back to the back of the horse. The background is taupe-gray behind the sculpture and darkens at the upper corners.
creator: Probably English or Scandinavian 13th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Morse with the Trinity
title: Morse with the Trinity
assistive_text: This round sculpture contains several ornate designs and figures. In the center is a man with pale skin, long golden hair, and a golden beard, wearing red robes over a white garment. His hands are raised by his chest, and in them he holds a large cross with a smaller man attached to it. This man has his arms stretched out to each side, and his hands and feet have been nailed to the cross. He is shirtless, with a red cut on one side of his chest, white cloth wrapped around his waist, and a leafy crown on his head. He has pale skin with some areas of gold and long gold hair. At the top of the cross seems to be the shape of a white bird, its wings stretched to either side. Surrounding these two men are angelic figures with large brown wings, white skin, and golden hair. Circling them is a ring of thorns, and beyond that is a wreath of leaves with several large pearls in it. At the edge of the sculpture is an ornate golden frame. The piece is richly colored with gold, white, red, blue, and green tones.
creator: French 15th Century (Trinity and Angels); European 19th Century (setting)
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Plaque with the Last Supper
title: Plaque with the Last Supper
assistive_text: This is a painting of a group of figures gathered around a long table with various dishes and food items. The figures are depicted in intricate detail, with the central figures showing emotional expressions. The setting is a richly decorated interior with ornate architectural elements, including columns, arches, and a large window. The clothing of the figures is rendered with rich colors and patterns, emphasizing the formal and historical significance of the scene. The artwork exhibits rich texture and vibrant colors, consistent with the style associated with the artist, reflecting a scene of historical or religious importance.
creator: Jean Penicaud I
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Pendant with a Centaur
title: Pendant with a Centaur
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts a centaur, a mythical creature with the upper body of a human and the lower body of a horse. The human part is holding a bow. The sculpture is colorful and detailed. It has gold and enamel detailing. The centaur features a combination of enamel in rich hues, possibly including reds, blacks, and whites, while the horse body has a fur-like texture, with gilded highlights. The body is adorned with decorative jewels or stones. There are tear-shaped pearls dangling from the sculpture.
creator: Alfred André
medium: baroque pearl; gold enameled in black, white, pale blue, translucent red, green, and blue; 2 emeralds, 2 rubies, 1 piece of rock crystal or glass, 4 hanging pearls, 10 small pearls in the chain
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Large dish with segmental border of plant sprays and scale pattern; in the center, an emblematic female figure holding a crowned toad and cornucopia
title: Large dish with segmental border of plant sprays and scale pattern; in the center, an emblematic female figure holding a crowned toad and cornucopia
assistive_text: This is a colorful ceramic plate. In the center of the plate is a scene that features a person in a long, draped garment holding some sort of long object that looks like a thin horn or flower in one hand, and a small, spotted animal with a crown floating above it in their other hand. The person stands against a backdrop of a town or cityscape, and in the air on the right are a series of floral shapes. These designs are in bright yellow and blue colors, with some of the white background visible. The rim of the plate exhibits patterns of scales, vertical stripes, and floral motifs in yellow and blue, with some areas of bright orange.
creator: Deruta 16th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Large dish with segmental border of plant sprays and scale pattern; in the center, a profile bust of a woman in a winged headdress
title: Large dish with segmental border of plant sprays and scale pattern; in the center, a profile bust of a woman in a winged headdress
assistive_text: The image depicts a decorative ceramic plate with an artistic portrayal of a woman in profile. The woman is facing left, showcasing her upper body. She has delicate and idealized facial features with a serene expression. Her hair is styled with an intricate headdress adorned with ornamental elements. She wears a garment with detailed embellishments, likely representing period clothing, in warm earth tones with lacing details. A necklace is depicted around her neck. The plate's surroundings feature elaborate designs with patterned motifs, contrasting blue and orange tones, and plant-like elements. The background is filled with intricate geometric and floral patterns, adding texture to the image.
creator: Deruta 16th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Plate with border of rounded hills within pointed arches with flowers between them; in the center, a wading bird between stylized plants
title: Plate with border of rounded hills within pointed arches with flowers between them; in the center, a wading bird between stylized plants
assistive_text: This is a photograph of a decorative ceramic plate with a bird motif surrounded by floral patterns. The central part of the plate features an illustration of a bird amidst branches and flowers on a light blue background, all encased in a red circular border. The surrounding design consists of radiating triangular shapes colored in shades of ochre with blue accents, interspersed with clusters that resemble grains. The outer rim of the plate is adorned with red flowers against ochre and cream tones, while the plate rests against an olive green background.
creator: Deruta or Possibly Gubbio 16th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Plate with border of foliate scrollwork with dolphin heads and cornucopias; in the center, shield of arms of Vigerio of Savona
title: Plate with border of foliate scrollwork with dolphin heads and cornucopias; in the center, shield of arms of Vigerio of Savona
assistive_text: This is a colorful, decorative plate. The center of the plate features a coat of arms in vibrant tones of gold and deep blue, with the outline of a black bird. The shield is against a green and blue landscape, circled by a thick mustard-yellow border. The wide rim of the plate is adorned with green leaves, floral patterns, and curling scrollwork in blue, red, and yellow hues. There is the repeating image of the head of a creature with curled lips and fangs that tapers into a thin, intertwining body.
creator: Workshop of Maestro Giorgio Andreoli of Gubbio
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Flat plate with a battle scene
title: Flat plate with a battle scene
assistive_text: This painted plate shows three armored people and two horses in a dynamic scene set against a green and blue landscape. The people all have light skin and wear armor in shades of yellow and gold, with red fabric around their waists. They all wear different hats: one wears a yellow hat, one wears a blue hat, and one wears an orange hat with large blue feathers. Closest to us, a person jabs a spear towards a large white horse on the right. Another person is behind this horse, holding its reigns and looking over their shoulder. In the background on the left, a person riding a tan horse points a long sword down at the spear-wielder. In the background, blue water winds through light green grass and pale rock formations, with a few light blue trees. In the distance on the right is a large white castle with a golden roof under a blue sky that fades to yellow near the horizon. The rim of the plate is gold.
creator: Workshop of Maestro Giorgio Andreoli of Gubbio; painting by the Painter of the Three Graces
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Panel with the Adoration of the Magi
title: Panel with the Adoration of the Magi
assistive_text: This is a painting of people and animals in a rich green landscape under a blue sky with one bright star. On the right, under an arch, there is a seated woman with an infant on her lap, one man standing behind her and another kneeling in front of her, a crown on the ground next to him. There are two more men with crowns standing near the kneeling man, both pointing towards the child. The left side shows more people standing and looking at the woman and child, with some mounted on horses. More people are walking down a tall hill on the left, coming towards us. The people are clothed in tunics and cloaks in bright shades of green, blue, and orange-yellow. Most of them have pale yellow skin, although one of the crowned men in front of the woman has brown skin.
creator: Painted by Nicola da Urbino
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Circular plaque with fruited wreath enclosing a shield of arms
title: Circular plaque with fruited wreath enclosing a shield of arms
assistive_text: This is an image of a decorative ceramic plate with a heraldic design. The plate is circular and adorned with a central coat of arms or shield. The shield is divided diagonally by a gold band with two heraldic animals, likely greyhounds, depicted in a running posture with gold stripes. The upper part of the shield contains three gold fleur-de-lis symbols on a blue field. Surrounding the shield is an intricate design of green laurel branches with acorns and yellow floral elements on a blue background. The date "1532" is inscribed on the plate. The ceramic plate combines craftsmanship with rich symbolic imagery, indicative of heraldry. The design reflects a family or regional coat of arms and emphasizes tradition and artistry common in European decorative arts.
creator: Probably Faenza 16th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Broad-rimmed bowl with border of urns and cherubs' heads; in the center, device of a bird standing on a bundle with the inscription VINCENZO
title: Broad-rimmed bowl with border of urns and cherubs' heads; in the center, device of a bird standing on a bundle with the inscription VINCENZO
assistive_text: This is a photograph of an ornate ceramic plate with intricate designs. The plate features a central circular motif with a black bird standing on stylized wheat or hay against an orange background. Surrounding the central motif are blue and gray decorations, including winged cherub-like faces and scrolls, with various words inscribed on them, such as "SPQR," "AMAS," "DIO," and "GADI." The plate has a richly detailed and symmetrical design, combining vibrant colors and classical elements.
creator: Urbino district 16th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Shallow bowl on low foot with the Conversion of Saul
title: Shallow bowl on low foot with the Conversion of Saul
assistive_text: This is a painting on ceramic of a scene with horses and a landscape. The artwork features a central figure on a brown horse, with others on white horses on either side. The setting includes trees, a river, and distant architecture under a cloudy sky. Armor and weaponry are present, along with a figure on the ground. It is in the style of Italian Renaissance maiolica, known for its bright colors and detailed narrative scenes inspired by classical and mythological themes.
creator: Painting attributed to Francesco Xanto Avelli; place of production uncertain
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cup on high foot with the royal arms of France crowned
title: Cup on high foot with the royal arms of France crowned
assistive_text: The sculpture is a decorative footed bowl with intricate carvings. The body of the bowl is adorned with detailed scrollwork and several human faces or mask-like details with open mouths on the bowl and stem. It is mostly off-white and pale yellow, with black and green accents highlighting swirling patterns. It stands on a circular base and features small lion heads near the center.
creator: French 16th Century, probably Saint-Porchaire (Deux-Sevres), or Paris region
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: "The Morosini Helmet" (visored burgonet)
title: "The Morosini Helmet" (visored burgonet)
assistive_text: This is an ornate helmet made of dark metal with gold-colored details. It features intricate designs and patterns throughout, including symmetrical swirling and floral designs, as well as designs on the faceguard that look similar to an animal’s face, including a snarling mouth and eye holes. The lighting emphasizes the embossed and engraved elements of the helmet.
creator: Probably Milanese 16th Century
medium: repoussé and embossed iron or steel, with gilding and silvering
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Walnut Savonarola Chair with Letters G.M.
title: Walnut Savonarola Chair with Letters G.M.
assistive_text: The sculpture is a wooden chair featuring a decorative backrest with a circular emblem in the center that includes a coat of arms and the letters "G M" etched on either side. The chair is made of richly colored brown wood with visible grain patterns and detailed carvings, adding texture and depth. The legs cross in an X pattern and end in carved lion's paws. The armrests have a rolled design. The chair is topped with a blue cushioned seat with tassels at the edges.
creator: Italian 16th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Small Side Chair
title: Small Side Chair
assistive_text: This photograph depicts an intricately designed wooden chair with a richly upholstered seat. The chair features a carved wooden backrest with an ornate crest at its center and is supported by spindled balusters. The upholstery is a deep red fabric with a fading pattern from rich red to a lighter hue, trimmed with a decorative fringe. The legs and base are crafted from matching dark wood with turned detailing, providing a robust and elegant structure. The overall composition showcases the craftsmanship and artistry of furniture design, reflecting a classic and possibly antique style.
creator: Sienese 16th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Vase in the Form of a Carp, Mounted as an Ewer
title: Vase in the Form of a Carp, Mounted as an Ewer
assistive_text: The sculpture is a pitcher designed in the shape of a fish, with scales and facial features. The main portion of the pitcher is light blue and embellished with gilded designs forming the handle and base. The gilded portions have leaf-like patterns that contrast with the smooth blue surface.
creator: Chinese Qing Dynasty
medium: porcelain with blue celadon glaze, in gilt-bronze mount
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Triumph of Christ ("The Mazarin Tapestry")
title: The Triumph of Christ ("The Mazarin Tapestry")
assistive_text: This horizontal tapestry is divided into three vertical sections by architectural columns and arches. The center column is a little wider than those to either side, but all three sections are packed with people, all with ivory-white skin. In the center column, a crowned Jesus is seated on a throne at the top center. His elaborately patterned robe falls in folds down past his feet. He hovers above a landscape view, which is flanked in the foreground by groups of men and women. About a dozen people are clustered on each side, many of them looking up at Jesus, and most of them wearing religious garments that range from monks and nuns to cardinals and bishops. Two crowned men kneel to our right in the center panel, their hands pressed together in prayer. Each column on either side of the central panel is divided so there is a smaller vignette above taller vignettes below. Large groups of people gather in each scene. Much of the tapestry’s surface is now brown, but it is punctuated throughout with patches of rust red, sky blue, and pale yellow.
creator: Netherlandish 16th Century
medium: tapestry: undyed wool warp; dyed wool, silk, and silver-gilt- and silver-wrapped silk weft
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Dream of Rinaldo
title: Dream of Rinaldo
assistive_text: This is a tapestry of people in flowing garments in a pastoral landscape. At the center of the tapestry, a man in a red garment reclines, his eyes closed. He holds a plumed golden helmet on his knee and wears golden sandals. Around him, a crowd of people sitting or lounging on the ground turn to look at him, some pointing. All of the people have light skin and pale-yellow hair. The scene includes musical instruments, white sculptures, vessels spilling water, and many pink flowers among green leaves. Some sections of the tapestry, especially around the center, are bright white. The scene is surrounded by a golden border.
creator: design and cartoon by François Boucher; woven under the direction of Jean-Baptiste Oudry and Nicolas Besnier at the Beauvais manufactory
medium: tapestry: undyed wool warp; dyed wool and silk weft
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Tapestry-covered Cushion
title: Tapestry-covered Cushion
assistive_text: This is a photograph of an ornately embroidered pillow. The pillow features an intricate design with a central heraldic emblem depicting a red lion in a standing pose enclosed within a woven-like fence, topped by a crown. Surrounding this central motif are floral embellishments with leaves and flowers in various colors, including red, pink, blue, and beige, set against a dark background.
creator: Netherlandish 17th or 18th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Amphora Vase
title: Amphora Vase
assistive_text: The sculpture is a blue vase with a tall, slender neck that widens into a bulbous body before tapering towards the bottom. The vase is made from smooth ceramic material and stands upright with a symmetrical shape, reflecting light.
creator: Chinese Qing Dynasty
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Vase, Meiping Shape
title: Vase, Meiping Shape
assistive_text: The sculpture is a vase with a simple design. It is white and appears to be made of porcelain or ceramic material with a glossy finish. The vase has a rounded, tapered body that extends into a narrower neck and flares out slightly at the mouth and base. An embossed subtle decorative element can be seen near the upper portion of the vase. The overall appearance of the vase is smooth and symmetrical, reflecting light evenly across its surface.
creator: Chinese Qing Dynasty
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jar
title: Jar
assistive_text: The sculpture is a rounded vase or vessel with a crackle glaze. It is a vibrant green color which is slightly lighter in some areas, highlighting the thin cracks running across it. The vase has a curved shape with a narrow neck and a flared white lip.
creator: Chinese Qing Dynasty
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hexagonal Lantern
title: Hexagonal Lantern
assistive_text: The sculpture is a hexagonal porcelain vase with intricate painted scenes. The subjects include figures engaged in various activities, such as combat or celebration and conversation or musical performance. The color scheme consists of green, red, and black on an off-white background, with accents of orange and other colors. The upper edge of the vase has a decorative geometric openwork flange in green and white porcelain. Various patterns, including waves and clouds, border the scenes on the vase.
creator: Chinese Qing Dynasty
medium: porcelain with overglaze famille verte enamels on the biscuit
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Young Woman
title: Young Woman
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts a standing woman in a green robe with floral decorations in red, yellow, and blue. Below the green robe, a similarly patterned yellow garment peaks out by her feet and wrists. One of her hands is visible, raised near her chest. Her face is turned slightly towards the right, and her expression is calm, with high eyebrows and a slightly upturned mouth. Her glossy black hair is styled above her head in a flat bun with a band of beads around it. The sculpture has a smooth, glossy finish.
creator: Chinese Qing Dynasty
medium: porcelain with famille verte enamels on the biscuit
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Female Attendant
title: Female Attendant
assistive_text: The sculpture portrays a kneeling person wearing colorful clothing. Their black hair is tied into two bunches that run behind their ears and down onto their chest. Their skin is white, and their facial features are minimal, showing thin, arched eyebrows, a small nose, and a smiling mouth. The person’s attire includes a black jacket with red, blue, and white floral patterns, over a green gown embellished with a blue-and-red floral border at the bottom. The person’s hands are outstretched in front of them, with the palms turned towards each other. The sculpture is crafted from a smooth, glazed material.
creator: Chinese Qing Dynasty
medium: porcelain with famille verte enamels on the biscuit
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Baluster Vase
title: Baluster Vase
assistive_text: This is a vase that features delicate white flowers with brown branches and a small gray bird. The vase is predominantly green. At the bottom of the vase there are some tall triangular shapes in lighter shades of green which may be representing the tops of mountains.
creator: Chinese Qing Dynasty
medium: porcelain with famille verte enamels on the biscuit
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Rouleau-Shaped Vase
title: Rouleau-Shaped Vase
assistive_text: The sculpture is a decorative vase with intricate detailing. The vase is predominantly black with a colorful depiction of blooming flowers and foliage with a perched bird. The flowers are painted in shades of orange, yellow, blue, and white, with green leaves. The material seems to be ceramic or porcelain. The sculpture stands upright with a wide cylindrical form, tapering towards the neck before flaring out at the top. The rim has a pattern in yellow and white.
creator: Chinese Qing Dynasty
medium: porcelain with famille noire enamels on the biscuit
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Large Covered Baluster Jar
title: Large Covered Baluster Jar
assistive_text: This is an elaborately decorated urn or vase with a lid. It features colorful floral patterns with large blossoms in shades of pink, yellow, and white, smaller blossoms in blue, small green leaves, and cranes with white and black feathers and long beaks. The base and neck of the vase have stripes of colors such as red, green, yellow, and white. The lid is topped with a sculptural figure of a dog or lion in pink and green.
creator: Chinese Qing Dynasty
medium: porcelain with overglaze famille rose enamels
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Covered Jar
title: Covered Jar
assistive_text: This is a photograph of a decorative vase. The vase has a red background with intricate designs and motifs across its surface.
