It has a lid decorated with floral patterns and circular insets with illustrations of flowers, a bird, and landscape scenes with mountains, trees, and water motifs. It sits on a dark wooden base with a swirling design that complements the artwork on the vase.
creator: Chinese Qing Dynasty
medium: porcelain with overglaze famille rose enamels, on gilded bronze mount
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Large Fish Bowl
title: Large Fish Bowl
assistive_text: The sculpture is a ceramic pot decorated with floral motifs. The pot is blue with gold detailing and features an oval panel displaying colorful flowers against a white background. Surrounding the panel is a geometric pattern in gold. Animal head-shaped handles are on either side of the pot. The rim is white with a pink and orange pattern, and smaller floral motifs are repeated around the upper part of the pot.
creator: Chinese Qing Dynasty
medium: porcelain with blue and overglaze famille rose enamels
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Tête-à-tête
title: Tête-à-tête
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with two people sitting together with a small dog amidst nature. In the center of the drawing, the people are reclining on the ground, surrounded by leaves, tree trunks, and a low wall on the left. The people, a man and a woman, have their arms around one another, the woman sitting partially in the man's lap. They both have light skin and light hair, and she wears a long dress with a low neckline, and he appears to wear a tunic and has a wide-brimmed hat sitting in his lap. Their faces are close together, and they are looking at each other. The surrounding environment includes dense trees and overgrown shrubs, and on the left is a stone wall that appears to be half-built or in ruins, with a small fountain at its center. Near the bottom left corner, a small dog sits by the couple, looking up at them.
creator: François Boucher
medium: black chalk heightened with white on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Adoration of the Shepherds
title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
assistive_text: This is a drawing of several people gathered under a simple shelter. The sketch shows figures assembled around a central point under a makeshift canopy. The structure consists of wooden posts supporting a slanted roof. The figures seem engaged in communal activities such as conversation or focused on a task. The artwork uses expressive lines to capture the mood and actions of the subjects. Lighting and shading add depth to the scene, providing a glimpse into a moment of interaction among the individuals.
creator: Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn
medium: pen and brown ink with gray-brown wash
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hagar Seated at the Fountain
title: Hagar Seated at the Fountain
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two figures interacting with each other. The drawing depicts an angelic figure on the left, sketched with flowing lines, expansive wings, and robes. The figure's head is slightly inclined forward. On the right, a seated figure is drawn with a few lines, appearing to gesture with both arms raised. The seated figure wears a wide-brimmed hat. The drawing suggests a narrative or moment of encounter between the two figures, with a simplistic yet expressive style capturing the essence of the scene.
creator: follower of Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Judas Leaving the High Priest
title: Judas Leaving the High Priest
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of people inside a building with large columns on the right. A group of people is gathered on the left side, facing the right. To the right of center, there is one person at the top of the steps that are between the large columns, appearing to walk down the stairs and away from the group. They are facing us with their hands raised. The drawing features loose lines and minimal details, and it is in shades of gray and brown on off-white paper.
creator: Style of Rembrandt van Rijn
medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash on  laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Betrothal of the Holy Virgin
title: The Betrothal of the Holy Virgin
assistive_text: The image shows a full-body depiction of three figures positioned in a scene of interaction. The central figure stands upright, facing the viewer, wearing a tall hat and a long robe. On either side, two other figures lean slightly toward the central figure. The figure on the left has long hair and a beard, draped in a robe, while the figure on the right also wears a robe and a head covering. All three are engaged in a gesture of joining hands, with the central figure's hands extended toward the hands of the others. There is no noticeable detail of facial features due to the style of the sketch, which is simple and linear. The background consists of a curtained setting with hints of arches and pillars, suggesting an indoor setting. The image is monochromatic.
creator: Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn
medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Temptation of Christ
title: Temptation of Christ
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two people interacting with each other. The person on the left is in profile, extending their arms out towards the person on the right. They appear to have the legs and tail of a goat, and they wear a pointed hat that flops forward. They hold something in their outstretched hands which looks like a bowl. The person on the right is a man with long hair and a beard. He wears long, draped robes. His body is turned to the right, but he looks over his shoulder at the object held out to him by the other person, lifting one of his hands slightly. The scene is set against a backdrop of minimalistic landscape features with simple lines defining the ground and a few indications of natural forms, such as rocks or a bank. The drawing is executed with dark, fluid lines and has a sketch-like quality. The background is beige paper.
creator: attributed to Govaert Flinck
medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jupiter and Callisto
title: Jupiter and Callisto
assistive_text: The artwork features a detailed illustration of multiple figures in a natural setting. The central scene shows three figures seated among foliage. A female figure in the center is reclined against another figure, with her face turned towards her companions. Two female figures are engaged in conversation, while a cherubic child reaches towards them. Above, a floating figure is surrounded by clouds and tree branches. In the foreground, hunting dogs rest beside a horn. The background includes trees and clouds, creating a pastoral setting. The illustration is framed with an ornate border and attributed to Ch. Eisen from 1765, depicting the mythological theme of Jupiter taking the form of Diana to seduce the nymph Callisto.
creator: Charles Eisen
medium: graphite on wove(?) paper, laid down
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Sacrifice of Iphigenia
title: The Sacrifice of Iphigenia
assistive_text: This is a detailed drawing of several characters within a scene featuring clouds and classical architecture. The central figure is reclining, surrounded by other figures displaying various emotions and interactions. A winged figure is above, reaching towards the group, accompanied by a ram-like animal. The composition is filled with drapery, gestures, and expressions, creating a dense atmosphere full of narrative and historical elements.
creator: Jean-Michel Moreau
medium: pen and brush and black ink with gray wash over traces of graphite with border line by the artist on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Fetes venitiennes
title: Fetes venitiennes
assistive_text: The image shows a group of figures gathered in an outdoor setting. A woman in a gown stands at the center, surrounded by other seated or reclining figures. The clothing and hairstyles suggest a historical period. Some figures are reclining on the ground, while others are seated or standing. The scene includes an ornate urn, a reclining statue, and lush trees and foliage. The sky above is partially cloudy.
creator: Laurent Cars after Antoine Watteau
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La colation
title: La colation
assistive_text: The image shows a wooded area with four elegantly dressed individuals gathered on a blanket. The viewpoint is at ground level, with dense foliage obscuring the horizon. The trees are finely detailed, with a monochromatic color palette of gray shades. In the distance, more trees form a natural alcove, and a light source illuminates the scene. The composition conveys a sense of peaceful leisure under the canopy of leaves.
creator: Jean Moyreau after Antoine Watteau
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Lecon d'amour
title: Lecon d'amour
assistive_text: The image shows a pastoral scene with figures in elegant clothing gathered around a guitarist. A seated woman and lush foliage are on the left, with rolling hills and a village in the distance. The sky features dramatic clouds. The artwork utilizes a monochromatic palette in tones of beige and sepia, resembling an etching technique.
creator: Charles Dupuis after Antoine Watteau
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Marie-Antoinette
title: Marie-Antoinette
assistive_text: This print shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is turned slightly to the right, looking at us, and she has white skin and white hair, arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and a small mouth in a neutral expression. Her curled hair is styled in an elaborate updo with small flowers. The woman is wearing an elegant gown with puffed sleeves and lace detailing around the low neckline. She also has a necklace of small pearls or beads, and flower-shaped earrings. The background features an oval frame enclosing the portrait, set against a gray backdrop. Below the oval frame are two small circular designs that look like small crests or shields.
creator: Richard Brookshaw
medium: mezzotint and etching on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Louis XVI and Marie-Antoinette
title: Louis XVI and Marie-Antoinette
assistive_text: This print shows two oval portraits side by side, each displaying a bust of a person in profile looking towards the middle. The left portrait features a man with a high forehead, white hair that curls around his ears, a sharp nose, and a soft chin, with his lips set in a slight smile. He is wearing an ornate jacket with ruffles around the neck. The right portrait shows a woman with an ornate hairstyle featuring curls, feathers, pearls, lace, and a cloth veil. She wears a dress with a low neckline trimmed with lace and strands of pearls across her chest. She has a long neck, thin eyebrows, and thin lips. Both portraits are set within blue frames rimmed in gold and surrounding them is a background filled with a garland of pink flowers, green leaves, and blue ribbons. A green wreath is positioned above the two portraits. The background is beige paper.
creator: Jean Pillement, Jean-Baptiste-André Gautier-Dagoty, and Louis Bonvallet
medium: color etching, wash manner, and stipple engraving with gold leaf and hand coloring with silver paint (tarnished) on silk satin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Francois Boucher
title: Francois Boucher
assistive_text: The image shows a portrait of a man turned slightly to his left. He has a prominent nose and a composed expression. His hair is styled in an 18th-century fashion with curls and appears white or gray. He is dressed in formal attire with a high-collared garment and lace cravat. The portrait is encased in an oval frame with decorative elements and the name "F. BOUCHER" below the portrait in a rectangular plaque. The background is a textured surface, giving the piece an engraved style.
creator: Louis Bosse
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Nous n'avons pas le patience d'attendre que nous fussions seuls
title: Nous n'avons pas le patience d'attendre que nous fussions seuls
assistive_text: The image displays a man and a woman embracing in the center. The man is wearing 18th-century attire, including a tricorn hat and an elaborate coat. The woman is lifted off the ground by the man, wearing a formal dress with detailed ruffles. Around them are other figures, including what appears to be children observing them. The background shows a lively environment, possibly a social gathering or a busy room. The room features a fireplace with various items, a high mantle with vases and dishes, exposed wooden beams on the ceiling, and a small dog on the floor.
creator: Louis-Joseph Lefevre
medium: pen and black ink and brush and black ink with gray wash
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le roman dangereux
title: Le roman dangereux
assistive_text: This print shows a woman lying on a bed with a man leaning over a chair beside her. The woman is in the center of the print, with her head towards the left and her feet towards the bottom right corner. She is dressed in a gown with a low neckline, lying on her back with her head on a pillow and her arm bent by her head. Her eyes are closed. She has light skin and her hair is in an elaborate updo. The wide skirts of her dress are spread out across the bed, and one of her feet rests on a cushioned footrest. The man is to the right, leaning over a cushioned chair towards the sleeping woman's face. He has light skin and curled white hair, and he wears a long coat with ruffles at the cuffs and neckline. He is looking towards her and has one finger raised to his lips. The room is ornately decorated with heavy curtains above the bed, large decorative urns, and a high circular ceiling.
creator: Isidore-Stanislas Helman after Nicolas Lavreince
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Consolation de l'absence
title: La Consolation de l'absence
assistive_text: This print shows a woman sitting on a cushioned settee in an ornate room. She extends her one arm outward, holding a small round object that seems to feature a small portrait of a man. She is looking towards this portrait. The woman has pale skin and light-colored hair in an elaborate hairstyle that features lace and feathers. She is wearing an elegant gown with a low, lacy neckline, a fitted bodice, and a wide, flowing skirt. The room is richly decorated with detailed wall coverings and a large, framed picture of a cherub on the wall. The cherub is positioned above her, and it appears to point an arrow directly at the woman. On the left, a small round table near the woman holds a tea set and some other objects, and a small dog stands beside it, looking to the left. On the left is a shelf supporting a large decorative vase and a statue below a large, ornate mirror, while on the right is a large, draped curtain and a chair with a musical instrument on it. This central image is surrounded by a border, and below it are several lines of text.
creator: Nicolas Delaunay after Nicolas Lavreince
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Bon Exemple
title: Le Bon Exemple
assistive_text: The image shows a woman sitting on a chair, sewing. She is positioned in profile, looking down at a piece of fabric. She has a lace cap on her styled hair, her face has a gentle expression. The woman wears a detailed dress with ruffles, lace trim, and a choker. Next to her, a table holds sewing materials. The background shows a patterned wall and draped curtain, within an ornate frame.
creator: Juste Chevillet after Jean-Gaspard Heilmann
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mlle. Salle
title: Mlle. Salle
assistive_text: The image depicts several figures in elaborate, historical attire positioned in a formal outdoor setting. The central figure, a woman in a detailed gown, is shown dancing with one arm extended. Three other women in similar attire are dancing nearby. On the right, a group of men is playing musical instruments. In the background, classical columns and a partial statue can be seen amid trees. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic palette, emphasizing the clothing's intricacies and the background foliage.
creator: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Nicolas Lancret
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le midi
title: Le midi
assistive_text: The image shows four individuals, three women and one man, standing in front of an ornate fountain with a sculpture of a child holding an arrow pointing to a sundial. The women wear 18th-century gowns, styled hair, and hold decorative objects. The man is seated next to them, wearing a detailed long coat. The background features dense foliage, suggesting a garden or wooded area.
creator: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Nicolas Lancret
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'apres-diner
title: L'apres-diner
assistive_text: This is a print of four people gathered around a table outdoors. In the center, there is a rectangular table with thin legs, set with dice and game pieces. Two of the people sit at the table, a woman on the right and a man on the left. Two more women stand behind the man, who looks over his shoulder towards them. All of the people have pale skin, and the women wear long dresses with wide skirts and ruffled sleeves, and their hair is put up under small cloth bonnets. The man wears a long jacket with large buttons, which is open to reveal a white shirt and trousers that go down to his knees. He wears black buckled shoes, and his hair is curled. The group is surrounded by leafy trees and bushes, and a cloudy sky is visible on the left. Below the scene, there are several lines of words on the beige paper.
creator: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Nicolas Lancret
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Serment
title: Le Serment
assistive_text: The image depicts four people: two standing and two seated on the ground. One standing man is supporting a woman who is slightly leaning back with her arm raised. The woman has elaborate hairstyles, and both characters are dressed in ornate, historical clothing. The other seated man and woman seem to be engaged in conversation. The setting features dense foliage, trees, and ruins in the background, including a statue with a female figure and a cupid-like child.
creator: Charles-Clement Bervic after Louis Rolland Trinquesse
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Fontaine d'Amour (The Fountain of Love)
title: La Fontaine d'Amour (The Fountain of Love)
assistive_text: This is a painting depicting mythical figures gathered around a fountain. The scene shows angelic cherubs with wings surrounding two female figures. The figures are engaging in interaction among clouds. Water cascades from the fountain into a pool, and trees frame the scene. The painting is done in the style of François Boucher.
creator: Nicolas François Regnault after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Chiffre d'amour
title: Le Chiffre d'amour
assistive_text: The image shows a woman in a side profile view, standing and leaning forward towards a tree. She seems to be carving or writing on the tree. She has delicate facial features, styled hair, and wears an elegant gown. A dog sits beside her on a stone bench. The background includes a large tree, foliage, and a cloudy sky. The image is bordered and titled at the bottom.
creator: Nicolas Delaunay after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Verrou
title: Le Verrou
assistive_text: This print displays two individuals in a room. A man is on the left, facing away from us. In his right hand, he holds a woman by the waist, and his left hand is flung upward, positioned near a latch on a large door. He wears a white shirt, knee-length breeches, and is barefoot, his heels raised off the ground as if he is dancing. He has pale skin and curly brown hair. The woman is grabbing his shoulder, her head flung back. She appears to be coming down from a large bed on the right of the print, and one of her feet is on the floor while the other is raised in the air. She wears a garment with long, draped skirts, and some of them still lie on the bed. She has pale skin and light, curly hair. The bed on the right is unmade, with blankets draped across it and a large dent in the pillow. Heavy fabric hangs down around the bed. In the bottom right corner is a small table draped with fabric, with an overturned pitcher and small round object, perhaps an apple, resting on it. To the left of the table, a cushioned chair has been knocked on its side, with a short, dark dress draped over it. In the bottom left corner, small flowers lay on the floor near a cushioned footrest. The door and wall are dark gray. A bright beam of light is illuminating the embracing couple and the latched door behind them, with the rest of the room in shadow.
creator: Maurice Blot after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Rose mal defendue (The Poorly Defended Rose)
title: La Rose mal defendue (The Poorly Defended Rose)
assistive_text: In the image, a man and a woman are depicted. The man holds the woman, who appears to be stepping back or dancing. The woman faces the viewer, with a gentle expression and elaborately styled hair with curls and a large hat. She wears an elegant gown with ruffled details. The man stands behind her, looking engaged, with curled hair, dressed in late 18th-century formal attire. The woman holds a small bouquet. The background shows an opulent setting with a canopy bed, curtains, a side table with various items, and a richly patterned wall.
creator: Philibert-Louis Debucourt
medium: etching, wash manner, stipple, and aquatint on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Tambourin
title: Le Tambourin
assistive_text: This is a painting showing a lively outdoor gathering in a park setting. The scene captures elegantly dressed individuals engaged in various activities. In the foreground, a group of people sit on the grass, some chatting and others observing. To the left, a musician plays a drum. Children play with a small dog, adding joy to the scene. A statue on a pedestal is on the right, and lush trees surround the area. The sky has soft clouds, suggesting a pleasant day. The painting is in the style of François Boucher, known for pastoral themes and decorative elegance.
creator: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La vieillesse
title: La vieillesse
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an outdoor gathering in a rural setting. The scene depicts a group of individuals engaged in leisurely activities near a simple, rustic home, surrounded by trees. The central figures are elderly and involved in various activities such as spinning wool. One person is sitting and spinning yarn at a wheel, while others sit and stand around. A dog rests on the ground nearby. The architecture of the house includes textured stone walls and a tall, narrow building. The composition includes elaborate detailing in the textures of clothing and foliage. French text at the bottom reads "La Vieillesse," meaning "Old Age."
creator: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Nicolas Lancret
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Départ du Courrier
title: Le Départ du Courrier
assistive_text: The image shows a seated person playing a flute, leaning against a rock. The person is dressed in period clothing and has curly hair peeking out from under a hat. They are surrounded by a basket, a dog, and grazing sheep. The circular border is adorned with ivy, and the background is a dense forest with trees, bushes, and a sky visible through the branches.
creator: Jacques-Firmin Beauvarlet after François Boucher
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'Arrivée du Courrier
title: L'Arrivée du Courrier
assistive_text: The image shows a woman kneeling in a forest clearing. She is leaning forward with one hand on a branch and the other pointing upwards. She is wearing a flowing garment and has detailed facial features. Nearby, there is a basket of flowers and cloth, a lamb resting, and a dog looking up. The circular frame around the image has foliage motifs. The background includes trees, water, and a bird flying. The image is monochromatic in shades of gray with detailed engravings.
creator: Jacques-Firmin Beauvarlet after François Boucher
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'enlevement nocturne
title: L'enlevement nocturne
assistive_text: The image features several figures and animals in a dynamic scene. One person is climbing or perched on a tree, while another is being carried by a man. The individual in the tree has 18th-century fashion details such as delicate facial features, styled hair, and ornate clothing with ruffles, suggesting a dress. The man carrying the other person is dressed in typical 18th-century attire with a tricorn hat. A horse-drawn carriage with drivers and horses is depicted in motion, set against a backdrop of lush foliage and a church steeple. The composition is detailed with artistic embellishments and shading, creating a dramatic effect.
creator: Nicolas Ponce after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Fuite à dessein (The Pre-Arranged Flight)
title: La Fuite à dessein (The Pre-Arranged Flight)
assistive_text: The image shows a woman in full-body view positioned against a breezy landscape. She appears to be in mid-motion, with her arms extended and her body slightly angled forward. She has a surprised or playful expression, with wide eyes and slightly open lips. Her hair is styled in an updo with flowers. She is wearing a flowing, knee-length gown with puffed sleeves and a wrap-around bodice that billows around her. Tall grasses surround her, and a second figure, possibly male, is partially visible behind her. The background features a cloudy sky.
creator: Charles François Adrien Macret and Jacques Couché after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Petite Thérèse
title: La Petite Thérèse
assistive_text: This print shows a man and a woman surrounded by plants. On the left is the man, who is facing the right and leaning forward with his arms extended. He wears a dark, wide-brimmed hat, a long-sleeved jacket and shirt with a ruffled white collar, and dark trousers. The woman on the right faces us, appearing to move towards the right. The man is grabbing her arm with one hand and the fabric of her skirt with the other hand. She wears a light-colored dress with a neckline so low that it reveals her breasts, a ruffled white collar, a draped skirt, and puffed sleeves. Her hair is tied up into a bun on top of her head. Both people have pale skin, and the man is smiling slightly, while the woman has a neutral expression, her mouth partially open. They are both surrounded by twisting vines and dense leaves. The text "La Petite Therese" is below the print, alongside a decorative coat of arms featuring two figures and a shield.
creator: Jacques Couché after Jacques-Philippe Caresme
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Bonne éducation (The Good Education)
title: La Bonne éducation (The Good Education)
assistive_text: The image shows two women in an indoor setting. One woman is standing on the left side, facing slightly right, wearing a long gown with a bonnet. The other woman is seated on the right, reading from an open book on her lap. She also wears a gown with a bonnet. The room features a cupboard with a bowl, a window letting in light, a chair, a covered table, and heavy curtains.
creator: Jacques-Philippe Le Bas after Jean Siméon Chardin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Dame cachetant une lettre (Woman Sealing a Letter)
title: Dame cachetant une lettre (Woman Sealing a Letter)
assistive_text: In the image, two individuals are depicted. One person stands facing the other person seated. The standing individual has long, dark hair and is wearing a detailed garment with buttons. The seated person has curly hair and is dressed in a flowing robe with intricate fabric folds. The seated person appears to be interacting with the standing person, who is offering them an object, possibly a piece of paper. A small dog with pointed ears is near the seated individual, looking upwards. The background includes a textured curtain, paneled walls, a table covered with a patterned cloth holding various items, and an ornate chair.
creator: Etienne Fessard after Jean Siméon Chardin
medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le duc de Chartres, son epouse et ses enfants
title: Le duc de Chartres, son epouse et ses enfants
assistive_text: The image shows four individuals in an interior setting. One woman sits on a bench holding a baby, while a small child stands on the bench next to her. A man stands beside the bench holding a hat and coat. A small dog is on the floor. The room is ornately decorated with a table, flowers, a painting on the wall, and a doorway.
creator: Augustin de Saint-Aubin and Isidore-Stanislas Helman
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le tric-trac
title: Le tric-trac
assistive_text: The image shows a group of four individuals gathered around a small table, three of whom are seated while one stands nearby. The framed portion features their upper bodies to lower legs, with the main focus on their activities at the table. The central seated woman is engaged in a board game, wearing an elaborate gown with prominently puffed sleeves and lace detailing. Seated across from her is a gentleman in a vested coat, while his hair is styled in a neat wave. Another seated individual leans in on the conversation, wearing similar period attire. The standing individual, dressed in an elaborate coat and hat, appears to be observing the game. In the background, the room is tastefully decorated with patterned walls and a large ornate framed painting depicting a figure in armor, along with draped curtains and a window introducing light.
creator: Jacques-Philippe Le Bas after Charles Eisen
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La comete
title: La comete
assistive_text: The image depicts four individuals in interior settings. The central figure is a man seated at a table, elegantly dressed. A woman stands beside him, engaged in conversation. Another woman sits at the table, and a man stands behind her. The room is richly detailed with ornate furniture, a small dog, a cat, wall sconces with candles, and a carved panel.
creator: Jacques-Philippe Le Bas after Charles Eisen
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Jeune Femme
title: La Jeune Femme
assistive_text: The image depicts three figures standing on a path in an outdoor setting. In the center is a young woman wearing a dress with floral decorations in her hair. To her left is an elderly man with white hair and a stern expression, wearing a tailcoat and holding a top hat. To her right is a younger man with dark hair and sideburns, elegantly dressed and also holding a top hat. In the background are trees, people in the distance, and a wooden fence.
creator: Philibert-Louis Debucourt
medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'Orange, ou le moderne Jugement de Paris
title: L'Orange, ou le moderne Jugement de Paris
assistive_text: The image displays a group of people in a room engaged in various activities. The scene shows three women and four men. The two women in the center are engaged in conversation with a man seated on a chair to their right. The man is shown from the side, sitting comfortably with one leg crossed over the other, holding an object in his hand. The women are dressed in elegant gowns with high waistlines, typical of the early 19th century, and have elaborately styled hair. One of them carries a fan. To the left, a few men in formal attire appear to be watching the interaction. One man standing to the farthest right is holding a long object resembling a cane or a stick. The background features a few decorative elements such as a candlestick and ornaments on a shelf.
creator: Philibert-Louis Debucourt
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Carnaval
title: Le Carnaval
assistive_text: The image depicts an outdoor scene of a carnival. A diverse group of people are gathered around a large carriage, with some individuals sitting or standing around it. On top of the carriage, several people are lounging, including a person in a striped outfit holding a wooden stick and others in various costumes. Attendees in period-style clothing with hats and gowns are below, some on horseback or holding canes. A horse is at the front of the carriage, and people in the crowd are engaging with each other. The background shows additional figures and trees, suggesting a festive outdoor environment.
creator: Philibert-Louis Debucourt
medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mlle. Lavergne
title: Mlle. Lavergne
assistive_text: The image shows a young woman depicted from the waist up, seated in a three-quarter view, focusing on a piece of paper she holds with both hands. Her head is slightly tilted downwards as she reads. She has delicate facial features with a serene expression, and her hair is styled up with a ribbon accentuating her curls. She wears an elaborate dress with intricate patterns on the bodice and sleeves, and the fabric is rich with textures and decorative embroidery. A cross necklace is around her neck. She sits against a plain background, and the chair she is sitting on is faintly visible.
creator: Jean Daullé and Simon Francois Ravenet I after Jean-Étienne Liotard
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le catechisme
title: Le catechisme
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of people inside a grand architectural space. The individuals are in period attire, with a female figure at the center and another figure on the right addressing the group. Various people of different ages and status are present, along with a dog sitting calmly near the center. The image is framed by ornate borders.
creator: Pierre Etienne Moitte after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Tableau des portraits a la mode
title: Tableau des portraits a la mode
assistive_text: This drawing depicts an elegant gathering scene in an 18th-century setting. The artwork features finely dressed figures interacting and observing each other, with carriages nearby. The background includes townhouses and a monument. In the foreground, a small dog is seen running. The detailed artwork portrays the social norms, fashion, and lifestyle of the era.
creator: Pierre-Francois Courtois after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ballet at the Opera
title: Ballet at the Opera
assistive_text: This is a detailed engraving showing elegantly dressed figures engaged in a dance. The scene is possibly set in a woodland clearing, with trees forming a canopy above. The engraving showcases fine lines, cross-hatching, and a monochromatic color palette to create textures and movement. Figures in motion, a seated woman, musicians, and a distant landscape are also depicted in the scene.
creator: Pierre-François Basan after Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Tavern
title: The Tavern
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a garden scene. The image shows elegantly dressed individuals dancing and socializing outdoors. The setting includes lush foliage, architecture, and a house with classic European design features. The figures are joyful, engaging in dancing and socializing near a table. There is musical accompaniment in the background, creating a celebratory mood in the garden party setting.
creator: Pierre-François Basan after Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Happy Union
title: The Happy Union
assistive_text: There is an image of two people sitting together in a lavishly detailed room. The man is seated on an armchair with one leg crossed over the other, while the woman is perched on the arm of the chair, leaning towards the man. Their bodies are depicted from head to knees. The man wears a tri-corner hat with a feather, a coat with intricate button detailing, waistcoat, breeches, and stockings. The woman has elaborate hair, and she wears a dress with ruffled sleeves and a decorative bodice, holding a small lyre-like musical instrument. The room has patterned wallpaper and a detailed carpet, a writing desk with a floral arrangement and a scroll, a wall sconce with candles, and a screen showing a domestic scene in the corner. An open book lies on the floor beside the chair.
creator: Louis Bosse after Sigmund Freudenberger
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'example des Meres
title: L'example des Meres
assistive_text: The image shows two figures, a woman and a child, in an indoor setting. The woman is seated in a chair, engaged in sewing or embroidery, holding a piece of cloth. She has a gentle expression, soft features, neatly styled hair with floral decorations, and wears an ornate gown with lace. The young girl stands beside her, leaning on the chair, with a decorative cap, buttons on her dress, and patterned embellishments. A pull toy shaped like a sheep on wheels is next to the girl. The background includes paneled walls, a fireplace with a candlestick, and a side table with a coffee set. A small sleeping dog is on the floor near the table.
creator: François Lucas after Etienne Jeaurat
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Carquois épuisé (The Empty Quiver)
title: Le Carquois épuisé (The Empty Quiver)
assistive_text: This print shows two people in a lavishly decorated room. On the left, a man is seated on an ornate sofa, leaning back comfortably with one arm on the backrest and one knee bent, his other leg extended. He wears a tailored outfit with a jacket and frilly cravat. He has light skin and light hair styled in curls around his ear. A discarded tricorn hat lies at his feet. He looks up at the woman standing next to him on the right. She wears a richly adorned dress with ruffles and lace, shoes with a small heel, a bracelet on her wrist, and ruffled collar around her neck. She also has light skin and light, curled hair, put in an updo on the top of her head. She holds a small makeup compact up to her face in one hand and a small brush in the other hand as she looks down at the man beside her. A small dog is near her feet, jumping up on its hind legs. The room features heavy draped curtains on the left and ornate furniture including a fireplace on the far right. To the right of the woman is a small folding screen decorated with an image of a man in a robe and a flat hat. In the center, above the woman, is a large statue of a cherub. It appears to aim a bow at the couple below, but the quiver by its side is empty. A large clock hangs on the wall above the cherub statue.
creator: Nicolas Delaunay after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Lever
title: Le Lever
assistive_text: The image shows three women in a richly decorated interior setting. One woman is central, depicted nearly in full, standing and wrapping herself with a piece of fabric. She has delicate facial features, classic makeup, and elegantly styled hair. Accompanied by a small dog on a chair beside her, behind her, to the left, stands another woman in a red gown with a white cap. To the right, the third woman sits in profile facing a mirror on an ornate wall. She wears a green dress with pink bows and a lace-adorned cap. The room features a patterned carpet, a canopy bed with blue and gold trimmings.
creator: Nicolas François Regnault
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Les cerises
title: Les cerises
assistive_text: The image displays three figures engaged in various activities. One male figure is on a ladder, reaching into a tree, possibly picking fruit or leaves. A second figure, a woman, stands near him gazing upward. A third figure, another woman, sits nearby, looking at the man and placing a hand on a dog beside her. In the background, a horse with a basket and some sheep can be seen. The scene is set outdoors, surrounded by trees, foliage, and hills in the distance. There are no visible jewelry items, but natural and rustic objects like a ladder and baskets are present. The setting is detailed and classical in style.
creator: Nicolas Ponce after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le chemin de la fortune
title: Le chemin de la fortune
assistive_text: The image captures a group of people in a room. On the left, a woman in an elaborate dress stands next to another woman seated on the floor wearing a bonnet. Next to them, a man stands holding a violin. Two other seated figures are present; one holds a book and the other is older, sitting on a chair holding a smoking pipe. A small dog sits by the seated man. The room features a bust, heavy curtains, a chandelier, pillars, a large framed circular painting, and a cello on the floor. In the background, there is a large round painting or relief with a reclining figure.
creator: Nicolas Joseph Voyez after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Déjeuné
title: Le Déjeuné
assistive_text: This print shows a group of five adults, a child, and a dog outdoors. The people have light skin and gray hair and are gathered around a small wooden table. There are three women and two men. On the left is a woman in a beige dress with a blue petticoat who is seated on a chair and holding her skirt flat. The two men are gathered around her, appearing to rinse a spot of her skirt with water. One of the men is in a red coat and blue breeches, and the other is in a black coat. At the edge of the table by the seated woman, a small child in a pink outfit holds one fist up to their eye with a distressed expression. On the right side of the table, two women stand, one in a pink dress and a wide brimmed hat with a red ribbon, and the other with a tan dress. A black tricorn hat lays on the ground on the bottom right, and on the left a small dog looks up at the scene. The background consists of tall trees, green shrubs, and a white tent-like structure behind the group. The sky is light blue and cloudy.
creator: Louis-Marin Bonnet after Jean-Baptiste Hüet, I
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sa taille est ravissante
title: Sa taille est ravissante
assistive_text: The image shows a woman seated at a vanity. She has delicate features, styled hair adorned with a bow and a confident expression. She is wearing an off-the-shoulder dress with ruffled sleeves. The vanity holds various objects. The woman's right hand holds a small item. The background includes a textured chair and the scene is framed within an oval boundary.
creator: Pierre Adrien Le Beau after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La toilette
title: La toilette
assistive_text: The image depicts three individuals within an elegantly decorated room. In the center, a woman stands near a bed, slightly turned towards a seated man on the right. Beside her, another woman assists with her attire. The man is dressed in fine attire, with a waistcoat and breeches. The room features a richly adorned wall, heavy drapery framing a window, and a small dog sitting beside the women. An intricate border surrounds the entire composition, featuring floral motifs and circular designs.
creator: Nicolas Ponce after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin with border by Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Marchez tout doux, parlez tout bas
title: Marchez tout doux, parlez tout bas
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an interior scene with intricate details of woodwork and furniture. In the center of the room, one figure appears surprised or alarmed, while another is at the window holding a pair of shoes. The room features a bed, detailed fabric, and a side door leading to another area. The drawing has classical elements and emotional expressions, suggesting a sense of narrative drama within a domestic setting. An ornate border and decorative emblem frame the illustration at the bottom.
creator: Pierre-Philippe Choffard after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La soiree des Thuileries
title: La soiree des Thuileries
assistive_text: The image shows two people sitting outside. The woman is standing to the left, leaning forward with one foot on an overturned chair, while the man is reclined in a chair with his arm over the backrest. The woman has elegant curled hair and wears a decorative hat, with delicate facial features and intricate clothing. The man wears clothing typical of 18th-century fashion. A small dog sits nearby. They are in front of a large stone structure, possibly a pedestal with a sculpture on top. The background includes trimmed hedges, tall trees, and cloudy skies, suggesting a formal garden setting.
creator: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le léger vêtement
title: Le léger vêtement
assistive_text: This image displays a young woman depicted from the waist up within an oval frame. She is seated with her right arm resting on a surface, supporting her head with her hand. Her serene facial expression features delicate features, including a slightly smiling mouth and high-arched eyebrows. Her hair is styled with curls framing her face and decorated with small floral ornaments. She wears a gown with a low neckline and ruffled sleeves, accessorized with a string of beads around her neck. In her left hand, she holds a small bouquet of flowers. The background features a subtle pattern and a cluster of flowers, adding to the portrait's elegant and decorative ambiance.
creator: Juste Chevillet after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le cocarde nationale
title: Le cocarde nationale
assistive_text: Two smooth-faced, smiling people embrace and look at us in a room a fireplace, chairs, and a table in this vertical, colored etching and aquatint. The couple are in the center of the composition. To the right in that pair, one person sits in a wood chair with an upholstered seat and the other stands. Both people have pale skin with rosy cheeks, wide-set, large brown eyes, delicate noses and mouths, and pointed chins. The seated person is dressed in a military uniform with a white vest, a rose-pink coat, white, knee-length britches, white stockings, and black shoes with silver buckles. His ankles are crossed and the britches trimmed with powder-blue at the knees. A sword hangs from his left hip, to our right. He has dark gray, curly hair under a bicorn hat, which has a blue and dark pink badge on the front and blue and white feathers issuing from the top. The woman stands close to him, and he rests the hand we can see on her waist. Her puffy, ash-blond hair curls along her shoulders and falls down her back. Her white bodice is cut low across an ample bosom, and pin ribbons are tied around the upper arm we can see. She wears a pale, sky-blue, voluminous skirt. She holds the seated person’s chin with one hand and touches the hat with the other. A long stringed instrument lies across the seat and armrest of a chair just behind her. A table next to that, along the left edge of the sheet, holds a white bottle and piece of cloth, perhaps a lacy cap. A mantle with a bellows and a screen is to the right of and behind the man. A gold-colored ormolu clock sits on the mantle and a gold double candle sconce hangs to the left on molding that frames the fireplace. More furniture, perhaps a dresser, is in the background in front of a sable-brown wall.
creator: Auguste-Claude-Simon Legrand after Louis-Léopold Boilly
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: It was pulled today (On la tire aujourd'hui)
title: It was pulled today (On la tire aujourd'hui)
assistive_text: A man and woman look at each other near a door as a second woman sits at a dressing table in this vertical, colored print. All three people have pale skin. The man’s body faces the partially open door, which is to our left, but he turns to look and smile at the woman embracing him from behind. He has chin-length gray hair and wears a black, brimmed hat, a high-collared, white shirt with a frilly cravat, a baby-blue vest, a tan, shin-length jacket, peach-colored, knee-length breeches, white stockings, and black shoes. He holds four papers with writing and signatures down by his right side, to our left. The woman behind him reaches one hand gently for the papers as she wraps the other around his other arm. She has long, brown hair and wears a high, wide-brimmed straw bonnet piled with carnation-pink bows. Her dress has a teal-blue bodice over a white, elbow-length shirt, which is pulled partially down her chest to reveal one pale pink nipple. A powder-blue shoe pokes out from her long, voluminous silvery-blue skirt. To the right and farther into the room, the woman at the table holds both hands to a cap on her long brown hair as she looks at us and smiles faintly. Her loose white gown is cinched at the waist and falls to her ankles. The bodice has a low neckline, and the sleeves are rolled up to her elbows. She wears white stockings and backless pink slippers with pointed toes. On the table are a round box with a white poof with a handle, scissors, a brown ribbon, and a rectangular brown object, presumably a mirror. A blue garment hangs over the arm of the chair we can see. Light falls on the couple near the door and the rest of the room is in shadow. Celestial-blue curtains fall in front of a bed behind the seated woman. Text in the margin below the image reads, “ON LA TIRE AUJOURD'HUI.” Much smaller, cursive printed text under the left corner reads “L. Boilly pinx,” and under the right corner, “Salv. Tresca Sculpt.”
creator: Salvatore Tresca after Louis-Léopold Boilly
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Que n'y est-il encore?
title: Que n'y est-il encore?
assistive_text: The image shows a woman standing in the center. She is slightly turned to her left, with her gaze directed upwards. The woman has long, wavy dark hair with a red ribbon tied around her head. She is wearing a light-colored blouse, a full beige skirt, and holding a draped purple garment in her left arm. Clothing is draped over a chair near her, and a decorative metal pitcher and basin are positioned behind her. In the background, there is a bed, deep green curtains, a decorative frieze above a door, and a cushioned seat with clothes and a hat. The scene suggests a private interior space with classical decor.
creator: Louis Petit after Louis-Léopold Boilly
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le bain des pieds (The Foot-Bath)
title: Le bain des pieds (The Foot-Bath)
assistive_text: The image shows two individuals in a richly decorated room. The first person, a woman, sits on an upholstered chair with one leg resting in an ornate basin. She appears to be washing or soaking her foot. She gazes towards the other person, with loose, curly hair flowing. She is dressed in a robe that is slightly open at the chest, with fabric draping around her legs. A small animal sits beside her feet. The second person, likely a man, leans forward from behind a room divider. He wears a tricorn hat and long coat, holding the edge of the hat in one hand and offering a small object with the other. The room is elaborate, with intricate moldings, an ornate cabinet or armoire, and a tall candlestick holder on a table. The walls feature detailed patterns, possibly landscapes or relief scenes.
creator: Antoine Cosme Giraud after Antoine Borel
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jupiter and Leda
title: Jupiter and Leda
assistive_text: The image shows two individuals who are mostly unclothed, with their bodies partially obscured by drapery. They are positioned close together on the ground, with luxurious fabric draped around them. The person on the left is on their knees, with their torso turned toward the viewer, their face lightly resting against the shoulder of the other person. The individual on the right is seated and leaning back slightly, appearing to gesture with their right arm extended upwards. Both have youthful and soft facial features, with curly hair styled close to their heads. Around them are foliage, leaves, branches, and flowers, creating a lush setting. A swan is positioned at their feet. The scene is set against a tapestry of rocky formations covered with plant engravings.
creator: William Wynne Ryland after François Boucher
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le reveil
title: Le reveil
assistive_text: The image shows a woman lying on her stomach on a bed made of soft cushions and draped in fabric. She is propped up on her elbows, with her chin resting on her hands, looking outside the frame. She has a slight smile and her hair is styled in an updo. There is a small table next to her with a decorative urn or teapot and a ribbon on top. The background features a textured wall with panels and drapery.
creator: Pierre Charles Levesque after François Boucher
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'Amant surpris
title: L'Amant surpris
assistive_text: The image shows two people in a park. One person is standing, covering the eyes of the seated individual. The standing person has curly brown hair, a hat with a red ribbon, and wears a light-colored dress with a brown sash. The seated person wears a red vest, a blue coat, and beige trousers. The seated person is smiling and leaning back. The setting includes lush greenery, trees, flowering bushes, a large potted plant on a stone pedestal, and a stone cherub statue. Papers are scattered on the ground.

name: Mme. de M ... en habit de bal
title: Mme. de M ... en habit de bal
assistive_text: The image shows a portrait of a woman displayed from the waist up as she sits in a chair. Her body is angled slightly to the side with her head turned toward the viewer. She has a delicate facial structure with her eyes looking directly outward, a subtle smile, and her hair styled in an elaborate updo adorned with a bow. The woman is dressed in an ornate gown featuring intricate patterns and decorations, such as bows and tassels. She holds a small mask in her left hand. Around her neck is a choker, and she wears earrings. The chair she sits in is upholstered and decorated with elegant carvings. In the background, there is a classical architectural element, such as a column, and the area is shaded with vertical lines.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Compliment ou La Matinée du jour de l'an (The Compliment or New Year's Morning)

assistive_text: The image shows a group of people in an indoor setting. On the left, an older man is seated in a chair, leaning forward with an open smile. Opposite him, an older woman is seated, smiling gently. Beside her stands a middle-aged man with curly hair and a decorative hat. A young girl in a brown dress and a young boy in a light-colored outfit stand beside them. The young boy is engaging with the seated man. Behind them, a man in a dark military-style coat stands next to a table with various objects. The room has paintings and a clock mounted on the walls, suggesting a formal and elegant ambiance of the late 18th century.

The woman in the center is wearing a white gown with floral decorations on her head. The man on the right is holding a palette and paintbrushes, dressed in a brown suit coat. The background includes a large painting, an artist's easel, a guitar, a bust, and a bookcase. There are draped curtains, tall windows, and a wooden floor.

Various elements of nature and human life are present around the fountain, including lush greenery, tall trees forming a canopy in the background, plants with vibrant flowers, a small animal by the fountain, and haystacks or a pile of straw. Dispersed clothing items suggest that someone may have been present. The painting is in the style of Jean-Baptiste Greuze.
creator: Philibert-Louis Debucourt
medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'Escalade, ou les Adieux du Matin

The woman is standing beside him, facing slightly towards him, and holding a small bundle. Both have wavy hair. The man wears a wide-brimmed hat, a white shirt, blue trousers, and a blue coat draped over one shoulder. The woman wears a white gown with an apron tied around her waist. They are both barefoot. A dog is beside the woman, and a rooster is near the stone steps to the right. In the background, there is a thatched cottage, stone walls, and dense, overhanging trees.

medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper

name: Le Menuet de la mariee (The Bride's Minuet)
title: Le Menuet de la mariee (The Bride's Minuet)
assistive_text: The painting depicts an outdoor gathering scene with figures engaged in conversation, dancing, and various activities typical of a festive event. The central focus is a group of people in elaborate period costumes, with others around them in different postures. There is a makeshift dwelling or pavilion draped with fabric in the background. Trees and a cloudy sky complete the setting. This artwork is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson, known for his detailed depiction of English social life in the 18th century.

medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'Oiseau ranime

title: The Palais Royal--Garden's Walk / Promenade du Jardin du Palais Royal
assistive_text: This is a painting of a gathering in a garden with striped tents and large trees providing shade. The architecture in the background suggests an urban setting. The people in the painting are dressed in elaborate, colorful attire. The style is reminiscent of Jean-Honoré Fragonard, known for lively scenes and intricate compositions of the Rococo period.

medium: wash manner with etching and engraving, printed in blue, red, yellow, and black inks

name: La Promenade Publique

assistive_text: This is a painting of a social gathering in an outdoor setting. Numerous elegantly dressed individuals are under a canopy of trees in a garden or park. In the foreground, there are chairs and a table with figures interacting. The participants wear 18th-century style clothing. The painting depicts movement and social dynamics. This is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.

name: Pauvre Annette

She has light, curly hair that falls to her shoulders and wears a wide-brimmed straw hat adorned with a ribbon and flowers. Her facial features include a delicate nose and slightly smiling lips. She is dressed in a voluminous gown featuring layers of earthy colors, with a blueish underskirt and a warm-toned shawl. Her left hand rests on her lap. She wears a pendant on a ribbon around her neck. A large straw basket or bundle is positioned behind her, and she is surrounded by foliage with a large tree to the left. In the background, the scenery includes lush greenery with a mix of trees and bushy plants under a cloudy but bright sky. To the right, there is a large, overturned urn or terracotta vase resting on the ground.

medium: etching and aquatint with hand coloring on laid paper

name: Frascati
title: Frascati

The setting features an opulent interior with architectural elements such as gilded molding, tall windows draped with curtains, and classical statues. Large chandeliers hang in the center of the room. Figures dressed in formal attire are engaged in conversation, socializing, and leisure activities. Small groups of people are seated around tables, while others walk around the space. The painting captures the sophisticated atmosphere of the gathering.

medium: etching and aquatint with hand coloring on wove paper

name: Madame du Barry

The clothing is formal, featuring a high-collared shirt with intricate lacework and a buttoned coat with noticeable texture. The background consists of a patterned surface enclosed by a decorative oval border.

Her hair is styled in an elaborate manner typical of the period, likely powdered and arranged upwards. She wears a white garment with lace details and holds a teacup and saucer. A man in a colorful coat and blue feathered turban is serving her, holding a tray with a small kettle. In the background are draped green and beige curtains, suggesting a setting with a canopy or bed. The scene exudes an atmosphere of luxury.

A small figure resembling Cupid is on the harpsichord. The room has heavy drapery, architectural details, and a chandelier illuminating the scene.

name: Le jour

name: Le belle nourrice

name: Le matin

The seated woman appears serene and is wearing a loose-fitting gown. The man beside her wears a coat and breeches, with styled hair. The person attending to her has simpler attire, possibly indicating a servant. A table on the left holds a pitcher and goblet. On the right, a window with drapery lets in light, with a bird on a stand nearby and a small dog on a cushioned stool. The background features rich decor like curtains, tapestries, and artwork.

name: L'apres-midi
title: L'apres-midi

The scene features several individuals gathered around a small table in a classical setting with tall columns and an ornamental garden in the background, including a fountain and statues. The participants are engaged in conversation and are dressed in formal, period attire. A parrot is perched on the pillar. The architectural elements and scenery show precision and style typical of the period, emphasizing a balance between nature and human-made structures.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'ete
title: L'ete

The setting includes a lush environment with hills in the background, and a small flow of water cascading from an archway-like structure decorated with natural elements. There are figures engaged in activities in the foreground, including one seated and holding a fan, and another leaning close. A dog stands by the fountain. In the distance, a small village with a church steeple can be seen. The style and technique suggest delicacy and precision typical of a particular period known for capturing the simplicity and charm of rustic life.

name: L'hiver
title: L'hiver

One man is standing in the center, another person is tending to skates on the ground, and a couple is seated on a sled with a dog. Other figures are visible in the distance, engaged in various activities. The background features barren trees against a cloudy sky. The style of the image is detailed, linear, and monochrome with sepia tones. The brushstrokes emphasize texture and depth.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Country Dance
title: Country Dance
assistive_text: This drawing depicts a group of well-dressed individuals in a forest clearing, engaging in leisure activities. The scene captures a lively and graceful atmosphere typical of a Rococo style gathering, with figures positioned in various poses. The attire, expressions, and play of light and shadow bring vibrancy to the composition. The background features lush trees and foliage, creating a romantic setting that complements the elegance of the foreground figures. The drawing conveys a sense of sophistication and leisure characteristic of the era.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Rural Concert

They are seated on the ground under trees. The background shows open countryside with trees and foliage. In the distance, there is a building or estate. A dog is also part of the gathering. The drawing emphasizes the textures of the clothing and natural elements.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Satyrs' Dance (Danse de satyres)

On the left, a figure with goat-like features and horns holds two infant-like beings. On the right, a woman with flowing hair holds an object, while a cherubic child dances next to her. The setting is a lush garden with various plants and ivy, and a stone pillar and an urn decorated with a face motif are in the background.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

A curtain and architectural column are in the background, framed ornately with decorative patterns.

name: Les Baignets
title: Les Baignets

An individual tends to a pot or pan over a fire, while a dog watches nearby. The backdrop includes a brick or stone wall and a view of trees and foliage through an opening, indicating an outdoor setting. The composition is circular, emphasizing the central gathering and creating a sense of warmth and community.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'Education fait tout

The central area shows an interior space with a brick backdrop and leafy decoration near a window. The figures are engaged in a gathering, with one figure gesturing enthusiastically. The clothing and surroundings suggest a historical or rustic setting. The frame's decorative elements enhance the classic and timeless quality of the scene.

name: La Bonne Mère

She is dressed in a flowing gown. The child on her lap seems to be resting, while the other child pours liquid from a jug. The background is filled with foliage, creating a serene atmosphere. The image is framed in an oval shape.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La famille du fermier
title: La famille du fermier
assistive_text: The image shows a group of people engaging in different activities within a historical setting. The scene includes mostly full body depictions of individuals. In the center, a woman is seated, wearing a flowing dress, and holding a baby, while another woman leans over her shoulder to look at the child. Both women have their hair tied back. The baby has curly hair and is being held gently. Another child is seen to the side, also with curly hair, near a pet or livestock animal. To the far right, through a window space, another person, wearing a hat, interacts with a goat which is peering in. The individuals are wearing long, draped garments. In this scene, a child sitting on the floor holds a small animal or object. Around them, textured stone columns, an open window with draped curtains, and rustic furnishings set a classical environment. The floor appears uneven, with cracked tiles and stray objects. A basket hangs on the wall to the right, and various household items can be seen in the background.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Little Park (Le petit parc)
title: The Little Park (Le petit parc)
assistive_text: The image depicts a garden scene with lush vegetation, architectural elements, and human figures. The horizon appears high, with a wall and architectural features obscured by plants. The intricate etching style uses continuous lines for texture and detail. The monochromatic palette in varying shades of gray creates a serene atmosphere. A lion statue and human figures are visible in a clearing, adding depth. The sky features clouds with subtle hints of light.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La cruche cassee

In the background, there is a stone fountain with a sculpted lion's head from which water flows, and some trees are visible. The portrait is enclosed within an oval design.

name: La laitiere
title: La laitiere

Her facial expression is neutral, with soft features and slightly downturned eyes, as her lips remain closed. The woman wears a light-colored headscarf that wraps around her curly hair and matches her flowing, gathered dress, which is detailed with folds and a low neckline. The horse next to her has a dark coat, a white muzzle, and is wearing a simple bridle. Behind her, there are baskets filled with cloth or fabric. In the background, there are lightly sketched clouds that complement the classical style of the engraving.

name: La premiere lecon d'amour

She is wearing a long dress with loose sleeves and a shawl falling off her shoulders. Nearby, a small table holds two birds, possibly doves. There is a draped cloth on the table edge. In the background, there is a chest of drawers with a round container and a bottle on top. The room has a classic style with wall paneling and a luxurious chair. The setting is dimly lit, emphasizing the woman.

Nearby are a hat with feathers, a table with books, and in the background are more books and a globe. The background is textured.

name: La voluptueuse

The woman is dressed in a loose-fitting garment that drapes over her shoulders, revealing the upper part of her chest. Below the main image is a smaller circular illustration featuring a reclining figure surrounded by floral arrangements. The background consists of decorative floral motifs.

name: L'Amant écouté

A bouquet of flowers is on the floor beside the table.

name: L'agreable neglige

name: L'Oiseau privé

name: Projet d'un monument a ériger pour le roi
title: Projet d'un monument a ériger pour le roi
assistive_text: This is a painting of a grand monument in a historical town square. The artwork depicts a large stone pedestal with bronze statues mounted on top. The central figures atop the pedestal include two standing men in historical attire, seemingly engaged in conversation, with one of them gesturing towards the other. At the base, a seated female figure holding a book emanates a sense of wisdom and contemplation. The foreground shows a bustling scene with elegantly dressed figures and a running dog. The background features classical architectural buildings. The sky above is vast and cloudy. This is in the style of an 18th-century European artist, capturing the grandeur and tradition of the depicted era.
creator: Jean-François Janinet after Jean-Michel Moreau
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Les heures du jour
title: Les heures du jour
assistive_text: The image features four circular illustrations, each showing a woman in a different setting. In the top left circle, a woman is sitting on an outdoor bench with a parasol. In the top right circle, two women are seated at a table. The bottom left circle shows a woman lounging on a chaise, and the bottom right circle depicts a woman at a writing desk. Each illustration is detailed with a focus on fashion, posture, and surroundings.
creator: Jean-François Janinet after Nicolas Lavreince
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Marie-Antoinette, Dauphine
title: Marie-Antoinette, Dauphine
assistive_text: The image shows a portrait of a person displayed from the mid-torso up. The individual faces slightly to the left, with their gaze forward. They have a pale complexion, delicate facial features, and powdered hair styled pulled back. The person wears a garment with a red fur-trimmed collar and a light blue bow at the neckline. No jewelry is visible. The background features an oval frame with decorative leaf motifs on a dark, textured backdrop. An inscription below the oval states the name and title of the person depicted.
creator: Louis-Marin Bonnet after Joseph Kranzinger
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'assemblee au concert
title: L'assemblee au concert
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an indoor scene featuring individuals gathered for a musical concert. The drawing depicts an opulently decorated room with a domed ceiling adorned with floral designs and classical statues. On the left, three individuals are engaged in conversation, while on the right, musicians are seen preparing for a performance. In the center, an individual is seated at a piano-like instrument. The use of intricate lines and shading techniques highlights the details of the scene.
creator: Francois-Nicolas-Barthelemy Dequevauviller after Nicolas Lavreince
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Billet doux
title: Le Billet doux
assistive_text: The image depicts three individuals in an ornate room. In the center, a man is slightly bent forward, holding the hand of a seated woman on the right. The man has curly, shoulder-length hair tied back and is dressed in a period-style coat, waistcoat, knee breeches, and shoes with buckles. The seated woman has a braided updo adorned with feathers, wearing an elaborately decorated gown among musical instruments. The third individual, another seated woman on the left, is reading a document. She wears a similar period gown with elaborate detail and styled hair. The room features classical architectural elements, such as grand columns and arches, with a highly decorative wall, sconces, and relief sculptures. An elaborate coat of arms flanked by lions is visible in the foreground.
creator: Nicolas Delaunay after Nicolas Lavreince
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Qu'en dit l'Abbé?
title: Qu'en dit l'Abbé?
assistive_text: This print features nine individuals in an opulent interior. The people are shown engaging in various poses, including standing, sitting, and leaning. They all have pale skin and elaborate hairstyles of white and gray curls. Their clothing is formal and richly detailed, with the women wearing ornate gowns with ruffles and the men dressed in tailored suits with waistcoats and breeches. To the right of center, a woman lounges in a chair, with two people attending to her, one of them combing her hair. On the left, three people are turned toward her, examining a long sheet of paper or cloth decorated with curving vines. Behind them, two people whisper together on the far left. On the far right, a person sits with their back to us, appearing to work with a stringed instrument like a lute. The setting is an elegant room with a high ceiling adorned with decorative garlands, columns, and draped curtains framing large arched windows. The ceiling features cherubs and intricate molding. In the background, tall doors with classical details can be seen, partially open.
creator: Nicolas Delaunay after Nicolas Lavreince
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'heureux moment
title: L'heureux moment
assistive_text: The image captures two people, a man kneeling in front of a seated woman. The man is dressed in historical attire and has his hair tied back. The woman wears an elaborate gown and an intricate headpiece. A small dog is on the sofa next to her. The room is ornately decorated with drapery, wall decorations, a pedestal with an urn, and an oval portrait of a cherub surrounded by floral designs. An armchair and a folding screen are in the foreground, with a small table holding a pillow and fabric next to the woman.
creator: Nicolas Delaunay after Nicolas Lavreince
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le coucher des ouvrieres en modes
title: Le coucher des ouvrieres en modes
assistive_text: The engraving shows several women in a dimly lit room engaged in various activities. One woman leans against a drawer, two women are seated at a table working, another woman stands holding fabric, and another woman is seated in conversation with a standing woman. The women wear elegant gowns and have styled hair. In the background, a woman is changing clothes near a bed canopy. The room has wooden ceiling beams, a painting on the wall, and a small table with a mirror.
creator: Francois-Nicolas-Barthelemy Dequevauviller after Nicolas Lavreince
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le joli chien
title: Le joli chien
assistive_text: The image shows the upper half of a person reclining on a bed covered with draped fabric, with a small dog nearby. The person is positioned on their side with one arm raised, wearing a bonnet and elegant clothing. The room is elaborately furnished, with a candle on a bedside table and ornate curtains with fringe details enclosing the bed. A chair piled with fabrics is slightly visible on the right side. The setting suggests a period ambiance, indicated by the furniture and clothing style.
creator: Auguste-Claude-Simon Legrand after Nicolas Lavreince
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le restaurant
title: Le restaurant
assistive_text: The image shows three individuals in an ornate room. A man and a woman are seated on a luxurious canopied bed in a half-hidden alcove, while another person, a woman, stands beside them. The seated woman has a delicate face with intricate hairstyle adorned with flowers. The man beside her has medium-length hair styled in soft waves. They both gaze towards each other and are dressed in opulent clothing. The standing woman is turned partially away and wears an elaborate gown. She holds a small cup or object, possibly offering it to the seated couple. The room is richly decorated, with a grand draped canopy over the bed, an ornate urn on a pedestal, an elegantly designed chair, and a large floral arrangement on a table by an archway.
creator: Jeanne Deny or Martial Deny after Niclas Lafrensen II
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le retour trop precipite
title: Le retour trop precipite
assistive_text: Three individuals are depicted in a garden setting. A woman is seated on the ground, leaning back slightly with her upper body supported by her arms, gazing upwards towards a man who is kneeling beside her while holding her hand. The woman has curly hair and wears a flowing dress with a ruffled neckline. The man, who leans towards her, is dressed in a coat and breeches and has his hair tied back. Behind them, a second woman walks towards them. She wears a large hat adorned with bows and a full-length dress with wide skirts, and her hair is styled in curls under her hat. The first woman and the man both appear relaxed, surrounded by dense foliage. Near them, a small dog lies on the ground. To the left of the image, there is a statue of a cherub on a pedestal. In the background, tall trees frame the scene, and fluffy clouds are visible in the sky above.
creator: Jean Antoine Pierron
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le seducteur
title: Le seducteur
assistive_text: The image shows five individuals in a lavishly decorated interior. On the right, a woman is reclined against a bed or chaise, wearing an elegant gown, and holding a dog on her lap. Another man is seated on the floor to her left. Three other figures are clustered further left; a standing man with a tricorn hat, a woman with elaborate hair, and another woman. The figures wear 18th-century clothing. The room has wooden paneling, ornate ceiling molding, an oval portrait on the wall, and a draped curtain. The floor has an intricate pattern, and there is a side table in the room.
