creator: after Niclas Lafrensen II
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le coup de vent (The Gust of Wind)
title: Le coup de vent (The Gust of Wind)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with two human figures, a dog, and a cupid. The figures appear engaged in a playful movement, with one gesturing and the other maintaining balance. A dog is nearby, and a cherubic cupid is pointing an arrow. The background includes a rocky landscape with a waterfall and overhanging branches.
creator: Abraham Girardet after Antoine Lebel
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La cage symbolique (The Symbolic Cage)
title: La cage symbolique (The Symbolic Cage)
assistive_text: The image shows three people; a woman seated on the right, a man and a young girl standing near her. The woman is seated on a cushioned chair, wearing a ruffled dress, an ornate hat with feathers, and holding an open book. The man is kneeling slightly towards the left, shown in profile, with short hair and wearing a tailored coat. The girl stands between them, holding a birdcage with a bird inside. She has her hair styled up and wears an elaborate dress. The setting is an opulent interior with draped curtains, wall paneling, and a decorative emblem. A side table holds vases and a candlestick, and a dog is seated on the floor to the right of the girl.
creator: Etienne Fessard after Charles Lepeintre
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: On y court plus d'un danger
title: On y court plus d'un danger
assistive_text: The image shows a woman on a swing pushed by a man, with a small dog nearby. Trees with detailed foliage surround the scene. The background is a lush forest. The artwork is created using fine-lined brushstrokes, capturing textures and details. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly browns and tans. Light and shadow are used to enhance the detailed rendering.
creator: Louis Germain and Charles Emmanuel Patas after Louis Gabriel Moreau
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Nouvelles du bien-aime
title: Nouvelles du bien-aime
assistive_text: The image shows two women in a cozy, intimate setting. One woman is sitting on a bed, partially reclining, with her legs elegantly crossed and draped in a loose, flowing gown that exposes her shoulders. Her hair is styled up. The other woman is seated closely, leaning forward with an attentive posture. She has long hair cascading down and is clothed in a detailed, long-sleeved dress. She appears to be engaged in conversation with the reclining woman. The setting is adorned with luxurious drapery and a side table with an ornate pitcher. The background is rich in fabrics and textures. The scene is within an oval frame, part of a larger artwork with intricate designs and embedded text elements.
creator: François Marie Isidore Queverdo and Antoine Louis Romanet
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Derniere heure de la Baronne de Rebecque
title: Derniere heure de la Baronne de Rebecque
assistive_text: The image shows a woman's face and part of her upper body enclosed in an oval frame. She is depicted in a relaxed, slightly reclined position, with her head slightly tilted to the side. She has delicate facial features, almond-shaped eyes, and a serene expression. Her hair is partially covered. She is wearing a voluminous, ruffled cloth wrapped around her head and upper body, adorned with intricate detailing and texture. The background is a plain, textured surface that complements the circular framed design, emphasizing the woman's detailed clothing and facial expression.
creator: Augustin de Saint-Aubin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le bal pare
title: Le bal pare
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an elaborate ballroom scene. The image depicts an opulent interior with finely detailed walls adorned with classical motifs and large draped windows. Several grand chandeliers hang from the ornate ceiling, illuminating the room with soft candlelight. The floor is filled with elaborately dressed figures, all wearing period clothing that suggests an 18th-century setting. The central figures are engaged in a dance. surrounding them are onlookers seated or standing, talking amongst themselves or watching the dancers. The scene conveys an air of elegance and refinement, reflecting the social activities and formal gatherings of the time.
creator: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le concert
title: Le concert
assistive_text: This is a drawing depicting a grand salon setting with elegantly dressed figures. The detailed interior scene shows an ornately decorated room with drapery-covered windows, elaborate wall moldings, and strategically placed busts and statues. A group of individuals in period attire is seen conversing or admiring a central activity, possibly involving music, as suggested by the presence of musical instruments and music sheets. Intricate details fill the room, capturing an opulent social gathering from the 18th century. The style is classical with attention to textures, patterns, and architectural elements like the ceiling fresco and columned walls.
creator: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Place to the First Occupier
title: The Place to the First Occupier
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an interior scene within a rustic setting. The image shows a cluttered room with various objects scattered around. In the lower section of the circle, figures are depicted sitting or reclining among objects like wooden boards, a basket, ropes, and textiles. Details in the room include everyday objects such as a bottle, hats, shoes, and a sketching board leaning against a chair. The light source appears indirect, casting soft shadows and highlighting the textures of draped fabrics. A window on the left shows an outdoor view framed by a lattice pattern. A central focus is created by the circle format of the drawing, emphasizing the cozy yet chaotic environment. A ceiling beam in the upper part of the drawing is adorned with what could be a small animal resting or sleeping. The setting conveys casual disarray and intimacy.
creator: Antoine-François Sergent after Augustin de Saint-Aubin
medium: etching and wash manner printed in brown on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Marie-Thérèse-Charlotte, Duchess of Angoulême
title: Marie-Thérèse-Charlotte, Duchess of Angoulême
assistive_text: The image shows a woman's upper body portrait. She is facing the viewer with slightly turned position. She has large eyes, a small nose, and a subtle expression with a beauty mark above her lip. She has curly, shoulder-length brown hair partially covered by a sheer black veil. She wears a dark high-collared dress with lace trim at the neckline and a purple sash around her waist. The background is a uniform dark oval framed within a border, and below the portrait, there is text identifying her as Marie-Thérèse-Charlotte, daughter of King Louis XVI. The image is within a rectangular frame with additional writing below the main portrait.
creator: Christian von Mechel after Antoine-François Sergent
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Caffeé des Patriotes - A Patriot's Coffée House
title: Caffeé des Patriotes - A Patriot's Coffée House
assistive_text: This is a painting of the interior of a coffee house. The scene shows a crowded space with people engaging in various activities like conversation and reading. The room is lit by a large window, with simple decorative elements on the ceiling. The individuals are dressed in period attire from the 18th or early 19th century, with details like tricorn hats and knee-length coats. The setting reflects a social atmosphere typical of coffee houses known for being social and intellectual hubs. This painting is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.
creator: Jean-Baptiste Morret after Jacques-François-Joseph Swebach-Desfontaines
medium: color etching and wash manner, printed in blue, red, yellow, and black inks, on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le danger des bosquets
title: Le danger des bosquets
assistive_text: The image shows an engraving of a woman seated, with one arm resting on a surface. She has an elaborate 18th-century hairstyle, a composed expression, and wears a formal gown with lace and ribbon embellishments. The background depicts trees and foliage. The image is framed with floral motifs and decorative elements.
creator: Pierre Adrien Le Beau after Nicolas Tanché
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Noce de Village (Village Wedding)
title: Noce de Village (Village Wedding)
assistive_text: This is a painting of a scene at a fair or gathering beneath a large canopy or tent. Various containers and barrels are present, adding to the rustic feel of the setting. Wooden structures and ropes suggest a temporary and utilitarian setup. Wisps of smoke or haze are visible in the atmosphere. The characters are dressed in period attire indicative of an 18th-century setting, with women's dresses and men's coats and hats. The style is reminiscent of Jean-Baptiste Joseph Pater, known for his depictions of festive gatherings and outdoor scenes.
creator: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
medium: color etching and wash-manner engraving on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Foire de Village
title: Foire de Village
assistive_text: The image depicts an outdoor scene from what appears to be an 18th-century setting. The point of view is from a slight elevation, showing a crowd gathered for a performance on a small stage to the right. The stage is surrounded by tall trees with lush foliage blending into the sky. The horizon is not visible, as the scene is enclosed by the foliage and stage. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, capturing intricate textures of trees, clothing, and facial expressions of the figures. The color palette is muted and earthy, with shades of green dominating the landscape, contrasted by warmer tones of people's attire. Closest to us, two dogs stand on the grass, while a child holds a woman's hand slightly left of center. Further in the distance, behind the crowd, tents are pitched, indicating a temporary festive setting.
creator: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Belle Jardinière - Madame de Pompadour
title: La Belle Jardinière - Madame de Pompadour
assistive_text: The image depicts a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is seated in a relaxed posture, slightly angled to the side, looking directly at the viewer with a composed expression. She has an oval face, soft eyes, and a subtle smile. Her hair is styled in an elegant updo, and she wears a large, broad-brimmed hat. The woman is dressed in a flowing garment with ruffles and bows at the shoulders. She holds a bouquet of flowers in one hand, with additional flowers and a rope basket in her lap. She wears an earring and a ribbon around her neck. The background shows foliage, implying an outdoor setting, creating a serene and refined atmosphere.
creator: Jean-Louis Anselin after Carle Van Loo
medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La soiree du Palais Royal
title: La soiree du Palais Royal
assistive_text: The image shows three individuals outdoors. On the left, a seated woman faces her companion. The woman on the left wears a dress and a hat with feathers. The woman next to her wears a dress with ruffles and holds a fan. A man stands nearby, wearing a coat and holding a cane. In the background, there is a garden with a large statue on a pedestal, surrounded by trees and foliage. A small dog is next to the seated women.
creator: Jean Gabriel Caquet after François-André Vincent
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Frontispiece: J.J. Rousseau
title: Frontispiece: J.J. Rousseau
assistive_text: The engraving features the upper half of a man's body, from the chest upwards. He faces slightly to the right but looks directly at the viewer with a calm expression. His facial features include a pronounced forehead, defined eyebrows, and a straight nose. His hair is styled back with curls at the sides. He wears a formal coat, vest, white shirt, and collar. No jewelry is visible. The portrait is within an oval frame, and below is a rectangular block engraved with "J.J. ROUSSEAU." The background is a plain shape around the oval frame.
creator: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Maurice-Quentin de La Tour
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La provocation
title: La provocation
assistive_text: The image shows three men in an interior setting. The man on the left is standing beside a chair, facing forward, with his left hand resting on the back of the chair. He is wearing 18th-century style clothing. The central man is seated on the chair, with his arms stretched out in front of him, and his face turned slightly to the right. The third man is standing on the right, gesturing outward with one hand. They are gathered around a small circular table with a lit candle. Two more chairs are part of the setting on either side of the table. The room has tall walls and is decorated with heavy drapery that falls from the ceiling. Additionally, there are objects on the right side, including another candle on a desk, a book, and a small vase or pitcher. The background is nondescript with muted shadows and textures.
creator: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Michel Moreau
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La confiance des belles âmes
title: La confiance des belles âmes
assistive_text: The image shows three individuals in front of a gate. In the center, a woman in a wide-brimmed hat and a dress is being held by two men. The man on her left wears a long coat and boots, while the man on her right is opening the gate. Behind them, there is a man loading a carriage, and a small dog is jumping. The background features a tall stone structure with foliage and the sky.
creator: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Michel Moreau
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Chacun respecte le travail des autres, afin que le sein soit en sûreté
title: Chacun respecte le travail des autres, afin que le sein soit en sûreté
assistive_text: The image shows three individuals standing in a natural setting. From left to right, there is a man holding a shovel, a young boy pouring water from a jug, and another man pointing towards the ground. The background includes lush foliage, a large tree, and a house in the distance. The scene suggests a garden or farm setting with planted rows of foliage.
creator: Pierre-Philippe Choffard after Jean-Michel Moreau
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Un violent exercice étouffe les sentimens tendres
title: Un violent exercice étouffe les sentimens tendres
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a hunting scene with a dog and two figures. The drawing depicts two individuals engaged in a conversation or instruction session in a natural setting. One figure is holding a large stick or pole, while the other is bending down by a small dog. The background features rolling clouds in the sky and distant trees, adding depth to the landscape. The ground is detailed with foliage and grass, indicative of a rural or wild environment with various plants depicted in the foreground. The artwork includes a caption in French.
creator: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sophie remettez-vous
title: Sophie remettez-vous
assistive_text: The image depicts five individuals in a historical-style setting around a dining table. Four individuals, three women, and one man, are seated while one woman is standing. They are all dressed in elaborate 18th-century attire, engaging in conversation and gestures. The setting includes a table with items like a candlestick and dishes, and a softly textured wall with an open cupboard displaying objects.
creator: Nicolas Delaunay after Jean-Michel Moreau
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Discours sur l'égalité des conditions: Il retourne chez ses égaux
title: Discours sur l'égalité des conditions: Il retourne chez ses égaux
assistive_text: The image shows a group of people gathered outdoors. Two main figures are depicted, one standing in profile facing the other who is facing away. The first person is dressed in attire typical of the 17th or 18th century, with a long coat, shirt, stockings, shoes, and a wide-brimmed hat. They have European facial features and wavy hair under the hat. The second person is minimally clothed, wearing what seems to be a cloth around their waist. They are muscular and gesturing with their right hand. Several other men in similar period clothing, some with hats and swords, are also visible. The background includes a fenced area, buildings or structures, ships on the water, and clouds in the sky, suggesting an outdoor setting near a port or settlement. There is a bundle on the ground between the two main figures.
creator: Nicolas Delaunay after Jean-Michel Moreau
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La vertu chancelante
title: La vertu chancelante
assistive_text: The image displays a woman seated on a wooden chair in an attic-like room. She has a calm expression and styled hair, wearing a long dress while holding an object that looks like yarn. Nearby, there is a basket with more yarn. The room has visible beams and a slanted window letting in light, with minimal furniture and a simple bed in the background.
creator: Jean Massard after Jean-Baptiste Greuze
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Captain Warren Delano
title: Captain Warren Delano
assistive_text: The painting depicts a man shown from the waist up, seated and facing forward. He has a sturdy build and is positioned with a relaxed posture. His facial features include a fair complexion, a slightly flushed tone, and a solemn expression, with round cheeks, deep-set eyes, and a strong jawline. His dark hair is short and somewhat tousled, framing his face. He is dressed in formal attire consisting of a dark coat over a white shirt with a high collar, a gray cravat around his neck. His right hand is resting on his lap, holding a cane, and a gold ring is visible on his finger. The background is plain with a muted color, and is set within an oval frame.
creator: Charles Loring Elliott
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Little Lagoon
title: The Little Lagoon
assistive_text: The image shows a scene of a calm water body with distant shores visible. Buildings and masts of ships are silhouetted against the horizon line. Boats with tall masts are seen in the middle distance, reflecting on the water. Closer, smaller boats with figures can be seen. The sky is lightly cloudy, indicating a gentle day. The artwork has a minimalistic color palette dominated by tan and sepia tones, emphasizing tranquil atmosphere and intricate linework.
creator: James McNeill Whistler
medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
credit_line: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Upright Venice
title: Upright Venice
assistive_text: The image shows a waterway with boats and gondolas. People are gathered along a sidewalk near the water's edge. More boats are docked nearby. The skyline features buildings and architectural details, including a domed structure with spires and rooftops. Wispy clouds are visible above the horizon. The style uses linear etching with fine, varied lines to convey texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by a creamy beige tone.
creator: James McNeill Whistler
medium: etching and drypoint  on laid paper
credit_line: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Balcony
title: The Balcony
assistive_text: The image depicts a building next to a canal in Venice. The point of view is from the canal, facing the building. There is no visible horizon line. The intricate architectural details such as balconies, arched windows, and walls are shown with delicate lines. The scene is in sepia tones, giving it a vintage look. There is a figure in a gondola near the building, and another figure further back. The style resembles an etching, with fine linework showing the building and its reflection on the water.
creator: James McNeill Whistler
medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
credit_line: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Elisha Doane
title: Elisha Doane
assistive_text: The image shows an upper body portrait of a seated man. He has short brown hair and a firm expression, wearing historical clothing including a brown coat, decorated vest, floral embroidery, and a white cravat. The man has lace cuffs on his sleeves, and is seated on a wooden chair with intricate carvings. His left arm is on his lap, and his right hand is inside his vest. The background is dark with a draped curtain, and a small table with a book or document is to the right of the man.
creator: American 18th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jane Cutler Doane
title: Jane Cutler Doane
assistive_text: The image depicts a woman seated in a red upholstered chair. She has dark brown, curly hair falling over her left shoulder and is wearing a white dress with a green ribbon tied around the waist. A dark shawl with lace-trimmed sleeves is draped over her shoulders. The woman has a composed expression with softly smiling lips and large, slightly downturned eyes.
creator: American 18th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Auguste-Hilarion, Comte de Kératry
title: Auguste-Hilarion, Comte de Kératry
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts a male figure with a broad smile and closed eyes. It is made of a dark-toned material, possibly bronze, giving it a rich brown color with reflective properties. The surface is rough and textured, emphasizing the contours of the man's face and draped garment. The texture adds depth to the facial features, enhancing the three-dimensional quality of the piece. The sculpture is life-sized, showing a relaxed and joyful expression in the head and upper torso.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Félix Barthe
title: Félix Barthe
assistive_text: The sculpture is a bust representing a man's head and upper torso. The subject features a face with distinct facial features, including a broad forehead, prominent nose, and a solemn expression, accentuated by deep lines and furrows in the brow and cheeks. The material is a dark bronze, giving it a rich, earthy brown color with a slightly glossy surface that captures reflections of light. The sculpture presents a rugged and textured surface, with roughly hewn details that emphasize a sense of weight and solidity.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Pierre-Paul Royer-Collard
title: Pierre-Paul Royer-Collard
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts the bust of a person with a heavily textured surface, capturing the intricate details of the figure's facial features and upper torso. The sculpture is made of a dark brown material, likely bronze, giving it a metallic sheen. The figure appears to have a pronounced brow, deep-set eyes, and a solemn expression, framed by textured hair that cascades down around the head. The shoulders are draped in a garment that blends into the rest of the sculpture, adding to its textured appearance. The sculpture size is small enough to be viewed as a table-sized art piece, with the figure's presence captured in a stationary yet dynamic form.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: André-Marie-Jean-Jacques Dupin Aîné
title: André-Marie-Jean-Jacques Dupin Aîné
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts the bust of a man with rugged facial structure and textured surface. The figure is adorned in a formal coat with a high collar. The sculpture is rendered in a dark bronze color. The bust appears solid with slightly rough texture. The facial features are pronounced, with an open mouth and focused gaze. The bust rests on a simple base.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jean-Charles Persil
title: Jean-Charles Persil
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts a bust of a man with distinct facial features. The man appears to be wearing a textured garment. The sculpture is made of dark bronze material, giving it a metallic sheen. The sculpture is life-sized and features realistic proportions, capturing the nuances of the man's expression and attire with intricately carved details.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Alexandre Lecomte
title: Alexandre Lecomte
assistive_text: The sculpture is a bust of an older man with defined facial features. The man has deep-set eyes, a pronounced nose, and pronounced lips. He has a serious expression and wears a scarf around his neck. The sculpture is dark in color, resembling bronze, and has an uneven surface texture that reflects light in patches, giving it a glossy appearance in some areas. It is a roughly textured, dimensional representation with heavy features elevated from a textured background, demonstrating the artist's technique in capturing the likeness with bold strokes.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sketch of a Woman
title: Sketch of a Woman
assistive_text: This drawing depicts a woman's head and neck in two overlapping sketches, with one that is upside-down, like a reflection. The top sketch of the woman has her face looking towards us. She has pale, white-blue skin and dark brown hair in a bun at the top of her head. Her facial features are outlined in pale gray, making them hard to see against her skin, but she appears to have round eyes, a small nose, and lips set in a neutral expression. The upside-down portrait shows her head turned in profile, with her hair down, cascading over one shoulder. Hints of fingers can be seen near this hair, and it overlaps with the upright face. Surrounding these overlapping portraits are lines of white, green, and gray on the pale-yellow background.
creator: Jean-Louis Forain
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Baptism of Christ
title: The Baptism of Christ
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a kneeling figure in a robe, another figure with wings, and a celestial figure overhead. The central figure stands in a body of water, draped in cloth, receiving a blessing gesture from another figure standing on a rocky bank. An angelic figure is also present, holding a cloth, with a serene expression. Above them, in the clouds, is a divine being observing the scene. The background shows a landscape with water and rolling hills. The drawing is intricate, with detailed line work and hatching.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Virgin and Child on a Grassy Bench
title: Virgin and Child on a Grassy Bench
assistive_text: The image shows a woman seated with a child on her lap. The woman is facing forward, with long hair flowing down her back. Her facial expression is serene. She wears a headdress and a long robe. The child reaches towards the woman. There is a fence-like structure around them, with a bare tree, hills, and a building in the background.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Fourth Wise Virgin
title: Fourth Wise Virgin
assistive_text: The image depicts a full-length figure of a woman. She is standing with her body slightly turned to the side and her head gently tilted. Her facial features are delicately drawn, with a slightly pointed chin, narrow eyes, and a composed expression. Her hair is adorned with a garland of foliage and partially covered by a sheer veil. She is dressed in a long flowing gown with voluminous sleeves, cinched at the waist. She holds a large cup or chalice with a flame rising from it in both hands, in front of her chest. The background is plain, and the initials "M S" are inscribed at the bottom.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Second Foolish Virgin
title: Second Foolish Virgin
assistive_text: The image features a person standing in a slightly sideways position with their head turned downward. The person has delicate facial features and a gentle expression, with hair styled neatly back. They are wearing a long, flowing garment, holding a small, cylindrical object in one hand. The background is plain, and there is an intricate circular design on the ground at the bottom of the image.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Peasant Family Going to Market
title: Peasant Family Going to Market
assistive_text: This is an image of a man riding a horse in a countryside setting. The drawing shows the man riding a horse, with another person walking beside them, moving through a rugged terrain with rocks, trees, and hills in the background. The focus is on the details of the horse and the rider's clothing, with additional elements like a structure and other figures in the distance. The style appears to be influenced by medieval or Renaissance art, emphasizing the movement of the travelers in the rural landscape.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Shield with Lion, Held by Angel
title: Shield with Lion, Held by Angel
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an angel holding a heraldic shield. The image features an angel with flowing robes and curled hair, depicted in a circular frame. The angel has two large wings extending from its back. It is holding a large heraldic shield with an ornate design, which includes a detailed depiction of a lion. The surroundings show detailed shading and line work, adding texture to the drapery.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Shield with Unicorn, Held by Woman
title: Shield with Unicorn, Held by Woman
assistive_text: The image displays a full view of a seated person within a round frame. The person is seated, facing forward with a serene expression. They wear a robe and hold a shield with a horse image. On their left side, they hold flowers. The background shows floral and plant decorations.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Shield with Swan, Held by Woman
title: Shield with Swan, Held by Woman
assistive_text: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the knees up, seated in a relaxed position. She has distinct facial features with a gentle expression, her hair styled in an intricate braid wrapped around her head. She is dressed in a long, flowing gown with fitted sleeves, adorned with a small decorative element on the bodice. The gown extends with draped fabric pooling around her. The woman holds a large heraldic shield in her right hand, depicting an image of a swan with an elongated neck. Surrounding her are stylized details of foliage and flowers, enhancing the circular composition. There are no other objects of note or jewelry visible on her. The background is plain, focusing attention on the central figure within the circular frame.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Shields with Rabbit and Moor's Head, Held by Wild Man
title: Shields with Rabbit and Moor's Head, Held by Wild Man
assistive_text: This is a circular print depicting a man standing between two shield-shaped objects, one decorated with a rabbit and the other with a person's head. The man in the center is covered in short, wavy fur. Only his face and feet are bare. He has a curly beard and curly hair adorned with a crown of leafy twigs. His arms are stretched out to either side, where he holds the edges of the two shields, which appear to be balanced on rocky ledges. The left shield depicts a rabbit in mid-leap, facing the right. The other side shows a person in profile, facing the left. They are wearing a high-necked garment and have short, curly hair tied up with a cloth. The scene is enclosed within a circular border.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Foolish Old Man and the Young Girl
title: The Foolish Old Man and the Young Girl
assistive_text: The image depicts two figures positioned close to each other. The figure on the left has curly hair, prominent cheekbones, and a furrowed brow, wearing a flowing garment with a high collar. The person on the right has a serene expression, softly arched eyebrows, and a gentle demeanor, with intricate knotted hair adorned with a leafy or floral crown and wearing a fitted dress. The figure on the left holds a plate with something round on it, while the figure on the right rests their hands under it. The background features an engraved design with scrolls and illegible script or ornamentation.
creator: Israhel van Meckenem after Master of the Housebook
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Lovers
title: The Lovers
assistive_text: The image shows two seated individuals on a bench within an archway setting. The first individual is dressed in a long-sleeved top, shorts, and pointed shoes, with long, curly hair under a round cap. The second individual wears a long dress and a head covering, with hair hidden. They are holding a small furry animal. Nearby, there is a potted plant, an ornate basin, and decorative vines forming an archway. In the background, there is a round emblem with insignia.
creator: Israhel van Meckenem after Wenzel von Olmutz after Master of the Housebook
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Dissimilar Couple
title: The Dissimilar Couple
assistive_text: The image shows a man and a woman standing side by side. The man is positioned with his body slightly turned towards the woman, and his head is tilted in her direction. He has distinct facial features, with a serious expression. He wears a cap with a row of buttons, a long tunic belted at the waist, tights, pointed shoes, and holds a sword. The woman stands with her arms crossed, facing the man. Her facial features are soft, and she wears a tall, elaborate headdress with a lattice pattern, a long dress, and voluminous sleeves. The background has a dark, textured backdrop with a swirling ribbon pattern around the figures, and decorative plants with prominent leaves. The artwork is monochromatic with detailed line work.
creator: Israhel van Meckenem
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Angry Wife
title: The Angry Wife
assistive_text: This is a print showing a woman holding a broom-like object and engaging in a struggle with a man. The woman is on the left, holding the object above her head in one hand and with the other holding the wrist of the man, who is partially kneeling on the left. They both have pale skin and light hair. Above them is a fantastical creature with the body of a snake, wings, human arms, and the face of a beast. A small dog stands near the bottom left corner of the print, looking up at them. Next to it on the ground is what looks like a discarded apron. The ground and dark background are both detailed with cross-hatching.
creator: Israhel van Meckenem
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Coat of Arms with Lion
title: Coat of Arms with Lion
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a heraldic coat of arms featuring a lion. The image includes a shield with a rampant lion, a helmet above it with a lion crest, and decorative mantling around them. The drawing is detailed and intricate, with the letters 'I' and 'M' on either side of the shield and the word 'Vorholt' below.
creator: Israhel van Meckenem
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Knight and Lady on Horseback
title: Knight and Lady on Horseback
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a mounted figure holding a whip in a scenic background of a medieval town. The image features a horse with ornamental tack and a figure in a traditional early European costume. The landscape includes detailed illustrations of architecture resembling castles and small buildings, set among hills and foliage. The line work and cross-hatching enhance the depth and texture in the drawing, capturing a historical ambiance.
creator: Master MZ
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Tournament
title: The Tournament
assistive_text: This is a painting of a medieval jousting tournament in a city. The scene shows horse-mounted knights in detailed armor engaging in combat or preparing for the tournament. The foreground features riders in action with lances, suggesting a chaotic melee with rearing horses and falling knights. In the background are tightly packed buildings, creating a sense of a large audience. The setting is a cobbled street with historic architectural structures, reflecting an era of chivalry and medieval life. This artwork is in the style of Hans Burgkmair the Elder.
creator: Master MZ
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Betrayal
title: The Betrayal
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene with multiple figures gathered in what seems to be an event. The figures are depicted with detailed garments and facial expressions, holding weapons and torches, set against a rocky landscape. In the background, there are hills with trees and structures. The linework is intricate, emphasizing texture and creating depth within the scene.
creator: Netherlandish 15th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Coat of Arms with a Lion and Unicorn
title: Coat of Arms with a Lion and Unicorn
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a coat of arms featuring a unicorn. The illustration includes a shield with a rampant lion, a helmet above the shield, and a unicorn emerging from the helmet. Surrounding the coat of arms are intricate floral and leafy scrolls. The background includes handwritten script in old-style cursive. The paper appears aged with wear at the edges.
creator: Master hw
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Expulsion from Paradise
title: Expulsion from Paradise
assistive_text: The image shows three figures outdoors. On the left, a male figure with curly hair is covering his lower body. Next to him, a woman with long hair is standing with her hands clasped near her chest. On the right, an angelic figure with large wings, curly hair, and a serious expression is holding a sword aloft with one hand while gesturing with the other. The background includes large trees with textured bark and dense foliage.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Two Elders Before the Judge
title: The Two Elders Before the Judge
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an ancient court scene. It features a group of figures in a classical architectural setting with columns and archways. The central figure is seated on a raised platform, surrounded by other standing or seated figures engaging in conversation. The composition is detailed, with strong use of line and shadow to create depth and texture. The figures are dressed in draped garments.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Good Samaritan Placing the Traveler on a Mule
title: The Good Samaritan Placing the Traveler on a Mule
assistive_text: A drawing featuring a man, a horse, buildings, and a landscape. The man and horse are near a large tree and rocky formation. In the background, there are buildings with architectural details. The landscape includes various trees, figures, and buildings in the distance. The drawing is detailed with fine lines typical of engraving techniques.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Good Samaritan Paying for the Lodgings  of the Traveler
title: The Good Samaritan Paying for the Lodgings  of the Traveler
assistive_text: The image shows three individuals and a donkey. The central figure is a man seated on the donkey, extending his arm towards an older man standing next to him. The older man is looking at his hand. A third person stands partially visible between them. The donkey has a bridle and is standing calmly. In the background, there is an architectural structure with a visible door and windows with open shutters. A curved archway provides a view into a dimly lit interior space, where a person lies in bed covered with a blanket, with two other figures nearby. Stone pavement and hints of a town structure make up the background.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Virgin Seated
title: The Virgin Seated
assistive_text: The image shows a woman seated, holding an infant. The woman has her body turned to the side, cradling the child. She has closed eyes and a serene expression, with long, wavy hair and a decorative band. She wears a detailed gown with a brooch. The infant is unclothed. There is a potted plant nearby, and the setting includes a stone surface, rustic wooden fence, and landscaped scenery in the background. The image is rendered in a monochromatic style with emphasis on line and texture.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Madonna in a Landscape Sitting on a Cushion
title: Madonna in a Landscape Sitting on a Cushion
assistive_text: The image depicts the upper body of a seated woman holding an infant in her lap. The woman is slightly angled towards the viewer, looking down at the child with gentle expression. She has soft facial features, wavy shoulder-length hair with a veil, and is dressed in a richly textured gown. The baby has curly hair and is reclining against the woman's chest. In the background, there is a landscape with hills and a structure resembling a small tower or church.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mark
title: Mark
assistive_text: The image shows a seated figure on a cloud writing on a tablet held in their left hand, with a quill in their right hand. The person has detailed facial features, curly hair, and is dressed in layered garments. A lion sits beside them. There are swirling clouds in the background, with rays of light behind the figure. There is an inscription in the top right corner reading "1539" with an emblem beneath it.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Luke
title: Luke
assistive_text: The image depicts a full-length view of a seated man surrounded by clouds, with an animal, likely an ox, beside him. The man is positioned slightly angled to the left, with his head turned forward. He has long curly hair and a thick beard. His facial expression is serious, and he has prominent, deep-set eyes. He is dressed in a long, flowing robe that covers most of his body except for his bare feet, which rest on a cloud. In his hands, he holds an open book. There is no visible jewelry, but his presence is completed by the decorative folds of his garment. Behind him, a radiant halo of lines spreads outwards, and the background is filled with clouds. The top right corner has the numbers "1539" and a monogram resembling initials.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jason and Medea
title: Jason and Medea
assistive_text: Two figures are depicted. One is a standing warrior, while the other is a seated woman. The warrior is depicted in armor and holding a statuette of a soldier. The woman is reaching up towards the statuette with a contemplative expression. She is partially draped in fabric with her upper body exposed, has long wavy hair, wears a beaded necklace, and is surrounded by cylindrical objects. The background includes architectural elements and a textured wall.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hercules Slaying the Lion of Nemea
title: Hercules Slaying the Lion of Nemea
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a man battling a lion. The drawing depicts a muscular, bearded figure holding an aggressive stance over a lion; his hands are around the lion's neck. The background shows a dense forest with a small building in the distance. Another smaller scene in the background portrays another similar confrontation with a lion. The composition is detailed with intricate lines and shading, adding texture and form to the figures and foliage. The bottom of the drawing includes ancient script.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hercules Fighting with the Hydra of Lernea
title: Hercules Fighting with the Hydra of Lernea
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene with a human figure fighting a multi-headed creature. The human is on the left, wielding a club, and wearing a lion's pelt. The creature on the right has multiple heads and is in an aggressive pose. Dark textures are in the background, and skeletal remains are in the foreground. Latin text is at the bottom. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of Renaissance printmaking.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hercules and Cerberus
title: Hercules and Cerberus
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a male figure and a three-headed dog. The figure is unclothed and holds a chain that controls the three-headed dog. The setting is an ancient or mythical urban environment with stone buildings in the background. There is movement in the flowing hair and dynamic pose of both figures. Fine lines and hatching create detailed texture. Latin text is inscribed at the bottom.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hercules and the Hind
title: Hercules and the Hind
assistive_text: This print depicts a bare-chested man on top of a large deer, with the man's full body shown. He is positioned in a crouched manner with one foot against the deer's back, gripping its antlers tightly with both hands. He has a full beard and curly hair that covers much of his head, and his muscles are visible down his body. He wears no clothing except for a cloak draped over one shoulder. There appears to be an explosion occurring to the left, with erupting fire and smoke, and a human near it seems to be falling. In the background there are buildings in the distance, perhaps a city. The print includes text at the bottom, with the date "1550" and a monogram "AG" appearing on the upper right side.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sophonisba
title: Sophonisba
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two figures in a classical interior scene. The drawing features a standing figure in historical attire gesturing or speaking, while a seated figure in a draped garment is raising a cup. The setting includes classical architectural elements like columns and an arch. The composition uses intricate linework to establish texture and depth, focusing on detailed clothing and facial expressions. The style is reminiscent of Renaissance or early baroque printmaking techniques, with a clear influence of Northern European art.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Large Wedding Dancers
title: Large Wedding Dancers
assistive_text: The image shows a man standing with his right arm raised, holding a long object resembling a spear or staff. He is turned slightly to his right, gazing in that direction with a serious expression. He has short, wavy hair and elaborate attire, including a flowing garment with sleeves, decorative chains, brooches, and medallions. He wears tight-fitting foot coverings. Next to him is an animal skin with detailed features. The background is minimally shaded.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Couple of Lovers Seated
title: A Couple of Lovers Seated
assistive_text: The image shows two individuals seated closely together on a bench. The man on the left is in profile view, while the woman on the right faces forward. The man has distinct facial features with a large nose and mustache, and his hair is short and wavy. He is wearing a detailed garment with what appears to be thick, ornate fabric and a feathered hat or shoulder piece. The woman has a serene expression, with smooth facial features, and she wears her long hair swept back and flowing behind her. Her attire appears to be an elegant, patterned dress with ruffles and a high outfit with laces on the sleeves. She holds a small object in her right hand. The man holds a small goblet or cup in his left hand and another unidentifiable object in the other. Both wear decorative jewelry—bracelets and rings are visible. In the background, there is a pattern that suggests wooden or panel structures. The image has an intricate engraver's style, with detailed shading and texture throughout. The date "1529" and the initials "AG" are inscribed in the background.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Self-Portrait
title: Self-Portrait
assistive_text: The image shows a portrait of a man in profile view. He has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and lips. He has a serious expression and short, wavy hair under a wide-brimmed hat with decorative elements. The man wears Renaissance-style clothing with intricate details, including a beaded necklace and a textured background with a coat of arms or shield-like element bearing a letter. Latin inscriptions appear above and below the portrait.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Three Cupids and a Bear
title: Three Cupids and a Bear
assistive_text: This is a drawing depicting three cherubs holding ornate staffs that support a circular platform, on which a bear is resting. The cherubs have wings and one of them is looking upwards. The bear is reclined with its head on its paws. Intricate foliage and decorative details surround the scene. Below the bear, there is a plaque inscribed with the date "1529." The drawing features detailed line work and fine hatching typical of the early 16th century.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Dancing Children
title: Dancing Children
assistive_text: This is a drawing of cherubs dancing. The cherubs have curly hair and are shown in various dance poses, holding hands and moving in a circular formation. The drawing features detailed textures, intricate hair and limb detailing, and a dark background that contrasts with the lighter cherubs.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ornament with Mask
title: Ornament with Mask
assistive_text: This is a drawing of various mythological creatures and figures intertwined in a decorative style. The imagery includes a central bearded face with an exaggerated expression surrounded by anthropomorphic figures and mythical creatures. Two large, mythical figures with long robes and head coverings flank the central face. Above the central face, there is a muscular figure with a wrapped headdress and a creature resembling a goat with a human body on the opposite side. The lower section of the image includes cherubic figures and detailed ornamentation featuring floral and scroll motifs. The entire piece is rendered with fine linework and showcases a high level of detail typical of engravings.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ornament
title: Ornament
assistive_text: The image displays swirling lines and organic shapes forming an abstract pattern. These shapes resemble ornate foliage and floral designs, with curling leaves and pointed petal-like forms intertwining throughout the composition. Some parts suggest stylized lion heads and a human torso. The detailed curves and symmetry in the artwork hint at lavish ornamentation similar to classical architectural designs.
creator: Heinrich Aldegrever
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ Taking Leave of his Mother
title: Christ Taking Leave of his Mother
assistive_text: This is a detailed woodcut print of a biblical scene showing multiple figures engaging in interaction. The central figure stands as others gather around, with a natural outdoor setting including trees in the background. The style resembles early Renaissance engravings, with dense lines and intricate details capturing the flow of robes and texture of foliage. The focus is on the interaction within the group, conveying a sense of narrative through their gestures and expressions.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Arrest of Christ
title: The Arrest of Christ
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a battle scene with soldiers and weapons, all centered around a radiant light source. There are figures engaged in a confrontation with swords, pikes, and helmets visible. The figures are closely positioned, suggesting conflict. In the center, there is a bright light or explosion radiating outwards, emphasizing the intensity of the moment. The light appears to be the focal point of the scene. The drawing features strong contrasts between light and dark, typical of line engravings, creating depth.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Flagellation of Christ
title: The Flagellation of Christ
assistive_text: This is a drawing of three figures engaged in physical interaction in an architectural setting with arched structures in the background. The figures are depicted in elaborate clothing, showing a confrontation or struggle with one central figure bound to a column or post. The composition is full of movement and tension, suggested by the postures and gestures of the figures, as well as the tools or weapons they are holding. The intricate line work creates a sense of texture and depth, typical of woodcut or engraving illustrations.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Virgin and Child in a Church
title: Virgin and Child in a Church
assistive_text: The image depicts a woman and a child. The woman is standing, holding the child in her arms. Her facial features are delicate, with a serene expression. Her hair is mostly covered by a headdress or elaborate covering, extending over her shoulders. The child has curly hair and is positioned against the woman's body, both surrounded by halos. The woman wears a flowing garment with intricate details and a decorative element on her chest. In her hand, she holds a small cross. The child clutches her shoulder. The scene is set in a structure resembling a church or cathedral with tall arches and windows allowing light to illuminate the figures. The background includes stone pillars and a patterned floor.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Virgin with the Blessing Child in a Landscape
title: The Virgin with the Blessing Child in a Landscape
assistive_text: The image depicts a woman seated on the ground, holding a child in her lap. The woman faces to her right, while the child stands on her lap, looking outward with one arm raised. The woman has a serene expression and long hair covered with a headscarf. The child has curly hair. Both figures wear halos. The scene includes detailed grass and rock textures. In the background, there are trees with foliage reaching into the sky, cloud patterns, distant mountains, and a rustic structure resembling a house or barn on the left side.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Judgment of Paris
title: The Judgment of Paris
assistive_text: This drawing depicts mythological figures in a natural setting. The central part of the image shows several figures gathered in an outdoor environment. The setting is lush with vegetation, dominated by a large tree in the background. The drawing is detailed and cross-hatched, creating depth and texture. The arrangement of the figures and their gestures suggest a narrative or allegory. The figures are depicted with a strong emphasis on form and pose, similar to the style of the Renaissance period.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
assistive_text: The image shows a standing figure with classical features and a helmet-like headpiece. The figure is carrying a staff topped with a lion-like head and is dressed in a draped garment. The background has a lined texture and a visible architectural feature. A sun-like motif is partially obscured by the drapery.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hercules Overcoming the Nemean Lion
title: Hercules Overcoming the Nemean Lion
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a human figure interacting with a lion. The human figure is kneeling and grappling with the lion, with one hand holding the lion's mane and the other keeping its jaw open. The lion is depicted lying down, with detailed muscles and fur. The human figure appears to be in motion, indicated by flowing lines suggesting movement and tension. The drawing utilizes fine lines and shading commonly seen in early printmaking, adding a dramatic intensity to the scene.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Arion and a Nereid
title: Arion and a Nereid
assistive_text: This is a drawing of mythological figures with marine creatures. The image depicts two figures often seen in mythology, appearing to be a merman and mermaid, interacting with large sea creatures which resemble fantastical fish. The merman is shown with a muscular build, holding a trident-like object, while the mermaid is reaching out with a vine or ribbon-like object. The water around them is suggested by a series of swirling lines. In the background, there is a small landmass. The figures and creatures are rendered in a detailed, textural manner, consistent with traditional engravings or woodcuts.
creator: Albrecht Altdorfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ's Entry into Jerusalem
title: Christ's Entry into Jerusalem
assistive_text: This is a painting of a historic city scene with a central figure on a donkey surrounded by other figures. The main image depicts a cityscape with buildings featuring towers and domes of various shapes and sizes. In the foreground, a central figure is riding a donkey, surrounded by other figures, some holding branches and laying garments on the ground. The scene is enclosed within a decorative border with panels containing intricate patterns and small illustrations, including figures writing and mythical creatures. The use of earthy tones like greens, reds, and browns along with fine lines suggest it is an example of manuscript or print work from the medieval or early renaissance period.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in rose, yellow, brown, green, and gray
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Betrayal of Christ
title: The Betrayal of Christ
assistive_text: The image shows six individuals in an animated interaction. Most figures are depicted from the waist up, except two shown from head to toe, and one lying down. The central figure is standing, wearing a robe and a halo, holding a bag. The figures' facial features are stylized with simple, expressive lines. The central figure has long hair, while others have short hair or head coverings. The surrounding figures wear medieval-style clothing in earth tones and blues, some with green accents. The figure on the ground is bald and wearing a garment with a white collar. One individual holds a scroll or baton, while others interact with or gesture towards the central figure. The background has a blue sky and green ground, enclosed by a red border.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut in dark brown, hand-colored in red lake, green, blue, orange, and gold
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Holy Ghost
title: The Holy Ghost
assistive_text: This is a painting of a stylized bird with a halo. The bird is in the center of the image with outstretched wings, rendered in a linear, geometric style with zigzag patterns. The bird's head is crowned with a halo depicted as a circular shape with radiating lines. Below the bird, there are flower-like forms with layered petals in pink and purple, surrounded by yellow streaks. The background is a neutral beige.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in yellow, lavender, and rose
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ Measuring the Globe
title: Christ Measuring the Globe
assistive_text: This is a painting of a cosmic scene with a large circular depiction of a cosmological concept. Inside the circle is a smaller circle containing a stylized city landscape with buildings. Surrounding the inner circle are celestial elements like a sun, crescent moon, and stars. There is a figure to the right holding a stick pointing towards the center. The figure is dressed in traditional robes with red and pink hues and a halo. The color palette is limited to yellow, green, pink, and black. The style resembles an illuminated medieval manuscript or early woodcut print from historical religious or mystical iconography.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in venetian red, lavender, yellow, and green
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Descent of the Holy Ghost
title: The Descent of the Holy Ghost
assistive_text: The image shows a group of people seated closely together in a semi-circle around a central figure holding a book. The figures have simplified facial features and varied hair colors. The central figure wears a blue robe, while the others are dressed in different colors with halo-like shapes above their heads. Each person has a small flame above their head. The background features a stylized upper section with a dove-like bird spreading its wings. The scene is enclosed within a red and orange border, with a green floor and linear patterns indicating a wall in the background.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, blue, green, gray, and gold
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Head of Christ
title: The Head of Christ
assistive_text: The image displays a monochrome illustration of a long-haired, bearded figure with intricate line work. The figure is centrally positioned, looking outward with a composed expression. The hair is wavy, cascading down both sides of the face. Radiating lines create a halo effect around the head. The background is textured and neutral, highlighting the central figure. Below the image, there is a block of text in a decorative typeface framed by a border.
creator: German 15th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ Child on Donkey
title: Christ Child on Donkey
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a small figure riding on an animal. The figure has curly hair and is holding a stick with a ribbon. There is a banner above the figure with text. The background is simple, with rough lines outlining the frame. The paper looks aged and weathered. The drawing style is traditional or folk art, characterized by simplistic and naive rendering.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in yellow, rose, and brown
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
title: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
assistive_text: The image shows a person standing in a slightly hunched position. The individual has long, dark hair and is wearing a crown of leaves on their head. Their facial expression is downcast, with closed eyes and a solemn demeanor. The person is minimally clothed, wearing only a simple waistcloth. They are holding a bundle of green branches against their chest and are surrounded by various objects, including spears, sticks, and a rooster. The background features an intricately detailed border with floral and vine motifs in green and red.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, and yellow
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Man of Sorrows and His Mother
title: The Man of Sorrows and His Mother
assistive_text: The image shows a medieval woodcut-style rendition of two figures. One figure has long brown hair and a beard, wearing a green crown of leaves and a patterned cloth. The other figure wears a deep blue and golden robe with a hood, with soft facial features and a veil blending into a halo-like shape behind their head. The figures are surrounded by a simple colored arch with text above them reading "Ecce homo." Below the central image is a block of text in a Gothic script. The background is filled with deep blue and framed with a red border with decorative motifs at the top and bottom.
creator: Netherlandish 15th Century
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in rose, blue, lilac, vermilion, mustard yellow, white, brown, and silver on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Man of Sorrows with a Franciscan
title: The Man of Sorrows with a Franciscan
assistive_text: The image shows an upper body depiction of a figure to the left, standing upright. The facial features include closed eyes, a beard, and long wavy hair. Stripes of red streak across the figure's chest, and a red cross is visible on one shoulder. The figure has a halo around the head. Beside this figure, there is a monk-like person to the lower right, facing the first figure. The monk has a shaven hairstyle and wears a simple robe with a cowl. He appears to be speaking, with a scroll emerging from his mouth. The background is filled with decorative elements, including a floral design and swirling patterns, against a blue and golden-colored background. At the top, there is a banner with the letters "INRI."
creator: French 15th Century
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, blue, green-yellow, gray, and flesh
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Pietà
title: The Pietà
assistive_text: The image shows two figures in a traditional Christian iconographic style. One figure is lying on the lap of the other, who is seated. The lying figure has a solemn expression, a beard, and wears a crown of thorns. The seated figure has clasped hands over their chest, a serene expression, and possibly a halo or hood. Both figures are fully clothed. The background includes a large cross with an inscription at the top, set in a simple landscape with green coloration. The image is framed with a simple red border.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in yellow ochre, green, rose, and gold
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Madonna as Protectress
title: Madonna as Protectress
assistive_text: The image shows a woman with long blonde hair and light skin, wearing a brown gown and blue mantle. Her arms are slightly extended and she has a serene expression. A dark halo-like circle frames her head. Surrounding her are smaller figures with only their heads and shoulders visible under her mantle. The background is textured with horizontal blue lines, enclosed by a red border.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in blue, red brown, yellow, gold, and red
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Madonna and Child
title: Madonna and Child
assistive_text: The image depicts the upper half of two figures in a close embrace. The figure on the left is a child with short hair, a round face, and a halo. The other figure is a woman with long hair, a halo, and a crown. The woman has a serene expression and is wearing a robe with star patterns. Both figures are surrounded by a circular design with green and red colors in the background. At the bottom, there is text that reads "MARIA DEL CARMELI." The background is a light-colored surface.
creator: Spanish 15th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Madonna and Child in a Glory
title: Madonna and Child in a Glory
assistive_text: The image depicts two figures' upper bodies. The figure on the left stands upright and holds a smaller figure. The larger figure has long wavy hair, a serene expression, and delicate facial features indicated by minimalist lines. They wear a red robe with a blue garment visible underneath, and a large, ornate crown. The smaller figure held also wears a similar crown and sits facing the larger figure. The background shows a radiant pattern resembling rays of light, set against a textured blue and green backdrop with a simple border.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, blue, yellow, green, gold, and orange; retouched with pen and ink
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Madonna and Child in a Rosary
title: The Madonna and Child in a Rosary
assistive_text: The image displays a woman standing on a crescent moon, holding a child in her left arm. The woman has a calm expression, wears a crown, and has straight hair falling from under the crown. She is clothed in a long red robe with hints of an undergarment showing. The child is wrapped in a cloth and seated facing slightly forward. The scene is framed by emanating rays and a floral border, with the woman's head surrounded by a halo and almond-shaped elements. The background features decorative patterns with floral motifs and scrolls.
creator: French 15th Century
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in brown, red, and green
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Madonna and Child in a Rosary
title: Madonna and Child in a Rosary
assistive_text: This print depicts a woman holding a child. The woman has simple facial features, pale skin, and long, wavy, yellow hair. She is dressed in a red robe over a gray garment, and there is a yellow crown on her head surrounded by a yellow halo. The child in her arms also has pale skin and short curly hair surrounded by a yellow halo, and they are unclothed. The woman is surrounded by rays of yellow light that emanate from her against a black background. Below the bottom of her dress, there seems to be a human face with pale skin that points downward, a frown on its face. Surrounding the woman is a circular border of flowers in white, red, and yellow, with green leaves between them. In the four corners of the print are different creatures holding scrolls, including an angel in the top left, a bird in the top right, a bull in the bottom right, and a lion in the bottom left. The bottom two animals have red wings, and all three have yellow halos. The angel has green wings.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, yelllow, black,green, brown, and rose on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Hand as the Mirror of Salvation
title: The Hand as the Mirror of Salvation
assistive_text: This is a print of a hand with detailed annotations and accompanying illustrations. The hand is the central focus, with inscriptions on each finger. Two small people are on either side of the hand, both dressed in robes with round yellow halos behind their heads. The person on the left appears to shake something held up by their head, with a jar beside them. The person on the right is holding a long object connected to a wolf or dog covered in green paint, and in the other hand they hold a small bucket. Latin text is on scroll-like banners surrounding the hand. Longer blocks of text fill the spaces around the hand and figures.
creator: Netherlandish 15th Century
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in rose, green, yellow and gray; printed by friction in brown ink
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Bookplate of Hilprand Brandenburg of Bibrach
title: Bookplate of Hilprand Brandenburg of Bibrach
assistive_text: This is a painting of a heraldic shield held by an angelic figure. The image shows an angelic figure dressed in a long robe with wings spread wide behind it. The wings are colored in shades of green, contrasting against the earthy tone of the robe. The face of the figure is designed with simple lines giving it a serene expression. The angel is holding a blue shield emblazoned with the image of a bull or an ox. The bull is depicted in a contrasting light color against the blue of the shield. The style is reminiscent of a medieval woodcut illustration.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, rose, light blue, red, and yellow on laid paper, mounted on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Gerson as Pilgrim
title: Gerson as Pilgrim
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a traveler with a dog in a medieval setting. The traveler is carrying a bundle of sticks on their back, standing on the ground with stylized flora. They are holding a staff and accompanied by a small dog. In the background, there is a castle on a hill. The drawing predominantly uses line work with red accents highlighting certain features, such as plants and clothing. The scene is framed by intricate designs.
creator: German 15th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Franciscan, Pelbartus of Temesvar, in a Garden
title: Franciscan, Pelbartus of Temesvar, in a Garden
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a monk writing in a garden under a tree. The central image shows a monk writing at a wooden lectern in a garden, surrounded by lush vegetation. Decorative circular medallions with symbolic creatures are depicted above and below the main image. The background features Gothic-style text. The illustration follows a medieval style with a religious or scholarly theme.
creator: German 15th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Bishop of Augsburg with Three Coats of Arms
title: Bishop of Augsburg with Three Coats of Arms
assistive_text: The image shows a figure standing upright. The person is positioned facing forward, with one hand raised in a gesture and the other hand holding a long golden staff with an ornate top. The figure has prominent facial features, depicted with linear details, and the person's hair is not visible as they are wearing a tall red and white mitre adorned with blue and green gems. Their clothing is a rich brown robe draped over a blue garment with white sleeves visible, featuring jewel-like red accents on the cuffs. The figure is surrounded by a decorative frame with floral motifs at the top. At the bottom, there are two heraldic shields, one red and white and the other black and white, resting on a green background. There is no visible background behind the figure, as it is set against a cream-colored backdrop.
creator: German 15th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Friedrich Count of Schaumberg - Bishop of Salzburg
title: Friedrich Count of Schaumberg - Bishop of Salzburg
assistive_text: The image shows the upper half of a figure dressed in ornate religious attire. The person is seated behind a large heraldic shield featuring a black lion on a yellow background on the left and red stripes on the right. The individual is holding an open book in their left hand and a decorative crosier in their right hand. They are wearing a mitre adorned with red and yellow patterns on their head. Their hair is gray and appears to be styled in short curls on the sides. The face is shown with mature, slightly wrinkled features. Their clothing includes a richly patterned blue robe with a red vestment adorned with a large jeweled medallion at the center. The background is simple, featuring grass and small plants at the bottom, with a gradient sky above.
creator: German 15th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Resurrection
title: The Resurrection
assistive_text: This is a painting of a figure holding a long staff and surrounded by architectural elements and landscape. The scene is enclosed within a decorative border. The painting depicts a central figure with a tranquil expression, holding a staff with a cross-like top. The figure wears a red cloak and has long hair and a halo around their head. They are seated on a stone structure with intricate designs, surrounded by stylized foliage in green and brown hues. The background features a castle-like scene with tall towers and a tree to the left, set against a hilly landscape. The entire scene is framed with a yellow and black patterned border.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Three Maries at the Tomb
title: The Three Maries at the Tomb
assistive_text: The image depicts a group of figures gathered around a tomb. There is an angel with a green and brown wing on the left, gesturing towards three haloed figures by the tomb. The tomb is detailed with intricate patterns and textiles, and the background features an elaborate border with golden floral patterns, similar to early Renaissance religious art.
creator: Workshop of Master of the Borders with the Four Fathers of the Church
medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red-brown lake, and green
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Madonna and Child in Glory
title: Madonna and Child in Glory
assistive_text: The image depicts two figures: a woman and a child. The woman is standing and holding the child on her lap. She has long hair, wears a starry crown, and a radiating halo. Her expression is gentle. She wears a robe with green and reddish-brown colors, gold trimmings, and intricate patterns. The child has curly hair, wears a cloth around the waist, and also has a halo. They are close to each other, with the child leaning towards the woman. Both figures are surrounded by a radiant glow. The background shows a pattern resembling cloud-like waves.
creator: German 15th Century or Master of the Meshed Background
medium: metalcut, hand-colored in yellow, red, and green
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Baptism of Christ; Pharoah Passing through the Red Sea; Joshua and Caleb
title: The Baptism of Christ; Pharoah Passing through the Red Sea; Joshua and Caleb
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a religious scene depicting biblical narratives and figures. The central portion shows a significant religious event with a central figure surrounded by others.
