Flanking this centerpiece are smaller scenes. On the left, there is a gathering of figures, and on the right, individuals are carrying a bunch of grapes. The upper portion features two figures in dialogue and accompanying text. The bottom portion also shows two seated figures and more text. The drawing is intricate, with detailed lines suggesting a meticulous style focused on religious storytelling.
creator: Netherlandish 15th Century
medium: woodcut (block book page) on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Ecstasy of Mary Magdalene
title: The Ecstasy of Mary Magdalene
assistive_text: The image shows a woman standing with her hands clasped near her chin. Surrounding her are four angelic figures, two on each side, wearing red robes. Below them is an upside-down head with a serene expression, surrounded by blue fabric and black triangular shapes or handles. The background is light beige with abstract colored shapes, enclosed by a bold red and orange border, and blue coloring at the top.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, blue, green, rose, gold, and orange
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ Washing the Apostles' Feet
title: Christ Washing the Apostles' Feet
assistive_text: This is a painting of a group of figures gathered, with one kneeling and performing a gesture on another's foot, while other figures are seated around them. The scene is framed with a bold rectangular border. The figures are illustrated in a linear style with simplified forms, and the color palette includes earthy tones with touches of green and gold hues. The central figure kneels before another, who is seated, and appears engaged in an act of washing or anointing feet. The setup suggests an intimate gathering or ritual scene. The illustration is stylized, employing simple yet expressive lines to depict facial expressions and garments, giving it a woodcut appearance.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in tan, green, rose, and yellow
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Virgin in a Robe Embroidered with Ears  of Corn
title: The Virgin in a Robe Embroidered with Ears  of Corn
assistive_text: The image shows a person standing in a slightly contorted profile view, facing towards the right side. The person has hands clasped together as if in prayer, a delicate profile with small eyes and a serene expression. They have long, flowing hair cascading down their shoulders and back, topped with a circular halo-like headdress. The individual wears a long, flowing blue garment with darker blue accents and a green sash or collar around the neck. They stand beside an altar or table, on which a chalice is placed alongside a smaller, unidentified object. In the background, there is a decorative element resembling draped garlands. To the side, a bordered architectural detail suggests a wall, and an intricate lattice window design can be seen. The scene is surrounded by a colored border framing the image.
creator: German 15th Century
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, green, orange, yellow, rose, and gold
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Man of Sorrows Mocked by a Soldier
title: The Man of Sorrows Mocked by a Soldier
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a seated figure and a person kneeling. The image depicts a man sitting on a raised platform, with a solemn expression and wearing a crown of thorns. His hands are clasped together, and he is partially covered by a draped cloth. Another man kneels before him, pointing towards him with a stick or thin rod, gesturing emphatically. The drawing is highly detailed with strong lines and shading that create depth and texture. The entire scene is surrounded by a cloud-like form at the bottom.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Riding Standard Bearer and Foot Soldier
title: Riding Standard Bearer and Foot Soldier
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a man on a horse and a second man standing beside it. The scene features an elaborately dressed man mounted on a horse, holding a staff or lance, while another man, partially obscured and closer to the viewer, appears to be interacting with the horse. The composition shows intricate patterns on the clothing of both figures, especially on the mounted man's attire. The horse has a focused expression, and the background includes indications of a landscape with trees and elements of nature. The drawing conveys movement and interaction between the figures, capturing a moment suggestive of a conversation or transaction.
creator: Barthel Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Titus Gracchus
title: Titus Gracchus
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The image depicts a clash between centaurs and human figures. The composition features figures engaged in combat with various weapons and fighting stances. The centaurs are shown attacking and being attacked. The drawing uses fine lines and detailing to depict muscular forms and expressions of struggle. Actions extend across the panoramic format, creating a narrative of conflict.
creator: Barthel Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Foot Soldier in Front of a Tree
title: Foot Soldier in Front of a Tree
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a fantastical creature with human and animal features. The image depicts a figure with a heavily muscled and contorted body, resembling a combination of a human and a mythical creature. It stands in an unusual pose with its legs planted firmly on the ground, near some grass or foliage. Its upper body is robust with exaggerated bulges and muscles, detailed with elaborate linework. The creature holds a spear or staff in its right hand, and there seems to be a large sword tucked in its belt. The head and face are obscured by the position of the arms and shoulders. A tree trunk or branch extends upwards behind the creature, framing its upper body, with the date "1520" inscribed in the top right. The exaggerated proportions and intricate detailing reflect a touch of surrealism, distinctive of Northern Renaissance art.
creator: Barthel Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Peasant in a Window
title: The Peasant in a Window
assistive_text: A person is shown from the shoulders up, leaning through a window opening with one arm resting on the windowsill. The facial features are shadowed, with deep-set eyes and a serious expression. The person is wearing a hooded garment that covers most of the head and drapes over the shoulders. Wooden beams form the window frame and a closed wooden shutter is visible on one side. There is no visible jewelry, and the background is a dark space that contrasts with the lighter tones of the person's attire and the window’s materials.
creator: Cornelis Bega
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Apostle Judas Thaddeus
title: Apostle Judas Thaddeus
assistive_text: The image depicts a bearded man with flowing hair standing in a slightly stooped position. The man has detailed facial features with a strong, serious expression, deep-set eyes, and a prominent beard. He is wearing a loose, long robe that covers most of his body, revealing his bare feet. In his left hand, he holds a book, and his right hand holds a long staff resting on the ground. A halo with radiating lines surrounds his head, and the background has simple lines defining the halo effect and ground texture. The initials "I G B" appear to the right of the figure, and the ground beneath his feet is depicted with grass or foliage.
creator: Hans Baldung Grien
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ Disputing with the Doctors
title: Christ Disputing with the Doctors
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with a central seated figure surrounded by other figures. The composition includes an ornate chair on a raised platform, an archway, columns, open books, and scrolls. The figures are depicted in poses of discussion and contemplation. The style features detailed line work and shading, creating a sense of depth and realism.
creator: Master HFE
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Satyr's Family
title: Satyr's Family
assistive_text: The scene shows a faun-like figure playing a stringed instrument next to a woman who is holding a small child. The faun has goat-like legs, cloven hooves, a human torso, sharp facial features, a beard, and small horns. He has curly hair. The woman has soft features and wears a head wrap. She is reclined on a grassy mound, holding the child close to her chest. The background is simple with sketched lines indicating a natural setting and sparse vegetation. A caduceus symbol is drawn in the top right corner.
creator: Jacopo de' Barbari
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Holy Family
title: Holy Family
assistive_text: The image depicts the upper bodies of three individuals in a drawing or etching. The central figure is seated, looking slightly downward and to the side, with her body angled to the left. She has long wavy hair and gentle facial features. She is draped in flowing, layered clothing and seated on an intricately designed seat. To her left is a child, with curly hair, who is supported by her arm. The child gazes outward with a curious expression. To the right of the central figure, an older man is partially visible, looking toward the woman. He has a long beard and wears a similarly textured robe. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects held by the individuals. In the background, the illustration is plain, with an insignia resembling a caduceus positioned near the upper left corner of the image.
creator: Jacopo de' Barbari
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Judith Holding the Head of Holofernes
title: Judith Holding the Head of Holofernes
assistive_text: The image depicts a woman standing, holding a sword in her right hand, and gripping an older man's head with a beard in her left hand. She has long hair in a braid, wearing a flowing robe that covers her body and head. The woman's eyes are partially closed, with a serene expression. The setting is plain, with just the figures visible.
creator: Jacopo de' Barbari
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Caliope (Calliope)
title: Caliope (Calliope)
assistive_text: The image shows a person playing a double recorder. The individual's head is tilted slightly, and they are standing with their left leg extended forward and the right leg pulled back. The person has a calm expression and long hair flowing over their shoulders and down their back. They are dressed in a flowing garment, exposing the left shoulder and extending to their bare feet. In the background, there is a landscape with a distant castle-like structure on the left and rocky formations on the right. Next to the person, there is an ornate fountain with flowing water. The scene is enclosed within a decorative border.
creator: Master of the E-Series Tarocchi
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Octava Spera (Eighth Sphere)
title: Octava Spera (Eighth Sphere)
assistive_text: The image shows a winged figure standing in a full-body pose. The figure's head is turned slightly upward to the left with a serene expression, delicate facial features, wavy hair, and shoulder-length attire. Large feathered wings extend from the figure's back. The figure holds a circular object with a star pattern. An inscription "OCTAVA SPERAXXXVIII 48" is featured at the bottom of the canvas. The background is plain.
creator: Master of the S-Series Tarocchi
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Prudencia (Prudence)
title: Prudencia (Prudence)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an allegorical figure holding a mirror supported by a winged child on a pedestal. The figure is shown in profile, draped in long, flowing robes with intricate folds. The figure holds a mirror in which a winged child is reflected. At the feet of the figure, there is a small dragon with a curled tail, open mouth, and wings. The composition is contained within a decorative border, and the bottom panel contains markings that read "PRVDENCIA XXXV."
creator: Master of the E-Series Tarocchi
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Saturno (Saturn)
title: Saturno (Saturn)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a mythological figure holding an infant and surrounded by seated children. The figure is depicted in traditional attire with draped robes and a long beard. He holds an infant, with a gesture that suggests a narrative involving parental sacrifice or protection. The infant is shown with exaggerated proportions, suspended above a sickle, a symbolic object held in one of the figure's hands. The other hand stabilizes the infant's back. Around the lower part of the figure, four children are seated peacefully. The border of the image contains diagonal lines. The text at the bottom, "A SATVRNO XXXXVII," is present. The drawing contains intricate detailing.
creator: Master of the S-Series Tarocchi
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Dance of the Gods of Love
title: Dance of the Gods of Love
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of cherubic figures engaged in a dance in a circular formation. The figures are depicted with a sense of movement, their arms interlinked as they twirl together. Each figure is characterized by curly hair, rounded forms, and wings. The background is textured, suggesting a setting of a natural surface with small stones or a path.
creator: Sebald Beham, after Marcantonio Raimondi, after Raphael
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Trajan
title: Trajan
assistive_text: The image shows a profile of a person's head and partial neck within a circular laurel wreath. The individual has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and chin. The hairstyle is tight, wavy locks pulled back, and a laurel wreath crowns the head. The background is plain, with an inscription reading "IMP. CAESAR. TRAIANVS. AVG." Below the portrait are the initials "ISB" and the year "1546". The overall style resembles a classical engraving, featuring detailed line work and traditional iconography.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Battle Scene, with Castor and Pollux Abducting the Daughters of Leukippos
title: Battle Scene, with Castor and Pollux Abducting the Daughters of Leukippos
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two centaurs in a confrontation with a human-like figure standing between them. The figure is holding a club-like object. The centaurs are rearing up on their hind legs, with one holding a tree branch-like weapon and the other aiming a bow and arrow. The background is neutral. The drawing shows detailed musculature, hair, and fur, rendered with precise line work in a style influenced by classical European art.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Lichas Presenting Nessus' Tunic to Hercules
title: Lichas Presenting Nessus' Tunic to Hercules
assistive_text: This is a drawing depicting two muscular, classical male figures standing in front of architectural structures. The figures wear ancient Roman-style attire and are positioned on a tiled platform with grand structures featuring columns and arches in the background. One figure holds a club and draped lion skin over his arm, while the other carries a large piece of cloth. In the background, two smaller figures are shown in motion. The composition is detailed, with intricate line work and architectural elements typical of classical illustrations. There is text at the top right corner of the image.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Satyr Playing the Lyre
title: Satyr Playing the Lyre
assistive_text: The image shows a mythical creature, likely a satyr, depicted in a seated position on a stone block. The satyr's full body is visible, with a muscular upper torso covered in fur-like texture, transitioning into goat-like legs with hooves. The creature is positioned in profile, facing to the right, and is playing a lyre, which is held with both hands. The satyr has a prominent facial structure with a broad nose, thick eyebrows, and a pronounced brow. Its hair is curly and unruly, with pointed ears emerging from the curls. No clothing is visible, highlighting its half-man, half-goat form. The background consists of tall, stylized grasses or reeds. In the top left corner of the image, there is a small, rectangular banner containing the initials "ISB." The overall composition is richly detailed with crosshatching and intricate line work.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Saturn
title: Saturn
assistive_text: The drawing shows a figure resembling a satyr, with a child in one arm and holding a goat's horn in the other. A goat sits at their feet. In the background, another figure leans over a jug. The style features fine lines and detailed cross-hatching for texture and depth, with careful attention to shading and contours. The image is labeled "SATVRNVS" and has the initials "ISB" in the corner. The composition is balanced, with the figures in the foreground and minimal background elements.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jupiter
title: Jupiter
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an armor-clad warrior figure standing over a mythical sea creature amidst architectural ruins. The warrior figure holds a large sword in one hand and a shield in the other, donning a helmet adorned with ram-like horns, a short pleated skirt, and a flowing cape. The lower part of the drawing shows a hybrid creature with the upper body and head of a human and the lower body of a fish. The ground on which the figure stands is adorned with two fish, and the background features ruins of ancient architectural blocks. The drawing includes inscriptions and symbols adjacent to the figures.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mars
title: Mars
assistive_text: The image shows a figure in an armor suit, holding a pole weapon and a curved sword. The person has a stern expression, a mustache, and a helmet. The armor includes a segmented plate around the waist and knee guards. There are celestial and mythological elements in the background, including a comet, the symbol of Mars, a ram, and a scorpion. The background has a textured surface.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sun
title: Sun
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a crowned figure holding a sun-faced staff and standing over a lion. The scene depicts a crowned individual holding a tall staff with a radiant sun that has a human face. The figure stands barefoot upon a lion, whose face expresses a human-like expression. On the upper left, there are inscriptions that include the number "4" and the word "SOL". The detailed cross-hatching and inkwork give the drawing a classic, symbolic appearance.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Venus
title: Venus
assistive_text: The image shows a person standing in a side profile position. The person's face is in profile with clear features and their hair is styled back with fabric or ribbon-like extensions flowing behind. They are wearing a draped garment and hold a burning heart in one hand and a spear or staff in the other. The person stands above a reclining cow, near a basket. In the background, there is a simple landscape with trees, shrubs, and what appears to be a body of water visible in the distance. The word "VENVS" is inscribed at the top of the image, along with symbols that may be astrological or symbolic references.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Allegory of Christianity
title: Allegory of Christianity
assistive_text: The image shows a winged figure standing in a contrapposto pose. They have a calm expression, intricate hair with a leaf crown, and wear draped classical attire. They hold a heart emitting sun rays in their left hand and a staff in their right hand. A snake is at their feet. The background shows a paved area with sparse vegetation. Inscriptions are present in the image.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cognicio (Cognition)
title: Cognicio (Cognition)
assistive_text: The image features a winged figure kneeling on one knee. The figure's head is turned toward the right side, looking at a small bird on its extended hand. The figure has curled hair with a laurel wreath and wears a sleeveless garment. Around the figure are several books and a pot with leaves. The background has a light texture.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Fortuna (Fortune)
title: Fortuna (Fortune)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a female figure holding a wheel and standing on a globe. The image depicts a classical representation of Fortuna, complete with wings, a flowing garment, and a staff-like attribute in her hand. She is portrayed with a serene expression, balancing on a globe. The drawing includes detailed elements like the figure's hair and garment folds. In the background, there is a ship on rough waters. On the wheel she holds, there is a smaller figure. The text "FORTVNA" is at the top between two columns of numbers.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Peasants' Feast
title: Peasants' Feast
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a table with a meal served. The illustration depicts figures dressed in traditional attire around a wooden table with food on it. Some figures are engaging in conversation, while one figure reaches towards another with a container raised. The background includes a decorative arch with leaves and grapes. The scene is detailed with intricate line work in an engraving style, and it includes a speech scroll with text.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Peasant at Market
title: Peasant at Market
assistive_text: The image shows a man standing upright. He leans on a staff with his left hand and holds a sword or large knife in his right hand. He has detailed facial features, a stern expression, and wears a textured tunic, a belt, and a hat with a feather. Nearby are a large sack, ceramic vessels, and a scroll with text that reads “DETEN WIR VERKAUFEN.”
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Three Soldiers and a Dog
title: Three Soldiers and a Dog
assistive_text: The image shows three figures and a dog. One figure on the left wears a large hat and a beard. The central figure has their back turned slightly to the right, wearing a long cloak. The figure on the right holds a staff or weapon, possibly a halberd, and wears protective headgear. The scene is detailed with textural lines emphasizing fabric folds and material textures. The setting appears historical, indicating a moment of consultation or planning. The style suggests a woodcut or engraving.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Standard Bearer
title: Standard Bearer
assistive_text: The image depicts a man standing upright, turned slightly to the left. He has a distinct facial expression with defined eyebrows, a mustache, and a beard. His curly hair is covered by an elaborate hat, and he wears a detailed garment with padded components and wide puffed sleeves. He holds a sword in his left hand and a shovel over his right shoulder. A textured cloak billows out behind him. In the background are subtle landscape elements, such as a tree and plants. A plinth beside him indicates the date of the image as 1536.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Profile Study of Two Horse Heads
title: Profile Study of Two Horse Heads
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a horse's head with a geometric framework. The left side shows a diagrammatic representation of a horse's head framed by geometric lines and shapes, illustrating a method of constructing proportions. On the right side, there is a detailed depiction of the horse's head, with intricate mane curls and emphasis on musculature and features like the eye and nostrils.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Two Profile Studies of a Man's Head
title: Two Profile Studies of a Man's Head
assistive_text: The image shows an illustration of a man's head and neck in profile. The man is facing right with a grid structure on the left side displaying the same profile. His face features include a slightly pronounced brow, straight nose, and full lips. He has short hair with visible texture lines. He is depicted without clothing except for a faint line at the base of his neck. There is no jewelry or objects in the image. The background has parallel lines, with text reading "EINES MANNES HAVPT" above and a shield with "1542" and "HsB" between the two profiles.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Three Medals with Coats of Arms
title: Three Medals with Coats of Arms
assistive_text: The image shows three heraldic shields with intricate designs. The shields are adorned with decorative elements and are displayed in circular borders horizontally. The left shield features two stylized creatures, the center shield depicts a lion, and the right shield includes a horn symbol. Acanthus leaves frame each shield design.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ornament with Three Satyrs
title: Ornament with Three Satyrs
assistive_text: This is a drawing of mythical creatures holding ornate scrolls. The image features a central figure with the body of a human and the legs of an animal, holding two large leafy scrolls. Alongside this figure are two other creatures resembling satyrs with goat-like features, each playing a musical instrument. These creatures are intricately detailed with fur-like etchings, and the leafy scrolls showcase detailed patterns and textures. The background is filled with a stippled texture that contrasts with the finely engraved outlines of the figures and foliage.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ornament with Two Genii Riding on Two Chimeras
title: Ornament with Two Genii Riding on Two Chimeras
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a symmetrical ornamental design featuring cherubs and fantastical creatures. The central part of the drawing presents two cherubic figures, each with detailed feathered wings, interacting with goat-like mythical creatures. These creatures have curled horns and serpentine tails. The scene is bordered with swirling acanthus leaves and spirals that adorn the composition. The piece is intricate and rendered in fine detail, emphasizing the contrast in texture between the smooth bodies of the cherubs and the scaled, curled motifs of the background and mythical creatures. The artistic style is reminiscent of Renaissance engravings with elaborate detailing and classical themes.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Capital and Base of a Column
title: Capital and Base of a Column
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural column capital featuring intricate designs of floral and scroll motifs combined with stylized animal heads. The column's capital is embellished with classical decorative elements like acanthus leaves and volutes. The base of the column has simple, elegant moulding. Architectural texts in Latin and German script frame the illustration. The drawing is dated with 'Vitruvius I' noted at the top, suggesting inspiration from the classical architect Vitruvius. The detailed line work and shading convey depth and texture, giving a sense of the column's solidity and craftsmanship.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Coat of Arms with a Rampant Lion
title: Coat of Arms with a Rampant Lion
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a heraldic emblem. The image features a coat of arms centered around a helmet with wings. The helmet has a plume, and a lion is depicted in the shield below it. The emblem is enclosed in a circular frame with an inscription. The drawing shows detailed line work and shading techniques. A date is inscribed at the bottom of the circle.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Coat of Arms with an Eagle
title: Coat of Arms with an Eagle
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a heraldic emblem featuring a helmet with ornate decorations and a bird. The image depicts a detailed medieval-style helmet adorned with a crown-like top and flanked by large plumes. Surrounding the helmet are elaborate scrolls, and foliage motifs creating an intricate frame. Below the helmet, a shield displays an eagle or bird with outstretched wings, a common heraldic symbol. The style of the drawing emphasizes ornate detail and craftsmanship, reminiscent of historical engravings and heraldic illustrations. Decorative banners with text are also included, adding to the heraldic context of the piece.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Job Conversing with His Friends
title: Job Conversing with His Friends
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of figures and an angel in a classical scene. The artwork depicts four seated figures engaged in a serious conversation, each displaying expressive gestures and facial expressions. They are clad in period clothing and are positioned under a tree. To the left, a sack rests on the ground. Central in the scene is a standing woman gesturing with her hands, while an angelic figure hovers above her in the sky. The backdrop displays ancient architecture with the details of stone bricks and arches creating depth.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Virgin and Child with a Parrot
title: The Virgin and Child with a Parrot
assistive_text: The image shows a person sitting with a child standing next to them. The person has distinct facial features, long hair, and wears flowing clothing with voluminous sleeves. The child has curly hair and holds a bird in their hand. The person holds an apple close to the child. In the background, there is a tree with bare branches and a castle or large building labeled "S. MARIA."
creator: Sebald Beham, after Barthel Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Wedding at Cana
title: The Wedding at Cana
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group dining scene. The drawing features several figures seated around a table that is laden with dishes. The architecture of the room shows arched windows that open to a view with trees, through which light streams in. A bird perches on the sill of one of these windows. The composition is densely packed with intricate details, including the varied postures and gestures of the people in the scene. The style reflects techniques used in early European printmaking.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a well or water source. The detailed engraving captures a scene where an individual with a vessel or jug is reaching towards an elderly, bearded figure who is seated by the well. Several other figures are positioned around them, each showing expressions of interest or conversation. The scene features a pulley system at the well and various other containers, with rolling hills and a distant cityscape in the backdrop. The overall composition appears to convey a narrative moment.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Head of Christ
title: Head of Christ
assistive_text: The image is an engraving showing a close-up of an individual's face, displaying from the top of their head to the chin. The person is positioned facing forward and is wearing a crown of thorns on their head. Their facial features include a somber expression with downward-cast eyes, a long, flowing beard, and shoulder-length hair that is slightly wavy. The engraving style emphasizes the texture of the hair and the crown of thorns. The person is not shown wearing any visible clothing or jewelry, nor holding any objects. The background of the image consists of fine lines and shading that suggests a neutral backdrop. At the bottom of the image, there is an inscription that reads "ISP 1520."
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Prodigal Son Wasting His Fortune
title: The Prodigal Son Wasting His Fortune
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of elegantly dressed figures gathered around a table in a garden setting. The image shows finely dressed people engaging with each other beside a round table adorned with food and drink, under a rustic natural setting of trees and shrubs. The figures appear to be conversing or enjoying each other's company at the table, which is set with plates, a goblet, and a flask, indicating a moment of leisure or festivity. The background features nature with abundant foliage and detailed planter pots, suggesting a refined, cultivated environment.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Return of the Prodigal Son
title: The Return of the Prodigal Son
assistive_text: This is a detailed drawing depicting a pastoral scene with various figures engaging in agricultural and domestic tasks. One figure is preparing an animal for a feast, two figures are having an emotional reunion under a tree, and another figure is standing nearby. In the background, a figure is operating a plow near a castle-like structure and natural foliage. The image includes text at the top for context.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Greeks and Trojans
title: Greeks and Trojans
assistive_text: The drawing shows a battle scene with warriors fighting fantastical creatures. The warriors are armed with spears and shields, engaged in combat with centaur-like beings. The composition is dense, depicting chaos with rearing horses and fallen figures. Detailed line work and cross-hatching convey movement and energy of the scene.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Lucretia Standing
title: Lucretia Standing
assistive_text: The image shows a person standing with a dagger in their right hand, poised towards their chest. They have a calm expression with eyes closed, curly hair, and are partially draped in fabric. They are barefoot near a pedestal with engraved text, set against an architectural background with stone-like structures.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Justice of Trajan
title: The Justice of Trajan
assistive_text: This is a drawing of Roman soldiers, a noble figure on a horse, and a distressed woman. The soldiers are clustered in a group with some on horseback. A noble figure on a horse is approached by a woman gesturing. Soldiers with spears and shields surround them. The drawing features intricate detailing in the clothing, armor, and expressions. The text above and between the figures suggests a classical or historical context. The composition is well-balanced, focusing on the interaction between the central figures amidst a background of soldiers and a statue.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Moses and Aaron
title: Moses and Aaron
assistive_text: The image features two figures, Moses and Aaron, depicted from the waist up. Moses is turned slightly to the left, while Aaron is to the right. Moses has a long beard and a stern expression, wearing a robe and resting his hand on a book. Aaron also has a beard and wears a helmet with an inscription, with his hand on the book. Behind them is a stone tablet symbolizing the Ten Commandments, with the names "MOSE" and "AARON" above their heads. The background shows a hilly landscape with mountains and buildings, suggesting a historical or biblical setting. The image is dated 1526 with a monogram in the top right corner.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Une Matinée d'Hiver au Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu (Winter Morning on the Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu)
title: Une Matinée d'Hiver au Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu (Winter Morning on the Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu)
assistive_text: The image depicts a city street scene with horse-drawn carriages moving along a wet street reflecting the surroundings. In the distance, buildings are visible with smoke rising from chimneys. The brushstrokes are detailed, creating a textured portrayal of the scene with a hazy atmosphere. The color palette is sepia and gray, enhancing the historical vibe. People with umbrellas and a street lamp are also present in the scene.
creator: Félix-Hilaire Buhot
medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, stop-out and roulette on japan paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Petite Marine - Souvenir de Medway
title: La Petite Marine - Souvenir de Medway
assistive_text: The image displays a seascape with a sailing vessel positioned towards the left side of the picture, moving across choppy waters. The horizon line is below the midpoint, meeting a sky filled with dynamic clouds. The sky is characterized by varied brushstrokes conveying movement and texture. The color scheme is predominantly sepia. A small figure is seen sitting on a wooden structure in the foreground. Wooden posts and piles of stones are scattered around the coastal setting. In the distance, vague structures hint at nautical elements like lighthouses. The overall mood is dramatic, emphasizing the interaction between the sea and sky.
creator: Félix-Hilaire Buhot
medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and roulette in black on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ex-Libris pour "L'Ensorcelée" (Bookplate for "L'Ensorcelée")
title: Ex-Libris pour "L'Ensorcelée" (Bookplate for "L'Ensorcelée")
assistive_text: The image displays flowing and curved lines, forming an arch at the top center. In the artwork, intricate details mimic objects such as a winged figure or angel, two statuesque forms resembling human figures, and a swan-like bird gliding across a water surface. Wispy lines in the background and foreground create depth, with elements that could resemble foliage blending into the corners of the piece.
creator: Félix-Hilaire Buhot
medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint in black-brown on cream laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Les Noctambules (The Night Prowlers)
title: Les Noctambules (The Night Prowlers)
assistive_text: This is a painting of a dark, cobblestone street scene with dogs gathered around a figure holding an umbrella. The composition is centered on a silhouetted figure under a large umbrella, surrounded by a pack of darkly rendered dogs. The street they stand upon is textured with cobblestones. The background is a shadowy space with indications of buildings or structures. The play of light and shadow, along with textured lines, creates a moody atmosphere.
creator: Félix-Hilaire Buhot
medium: etching and aquatint with scraping and burnishing in black on light blue laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Les Bergeries, Soleil Couchant (Pastoral Scene, Setting Sun)
title: Les Bergeries, Soleil Couchant (Pastoral Scene, Setting Sun)
assistive_text: The image shows a pastoral landscape with farm buildings, fencing, and grazing sheep. The etched style emphasizes texture and the color palette is dominated by sepia tones and browns. In the background, additional animals can be seen in expansive open land merging into a cloudy sky.
creator: Félix-Hilaire Buhot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Adoration of the Magi (Virgin in the Grotto)
title: The Adoration of the Magi (Virgin in the Grotto)
assistive_text: The image shows three main figures in a cave-like setting. One woman and two men are present, along with several cherubic angels in the background. The woman is seated, holding an infant who is standing or leaning against her lap. Her facial features are delicate, with a slightly downward gaze. She wears a draped garment with a head covering, and her hair is partially visible. The man to the left is bald on top with a beard, shown in profile, and appears to be kneeling or bending forward with clasped hands. The man to the right is standing in profile, supporting himself with a staff, wearing a long robe and a wide-brimmed hat, with a beard. Small angels with wings surround the woman and infant, their faces hidden. The scene is framed by cave walls and a rocky foreground, creating a sense of depth. The artwork features intricate linework, typical of an etching or engraving style.
creator: Workshop of Andrea Mantegna
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cumaean Sibyl
title: Cumaean Sibyl
assistive_text: The image shows a full-body depiction of a seated woman positioned slightly to the left, with her head turned to the right. She has delicate facial features, with a serene expression and eyes gazing downward. Her hair is styled elaborately, pulled back with braids and a bun, and adorned with ribbons. The woman is wearing an intricately patterned dress with long sleeves and a square neckline, emphasizing ornate detailing. Draped fabric and decorations swirl around her. She holds an open book with visible text in one hand. The background is plain. Above her, a ribbon banner displays the word "SIBILLA CVMANA" in an elegant script.
creator: after Baccio Baldini
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Arabesque with Knight
title: Arabesque with Knight
assistive_text: This print depicts an armored horseman surrounded by ornate floral patterns. The central horseman is wearing armor, riding a horse that faces the right with its front legs raised, while the rider looks over his shoulder to the left. The area around him is adorned with swirling vines and large flowers. The details of the print are in white lines against a black background, and surrounding the print is off-white paper.
creator: Italian
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: "El Gran Capitanio"
title: "El Gran Capitanio"
assistive_text: The image features a man seen in a three-quarter view from the waist up. He faces slightly left with his gaze directed upwards and away from the viewer. He has distinct facial features including a pronounced nose, full beard and mustache, and wavy shoulder-length hair. The man wears a cap with a rope-like detail, along with a patterned quilted garment with a decorative collar. He holds a wooden rod or staff in his right hand. The background is plain with some shading, and there is text in the upper left corner of the image.
creator: Italian 16th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Portrait of Petrarch
title: Portrait of Petrarch
assistive_text: The image is an engraving of a person in left-facing profile. The individual has a prominent nose, defined jawline, and neutral expression. The head is covered by a hooded garment, with the hood loosely falling around the neck and shoulders. The garment appears simple with emphasis on the draping and folds. The background is plain, with the letters "F: PETR" on the left and "ARCHA" on the right.
creator: Italian 16th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Three Months
title: Three Months
assistive_text: This horizontal image shows three long rows of prints stacked on top of one another, with wide spaces of off-white paper between them. The prints contain scenes depicting various agricultural and domestic activities emblematic of an agrarian lifestyle. In the upper strip, people are depicted engaging in tasks such as transporting goods with a horse-drawn carriage, getting water from a well, cooking a meal, and eating together. The center strip features people laboring in fields, lighting fires, and playing music. The lower strip contains scenes of people working in gardens and planting bare fields. Next to each strip is a different section of text and a numbered illustration of an animal; on the top strip these are on the right side, while on the bottom two strips they are on the left side.
creator: Franz Brun
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Road Map of Central Europe
title: Road Map of Central Europe
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an old map depicting various geographical regions and landmarks. The image consists of a detailed, monochromatic map featuring numerous place names and topographical features, such as rivers, mountains, and seas, all densely labeled in a historical script. The map highlights an intricate network of towns, regions, and natural features. Architectural elements like castles or walled towns are illustrated with small sketches, and the border of the map contains additional information. The style and design suggest the map serves as both a navigational tool and a work of art, reflecting historic cartographic techniques.
creator: Erhard Etzlaub
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Dissolute Household
title: The Dissolute Household
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an interior scene with several figures engaged in various activities. The setting features a room populated with furniture and tools associated with cobbling or leatherwork, suggesting a workshop environment. There are children present causing a commotion, one riding a barrel-like object, another with a basket on their head, and a third interacting with an adult figure at the center who is crafting or carving a shoe. An distracted adult figure leans against a bench on the left. Tools and shoes hang from the walls. Detailed hatching and lines give depth and texture to the scene. The upper region features a smaller inset with an adult figure sitting by a window with a contemplative expression. The style suggests detailed early modern engravings, capturing both chaos and craftsmanship.
creator: Pieter Balten
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ornament - Large Goblet
title: Ornament - Large Goblet
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an ornately decorated chalice or goblet. The design features intricate line work with elaborate floral and scroll motifs throughout. The upper section has a detailed depiction of a face with curly hair. The stem is adorned with bird figures, possibly eagles or griffins. The base is also adorned with complex patterns and another face within an oval frame. The style suggests a Renaissance influence, emphasizing symmetry, mythological elements, and decorative motifs.
creator: German 16th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Silk Gown (La robe de soie)
title: The Silk Gown (La robe de soie)
assistive_text: The image depicts a person sitting in a chair. They are leaning slightly to one side with their hand on their face. They have a calm expression, delicate features, and short dark hair. The individual is wearing an elaborate, voluminous gown. The chair appears to be made of dark wood. The background shows a patterned floor and shadows, hinting at an indoor setting with light coming through windows.

medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Small Donkey at Berck (Un petit ane à Berck)
title: Small Donkey at Berck (Un petit ane à Berck)
assistive_text: The image depicts a donkey harnessed to a large cart or barge, positioned close to the viewer. The donkey and the vessel are seen in profile. The background shows a high horizon with a shaded area suggesting either water or sky. Fine lines and cross-hatching techniques are used to detail the donkey's fur and the cart's surface. The color scheme is monochromatic with cream tones and dark sepia-like lines. In the distance, the scene extends towards the horizon. The artwork portrays a simple yet detailed moment frozen in time.

medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Flore de le Gros
title: La Flore de le Gros

She has delicate features and styled hair, possibly with a headpiece or flowers. She wears a flowing garment with additional fabric and foliage around her. In her right hand, she holds a floral object with leaves. The background features intricate etchings of foliage or a garden setting, contrasting with the woman's smooth figure.

medium: etching, drypoint, and printed tone on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Dancer of Tanjore (La bayadère of Tanjore)
title: The Dancer of Tanjore (La bayadère of Tanjore)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a dancer with a vibrant background. A person on the left is playing a stringed instrument. The dancer is in motion on the right, with fluid movement in the dress. The setting appears to be dimly lit with dense shadowing and dynamic textures. The composition highlights the contrast between the dance posture and the musician's presence. Fine detail and subtle tones create an engaging atmosphere, capturing the essence of music and dance.

medium: etching, drypoint, and printed tone on wove paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Rembrandt van Rijn
title: Rembrandt van Rijn

The background is plain, focusing on the man within an arch frame, from the chest upwards, without prominently visible arms.

medium: chalk, pen and ink, brush and wash on sheet trimmed with gold paper

name: The End

The background is a dimly lit room with a bright wall lamp illuminating the scene.

The background is a textured, muted space, emphasizing the figures in the foreground.

title: Carlos V. lanceando un toro en la plaza de Valladolid (Charles V Spearing a Bull in the Ring at Valladolid)

medium: etching, burnished aquatint, drypoint and burin [first edition impression]

The use of line shading and tonal contrasts adds depth and texture to the image, capturing the tension and energy of the encounter.

medium: etching, burnished aquatint and burin [first edition impression]
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

The composition includes a background wall with a crowd of onlookers observing the action from the stands, adding depth and context to the setting. The lines and shading bring a sense of motion and tension to the image, capturing the dramatic interaction between the bull and the rider.

The image likely portrays themes of bravery and confrontation. The background is a dark expanse that emphasizes the central action. This is in the style of Francisco Goya.

The background is simple and consists of a textured, monochromatic space. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of works by artists known for capturing moments in bullfighting, such as Francisco Goya. The use of line work enhances the action and movement in the scene.

The bull is engaged with the dogs, which are shown in various positions indicating motion and struggle. A horse with a rider is moving away from the scene. The setting appears to be an arena, with minimal background details except for a simple horizontal band. The drawing effectively uses line and shading to convey texture and movement.

medium: etching, burnished aquatint and drypoint [first edition impression]

The onlookers are leaning over the barrier, watching the event with animated expressions. The art style uses strong contrast and detailed linework to show texture and shading. The drawing is in the style of Francisco Goya, reflecting the expressive depiction of Spanish bullfighting scenes in his work.

medium: etching, burnished aquatint and drypoint [first edition impression]

name: St James's Street
title: St James's Street
assistive_text: The image shows an elevated view of a busy street scene. In the distance, a building with a clock tower marks the low horizon. The etching technique features detailed lines outlining the buildings and people on the street. Buildings on both sides of the street lead towards the clock tower, creating depth. The color scheme is monochromatic with black and white shades. The street is filled with pedestrians and horse-drawn carriages, depicted with energetic strokes. Architectural details on the buildings are intricately drawn.

medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Job and His Family
title: Job and His Family
assistive_text: The illustration features a group of figures, with the entirety of their upper bodies and most of their lower bodies shown. The central figure, an older man with a long beard, stands in the middle, flanked by eight younger people on each side. The figures are posed upright, some with hands clasped in front of them. The older man has long, flowing hair, while the others have shorter, neatly styled hair. They wear simple, flowing robes. Rows of sheep surround them, with a large tree in the background holding musical instruments. Tent-like structures and a crescent moon are visible in the landscape against a hilly terrain. The sky is bright. The image is bordered by text featuring scriptural elements.
creator: William Blake
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Destruction of Job's Sons
title: The Destruction of Job's Sons
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a winged figure descending from a turbulent sky. Below them, multiple human forms are entangled amidst destroyed architecture. The figures express emotions such as fear and despair. The style is intricate with detailed line work, suggesting a narrative with mythological or biblical undertones. The border features text that reinforces the theme of divine or cosmic calamity, adding context to the scene with quotes and inscriptions.
creator: William Blake
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Satan Going Forth from the Presence of the Lord
title: Satan Going Forth from the Presence of the Lord
assistive_text: This image features ethereal figures and symbolic representations. In the center, a robed figure with a halo sits on a pedestal, surrounded by adoring figures. Below, a scene shows a robed figure conversing with an elderly figure, with an animal nearby. Angelic beings stand on either side. Intricate designs frame the composition, including snake-like motifs. Textual elements provide context to the scenes depicted.
creator: William Blake
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Lord Answering Job out of the Whirlwind
title: The Lord Answering Job out of the Whirlwind
assistive_text: This is a drawing depicting a biblical scene with a divine figure and onlookers. The scene is intricately sketched with fine lines primarily in monochrome tones, capturing a dynamic, swirling environment. At the center is a powerful figure emerging from a whirlwind. The figure displays an expression of authority and wisdom, surrounded by swirling lines suggesting movement and spiritual energy. Below, two observers appear to be listening intently. Surrounding text refers to divine communication and weather phenomena. The lower text hints at the narrative context, involving a deity's response. The swirling atmospheric elements around the figure emphasize themes of divine authority, human humility, and the interaction of natural elements with spiritual imagery.
creator: William Blake
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Job and His Wife Restored to Prosperity
title: Job and His Wife Restored to Prosperity
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a biblical scene featuring multiple figures and symbolic elements. The central image shows figures in robes, some with musical instruments, surrounded by sheep. The background includes a detailed landscape with a crescent moon and a bright light. Within a decorative border, there are inscriptions with biblical allusions, including references to the life of Job from the Old Testament. The drawing includes elaborate details in the figures' garments and has a sense of harmonious gathering. The text below the central scene references the blessing of Job's latter life with mentions of longevity and generational prosperity.
creator: William Blake
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: May-Day in London
title: May-Day in London
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene on May Day in London. The image shows a busy street filled with activities. Full-description: The drawing depicts characters engaging in a festive atmosphere, including musicians and dancers. In the center, people in period costumes are dancing, some holding hands and others clapping. The background shows urban buildings with banners and signs announcing events like concerts. A man is seen carrying a pole decorated with cups and teapots, possibly for street performance or sales. Dogs are also present. The characters' expressions and body language suggest joy and excitement. Onlookers lean out from upper floor windows to watch the festivities.
creator: William Blake after Samuel Collings
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Discomfited Duellists
title: The Discomfited Duellists
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a chaotic and humorous scene in an interior room. Several figures dressed in 18th-century clothing are engaged in a comical brawl. Two men are confronting each other, with one being pushed against a fireplace. Other figures are involved in different ways, some trying to separate individuals while others are watching. The room includes a fireplace, chairs, artwork on the wall, and a cabinet with decorative items. Two individuals near the wall are holding jugs or bottles, observing the scene. The drawing conveys disorder and absurdity with exaggerated facial expressions and postures.
creator: William Blake after Samuel Collings
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Coromantyn Free Negro, or Ranger, armed
title: A Coromantyn Free Negro, or Ranger, armed
assistive_text: There is a full-body illustration of a person standing upright, facing forward with a rifle resting across their shoulders and held by both hands. The person's facial features are captured in detail, with a neutral expression, and they have short, curly hair adorned with a decorative piece. They are minimally clothed, wearing a form of cloth around their waist and an ornamental strap across their chest. The person holds a rifle and has a sheath with a knife or blade attached to their side. The background depicts an open landscape with a few palm trees and two figures in the distance, also holding rifles and appearing to be in motion. The ground is depicted with some foliage and textured to indicate grass or dirt.
creator: William Blake after John Gabriel Stedman
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sketch of a Shipwreck
title: Sketch of a Shipwreck
assistive_text: This is an illustration of a shipwreck scene. The image shows a group of figures amidst waves and wreckage. The main focus is a shipwreck with broken masts in the background. Some figures cling to the ship remnants, while others are tossed around by waves. One figure, prominently centered, displays a gesture of despair or urgency. The image conveys the chaotic nature of a shipwreck through swirling lines representing water movement and the desperate situation. Detailed line work and shading create depth and drama similar to traditional engraving techniques. The title 'Sketch of a Shipwreck after Romney' suggests the piece is inspired by the style of artist George Romney.
creator: William Blake after George Romney
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Morning Amusements of her Royal Highness
title: The Morning Amusements of her Royal Highness
assistive_text: The image shows a group of six individuals, including both adults and children, gathered in a domestic setting. The individuals are engaging in various activities. One adult woman on the left is sitting in profile, wearing a dress with a full skirt and a lace apron, and a cap. She appears to be instructing two young girls seated next to her on the floor, both wearing dresses with lace detailing and caps, with one child holding an open book. Another adult woman is standing at the center, holding a young child, wrapping them in fabric. She is also wearing a dress with lace and a cap. To the right, another woman is seated, facing forward, leaning slightly on a chair, with elaborate hair and earrings visible; she holds a partially visible piece of cloth. Next to her, behind the chair she leans on, stands another adult wearing a cap and cloak, observing the scene. The background consists of intricately designed panels or wallpaper, and a decorative wall sconce is visible.
creator: William Blake after Thomas Stothard
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Thenot under Fruit Tree
title: Thenot under Fruit Tree

Two figures are sitting under a tree while a flock of sheep grazes nearby. There is a mountainous backdrop and a small dwelling in the distance. The drawing uses detailed line work and high contrast between light and dark areas to convey the stillness of the nighttime environment.
creator: William Blake
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Colinet Departs in Sorrow
title: Colinet Departs in Sorrow

A tree with a twisty trunk is to the right, and sheep are gathered in the background. The landscape slopes gently upward, possibly indicating a horizon line. The style uses linear brushstrokes and crosshatching for texture and shadow, creating depth. The color palette is monochrome with black ink on light paper.
creator: William Blake
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Solomon Worshipping Idols
title: Solomon Worshipping Idols
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an indoor scene with multiple figures and a statue. The gathering includes people in classical attire, with a central bearded figure kneeling before a statue on a pedestal. The statue appears to be of a horned figure, possibly representing a deity. Swirling forms surround the statue, suggesting movement. Other individuals are engaging with each other, dressed in elaborate garments, some wearing crowns or headdresses. The space has architectural features like columns in the background, creating a rich setting. The drawing depicts a complex composition with historical or mythological significance.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Fortitude
title: Fortitude

It includes a chaotic and surreal battlefield with unusual and mythological animals, soldiers using various weapons, and architectural structures. The drawing features detailed figures engaged in combat, riding horses, or lying defeated. The landscape includes a body of water with ships sailing in the background. A central figure stands near a column with wings and a robe. The intricate lines and composition suggest rich narrative and complex symbolism.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Swiss Embassy against the Blue King
title: The Swiss Embassy against the Blue King

The setting includes high walls and arched windows. The people wear medieval clothing with intricate designs and some wear hats or crowns. The detailed linework shows diverse facial features and hairstyles. Some individuals carry spears or staffs. In the background, there are trees, hills, and cloudy skies.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Fan
title: The Fan

name: Attributes of the Virgin

name: Drill with Tilted Pikes
title: Drill with Tilted Pikes

name: Fracischina and Gian Farina

name: Franca Trippa and Fritellino
title: Franca Trippa and Fritellino

"Franca Trippa," positioned on the left, appears to be holding a large exaggerated fork, and is animatedly balanced on one foot. "Fritellino," on the right, holds a string instrument in a poised position while in motion, also on one foot. In the background, a village scene is depicted, with small groups of figures engaged in dance or festive activities, set among buildings that suggest a quaint town or village environment. The style is detailed and theatrical, reflecting an atmosphere of performance or merriment.
creator: after Jacques Callot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Taglia Cantoni and Fracasso
title: Taglia Cantoni and Fracasso
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two figures in a sword fight. The image shows two fancifully dressed figures frozen in a dynamic stance as they cross swords. Both figures wear costumes with wide-brimmed hats adorned with feathers, fitted garments, and capes. The figure on the left is labeled "Taglia Cantoni," with a more assertive forward posture, while the one on the right, "Fracasso," stands with a defensive stance. The background includes smaller figures, possibly an audience. The use of lines and shading emphasizes the dramatic motion and attire, common in caricature or theatrical illustrations.
creator: after Jacques Callot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cap. Cardoni and Maramao
title: Cap. Cardoni and Maramao
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in a confrontation with spears. The scene features one figure labeled as "Cap. Cardoni" and the other as "Maramao." Both are dressed in costume-like outfits. The background includes small groups of additional figures and outlines of buildings, setting the confrontation in an urban environment. The illustration is rendered in a monochromatic style with fine line work and a sense of dynamic motion in the figures' postures.
creator: after Jacques Callot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cap. Esgangarato and Cap. Cocodrillo
title: Cap. Esgangarato and Cap. Cocodrillo
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two fantastical figures engaged in a dynamic pose with smaller figures in the background. The two central figures have exaggerated features, elongated limbs, and eerie, bird-like masks. They are adorned with various items and are depicted in energetic gestures. Smaller figures in the background seem to mimic them. The background shows a building and trees in an outdoor setting. Captions beneath the figures name them 'Csgangarato' and 'Cocodrillo.' The detailed line work adds expressiveness to the scene.
creator: after Jacques Callot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cap. Spessa Monti and Bagattino
title: Cap. Spessa Monti and Bagattino
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two figures in costume performing with a crowd in the background. The drawing depicts two characters in exaggerated theatrical costumes. The figure on the left is labeled "Cap. Spessa Monti" and wields a sword with a dramatic stance. The figure on the right is labeled "BaGattino" and strikes a comical pose with an amused expression. A group of smaller figures are shown in the background interacting with each other. The focus is on theatrical tradition, with detailed costumes and expressive body language.
creator: after Jacques Callot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cap. Cerimonia and Siga. Lavinia
title: Cap. Cerimonia and Siga. Lavinia
assistive_text: The image shows two figures in full body view. On the left is a character labeled "Cap. Cerimonia" standing with a slightly bent posture and head tilted to the right. This figure has exaggerated facial features, a large pointed nose, broad grin, and a wing-like structure emerging from the back. The character wears a long, buttoned garment with an elongated shoe and holds a theatrical mask with streamers. On the right is "Sig. Lauma," a female figure standing upright and slightly turned to the left. She wears a large feathered hat and has an elegant hairstyle with curled hair framing her face. She is dressed in a long gown with her right hand on her hip. Both figures are in an open courtyard or plaza with smaller figures in the background engaged in various festive activities and dancing. Simple buildings with facades and the characters' names inscribed below them can be seen.
creator: after Jacques Callot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cucorongna and Pernoualla
title: Cucorongna and Pernoualla
assistive_text: The image depicts two anthropomorphic figures positioned side-by-side in a dynamic stance. These figures have a humanoid shape but appear to be bird-like creatures with large beak-like structures, extensive plumage, and thin limbs. Their heads are adorned with multiple feathers. They are not wearing traditional clothing, but their bodies are covered with what resembles feathers or fur. They stand on a plain background with drawn figures resembling spectators and a possible stage or platform indicated by an uneven horizontal line. The setting features faintly depicted architectural structures in the background. The figures are captioned "Cucorongna" and "Pernoualla."
creator: after Jacques Callot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Guatsetto and Mestolino
title: Guatsetto and Mestolino
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two large, anthropomorphic bird-like figures engaged in a confrontation. The drawing features two figures with exaggerated features facing each other, each wearing wide-brimmed hats adorned with long feathers and holding swords. Their attire is reminiscent of 16th or 17th-century European fashion. The scene is lively with numerous smaller figures in the background, some with similar bird-like features, engaged in various activities such as gesturing or cheering. The composition suggests a theatrical or comical scenario, with the names "Guatsofro" and "Mestolino" inscribed beneath each primary figure. The style suggests a satirical or caricatured portrayal, capturing a sense of drama and humor.
creator: after Jacques Callot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Envy
title: Envy
assistive_text: This is an image of a scene featuring a figure with elongated limbs and flowing garments, accompanied by a small dog-like creature and a winged demon perched on its head. The image includes the text "Invidia" at the bottom. The figure appears to be in motion, with hair and clothing billowing backwards. The figure holds a serpent in one hand and the other hand clutches its own chin. The dog-like creature beside them seems to snarl or bark. The winged demon on the figure's head adds an additional layer to the drawing. The style is reminiscent of works from the Renaissance.
creator: Jacques Callot
medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Camp
title: The Camp
assistive_text: This image depicts a military encampment from a bird's-eye view. In the foreground, there are soldiers gathered around a table engaging in various activities. In the center, there is a large tree with detailed branches. In the background, tents are scattered in a line. The artwork showcases precise brushstrokes and uses a monochromatic color palette of brown tones.
creator: Jacques Callot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Battle
title: The Battle
assistive_text: The scene depicts a battle with soldiers engaged in combat. The background shows a swirl of smoke, soldiers on horseback and foot, fallen soldiers, and a structure in the distance. The illustration is primarily monochromatic with detailed line work emphasizing complexity.
creator: Jacques Callot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Hospital
title: The Hospital
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an urban scene with a gathering of figures in a town square. The drawing depicts a bustling street of what appears to be a historical or old European city. The architecture consists of classical buildings with ornate facades and intricate window designs. In the foreground, a crowd of figures in various poses are wearing cloaks and hats, some using sticks to aid their movement. The composition features an array of buildings including a prominent domed structure on the right and several multi-story buildings on the left with rows of windows. Additionally, there's a well-like structure in the street and further details of urban life captured through figures engaged in activities in the background. The drawing is etched with careful line work, providing a detailed view of the surroundings and the narrative of daily life in this imagined or historical setting.
creator: Jacques Callot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Peasants Avenge Themselves
title: The Peasants Avenge Themselves
assistive_text: The image displays a chaotic scene with a high horizon line featuring distant trees and a building, potentially a church. The style is detailed and expressive with fine brushstrokes capturing the liveliness of the scene. The color scheme is monochrome in black and sepia on a beige background. Figures in combat or fleeing are in the foreground, while further back, there are individuals on horseback and more activity within a wooded area. In the background, there are more trees and faint structures indicating a town or settlement.
creator: Jacques Callot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Distribution of Rewards
title: Distribution of Rewards
assistive_text: This is a print of a military scene in a grand architectural setting. The scene depicts an elaborate ceremony or presentation in a large hall or courtyard surrounded by arches and columns. A central figure is seated on an elevated throne on the right, and surrounded by several standing individuals engaged with a large group of armed soldiers gathered in front of the throne. The soldiers appear to be assembled in a formal manner, holding banners, and clad in military attire of the period, including feathered caps and armor. The intricate cross-hatching technique used highlights the textures and shadows, adding depth to the scene. The text below the illustration in French suggests a didactic or moralizing element to the image.
creator: Jacques Callot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Assumption of the Virgin
title: The Assumption of the Virgin
assistive_text: The image is a black-and-white engraving depicting a religious scene. In the upper portion, a woman is shown ascending amongst clouds, with her hands clasped in front of her. She has closed eyes and long flowing hair. Surrounding her are cherubs with wings. Below her, a group of figures are gathered, appearing to witness the scene. They have various expressions and hairstyles, and are dressed in draped clothing. The background consists of dense cloud formations.
creator: Domenico Campagnola
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Virgin and Child with Saints
title: The Virgin and Child with Saints
assistive_text: The image depicts several figures in a detailed engraving style. The central figure is a robed woman holding a child. The child has curly hair and is facing the viewer. To the left stands another figure in robes holding a staff, and to the right, a woman is kneeling. Two bearded men stand behind them, one reading a book aloud. All figures wear draped garments suggesting a historical or religious theme. A large tree with a dense canopy is in the background, along with the silhouette of a cross. In the bottom right corner, there is a signature that reads "Dominicus a Compagnola."
creator: Domenico Campagnola
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jesus Preaching in the Temple
title: Jesus Preaching in the Temple
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene in a classical architectural setting. The image features several figures draped in robes, gathered in a semi-circular arrangement. The central figure is positioned behind a podium or a lectern, illuminated with rays of light emanating from them. Surrounding this figure are other individuals, some holding books or scrolls, depicted in various thoughtful and engaged poses. The background showcases an architectural space with arches and columns. The intricate details emphasize the folds of the clothing and the expressive features of the figures. The drawing is executed with fine lines and shading, creating a sense of depth and texture.
creator: after Master IB
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Paul Verlaine
title: Paul Verlaine
assistive_text: The image depicts the head of a man facing the viewer. He has distinct facial features with a full beard and mustache. His hair is sparse at the top, with a high forehead and a calm expression. The man is surrounded by a soft haze, creating a dream-like effect. The background is dark and indistinct, emphasizing the man's face with subtle tonal variations.
creator: Eugène Carrière
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Letter
title: The Letter
assistive_text: We look slightly down onto a young woman sitting at a writing desk as she licks an envelope in this vertical, color print. A table folds down or extends from a tall secretary desk to our right. The blotter on the table and the woman’s long dress are both royal blue. The dress has a vaguely floral pattern in the cream-white of the paper, and the jacket is open to reveal a vertically pleated, pale pink shirt beneath. The woman’s skin is also the color of the paper. Her black hair is pulled back over dark brows and a delicate nose. She holds the open flap of the envelope to her mouth with both hands. A piece of white paper lies on the desktop in front of her. She sits in a brown chair, and the wallpaper of the room is patterned with green leaves and muted pink flowers against a white background. The artist signed the work with her initials in graphite in the bottom left, “MC.”
creator: Mary Cassatt
medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Reine and Margot Seated on a Sofa (No. 2)
title: Reine and Margot Seated on a Sofa (No. 2)
assistive_text: The image depicts a woman with a young girl on her lap. The woman is seated, leaning slightly forward with her head tilted down towards the girl. Her facial features are soft, with closed eyes and a slight smile. Her hair is styled in a neat updo and she is wearing a simple, long-sleeved garment. The child is cradled in her arms, gazing up at the woman's face. The girl's hair is short and straight, falling just below her ears, and she wears a short-sleeved dress. The background is minimal and abstract, with just a few lines suggesting the outline of a window or a wall.
creator: Mary Cassatt
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Repose
title: Repose
assistive_text: The image shows an adult sitting with a child on her lap. Both figures are positioned centrally in the frame. The adult, a woman, has her hair styled back and features a solemn expression. The child has short hair and is looking towards the left.
