The woman is wearing a long-sleeved dress with a small pattern, while the child is dressed in a sleeveless garment. They are sitting in front of a plain background with vertical panel lines. There are no visible items of jewelry or objects. The artwork is a sketch with minimalist, monochromatic lines providing detail and shading.
creator: Mary Cassatt
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jean Baptiste Simeon Chardin
title: Jean Baptiste Simeon Chardin
assistive_text: The image is a portrait of a person with defined facial features and a gentle expression. They wear spectacles and a fabric headpiece, and are dressed in a coat with a scarf or cravat. The background is plain and dark, with a decorative border featuring ornate designs and an inscription with the name "Jean Baptiste Simeon Chardin" and other text below the portrait.
creator: Juste Chevillet after Jean Siméon Chardin
medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Blind Beggar
title: The Blind Beggar
assistive_text: The image shows a man standing upright and facing left. He has distinct facial features such as a long nose and a round chin, closed eyes, and short, wavy hair under a floppy hat. He wears a long robe, a scarf or collar around his neck, is holding a walking stick in his right hand, and a small metal cup in his left. A leash extends from his right hand to a small dog at his feet. The background features a stone wall with shadows and a wooden chair with a woven seat to the right. The overall setting appears to be an exterior space, perhaps a street or courtyard against a building wall.
creator: Pierre Louis de Surugue after Jean Siméon Chardin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Femmes Mauresques de Constantine
title: Femmes Mauresques de Constantine
assistive_text: The image shows two people seated together, from head to mid-calf. The person on the left is cross-legged, facing slightly towards the right. They have dark hair covered by a turban. The person on the right is reclining with one arm resting on a gazelle or similar animal. Both individuals have delicate facial features and are dressed in ornate garments. They are seated on a textured fabric, with subtle, indistinct patterns in the background.
creator: Théodore Chassériau
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Haywain
title: The Haywain
assistive_text: This is a print depicting a rural landscape scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon line is placed slightly below the center of the print, where in the distance the sky meets the treetops past far-away fields. Closest to us is a body of water with some tall, leafy trees on the left behind a small cottage with a pointed roof. In the center, a horse-drawn cart is partially submerged in the shallow water, heading away from us towards the distant bank. On the cart are two people, one of whom holds a long, thin object. To the left, a dog stands by the water's edge, observing the cart. Another person is partially visible in the water by the cottage. Above the scene, the sky is filled with soft, fluffy clouds. The shapes in the print are made up of small dots and lines in black against the off-white paper, making some details hard to discern.
creator: Timothy Cole after John Constable
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Design for a Pendant with a Sea-Monster Carrying Thetis and a Man with a Sail
title: Design for a Pendant with a Sea-Monster Carrying Thetis and a Man with a Sail
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a fantastical creature with intricate details and elaborate decorations. The creature resembles a dragon-like animal with baroque embellishments. A human figure stands on top of the creature with a bow, while another figure sits with a staff. The drawing features scrolling vines and decorative elements, showcasing expert linework and shading.
creator: Hans Collaert the Elder
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Title Plate with Designs for Pendants
title: Title Plate with Designs for Pendants
assistive_text: This is a black and white print featuring two large pendants resembling fantastical fish or sea dragons. Each creature supports a small human figure on its back, sitting on top of large seashells. The sea creatures hang from chains suspended from ornate jewels at the top of the image, and more jewels dangle from the bottoms of the creatures. Below the creatures is a separate design, where a central figure holds a trident and stands atop an elaborate decorative frame containing two lines of text. The text is surrounded by a border filled with decorative elements such as scrolling leaves, floral motifs, and the heads of animals. The background of the print is beige paper.
creator: Hans Collaert the Elder
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Virgin and Child
title: Virgin and Child
assistive_text: The image shows two figures, a seated woman with a child on her lap. The woman has her head slightly tilted downwards, looking at the child. She has soft facial features and long hair flowing down past her shoulders. She is draped in a flowing garment and supporting the child with her arms. The child is seated facing the viewer, with the head turned towards the woman, short curly hair, and minimal clothing. There are no visible jewelry pieces. A circular composition surrounds them, with radiant lines behind the woman's head. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures. Inscriptions read "IESVS MARIA" at the bottom, with additional smaller inscriptions below the scene.
creator: Bartolomeo Coriolano after Guido Reni
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sibyl
title: Sibyl
assistive_text: This print depicts a seated woman, with her body partially turned to the right and her face in profile, facing right. She has a long, straight nose, a strong brow, round eyes, and thin lips in a neutral expression, and her wavy hair is styled loosely around her head. She is wearing a draped garment, similar to a toga, which flows elegantly around her and bunches around her arms. The woman is holding a large blank tablet in her left hand, and her right elbow is resting on a piece of furniture. An inkwell with a quill inside it is on a surface next to her, on the right. One of her feet is visible below her garment, resting on what looks like a thick book. Behind her is a plain wall. The print contains thin white and black lines against a pale blue-gray background.
creator: Bartolomeo Coriolano or Giuseppe Maria Moretti after Guido Reni
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Gardens of Horace (Les Jardins d'Horace)
title: The Gardens of Horace (Les Jardins d'Horace)
assistive_text: The image depicts a wooden area. Trees and foliage arch above, framing the scene. In the foreground, there is a figure standing in tall grass. A dark shape, possibly an animal, is beside them. The trees and leaves form a canopy, almost hiding the sky. The horizon is not clear in the vertically-oriented composition. The color scheme is sepia, giving an aged look. The brushstrokes are detailed, emphasizing the texture of the woodland setting.
creator: Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hunter on Horseback Hunting a Wild Boar
title: Hunter on Horseback Hunting a Wild Boar
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a hunting scene in a dense forest. The drawing depicts a forest with tall, slender trees in the background and detailed branches and leaves. The foreground shows an interaction between animals and a figure on a horse. The figure is wearing period attire and is engaged with two wild boars. One of the boars appears to charge towards the figure. The drawing's line work captures textures of the animals' fur and the forest's foliage. The style and technique resemble the craftsmanship of a woodcut or engraving.
creator: Lucas Cranach the Elder
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
assistive_text: This is a print depicting a pastoral scene with numerous cherubs interacting with nature. The print features a large tree in the center, surrounded by several small, winged cherubs who are either perched on its branches, playing among the leaves, or sitting with each other on the ground. Details give the tree a dynamic character, with its gnarled branches twisting in various directions. Below the tree, a woman sits, holding an infant. On the left, a man bends down towards her, holding the reigns of a donkey that stands next to him on the far left. In the background, the small shapes of buildings seem to indicate a distant town or village.
creator: Lucas Cranach the Elder
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sunrise (Le Lever du soleil)
title: Sunrise (Le Lever du soleil)
assistive_text: The image shows a landscape from an elevated view, revealing a pastoral scene. The horizon is placed in the upper third of the composition, meeting rolling hills that fade into the distance. Above the horizon, the sun is partially obscured by fine lines, suggesting rays of light. The technique uses cross-hatching brushstrokes for depth and texture. Closest to us, sparse vegetation and a figure with animals, likely sheep, are visible. In the distance, a line of trees stretches across the scene, aligned with the land's slope. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of gray, enhancing the etched aesthetic of the artwork.
creator: Charles-François Daubigny
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le passé - Le présent - l'Avenir
title: Le passé - Le présent - l'Avenir
assistive_text: The image shows a caricature focusing on the upper body of a person. The individual is positioned facing forward with exaggerated head and facial features. The facial expression is stern, with squinted eyes, thick eyebrows, a bulbous nose, and a pronounced frown. The person is wearing a dark jacket with a white collared shirt and a cravat. The background is plain, and there are French words at the bottom of the image: "le passé," "le présent," and "l'avenir," which translate to "the past," "the present," and "the future."
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Gros Cupide, va!
title: Gros Cupide, va!
assistive_text: The image shows a standing man with a slouch, slightly leaning to his right. He has exaggerated facial features like a prominent nose and large sideburns, closed eyes, and a content expression. He wears a military-style hat with dark hair peeking out, a dark coat with decorations and epaulets, holding his belly with one hand. A sword hangs from his belt. He wears light trousers and dark shoes. The background is plain.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Voyage a travers les populations empressées
title: Voyage a travers les populations empressées
assistive_text: This is an image of a rider on a horse in a barren landscape. The scene features a rider wearing a large hat and coat, facing away, mounted on a horse. The background is sparse, with birds flying in the sky. In the foreground, there are figures on the ground. The terrain looks rugged and inhospitable, creating an atmosphere of hardship. The style of the drawing is caricature-like, with exaggerated features and a dramatic mood.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Repos de la France
title: Repos de la France
assistive_text: The image shows a man seated on an ornate chair with animal head carvings on the armrests. His legs are spread out and rest on cannon barrels. He wears light-colored trousers and a dark jacket, with a white top hat partly covering his face. Beside him stands a woman covered in a shawl, facing towards him. The plain background highlights the figures and the chair.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Marie-Louise-Charlotte-Philippinepairie
title: Marie-Louise-Charlotte-Philippinepairie
assistive_text: The image depicts a figure sitting in a chair. The person is shown with both arms resting on their lap. In the left hand, they hold a money bag labeled "1001", while coins spill from the right hand into another bag labeled "NATION". The facial features are exaggerated, with a round, plump face and a broad nose, adorned with a smile. A grand hat featuring three large plume-like feathers obscures the person's hair. The ornate clothing includes a dress with detailed patterns, roses, and folds that suggest heavy, luxurious fabric. At the figure's feet are elongated fingers labeled with names or words. The background is plain, with shading suggesting a simple indoor space.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Barbé-Marbois
title: Barbé-Marbois
assistive_text: The image shows an illustration of a person seated in a chair, seen in profile from the knees up. The individual has a solemn expression, a prominent nose, and is wearing a cap or head covering. They are dressed in a long robe and simple shoes, with their feet crossed at the ankles. The background is plain, highlighting the figure against an unadorned backdrop.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Gazan
title: Gazan
assistive_text: The image shows a man sitting down with his legs slightly spread apart and his hands resting on his thighs. He is leaning forward with his head facing downward and has a stern facial expression. The man has exaggerated, cartoonish features, closely cropped hair, and is wearing a dark suit with a vest, coat, and trousers. His formal shoes are partially visible. The background is a textured gradient.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Ventre Législatif (The Legislative Belly)
title: Le Ventre Législatif (The Legislative Belly)
assistive_text: The image shows a satirical drawing of a group of men in a legislative chamber. The men are depicted from the waist up, seated in several rows of benches. They have exaggerated facial features, varying hairstyles, and are dressed in 19th-century formal attire. Some hold papers. The scene is set in a semicircular hall with labeled rows, with figures in the background engaged in conversation or looking at documents.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Très hauts et très puissans moutards et moutardes légitimes
title: Très hauts et très puissans moutards et moutardes légitimes
assistive_text: The image shows three figures and a seated child with exaggerated facial features. The central figure is a young person sitting upright on a rocking horse, wearing a dark, tailored outfit with a large ruffled collar and a crown on their head. They hold a sword in one hand. To the left is another child with long hair and a crown, wearing a dark coat with intricate embroidery over a light dress and boots. On the right is a child with curls, a crown, and a flowing gown, holding a doll. In front of them is a smaller person wearing a large hat and an outfit with a collar, kneeling and holding an object. The background is plain.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: C'est tout de même flatteur d'avoir fait tant d'élèves!...
title: C'est tout de même flatteur d'avoir fait tant d'élèves!...
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene set on a busy street with several individuals engaged in conversation or movement. The composition features a variety of figures dressed in attire suggestive of the 19th century, including top hats and coats. The drawing captures the lively atmosphere of an urban setting, with people appearing to be engaged in social or business exchanges. Large signs in the background suggest commercial activity, with text indicating transactions or advertisements for stocks or capital investments. The expressions and postures of the individuals convey a sense of engagement or negotiation, and the style of the drawing employs detailed lines and exaggerated features.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'Éducation au biberon
title: L'Éducation au biberon
assistive_text: The image shows two individuals and a small doll-like figure sitting on a bed. The person in the middle has distinct facial features with sharp lines, a pointed nose, and slightly messy hair. The other individual, wearing a nightcap, has exaggerated facial features and an open-mouth expression. Both are dressed in nightshirts and are sitting closely together. The person in the middle holds the small figure, which has an oversized head compared to its body. The background is simple, with a handwritten signature and date in the lower right corner.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Oui Monsieur vous n'êtes pas de Paris...
title: Oui Monsieur vous n'êtes pas de Paris...
assistive_text: The image shows two men standing from the waist up. The man on the left is leaning towards the other man, whose body is partially turned towards him. Both men wear dark, brimmed hats. The man on the left has a sharp nose and facial hair under his chin, wearing a coat with a high collar and holding an object behind his back. The man on the right looks surprised, with wide eyes and a furrowed brow. He is clean-shaven and wearing a jacket over a vest, with his hand near his neck. The background is plain.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'Oeil du maitre
title: L'Oeil du maitre
assistive_text: The image shows two individuals in an interior setting. The person on the right is standing in a three-quarter pose, facing slightly to the right, appearing to examine a glass close to their face. They have prominent facial features, a sharp nose, and a thoughtful expression. They are dressed in a white cap, a long white shirt, fitted pants, and slippers. The second individual, positioned towards the background on the left, is standing in profile while looking down at something they hold with both hands. They wear a long white garment and a dark cap. The background features drapery, a framed picture, and a small table with a glass display case holding an object.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'Ami de collège
title: L'Ami de collège
assistive_text: This image shows two individuals in full length. The person on the left is facing the viewer, slightly bent backward with an expression. They have prominent facial features with exaggerated eyes and eyebrows, straight black hair, and are dressed in dark, long clothing and holding a top hat. The person on the right embraces the first person closely with arms wrapped around their shoulders. Their face is partially obscured, but they appear to wear a top hat and have a similarly elongated form. Their clothing is also dark with a somewhat tattered, long coat or dress. In the background, there is a sketchy depiction of a busy setting with numerous other figures in top hats, outlines of buildings, and cobblestone ground.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Pique-Assiette
title: Pique-Assiette
assistive_text: The image shows a person standing on a step, looking downward or contemplating. The individual has distinct facial features, wears glasses, a tall top hat, formal attire, and is in a cityscape setting with tall buildings and a horse-drawn carriage.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Claqueur
title: Le Claqueur
assistive_text: The image shows a person standing in profile with their hands in their pockets, leaning against a wall. They have a determined expression and are wearing a light-colored long coat, dark pants, and shoes. The person's hair is partially covered by a peaked cap and they have a cigar in their mouth, with smoke rising. The background includes textured walls and architectural elements, suggesting an urban setting.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'Acteur des Funambules
title: L'Acteur des Funambules
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a snowy night scene outside the entrance of a theater. The central figure is an older individual in a long overcoat, stockings, and a top hat. They are hunched forward, holding papers, possibly a script. Snow is falling around them. To the left, a crowd of onlookers watches from behind a wooden railing. The entrance to the theater reads "ENTREE DES ACTEURS." The drawing is rendered in black and white with detailed line work and shading, reminiscent of Honoré Daumier's style.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: J'ai vu Seigneur... votre malheureux fils...
title: J'ai vu Seigneur... votre malheureux fils...
assistive_text: This print shows two men. The man on the left is in profile, looking to the right at the other man. He has exaggerated features, with a sloping nose, a wide, downturned mouth opened to reveal a few large teeth, and a weak, flabby chin. His eyes are large and wide, and his eyebrows are raised high on his forehead. His arms are extended outward, towards the other man. The man on the right has his arms crossed and his shoulders raised in a shrug. He faces us, but his eyes look towards the right. He has a large, round nose, wide eyes, and raised eyebrows. His closed lips are downturned, and he has a dark beard and mustache. Both men have light skin and dark, curly hair, and they wear draped cloth garments. The background is mostly off-white paper, with some darker shading in the area between the men. Words are written faintly at the bottom of the paper.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ulysse et Pénélope
title: Ulysse et Pénélope
assistive_text: The image shows two people partially visible from the chest upwards, lying in a bed. One person is reclined with their head resting on a pillow and is covered up to the chest with a blanket. They have an angular face with defined features and are wearing a head covering. The other person is leaning over them, supporting themselves with their arm and smiling. This person has a round face with short dark hair. Both are dressed in loose, slightly rumpled clothing, likely bedclothes. The setting inside appears domestic, with a decorated large clock on the wall above the bed. The background suggests an interior room with simple decor, emphasizing the bed and the individuals within it.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Vois-tu, mon ami... il n'y a que deux élemens... du bonheur...
title: Vois-tu, mon ami... il n'y a que deux élemens... du bonheur...
assistive_text: This is a drawing of three individuals gathered around a table under a leafy canopy. Two individuals are seated at a wooden table, while a third stands beside them. The seated individuals have varied poses, one leaning forward attentively and the other wearing a hat with a striped pattern. The backdrop is dense with foliage creating a textured, intricate contrast to the white space around them. The style is sketch-like with emphasis on shading and line work, displaying the figures and greenery.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Allons donc... que diable cocher...
title: Allons donc... que diable cocher...
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn carriage traveling quickly. It shows the front view of the carriage being pulled by a horse. The open-topped carriage contains four figures. The horse is detailed, and its posture suggests movement. In the background, there is an explosion with curved lines indicating motion and a chaotic scene. The drawing is in black and white, emphasizing contrast and shadow.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Rencontre sous bois
title: La Rencontre sous bois
assistive_text: The image shows two men in a wooded setting, both engaged in an encounter or confrontation. The point of view is level with the two men. A large tree dominates the center, obscuring part of each man. The horizon is not clearly visible due to dense foliage. The style of the artwork is detailed with fine brushstrokes, characterized by cross-hatching and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black, white, and gray. One man stands holding a stick, crouched as if ready to spring. Across from him, the other man leans forward with a weapon in hand. Beyond them, more trees fade into the dark tones of the woods.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Une Nouvelle connaissance
title: Une Nouvelle connaissance
assistive_text: The image depicts two individuals in a half-body format. On the left, a man is leaning slightly forward, while a woman stands facing him on the right. The man has a bald head with a few tufts of hair, a prominent nose, and is wearing a dark suit. His hand is in his jacket pocket. The woman has a round face with lines on her forehead, wears a broad-brimmed bonnet tied under her chin, and carries a small dog wrapped in a blanket. The background is textured and dark, creating an old-fashioned feel.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Gibier qui peut être chassé en toutes les saisons
title: Gibier qui peut être chassé en toutes les saisons
assistive_text: The image shows five men standing. The central figure is held by four surrounding men, two on each side. The central figure stands still with a slightly concerned expression, medium-length hair swept to the sides, wearing a waistcoat, a dark jacket, and trousers, with hands by his sides. The other men wear top hats and long coats, holding onto him firmly. One gestures with his right hand while holding the central figure with his left hand. The other men have expressions of focus or determination. The setting is a simple interior with a tiled floor and a textured wall. A fallen top hat lies on the ground in front of the group.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Cour, vidant le délibéré...
title: La Cour, vidant le délibéré...
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. The image depicts a gathering in a courtroom, featuring several seated individuals involved in legal proceedings. Two figures are sitting behind a desk, one of them writing or reviewing documents, while another is reading from a piece of paper. In the foreground, two individuals are seated in a defendent's area, facing towards the judges and clerks.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mr. le Juge de paix a rendu sa décision...
title: Mr. le Juge de paix a rendu sa décision...
assistive_text: Three people are shown in the image. Two elderly women are in the foreground, depicted from the waist up. One woman is in profile, facing her companion with a gesture. The other woman has her hands clasped in front. Both women have gaunt faces and wear head coverings, one with a bonnet-like headscarf and the other with a fitted cap. They wear modest clothing typical of the 19th century. In the background, a man is seated. He wears a robe and a tall hat, typical of a judge. He is positioned behind a wooden desk or podium. There are other figures in the background wearing tall, cylindrical hats and dark clothing. The setting suggests a courtroom. The text header reads "Les Gens de Justice," translating to "The People of Justice."
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Voila le ministère public qui vous dit des choses... désagréables...
title: Voila le ministère public qui vous dit des choses... désagréables...
assistive_text: The image shows three men from the waist up in a courtroom setting. The man on the left is seated and appears asleep with his head leaning forward. He has a round, clean-shaven face with long hair under his tall hat. His attire consists of a robe or coat with a white collar. The central man stands and leans towards the man on the right. He wears a flat cap, has a beard and spectacles, and is dressed similarly to the seated man. He places one hand on a table with documents and a folded cloth. The rightmost man leans over a railing towards the man in the hat with a tense expression. His hair is unkempt, and his attire looks less formal. The background shows a crowd of indistinct faces, focusing on the three men in the foreground.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Vous avez perdu votre procès c'est vrai...
title: Vous avez perdu votre procès c'est vrai...
assistive_text: The image shows two men depicted in full-body view. The taller man stands upright with a demeanor of confidence, while the smaller man is clutching his robe and appears to be leaning back slightly. The taller man has plump facial features and a slight smile, dark hair styled beneath a cap. He is wearing a long black robe with wide sleeves and a white cravat at the neck. The shorter man is wearing a cap and a matching black outfit that consists of a coat and trousers. The backdrop has a textured wall and what appears to be a door to the left side. The image is in a monochromatic style with shading for depth. The border features handwritten text and the artist's initials "L.D." at the bottom.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Comment trouvez-vous ce petit vin-la...
title: Comment trouvez-vous ce petit vin-la...
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a large barrel, various instruments, and four individuals. Two figures are peering over the top of the large barrel, while two others stand alongside each other, one holding a glass near the pipe. To the side, a person is bent over, gathering something in a bag. The style is reminiscent of 19th-century satirical illustrations with exaggerated features and humorous expressions, capturing a vintage industrial or winemaking setting with a whimsical touch.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ah! Gringalet d'Paris... tu viendras faire danser...
title: Ah! Gringalet d'Paris... tu viendras faire danser...
assistive_text: This image shows a group of elegantly dressed people in a public setting. The individuals are wearing 19th-century attire, including top hats, long coats, bonnets, and dresses. Some are engaged in conversations. In the background, there is a podium with two figures; one is playing a flute, while the other is writing or sketching. The scene appears to be outdoors, possibly in a park or street, with a tree visible on the left. The drawing technique uses various shades to depict details and depth, with a focus on facial expressions and clothing textures. The lack of vibrant colors accentuates the contrasts and social interaction theme.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ah! il est frais... mais t'nez donc garçon...
title: Ah! il est frais... mais t'nez donc garçon...
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a formal dining scene. The image depicts a group seated around a table outdoors, where a waiter or server is presenting a dish under a canopy of trees. The figures at the table appear to be engaging in conversation while the server is positioned in a manner suggesting they are serving the main course. The shading and lines give depth to the image, especially the foliage overhead and the detailed attire of the participants. This composition captures a moment of interaction and serves as a vignette of a dining experience.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ah! vous êtes fort en vers latins, jeune homme...
title: Ah! vous êtes fort en vers latins, jeune homme...
assistive_text: The image shows three figures in full view: two men and one boy. The man on the left is slightly hunched forward, with his hands together, while the central man stands with one hand in his pocket and the other holding the boy's hand. The boy stands facing forward, holding a stack of books in his right hand. The man on the left has a prominent nose and chin, and he wears glasses and a tall black top hat. His hair is not visible under the hat. The central man has a large nose and a concerned expression, his hair is also covered by a tall black top hat. The boy has a mop of curly hair and facial features that suggest an expression of disapproval or discontent. All three are dressed in 19th-century clothing. The man on the left wears a long coat that reaches his knees, with pinstriped trousers and boots. The central man wears a dark jacket and trousers with a vest, and the boy wears a matching dark suit with a vest and bow tie. The background depicts an urban setting with suggestions of building facades sketched against the wall, and the ground is flat with slight shading suggesting shadows.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Bourgeois se fesant lire, après diner, quelques chapitres...
title: Bourgeois se fesant lire, après diner, quelques chapitres...
assistive_text: The image shows two individuals, one seated and one standing. The seated person is facing to the right with their hands clasped in their lap, legs crossed. They have their eyes closed and curly hair, wearing a jacket over a shirt and pants, sitting on a wooden chair. The standing person faces the seated individual, reading from a book with long hair and a focused expression, dressed in a long dress with puffed sleeves. In the background, there is a door, a framed item on the wall, and furniture with a bowl or pot. The image is monochromatic with cross-hatching shading.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Inconvénient de visiter sans précaution un entresol...
title: Inconvénient de visiter sans précaution un entresol...
assistive_text: The image depicts two individuals in a 19th-century setting. On the left, a figure wearing a long coat and a tall hat appears startled, with exaggerated gestures and a surprised expression. On the right, an older woman in traditional attire stands calmly with a steady gaze. The room has patterned wallpaper, and the sketch features strong lines and shading with contrast between light and shadow.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Attends... j'te vas en donner... du maitre d'école
title: Attends... j'te vas en donner... du maitre d'école
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a seated man holding a whip, a surprised onlooker, and several other people watching. The man behind the desk is wearing a hat and spectacles. The onlookers have varying expressions. The setting is an interior with a desk and a textured wall in the background.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Entrez donc, monsieur... ne vous gênez pas...
title: Entrez donc, monsieur... ne vous gênez pas...
assistive_text: The image depicts a man standing with a forward lean, in clothing consisting of a long dark coat and striped trousers. He holds two bottles, and his top hat is seen flying off his head. The man has a surprised expression, with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth. The background shows a row of buildings and other figures in the distance, with cobblestones on the ground.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Une Rencontre en pleine eau
title: Une Rencontre en pleine eau
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene on the water featuring several boats. The drawing depicts a group of individuals in a rowboat prominently in the foreground, with one figure seated and wearing a cap, smoking a pipe. Another figure stands, appearing to shout or call out to others. In the background, there is another boat with more figures, as well as a shoreline with distant buildings. The drawing is done in black and white, emphasizing shading and line work to convey the textures of the water and the clothing of the individuals. The overall composition captures the activity and camaraderie of the scene.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Trente secondes de station
title: Trente secondes de station
assistive_text: The image depicts a person being propelled off the roof of a train carriage. The person is shown mid-air with packages and a detached hat swirling around them. Their expression is startled as they reach out. Two other figures are on the train roof holding packages. Faces can be seen in the train windows observing the scene. A person on the station platform below watches the airborne figure with a basket in their arms. The station sign partials reads "STATION."
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: On rend des comptes aux actionnaires
title: On rend des comptes aux actionnaires
assistive_text: The image shows three individuals seated closely together. The central figure is engaged in conversation with another person to his left. The central figure has dark hair styled in an older fashion, with prominent cheekbones and a subtle smile. He is wearing a dark jacket and a collared shirt. The person to his left has lighter, curly hair and is wearing a patterned suit jacket. A third figure, mostly obscured, has a feminine appearance and is seated behind the other two. The setting is intimate with shaded textures suggesting depth. The sketch is monochromatic.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Première leçon de natation
title: La Première leçon de natation
assistive_text: The image shows two individuals: a man and a child. The man is seen in a side profile standing beside a bathtub, slightly bent forward. His facial features include a round face, glasses, prominent nose, and thinning hair. He is wearing a shirt with rolled-up sleeves, waistcoat, and trousers, and holding a thermometer or similar object pointing toward the bathtub. The child is immersed in the bathtub, with only the upper part of their body visible above the water, including arms, face, and hair. The room has a curtain on one side, a picture on the wall, and a chair partially visible. The image is monochromatic with shading and lines for depth.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ornamentation for a Dagger and Scabbard
title: Ornamentation for a Dagger and Scabbard
assistive_text: This drawing depicts ornate architectural elements. The intricate details include sections resembling columns or decorative capitals, with one capital featuring a human face flanked by mermaids and surrounded by ornamental leaves and scrolls. The style is meticulous, with rich textures and shading emphasizing depth and detail. Classic motifs such as acanthus leaves, volutes, and cherubs are present, reflecting opulent design sensibilities of the period. Additionally, an ornamental figure with a globe-like object and elaborate base contributes to the ornate composition.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Inconvénient de mettre son logement...
title: Inconvénient de mettre son logement...
assistive_text: The image shows three individuals positioned in a room. The first person, clothed in a long, dark coat and top hat, is leaning forward to look out of a window. Their face is hidden. Behind them, the second individual stands with hands on hips. This person wears a long-sleeved garment and has an older appearance with defined cheekbones, a stern expression, and short wavy hair. The third individual is seated, immersed in a wooden tub, wearing a pointed nightcap and nightshirt. Their eyes are closed, and they have a tired expression. A dark curtain partially surrounds the scene, and snow can be seen falling outside through the window.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Vue d'une antichambre ministérielle...
title: Vue d'une antichambre ministérielle...
assistive_text: The image shows two men engaged in conversation. The man on the left is slightly bent forward, holding a hat in both hands, with a balding head and sharp facial features. He is wearing a suit with vertically striped pants. The man on the right stands upright with his hands in his pockets. He has a full head of hair and a more weary facial expression, wearing a waistcoat and a necktie. Several other figures are visible in the blurred background of a crowded indoor setting. The scene is in shades of gray, with a textured wall implying an interior environment.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Tiens... je ne te reconnaissais pas...
title: Tiens... je ne te reconnaissais pas...
assistive_text: The image shows two men standing. The man on the left is facing sideways with his legs slightly apart, seemingly speaking. He has short hair and wears a dark coat over a white shirt and light pants. The man on the right faces forward with his hands in his coat pockets, has a long beard, and wears a high-crowned hat. He is dressed in a long, dark overcoat over lighter trousers. There is a framed painting on the wall behind them showing a landscape. The setting seems to be indoors with a neutral-toned wall as the backdrop.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ce satané Pigochard...
title: Ce satané Pigochard...
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a street scene with two uniformed guards and a civilian. The drawing depicts an interaction between three figures on a cobblestone street. Two are dressed in military uniforms with hats, one carrying a rifle, while the third figure appears to be in civilian attire, wearing a hat and a skirt. They appear to be engaged in a conversation. The background consists of a row of building facades fading into the distance and a large structure on the right with a small circular window. The shading and use of lines create a sense of depth and realism in the urban setting.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Eh! bien monsieur et mes trois termes...
title: Eh! bien monsieur et mes trois termes...
assistive_text: The image shows two men standing face to face. The man on the left has hunched shoulders, hands in his pockets, a serious expression, an angular nose, and wears a tall top hat. He is dressed in a dark overcoat and striped trousers. The man on the right is bent forward with hands clasped behind his back. He has a receding hairline, sharp facial features, and a focused gaze. He wears a long coat. The background has a textured wall with swirling patterns and lines suggesting panels or a doorway.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Les Barbotteuses
title: Les Barbotteuses
assistive_text: The image shows several people immersed in water, with their bodies visible from the waist up. The individuals are engaged in different activities. One person on the left is raising their hand, while another person is expressing an emotional reaction. To the right, a person is visible with crossed arms. The individuals have varied hairstyles, with some wearing head coverings. They are all wearing dark swimwear with short sleeves and rounded necklines. The scene takes place in a body of water, with a net behind them suggesting a swimming pool. In the background, two figures are seated on a bench, observing the activity. Another person is seen walking on a platform above the water, wearing similar clothing. The background is depicted with vertical lines.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A la buvette
title: A la buvette
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a dimly lit interior scene depicting two seated and two standing individuals. The two seated individuals are relaxed, smoking cigars, and appear to be in conversation, with a table set between them holding a carafe and two glasses. The setting suggests an informal or casual atmosphere, possibly a bar or lounge, with muted patterns decorating the background. The drawing is executed in monochrome, emphasizing the contrast between light and shadow to create a sense of depth and texture.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Fesant toutes partie de la plus belle moitié...
title: Fesant toutes partie de la plus belle moitié...
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an indoor pool scene. The image contains several individuals by and in a swimming pool, all wearing swimwear from an earlier period. Two figures stand on a poolside deck, one with a head covering and the other sitting on a bench with water dripping off them. In the water, two figures are visible, one glancing up at the person sitting on the bench and the other swimming. In the background, there is a sketchy, shaded wall. The sketch is monochrome, using shading to imply depth and texture.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Chiffonnier philosophe
title: Le Chiffonnier philosophe
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two figures in a room. The setting features an older person and a younger one standing in a dimly lit space. The older figure appears to be pointing or instructing the child, who is looking up. Behind them is a shelf with utensils stored in a container. The room is mostly obscured, but the lighting gives a sense of a workshop or domestic space with a lantern mounted on the wall for ambient lighting. The shading and line work suggest texture and depth, with cross-hatching used to create shadow and form. The details depict a narrative moment captured in a monochromatic style.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Désolé, citoyenne... je ne reçois pas de chiens...
title: Désolé, citoyenne... je ne reçois pas de chiens...
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a street scene involving a carriage. The drawing depicts a city street with a horse-drawn carriage where passengers are either boarding or waiting to board. The grayscale illustration shows a detailed architectural backdrop with buildings that suggest an urban environment. A figure with formal attire is carrying a small dog and holding an umbrella, standing on the cobblestone pavement facing the carriage. Several figures are visible through the windows and at the top of the carriage, which is highlighted using shading techniques to create depth and texture. The artist has used hatchings and various line densities to convey shadows, textures, and movement within the city scene.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Large Spaniard (Le grand Espagnol)
title: Large Spaniard (Le grand Espagnol)
assistive_text: The image shows a detailed drawing of a bust of an older man portrayed from the waist up, in a seated position and turned slightly to his right. The man has a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, high cheekbones, and a serious expression. His hair is short, tousled, and receding. He is dressed in a buttoned vest and a cloak draped over his shoulders. The man is not wearing any visible jewelry or holding any objects. The background is plain, directing focus to the man's portrait.
creator: Alphonse Legros
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Collège Henri IV, Paris, ou Lycée Napoléon (Henry IV College or Napoleon School, Paris)
title: Collège Henri IV, Paris, ou Lycée Napoléon (Henry IV College or Napoleon School, Paris)
assistive_text: The image is an intricate etching of an urban landscape, viewed from an elevated, bird's-eye perspective. The scene shows a sprawling cityscape with various buildings, rooftops, streets, and figures. One prominent structure is detailed with architectural elements and surrounded by courtyards and pathways lined with trees. The rest of the city consists of tightly packed buildings in rectangular and square shapes, with pitched roofs creating a rhythmic pattern. The etching features fine lines and cross-hatching to depict textures and uses a monochromatic color palette of black, brown, and cream to convey depth and contrast.
creator: Charles Meryon
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Charitas (Charity)
title: Charitas (Charity)
assistive_text: The image shows a central figure with wings and cherubim. The adult figure holds a winged cherub across their chest while another cherub reaches toward them from below. The adult figure has defined facial features, elaborate hair, and wears long robes cinched at the waist. Two cherubs and a small dog surround the main figure. The background is neutral with minimal details, and the text "CHARITAS" and an "ISB" monogram is included in the image.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Temperancia (Temperance)
title: Temperancia (Temperance)
assistive_text: The image depicts a full-body figure standing in a slight profile position. The figure has a classic profile facial feature with a well-defined nose and a serene expression. The hair is styled with curls and adorned with a headpiece or wreath. Draped clothing falls elegantly down to the ankles, with a sense of motion in the fabric's folds. Large feathered wings extend from the figure's back. They are holding a jug-like vessel in one hand, pouring liquid onto a ball beneath, while their other arm is bent upward, clutching another vessel. The background has a textured surface with geometric patterns resembling stair steps or a podium. The left side of the image has the word "TEMPERANCIA" along its length, and the inscription "I-SB 1539" is visible on the right.
creator: Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jean-Louis Greppo
title: Jean-Louis Greppo
assistive_text: The image shows a caricature of a man with exaggerated features. He is standing facing slightly to the right, with a long face, large nose, intense gaze, full beard, and short hair. He is dressed in a checkered suit and has his hands in his pockets. In the background, there are other vague figures, a seated person, and a gesturing figure on a platform. The background is lightly sketched with architectural and human elements in a whimsical, cartoonish style.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Adolphe Thiers
title: Adolphe Thiers
assistive_text: The man in this print is standing upright, partially turned to the left, with his hands behind his back. He has pale skin, a long nose, round cheeks, and a hint of a smile on his thin lips. He has short, neatly combed white hair and arched dark eyebrows, and he wears small round spectacles. The man is dressed in formal attire, including a long light-colored coat, a white waistcoat, trousers, and dark boots, with a high-collared shirt. He is holding a rolled object behind his back, like a rolled piece of paper. The background is plain, and the man casts a dark shadow on the blank ground.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: C.H. Odilon Barrot
title: C.H. Odilon Barrot
assistive_text: The image shows a caricature of a man standing on a pedestal. His exaggerated features include a large bald head with some hair at the sides, a prominent brow, and a stern expression. He is dressed in a suit, holding a book labeled "ÉCRIE." Smaller figures surround him, looking up. The background is simple, emphasizing the central figure.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ils prétendent qu'ils la soutiennent
title: Ils prétendent qu'ils la soutiennent
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of caricatured figures interacting with a statue of a woman. Four figures with exaggerated facial features are energetically engaged around the statue, which sits atop a plinth marked with "République Française". The figures appear to be trying to either climb onto or pull at the base, and each figure is rendered with elongated and distorted proportions. The statue of the woman is depicted with classical features and draped attire, reminiscent of allegorical representations of republics or liberty, and holds a shield inscribed with the same "République Française". The setting appears to be humorous or critical in tone, likely commenting on political or social issues.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ferdinand Flocon
title: Ferdinand Flocon
assistive_text: The image depicts a full-body caricature drawing of a person standing with their hands behind their back, holding a top hat. The person is facing forward, with a slightly turned head, exuding a prominent facial expression. Their face features exaggerated large eyes, facial lines, and a bushy mustache. The hair is long and flows down to their shoulders. The person is dressed in formal attire, consisting of a long, dark coat, a shirt, and a bow tie. The clothing appears to have a tailored look typical of formal wear. In the background, there is a faint sketch of seated people.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mais quand je vous dis que je ne peux pas remuer les pieds...
title: Mais quand je vous dis que je ne peux pas remuer les pieds...
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a domestic scene with two figures in an interior setting. The drawing depicts two men engaged in a conversation in a room. One man stands on the left holding a piece of cloth while the other faces him, gesturing. They are dressed in 19th-century attire. The room is furnished with a couch, and there are objects on the floor that resemble slippers or discarded items. The walls have two framed pictures and a decorative clock. The drawing is in a monochrome style using dark lines and shading for texture and depth. The focus is on the moment of interaction with expressive body language and the interior setting.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Un Mari brûlé du feu de la jalousie
title: Un Mari brûlé du feu de la jalousie
assistive_text: This drawing shows an individual submerged in water beneath a tree, with a couple standing on a hill in the background. In the foreground, a person is partially submerged in water, clinging to a large tree trunk amidst the watery landscape. The water is depicted with rippling lines, and vegetation surrounds the edges. A top hat floats nearby. In the background, on an elevated hill, a couple is shown embracing or possibly dancing, partially obscured by atmospheric clouds. The scene conveys a sense of drama and contrasts the struggle in the foreground with the serene moment on the hill. The use of monochromatic tones creates a somber atmosphere.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: C'est t'y a vous c'hien la?
title: C'est t'y a vous c'hien la?
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two figures in a park. One person is standing wearing a cloak and hat, holding out an object with multiple legs. The other person is seated on a bench, looking surprised and dressed in layered clothing. The background shows stylized trees. The artwork uses line and shading to create depth.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Les Temps sont durs...
title: Les Temps sont durs...
assistive_text: The image shows two men walking side by side, engaged in conversation. The man on the left has short, curly hair, raised brows, and a faint smile. He wears a double-breasted coat and holds a cane. The man on the right wears a suit with a waistcoat, has one hand in his pocket, and wears a top hat. The background features a simple sketch of a landscape with hills or dunes.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Plus farceur de la société
title: Le Plus farceur de la société
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a person standing in front of a group of people who are pointing and gesturing. The central figure is holding a bottle and appears animated. The group on the right side is seated and engaged with the central figure. The background is textured with trees, creating a natural setting. The drawing portrays a moment of social interaction using precise linework and shading to convey emotion.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Commerce un jour d'échéance
title: Le Commerce un jour d'échéance
assistive_text: The image shows a caricature with four figures visible. The primary figure in the foreground is a man captured from a side perspective, entering a building. His entire body is visible, wearing a simple, wrapped garment resembling a cloak or blanket, with one knee raised as if in motion. His face is not fully visible, but his head is covered with a cloth-plumed hat, and he wears tattered shoes. Behind him stands another figure with a rotund body, exaggerated facial features, and a top hat. This figure appears to be mid-gesture, watching the man in the foreground. Further behind them, two other figures can be seen, walking together. One of these figures wears glasses and a small top hat, with a shorter stature and pointed chin, while the other has a slightly hunched posture. The scene occurs on a city street, with tall buildings indicated by vertical shading in the background. A sign above the entryway reads "Mont de Piété," indicating the location, and suggests a pawnshop setting.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Se réjouissant... de la fin de la Canicule
title: Se réjouissant... de la fin de la Canicule
assistive_text: The image shows a man and a woman standing next to each other. The man is on the right, leaning back slightly with his arms extended forward. He has short, curly hair and a mustache. He wears a dark jacket over a lighter shirt and trousers. The woman on the left is slightly hunched over, wearing a long dress with a high collar and her head covered. She has a distinct facial expression and raised hands. In front of them is a small dog on all fours, looking at them. The background is a plain wall with simple paneling, and the floor is unobtrusive.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Je vous arrête, mauvais sujet...
title: Je vous arrête, mauvais sujet...
assistive_text: The image depicts two male figures standing on a cobblestone surface. The figure on the left is slightly bent forward, stretching his arm towards the figure on the right. He wears a long coat, knee-length pants, stockings, flat shoes, and a top hat. His facial features appear defined with wrinkles, a pointed nose, and a skeptical expression. The figure on the right stands upright, facing the left figure. He is dressed in a checkered coat, similar pants, stockings, holds a cane in his right hand, and wears a top hat. His facial features are more rounded, with a broad smile and softer expression. The background shows an urban setting with a row of buildings stretching into the distance.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Oui, monsieur Chapuzot...
title: Oui, monsieur Chapuzot...
assistive_text: The image shows a full-body depiction of three individuals: two adults and one child. The adult on the left is standing, bent slightly forward as if engaging in conversation, wearing a long dark coat and a top hat, with short dark hair visible beneath it. The adult on the right is standing straight, looking at the child, also wearing a long coat and a top hat, with short dark hair. Both adults are wearing dark trousers and shoes. The child stands between the two adults, looking towards the adult on the left. The child wears a knee-length dark coat and a small brimmed hat, with facial features that include chubby cheeks and a serious expression. The background consists of a simple sketch, with a wall, shadows, and an indistinct shape resembling a cloud or painting on the wall, suggesting an indoor setting.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Pierre Louis Parisis
title: Pierre Louis Parisis
assistive_text: The image depicts a full-length caricature of a person with an exaggeratedly large head standing upright, facing towards the left. Their facial features include wide-open eyes, a bulbous nose, and a slightly open mouth. The person's hair is sparse and combed back. They are wearing a long, dark, striped robe that drapes down to the ground, and they hold a book under their right arm. Their left hand is holding a whip with multiple lashes. In the background, smaller figures can be seen in chaotic movement, appearing to cower or run away. The background is a simple, unadorned setting with no distinct features.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Allons bon!... il parait... chasse réservée
title: Allons bon!... il parait... chasse réservée
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two cartoonish figures. The figure on the left has an oversized head, bulging eyes, and a helmet; they are running towards the right with a startled expression. They are holding an object that resembles a large knife. Below this figure, a small dog is running. To the right, another figure with an elongated face and wearing a hat is shouting while raising one arm and holding an object in their other hand. The background consists of cloudy shapes and a barren landscape. The drawing style and expressions convey a sense of humor.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'Ane et les deux voleurs
title: L'Ane et les deux voleurs
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two figures grappling on the ground, with an equestrian figure in the background. The composition is dynamic and intense, showcasing a struggle on a rugged landscape with rolling hills. The foreground features a tussle between two figures, with one figure pinning the other to the ground. A rider on a horse moves away swiftly in the background, blending into the rugged landscape. The contrast between the foreground action and the distant rider adds depth and narrative to the image.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ce char marchera toujours...
title: Ce char marchera toujours...
assistive_text: The image features a horse-drawn carriage labeled "RÉPUBLIQUE FRANÇAISE" being pulled by three figures. The carriage is driven by a statue holding an urn inscribed with “VOTE UNIVERSEL.” The scene includes a cobblestone street, a stylized horse, and exaggerated features on the figures, conveying a sense of humor and social commentary. The style is reminiscent of lithograph caricatures from the 19th century.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La paix a tout prix
title: La paix a tout prix
assistive_text: The image depicts a man crouching or bending forward. He has intense facial features with a furrowed brow and a focused expression. He is wearing a long-sleeved outfit, grasping a rifle, while a hand holds a feather behind him. Another hand holds a scepter with a crown and an architectural dome below it. The background is minimal.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Équilibre Européen
title: Équilibre Européen
assistive_text: The image depicts a person balancing on a round object with a lit fuse emitting smoke. The person has arms outstretched and a surprised or open expression. The person has short wavy hair and wears a flowing garment. The background is a plain surface with shading.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La veuve
title: La veuve
assistive_text: Two individuals are seated at a table. The man on the left is casually seated with one leg crossed over the other and his arm resting on the tabletop. He has wavy, short hair and a distinct facial profile. He is dressed in a dark checkered suit with a white shirt. Next to him, a woman is seated, wearing a long, dark dress and a veil covering her hair. Her face is partially obscured by her hands, holding a handkerchief. The background shows a bookshelf filled with books and a bust sculpture on a pedestal. The setting appears to be a study or library.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le Dimanche au Jardin des Plantes
title: Le Dimanche au Jardin des Plantes
assistive_text: The image shows a group of people standing in a line outdoors. In the foreground, an older man in a long coat and top hat holds a cane. To his left, a woman with curly hair and a bonnet is wrapped in a shawl. To his right, another man with a top hat, sideburns, and a long coat smokes a pipe. A woman next to him has her hair covered and looks towards someone off-camera. Others in the background wear similar attire. Foliage and structures are visible in the background, as well as a cow behind a barrier on the right.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Pourriez-vous me dire...? J'ai la grippe!...
title: Pourriez-vous me dire...? J'ai la grippe!...
assistive_text: The image shows two men in full-body view, engaged in a conversation or interaction in a room. The man on the left is standing in profile with his body slightly turned, holding a piece of paper with both hands. He has receding hair with sideburns and wears a coat that extends to his thighs, trousers, and knee-length boots or stockings. The man on the right is facing the viewer, standing with his hands in his pockets and his legs slightly apart. He has disheveled hair and a thick beard, with a furrowed brow and eyes that seem directed at the other man. His attire includes a dark, open jacket over a lighter shirt and striped trousers. The setting appears to be indoors, with large panel doors visible in the background and the room shaded in various grey tones.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Qu'on dise encore que la chasse...
title: Qu'on dise encore que la chasse...
assistive_text: In the image, there are two figures struggling intensely with exaggerated features. They are surrounded by dogs and a rabbit. One figure is on top of the other in a physical altercation. The figures have exaggerated expressions. To the left, a dog is pulling at one figure's clothing, while another dog is in the background, and a rabbit is on the ground. A hat is nearby. Minimal landscape with clouds in the background. The drawing is in black and white, giving it a stark intensity. The composition suggests a satirical interpretation, possibly depicting chaos and perils associated with a hunt.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Scene of the Tribunal (The Verdict)
title: Scene of the Tribunal (The Verdict)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. The drawing shows various sections with line sketches illustrating different parts of the scene. In the middle section, a crucifix is visible on the wall. Several figures are depicted, some in long robes and headwear, while others appear to be observers or participants. One figure in the center seems to be engaging in writing or reading near a desk. In the lower right portion, a figure appears to lean over another. The drawing is simplistic, focusing on capturing the essence and positioning of subjects within a structured environment.
creator: Honoré Daumier
medium: pen and ink over charcoal, pieced on laid paper and laid down
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Don Quixote
title: Don Quixote
assistive_text: The image shows a figure on horseback in a light, sketchy style. The horse is depicted in motion, with extended legs. The rider holds an object that resembles a lance or pole. Soft lines in the background convey a sense of movement and speed.
creator: Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Actor Posing in Front of a Mirror
title: Actor Posing in Front of a Mirror
assistive_text: A figure is shown in a three-quarter view, with the upper body visible beside a mirror. The person is depicted in a dynamic pose with one arm raised above their head. The facial features are drawn with distinct lines, emphasizing a sharp nose, prominent cheekbones, and an open mouth. The individual has curly hair. They are wearing a long garment with a slightly open collar. The mirror reflects a distorted version of the person, emphasizing the wildness of their hair and expression. Objects surround the mirror. The background is a dark, wash-colored wall.
creator: Honoré Daumier
medium: pen and black ink with crayon and watercolor on heavy laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Woman with Veil
title: Woman with Veil
assistive_text: The image shows a drawing of a person from the waist up in a seated position. The individual's body is slightly turned to one side, with arms resting along their torso. The facial features are defined with confident lines, including eyes, nose, and a subtle smile. The hair is depicted with wavy lines, suggesting a textured style. The person appears unclothed, and there are no visible jewelry items or objects. The background is a plain, lightly textured surface.
creator: Honoré Daumier
medium: pen and black ink over black chalk on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Exposition universelle: L'Etranger trouve toutes les facilites desirables...
title: Exposition universelle: L'Etranger trouve toutes les facilites desirables...
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a crowd gathering around a large carriage. The people are dressed in formal attire, many wearing top hats. The detailed line-work shows the expressions of the individuals closely examining the carriage or an event nearby. The background includes more figures and trees, indicating an outdoor setting. The bold lines and sketch-like texture bring a sense of motion and energy to the drawing.
creator: Julien Antoine Peulot after Honoré Daumier
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Fountain of Youth
title: Fountain of Youth
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a bathhouse scene. The image features a large, ornate bathhouse with classical architectural elements like columns and frieze work. The structure is busy with people bathing and socializing in and around the pools. Outside, there is a large fountain with figures climbing and interacting with it. The background includes hills and a church. At the bottom of the drawing, there is a block of text.
creator: Johann Theodor de Bry after Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Country Fair
title: Country Fair
assistive_text: This is an etching of a village scene with various activities and gatherings happening. The central house is surrounded by people engaging in different activities. To the left, there are figures involved in games, socializing, dancing, and holding tools or weapons. In the background, there are riders on horseback, with trees and hills in the distance. To the right, there's a church with a clock tower, where a line of people is entering or leaving. Beside the church, there is a market-like scene with people engaging in trade or bartering. The scene captures the hustle and bustle of a village festival or fair, with a castle in the background.
creator: Johann Theodor de Bry after Sebald Beham
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Engraver Joseph Tourny (Le graveur Joseph Tourny)
title: The Engraver Joseph Tourny (Le graveur Joseph Tourny)
assistive_text: This print shows a portrait of an individual seen from the waist up, turned slightly towards the left, looking at us with their arms resting on a ledge. They have a broad forehead, a long nose, deep-set eyes, and thin lips in a neutral expression. Their short hair is mostly obscured by a cap. They wear a loose garment with a high collar, depicted with cross-hatched lines. The background is filled with horizontal and diagonal lines, suggesting a wall or curtain on the left. Below this central print is a smaller design that appears to show a profile sketch of another person wearing a dark cap. This smaller portrait is oriented horizontally.
creator: Edgar Degas
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mary Cassatt at the Louvre: The Etruscan Gallery
title: Mary Cassatt at the Louvre: The Etruscan Gallery
assistive_text: The image shows two women in an indoor setting surrounded by framed artwork on the walls. The woman on the left is seated, reading a book, wearing a detailed patterned dress and a bonnet with fur and lace. She holds a handbag. The standing woman is shown from the back, leaning slightly forward, holding an umbrella or cane. She wears a dark dress with fur or lace details. The background includes a wall with framed artwork and a textured floor.
creator: Edgar Degas
medium: soft-ground etching, drypoint, aquatint, and etching on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Tiger
title: Tiger
assistive_text: This painting shows a tiger lying on the ground. The tiger's body is stretched out, facing the left. Its eyes are closed, and its head is resting on its paws. Its fur is painted in a rich orange with black stripes and areas of white on its face, chest, and legs. In the background, there are soft, gray-blue mountain ranges under a light blue sky. The ground the tiger lies on is an olive-green color, with sections of tan earth. The painting has fluid and loose brushstrokes.
creator: Eugène Delacroix
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Horseman
title: Horseman
assistive_text: This print shows a horse with a rider. The horse appears to be in motion, facing the left, its legs bent and its tail flowing. The rider is wearing a hat and a long coat, and they are pointing off to the right with one finger extended. They appear to have a long beard, but we can't see much of their face.
creator: Pieter van Laer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sacrifice of Abraham
title: Sacrifice of Abraham
assistive_text: This is a drawing depicting two figures on a stepped platform. One figure holds a torch and the other holds a bundle of sticks. On top of the platform is a decorative object emitting smoke. Below are two winged serpent-like creatures with human heads, animals, and a figure with a hat holding the reins of a horse. The drawing features ornate swirling lines and plant motifs.
creator: Etienne Delaune
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Minerva Standing
title: Minerva Standing
assistive_text: This shows a black and white drawing with an elaborate design featuring a central figure. The drawing includes a standing figure within a cross-shaped border adorned with intricate scrolls and floral patterns. Above the figure is a bird or eagle-like creature with wings spread. Urns or vases are placed on either side of the arch, with additional bird figures nearby. The background has a textured surface, enhancing the contrast and detail of the dark ink work against the lighter backdrop. The composition suggests a focus on classical or mythological themes, blending human and ornamental elements.
creator: Etienne Delaune
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Neptune
title: Neptune
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a decorative heraldic shield. The image features an ornate design centered around a standing figure holding a trident. The central figure is surrounded by an elaborate frame with symmetrical ornate elements resembling curled foliage, volutes, and scrolls. Stylized fish are on either side of the figure, while below, two sea creature-like forms are symmetrically positioned. The drawing is intricately detailed, utilizing ornamental motifs in a monochromatic color scheme with a strong emphasis on contrast and symmetry.
creator: Etienne Delaune
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Female Figure
title: Female Figure
assistive_text: This is a print of a symmetrical ornament decorated with several figures. In the lower center is the largest figure, who appears to be a human with wings. Their torso is bare, and they have no legs, but instead two swirling lines below their navel. This figure is surrounded by motifs like winged animals, scrolls, leaves, feathers, floral elements, and decorative swirls. Winged horses, the heads of lions, a bird, and a fish are distinguishable. The design is black, and the details are the tan color of the paper the print is on.
creator: Etienne Delaune
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Louis-Alexandre de Bourdon, comte de Toulouse
title: Louis-Alexandre de Bourdon, comte de Toulouse
assistive_text: The image displays a bust portrait of a person within an oval frame. The individual is facing slightly to the right, with their head turned towards the viewer. They have long, curly hair and are wearing a suit of armor, including a breastplate and decorative shoulder guards. The person has distinct facial features and is looking forward. Their right arm is raised with the hand pointing to the right side. The background has a patterned texture, and the frame includes an inscription and decorative elements. A coat of arms is shown at the bottom center of the frame.
creator: Pierre Drevet after Hyacinthe Rigaud
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Marie de Laubespine
title: Marie de Laubespine
assistive_text: The image is a portrait of a woman showing her upper body and part of her lower body in a seated position. Her head is turned slightly towards the viewer, and she has a calm expression on her face. She has curly hair styled in an elaborate fashion. She is wearing a luxurious dress with puffed sleeves, lace, and embroidery, possibly accented with fur around her shoulder, and is seated on a draped fabric. In her lap, she is holding a small dog. The background features large draped curtains and ornate architectural elements, including columns and possibly a carved or painted wall.
creator: Pierre Drevet after Nicolas de Largillierre
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Riding School
title: Riding School
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a rider on horseback in a rural setting. The image depicts a rider on a prancing horse, holding a long thin instrument. In the foreground, a man stands beside a post, also with a narrow object in hand. In the background, two figures walk along a path near ruins or an old structure. The scene evokes a rustic ambiance with a sense of motion. The detailing and use of light and shadow suggest a historical or classical setting, highlighting the relationship between humans and animals in a cultivated landscape.
creator: Jacob Duck
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Holy Family with the Mayfly
