title: The Holy Family with the Mayfly
assistive_text: Printed with fine black lines and velvety black shading on off-white paper, a woman sits holding a baby as a bearded man sleeps nearby in a landscape in this vertical engraving. In the center of the composition, the woman sits with her knees angled slightly to our right, but she turns to look down at the baby, held in her arms to our left so they are almost chin to chin. She has hooded eyes, a straight, a short nose, thin lips, and a slight double chin. Long wavy hair falls behind her shoulders, and her dress has a high neckline and voluminous sleeves and skirt under a cloak. Facing the woman in profile, we see the child's chubby arm, leg, and cheek, and his eyelashes are silhouetted against the blank white paper. The woman and child sit on the low, wood-plank wall of a trough-shaped container planted with grasses and weeds. To our left, the sleeping man leans one arm up onto the wall and tips his head back, eyes closed. Hills roll back to a structure with a single-sided, steeply pitched roof to the left, and a waterway winds into the distance to the right. A bridge connects the two areas of land and leads to buildings on the farther bit of earth. One person stands and propels a low boat with a long stick and three sailboats are in the water in the deep distance. In the sky above and tiny in relation to the others, a bearded man wearing a robe is shown from the waist up in a bank of clouds. Just in front of him, a bird has its wings spread and rays below that reach down toward the woman. The man holds one hand up, palm facing out with the first two fingers raised, and holds an orb topped wit ha cross with the other hand. The artist signed the print with a lowercase letter d tucked between the long legs of an uppercase letter A at the bottom center.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Ill-Assorted Couple
title: The Ill-Assorted Couple
assistive_text: The image shows two individuals, a woman and a man, seated on the ground. The woman is on the left facing the man on the right. The woman has a braided hairstyle with a headpiece and is wearing a long dress with puffed sleeves. The man has a beard and is wearing a loose, long-sleeved garment. The background includes a castle on a hill to the left, a lake with a sailboat in the middle ground, and a horse tied to a tree on the right. The image is executed in a finely detailed drawing style.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Lady on Horseback and the Lansquenet
title: Lady on Horseback and the Lansquenet
assistive_text: Two individuals are depicted in the image. One person is standing beside a horse, while another is seated side-saddle on the horse. The man stands below the woman, who is seated above him on the horse. The man has sharp facial features and short hair, looking up at the woman. The woman has a gentle facial expression, delicate features, and her hair is tucked under a headdress with a long feather. Both individuals are dressed in historical attire. The man appears to be wearing armor or a fitted outfit with puffed sleeves, while the woman wears a long gown with puffed sleeves and a voluminous skirt. The man is holding a pole weapon with a blade, and the horse is equipped with a detailed bridle. The background shows a landscape with a body of water, a distant shore with mountains, and a castle on a hill among trees.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Deluge
title: The Deluge
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene featuring mythical creatures and elaborate decorations. The artwork includes a symmetrical composition with a central structure resembling a chariot or carriage, flanked by various mythological beings. In the scene, figures are riding on creatures with long flowing tails and other hybrid beings that combine animal and human features. The top of the image is dominated by draped curtains and flowing plumes, adorned with birds. The scene is bordered with swirling designs, enhancing the opulent and otherworldly theme. The overall tone of the image is mysterious and whimsical, blending fantasy and mythological elements.
creator: Etienne Delaune
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sol Iustitiae ("Sun of Righteousness")
title: Sol Iustitiae ("Sun of Righteousness")
assistive_text: This print shows a person seated on a lion. The person's body is turned towards us, their head facing the bottom right. They are holding a sword upright in their right hand and a set of scales in their left hand. The person is wearing flowing fabric that drapes over their shoulders and arms and goes down to their bent knees. They have wide round eyes, short curly hair, and slightly downturned lips. Around their eyes and forehead, is a mask-like covering shaped like a maple leaf, extending upwards and out to either side. Their head is surrounded by rays of light shooting outward and forming a halo. The lion the person sits on is standing, positioned horizontally, its head on the left and its tail on the right. It has a long, wavy mane, furrowed brows, and a partially open mouth. The background is blank beige paper.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Apollo and Diana
title: Apollo and Diana
assistive_text: The image shows two figures in a scene. The left figure is standing up, facing right with a slight turn to the left. The person is depicted in full-body view, with muscular features, long curly hair, a laurel wreath, and holding a bow. The right figure is seated on the ground, partially visible from the waist up, with distinct facial features, long straight hair held back by a band with a jewel, and holding foliage or a plant. The seated figure has a relaxed posture. The background has a lightly textured surface, and the ground where the seated figure rests shows a lion's pelt with a visible lion's head. A monogram or artist's signature is in the bottom right corner of the image.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ in Limbo
title: Christ in Limbo
assistive_text: The image shows three figures in a tightly framed scene. The central figure is bending forward, turning slightly to the right, with both arms extended. This individual has long, flowing hair and a beard, and is clothed in a flowing robe. To the left, two others stand closely together; the first is an older man with a full beard and long hair, his figure mostly unclothed, and next to him is a younger person with wavy hair pulled back. Both gaze in the same direction. The older man has one arm raised slightly and the other at his side. They are positioned under a stone arch, above which sits a large, reptilian creature holding a spear and a banner. Sunlight or radiant energy appears to burst from the background, casting light on the scene. The surrounding environment includes stonework, wooden elements, and depictions of various exaggerated or monstrous faces. The top of the arch displays the numbers "1512."
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Sudarium Held by Two Angels
title: The Sudarium Held by Two Angels
assistive_text: The image depicts two full-length figures of winged beings positioned on either side of a central head held between them on a cloth. The angels are shown in a hovering or floating position, with their draped garments billowing around them. Their facial features are delicately detailed, with both angels having curly hair that frames their expressions. They are dressed in elaborate robes with folds and textures. The central head they hold on a cloth displays strong facial features with a beard and an intense gaze. The background has minimal detail, emphasizing the figures. Below the scene, there is a small area with a date and a monogram, indicating the creation year "1513" and the artist's signature.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Virgin and Child Seated by the Wall
title: The Virgin and Child Seated by the Wall
assistive_text: The image shows a woman sitting on stone steps, holding a child. The woman is wearing draped clothing and a head covering. The child has chubby facial features and curly hair, dressed in simple garments. The woman has a serene expression and the child appears relaxed. In the background, there is a landscape with a river, distant castles, and tree-lined hills.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Virgin and Child Crowned by Two Angels
title: The Virgin and Child Crowned by Two Angels
assistive_text: The image depicts a woman seated on a stone holding a child in her lap. The woman has delicate features, long flowing hair, and a serene expression. She wears a detailed gown. The child has curly hair and is dressed in simple clothing. Two winged angels hover above, holding crowns. In the background, there is a rustic fence, hills, and trees. An object with inscriptions is near the woman's feet. The scene conveys tranquility and reverence.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cardinal Albrecht of Brandenburg ("Small Cardinal")
title: Cardinal Albrecht of Brandenburg ("Small Cardinal")
assistive_text: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man with a neutral expression. He has distinct facial features and wavy, shoulder-length hair covered by a cap. He wears a buttoned garment with a high collar, possibly a robe. In the background, there is a coat of arms with a double-headed eagle and other symbols. Latin text surrounds the portrait. The setting appears formal and suggests a sense of dignity.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Erasmus of Rotterdam
title: Erasmus of Rotterdam
assistive_text: Created with fine black lines printed on cream-white paper, this vertical engraving shows a man facing our left, wearing a cap and voluminous robe as he writes on a sheet of paper. Closest to us and along the bottom edge of the composition, a table or shelf is spread with several books, some upright, some on their sides, and one thick tome laid open. The open book has writing on the pages, but the words are not legible. Beyond the books, the man is shown from the waist up with his body angled to our left. A few curls peek out from the soft, rounded cap that covers his head down to his neck and his forehead, and nearly reaches the top edge of the paper. His face and jowls are deeply lined, and he has deep-set eyes, a long, sloped nose, and his lips are closed. His robe rides high on his shoulders and around his neck, parting at the throat to show a high-collared garment beneath. He gazes down at his hands, which rest on the paper on which he writes. One thick-fingered hand holds the inkwell and the other the pen. The paper and a book underneath it rest on a lectern that angles up toward the writer. The lectern sits on a desk that also holds a short urn with a small bunch of leaves and flowers at the front corner closest to us. Two packets or pieces of folded paper sit next to the lectern. Densely spaced, fine lines create dark shadows in the deep folds of the man’s garments and on the wall behind him. A panel on the wall behind the man reads, in Latin, “IMAGO ERASMI ROTERODA MI AB ALBERTO DVRERO AD VIVAM EFFIGIEM DELINIATA,” which is followed by a Greek inscription, and then, “MDXXXVI.” The artist signed the work with his monogram, consisting of an upper case D straddled by the legs of a wide, upper case A at the bottom center of the panel.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Small Horse
title: Small Horse
assistive_text: This print shows a knight and a horse in an archway. The white horse is in profile, facing the left, with one front leg raised and its lips slightly parted. It has a curly mane and a long tail tied in a knot. Behind the horse is a knight in armor. His back is to us, and he holds a long axe-like weapon. The knight's face is mostly obscured by what appears to be a large helmet shaped like a moth or other bug with large wings. The background includes a stone archway, showing a glimpse of the sky and a wall with a bowl or urn that appears to be emitting smoke. Above the bowl is the date "1505."
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Virgin and Child on a Crescent with a Diadem
title: The Virgin and Child on a Crescent with a Diadem
assistive_text: This print shows a woman holding an infant in her arms. The woman has a gentle expression as she looks down at the child. She is dressed in draped robes and there is a thin circlet around her head. Her light hair is long and curled. The infant in her arms is looking towards us and appears to be holding a small ball. Lines radiate from the two people, creating a halo around the woman's head. She stands on a crescent shape, with its curved edges pointing upwards.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Large Horse
title: Large Horse
assistive_text: The image shows an engraving of a man in armor riding a horse. The man is in profile, wearing a plumed helmet with a visor covering his face. His armor is detailed, and he appears authoritative. The horse, facing in a three-quarters view, looks composed and sturdy, with a groomed mane and tail. The background includes architectural elements and rough-hewn stone structures, suggesting a historical setting. The engraving is dated "1505."
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Deposition
title: The Deposition
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a central figure. The drawing is intricately detailed in a monochromatic color scheme. The scene features various expressions and interactions among the figures, set against a mountainous landscape with trees and a sky. A crucifix can be seen in the far left of the composition. The style resembles that of Albrecht Dürer, showing detailed linework and a blend of movement and stillness within a historical or religious context.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Joachim and the Angel
title: Joachim and the Angel
assistive_text: The image shows a winged figure and a man interacting in a forest setting. The angel is suspended in mid-air, wearing a long flowing garment. The man is in a full-body pose, reaching out towards the angel. A secondary figure is also present. In the background, there are sheep grazed under the watch of shepherds, and a distant body of water with small boats. The setting has tall trees and detailed textures.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Birth of the Virgin
title: The Birth of the Virgin
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an indoor scene with an angel and several figures engaged in various domestic activities. The image depicts a room bustling with activity, where multiple figures are attending to tasks around a central bed. A hovering angel figure appears amidst clouds at the upper part of the image. The architecture and furnishings, such as a staircase, fireplace, and wooden interior, add depth and context to the scene. The lower area shows figures interacting, possibly engaged in conversation and domestic work. The drawing has intricate lines and details.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Presentation of Christ in the Temple
title: The Presentation of Christ in the Temple
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an indoor scene with a group of figures gathered around a table. The image shows a room with fluted columns topped with Corinthian capitals, a detailed coffered ceiling, and figures dressed in robes. A table covered with a cloth is at the center.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Glorification of the Virgin
title: The Glorification of the Virgin
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring detailed figures and architectural elements. The setting is grand with columns, arches, and a coffered ceiling. Various figures are present, some with wings. A central seated figure is surrounded by other figures standing or kneeling. There is a figure reading from a large book in an alcove above. The scene includes robes, musical instruments, vases, and sculptures. The drawing is finely detailed with attention to textures and patterns.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Madonna on the Crescent
title: The Madonna on the Crescent
assistive_text: The image shows a seated woman holding an infant. She is seated with her legs bent, cradling the child in her arms. The woman's facial expression is calm, with her eyes gazing downward at the child. Her hair is partly covered by a headdress or veil. She wears a long, flowing dress with intricate details. A halo of stars encircles her head, and she sits on a crescent moon. The background displays radiating lines of light and small stars.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Assumption and Coronation of the Virgin
title: The Assumption and Coronation of the Virgin
assistive_text: The image is a detailed woodcut or engraving showing a scene with multiple figures. The upper portion of the image features a group consisting of three central figures seated on a cloud. The central figure, a female, is sitting with her eyes closed, head tilted slightly downward, hands clasped in her lap, and wearing flowing garments with a veil over her long hair. On her left, a bearded male figure is holding a staff or scepter in his left hand, while on her right, another bearded man is holding a large book. Both men gaze at the female figure, lifting a crown between them. Above the group, a dove is depicted with wide-spread wings, emitting rays of light. Below this celestial scene, on the ground in the foreground, stand several robed figures gazing upward. Two men, both bald and with beards, appear to be holding open books. The space around these people is filled with clouds and vegetation. The background features detailed trees and bushes. The lower foreground shows an empty stone tomb with an open lid. The figures are dressed in intricately patterned, voluminous robes.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Fall of Man
title: The Fall of Man
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene in a forest featuring intertwined figures and various animals. The intricate line work depicts two central figures, one giving an apple to the other, with a snake entwined around a tree nearby. There are also depictions of a badger and a goat at their feet, and the scene is filled with dense foliage and branches. The composition is carefully balanced with detailed textures in the bark of the trees and the fur of the animals. The strong contrast created by the black and white ink work adds depth and drama to the scene.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ before Herod
title: Christ before Herod
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring an elaborate throne and several figures engaged in conversation. The drawing displays a detailed room with rich textures and elaborate patterns, dominated by an intricately designed throne. On this throne sits a regal figure adorned with a crown, holding a long staff, and exuding a commanding presence. Surrounding this central figure are other characters, each distinctively rendered with attention to their attire. The scene captures dynamic interaction, with one figure gesturing as if communicating something significant to the one on the throne. The architectural elements, such columns and an archway, provide depth and context to the setting.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ at Emmaus
title: Christ at Emmaus
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a gathering at a table. It depicts a group of figures sitting around a rectangular table covered with a cloth. At the center of the gathering, a figure is seated with a radiant halo emanating from their head. This illumination contrasts with the intricate shadowing and details in the surrounding figures. The figures are engaged with each other, some gesturing or holding objects. The clothing and expressions of the figures are detailed, giving depth to the scene. The composition is completed by an arched frame.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Doubting Thomas
title: Doubting Thomas
assistive_text: The image shows a shirtless, bearded man standing centrally, surrounded by several other figures. The man is standing slightly off-center, with one hand raised and pointing upwards, while the other hand is at his side. The surrounding figures are cloaked in long garments, except for their feet. They appear engaged with the central figure, some leaning towards him and gesturing. The background includes an architectural arch or alcove framing the group, with detailed engravings adding texture. A halo emanates from the central figure's head.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The War at Hainault
title: The War at Hainault
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a medieval battle scene. It shows two armies clashing in front of a medieval town. The soldiers are armed and wearing armor, helmets, and various headgear. They wield spears, swords, and shields in a crowded and dynamic skirmish. The background includes the town with buildings and mountains. The drawing features fine lines, cross-hatching, and detailed textures.
creator: Hans Springinklee
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Masquerade Dance with Torches
title: Masquerade Dance with Torches
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group dance in a medieval or renaissance setting. In the center of the image, figures in period costumes partake in a formal dance on a checkered floor. The dancers are dressed in elaborate garments typical of the Renaissance era, with capes, patterned tunics, and feather-adorned hats. The background features an upper level where additional observers, dressed in similar ornate attire, peer over a balcony. Ornamentations and architectural details enrich the setting, giving it a sense of grandeur and nobility. The woodcut technique emphasizes the textures and details of the characters’ outfits and the decorating elements surrounding them.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A King and Diana Receiving Huntsmen
title: A King and Diana Receiving Huntsmen
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene featuring several figures in a landscape with a detailed cityscape in the background. The figures are engaged in conversation or preparation, some adorned in robes and holding objects like a scepter or shield. Hounds are resting nearby, while other figures stand holding spears or shepherd staffs, one of whom seems to be managing a group of dogs. The city in the background displays towers, bridges, and buildings, set against a backdrop of hills and forests. The artwork has detailed line work and complex compositions.
creator: Jean Duvet
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Angel in the Sun Calling the Birds of Prey
title: The Angel in the Sun Calling the Birds of Prey
assistive_text: This is a drawing illustrating a chaotic scene with a divine figure and a battle. The composition includes numerous figures engaged in action. A central angelic figure is depicted in the upper middle section, hovering amidst clouds. The figure is surrounded by radial lines and is gesturing outward. Below, there is a group of armored soldiers and animals involved in a fierce struggle. The artwork features intricate line work to depict the texture and detail. Various animals and soldiers contribute to the sense of conflict. In the upper left corner, two angels and an eagle are depicted. An inscription reads "HIST CAP 19 APOC," indicating a potential reference to a scriptural or apocalyptic narrative.
creator: Jean Duvet
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Rembrandt's Wife
title: Rembrandt's Wife
assistive_text: The image shows the upper body of an elderly woman seated, facing slightly to the left. She has her hands clasped in front of her and resting on a flat surface. The woman has a serene expression with prominent cheekbones and a gentle gaze. She has a headdress consisting of a white cap and a dark outer covering, and is wearing dark, voluminous clothing with fur or plush trim and a delicate collar at the neck. Her hands are adorned with a simple ring. The background is a plain, dark surface contrasting with the light tones of her face and hands.
creator: Richard Earlom after Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Nicolas de Blampignon
title: Nicolas de Blampignon
assistive_text: This image is a portrait of a man with wavy, medium-length hair, partially graying. He is wearing a garment with a fur collar and is facing the viewer with a neutral expression. The portrait is framed by an ornate oval with an emblem at the base. The man's facial features are detailed with a focused gaze and slightly arched eyebrows. The background inside the oval is textured, and the border outside contains inscriptions. The overall aesthetic is classical.
creator: Gerard Edelinck after Joseph Vivien
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Remi Du Laury
title: Remi Du Laury
assistive_text: The image depicts the upper half of a seated man within an oval frame. The man faces left but looks directly at the viewer, with a round face, broad forehead, a prominent nose, and a slight smile. His gray, wavy hair reaches his neck, and he wears a fur-trimmed garment over a dark robe with a white collar showing at the neck. He holds a cross on a chain in his right hand and wears a ring on his little finger. The background is lightly shaded with a decorative emblem at the bottom, along with inscriptions in small font. The portrait is bordered with intricate lines and patterns.
creator: Gerard Edelinck after Jacob van Oost II
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Philippe de Champaigne
title: Philippe de Champaigne
assistive_text: The image shows an engraved portrait of a person from the waist up. The individual is facing the viewer with a calm expression, with long, wavy hair, a broad forehead, curved eyebrows, and a relaxed mouth. They wear layered clothing and hold a rolled-up scroll with the year "1668" visible in their left hand. The background includes a tree, foliage, and a building with towers, suggesting a pastoral setting.
creator: Gerard Edelinck after Philippe de Champaigne
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Debut from "Paradise and the Peri" (2nd plate)
title: Debut from "Paradise and the Peri" (2nd plate)
assistive_text: The image depicts two figures in an ethereal setting, focusing on their upper bodies. One person sits on the ground, looking upwards with long dark hair falling over their shoulders. Their facial features are obscured by shadows. They wear a flowing garment. The other figure stands to the right, with partly spread wings. They have lighter hair and wear a gown-like garment. Their right arm is raised, hand gesturing upwards. The background is textured, resembling a cloudy or stormy sky, creating a mysterious atmosphere. The image is in grayscale with shading and texture for depth.
creator: Henri Fantin-Latour
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Evocation of Kundry (2nd plate)
title: Evocation of Kundry (2nd plate)
assistive_text: The image depicts a woman on the left and a man on the right. The woman is shown with her arms raised and head tilted back. Her flowing hair partially obscures her face. She wears a long, light dress. The man has a beard and is sitting, pointing upward with one hand and resting the other on an open book. He wears a cloak and a turban or hat. In the background are high walls and a circular form, set in a dark, swirling texture.
creator: Henri Fantin-Latour
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le café de la Nouvelle Athènes (The Cafe of the New Athens)
title: Le café de la Nouvelle Athènes (The Cafe of the New Athens)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a café scene with various patrons. It shows an interior setting with several figures gathered around a table. The lines are sketchy and drawn with ink. One of the elements is a woman in a striped dress facing away from the viewer. Beside her, there are men wearing top hats. On the table, there are glasses and a carafe. The background features linear patterns adding depth to the composition.
creator: Jean-Louis Forain
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Bullier (To Bullier's)
title: A Bullier (To Bullier's)
assistive_text: This print shows two women with their arms linked. The woman on the left is turned towards the right, facing with the other woman. Her facial features are partially visible; she has a sharp nose and an upturned mouth. Her light hair is styled up and covered by a wide-brimmed light blue hat. She wears a red, form-fitting dress. The woman on the right is turned towards the other woman, and more of her face is visible. She has wide, dark eyes and is smiling. Her dark hair is styled up with a yellow hat resting on top. She wears a dress with a high neckline and what appears to be a black-and-white plaid design. Around her waist, there's a dark belt that cinches the outfit. The background behind the women is dark, with light circular shapes resembling streetlamps glowing behind them.
creator: Jean-Louis Forain
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Témoins à l'audience (1ère planche) (Evidence at the Hearing) (first plate)
title: Témoins à l'audience (1ère planche) (Evidence at the Hearing) (first plate)
assistive_text: The image depicts a sketch of a woman and a child. The woman's upper body is shown, slightly leaning forward, holding the child in her arms. Her head is turned slightly to the right, with loose, curly hair falling around her face and a hat of some sort on her head. Her facial features are softly drawn, with distinctive lines defining her eyes and mouth. She wears an outfit with a pronounced collar and sleeves, with the rest of her attire blending into the impressionistic lines. The child is nestled closely in her arms, partly covered by fabric, with a faint hint of a face peeking through. Behind them, another figure stands tall and cloaked in flowing garments, with hands raised to chest level. The backdrop is minimally detailed, giving a textured appearance that enhances the prominence of the central figures. The sketch is composed of delicate lines against a pale background, creating an ethereal quality to the scene.
creator: Jean-Louis Forain
medium: soft-ground etching (zinc) in brown on laid Van Gelder paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le bon samaritain (The Good Samaritan)
title: Le bon samaritain (The Good Samaritan)
assistive_text: This is a drawing that shows a lion attacking a reclining figure along with abstract lines indicating motion or action. The composition includes dynamic lines creating a sense of movement. A dark mass on the left represents the lion, depicted with intense strokes suggesting fur and form. The right side shows the contours of a figure, possibly a fallen victim, with less detail. The background has flowing lines that could symbolize wind or atmosphere, enhancing the dramatic tension. The drawing uses a monochromatic palette to emphasize the scene's starkness and drama.
creator: Jean-Louis Forain
medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La sortie de l'audience (1ère planche) (Coming Out of the Hearing) (first plate)
title: La sortie de l'audience (1ère planche) (Coming Out of the Hearing) (first plate)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an interior scene with several figures gathered around a table or bench. At the center is a prominent figure standing over what appears to be an elevated platform. The use of light and shading created by fine lines gives depth and texture to the drawing. Some figures in the foreground appear seated, and there is a sense of interaction between the figures, suggested by their stances and gestures. The scene evokes a serious and contemplative atmosphere.
creator: Jean-Louis Forain
medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le calvaire (2e planche) (Calvary) (second plate)
title: Le calvaire (2e planche) (Calvary) (second plate)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of figures gathered around a ladder. Two groups of figures are on either side of a ladder extending upwards. On the left, three figures stand close together, draped in long garments. To the right of the ladder, a line of four figures are depicted standing in a slightly bowed posture. In the background, undefined lines and shading create a sense of an abstract sky or atmosphere.
creator: Jean-Louis Forain
medium: etching with graphite and lithographic crayon additions on laid Van Gelder paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A la table de jeu (1ère planche) (At the Gambling Table) (first plate)
title: A la table de jeu (1ère planche) (At the Gambling Table) (first plate)
assistive_text: The image features an etching showing multiple figures in a lively scene. The composition includes several individuals gathered around a table. Most figures are seated or leaning, with two women wearing elaborate hats. The figures have distinct facial features, expressions, and detailed hairstyles. The clothing varies, with most wearing coats or jackets. Some individuals seem to be in conversation or resting their hands on the table. The background includes sketch-like outlines of more figures, suggesting a crowded, bustling indoor environment.
creator: Jean-Louis Forain
medium: etching and drypoint on laid Van Gelder paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A la table de jeu (2e planche) (At the Gambling Table) (second plate)
title: A la table de jeu (2e planche) (At the Gambling Table) (second plate)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a casino scene with individuals gathered around a gaming table. The drawing portrays a lively yet intimate setting, with several figures closely grouped around a table, indicating a scene of gambling or other casino activities. The figures are rendered in delicate pencil strokes, capturing their concentrated and engaged postures. The individuals wear classic attire, including suits and a large hat. The detailed line work emphasizes the facial features and expressions of focus, as well as the hands engaged in the game.
creator: Jean-Louis Forain
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le repas à Emmaus (2e planche) (The Supper at Emmaus) (second plate)
title: Le repas à Emmaus (2e planche) (The Supper at Emmaus) (second plate)
assistive_text: The image shows a sketch of four individuals seated at a table. Two individuals are seen from the waist up. One is leaning forward with their head on their forearm, while the other, with short, curly hair and pronounced facial features, faces the viewer with a solemn expression. The third individual is partially obscured and looking down, while the fourth individual leans over the table, possibly resting their elbows on it, with a beard and balding head and a focused expression. All individuals wear indistinct clothing, and the background consists of vertical and diagonal lines suggesting a simple indoor setting.
creator: Jean-Louis Forain
medium: etching and drypoint in brown on laid Van Gelder paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le départ de l'enfant prodigue (1ère planche, en hauteur) (The Departure of the Prodigal Son) (first plate, vertical)
title: Le départ de l'enfant prodigue (1ère planche, en hauteur) (The Departure of the Prodigal Son) (first plate, vertical)
assistive_text: The image shows three people in full view. In the center, a woman faces a person on the right, holding onto their coat lapel. name: After the Pardon  (Il lui sera beaucoup pardonne parce qu'elle a beaucoup danse)
title: After the Pardon  (Il lui sera beaucoup pardonne parce qu'elle a beaucoup danse)
assistive_text: The image shows a person lying in bed with only the upper part of their body visible. The person is positioned on their side, facing us, with their head resting on a pillow. They have dark, curly hair that falls around their face, which has relaxed features as they appear to be asleep. The person is wearing a dark, loose garment that reveals their shoulders. The bedding around them appears plush, with blankets gathered loosely, and the scene is surrounded by draped fabric or curtains. On the ground beside the bed, there is a hat and a ribbon. The overall background is dim with heavy drapery.
creator: Paul Gavarni
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Discussion of Budget
title: Discussion of Budget
assistive_text: The graphite drawing features two people, with their upper bodies visible. A woman is leaning forward behind a chair, peering closely over the shoulder of a seated man. The woman's hair is styled in an updo, revealing a smooth forehead and delicate facial features, including slightly arched eyebrows and a gentle gaze. She wears a high-collared blouse with intricate detailing. The man, seated with his torso facing slightly away from the viewer, has a mustache and a concentrated expression. His hair is short, and he wears a patterned robe. His focus is directed onto a sheet of paper, which he holds close to a table. The background shows draped curtains and a framed artwork.
creator: Paul Gavarni
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Reverie
title: Reverie
assistive_text: The image depicts a person standing upright, holding a stick or cane in their right hand. They have a detailed face with a prominent nose and a contemplative expression. The individual wears a headscarf covering most of their hair and a long, heavy overcoat. Their oversized shoes and the plain brown background with diagonal sketch lines provide context to the image.
creator: Paul Gavarni
medium: pen and gray and red ink, heightened with white, on darkened paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Wayside Shrine in Brittany (Le calvaire Breton)
title: Wayside Shrine in Brittany (Le calvaire Breton)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of mythical and animal figures in a pastoral setting. The drawing is done in a style reminiscent of traditional woodcuts, utilizing strong contrast with black ink on a light background. On the left side, there are several humanoid figures with stylized facial features, who appear to be observing or participating in a scene with animals. In the center and to the right, a prominent bull, goats, and other creatures are depicted, suggesting a procession or gathering. The composition is dense with overlapping forms, and the lines used are bold and expressive, lending a dramatic aesthetic to the scene. The artwork combines elements of folklore with natural imagery to create a visually rich tableau.
creator: Paul Gauguin
medium: woodcut on very thin Japan paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Te Atua (The Gods) Small Plate
title: Te Atua (The Gods) Small Plate
assistive_text: The image consists of various shapes and lines forming figures and patterns. At the top is an arch-like shape enclosing a stylized face with flowing hair. Below, figures interact in a scene with curved lines creating a sense of movement. Two human-like figures are on either side, while abstract animal forms resembling a fowl or rooster are in the center. Swirling lines at the bottom suggest water or snakes, adding to the intricate and symbolic nature of the image.
creator: Paul Gauguin
medium: two laminated woodcuts on Japanese paper, double-mounted on wove paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Calliope
title: Calliope
assistive_text: The image shows a woman from the upper thigh upwards. She is seated, with her left hand on her side and her right hand palm open and slightly extended forward. She has a serene expression with large eyes, a straight nose, and closed lips. Her hair is neatly styled with a middle part and a braided detail. She is wearing a long-sleeved gown with a rounded neckline, a necklace with spherical beads, a bracelet on her left wrist, and an earring on her right ear. A few books are stacked next to her on the left side, and some beads or pearls are scattered on the ground next to the books. The background has a textured pattern.
creator: Hendrick Goltzius
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Thalia
title: Thalia
assistive_text: The image shows a woman seated from the knees up in profile, with her head slightly turned to the right. Her facial features are detailed, with a serene expression, a straight nose, and soft lips. She has braided hair styled in a bun with an earring on one ear. She wears a flowing gown, and holds a scepter in her left hand while her right hand rests on her lap. An open book is on the ground near her feet. The background is dark and textured, with a rocky surface. The image is framed with text at the bottom.
creator: Hendrick Goltzius
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Melpomene
title: Melpomene
assistive_text: The image depicts a seated woman from the torso up to her knees. She is seated slightly sideways, with her upper body facing the viewer. Her head is turned to the side, and she has a calm and direct gaze. The woman's facial features are detailed, with a composed expression. She has medium-length hair that is parted in the middle and tied with a ribbon. She is wearing a long-sleeved gown, and one can see a fold in the fabric. She holds a scroll in her right hand and a dagger in her left hand. Books are stacked on the ground beside her. The background features a textured surface.
creator: Hendrick Goltzius
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Clio
title: Clio
assistive_text: The image shows a woman seated in a three-quarters view with her full body visible. She is sitting with her head tilted downward, focusing on the tablet or book in her right hand. Her facial features are soft with closed eyes and a peaceful expression. Her hair is styled in an intricate updo. She is wearing a long-sleeved, full-length dress with the fabric gathered above her waist. Her left hand is holding an object, and there are two books on the ground next to her. The background has a textured pattern, adding depth to the scene.
creator: Hendrick Goltzius
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Aether
title: Aether
assistive_text: The image depicts a person standing with a dynamic pose. One hand is raised upwards and the other is pointing downwards. The individual's body is exposed with well-defined muscles. They are wearing a flowing piece of drapery attached from one shoulder. The person's face is angled upwards with finely carved facial features. They have curly hair and an object resembling antlers or tree branches on their head. No jewelry is visible. The background features swirling patterns resembling clouds, creating a dramatic setting around the figure. The oval framing adds to the sense of movement and energy in the composition.
creator: Hendrik Goltzius
medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in gold, olive and black on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sight
title: Sight
assistive_text: The image shows two people positioned closely together. The woman on the left is seated and facing slightly toward the viewer, while her upper body is turned slightly toward the man beside her who leans in from the right. Her facial features include full cheeks and a small, pointed chin, and her hair is styled in an elaborate updo with braids. She wears a dress with a detailed lace collar and ruffled sleeves, along with a pearl necklace and earrings. She holds a mirror in her left hand. The man wears a large hat, a mustache, and a beard; his expression seems animated, and he holds a hand out toward the woman. His clothing features a ruffled collar and pleated fabric. The background consists of engravings of foliage and a setting sun.
creator: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hearing
title: Hearing
assistive_text: The image shows two individuals from about the waist up. The person in the foreground is sitting with a slight turn to their right, their eyes downcast as they play a keyboard instrument. They have a detailed expression, with their hair styled in small curls framing the face and tied back. They are wearing an ornate garment featuring a ruffled collar and intricate embroidery along the sleeves and bodice. A necklace is visible, and they are wearing earrings. The second person stands slightly behind and to the right, holding what appears to be a book or music sheet and looking towards it. They have similar styled hair but it is swept back from the face. The background includes detailed foliage and drapery.
creator: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Smell
title: Smell
assistive_text: The image shows a couple seated closely together. The woman is on the left, facing the man while holding a basket of flowers. She has classic facial features with curled hair. She wears a dress and a pearl necklace. The man is on the right, leaning towards her, with wavy hair, and wearing a garment with ruffled sleeves. He is holding a flower and touching a dog in front of the woman. The background includes a vase with flowers on a ledge. The scene is intricately engraved with detailed textures and features. Latin text is included at the bottom.
creator: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Touch
title: Touch
assistive_text: The image shows a close-up of two figures, a man and a woman, depicted from the waist up. They are positioned closely together, facing each other with the woman's face slightly turned towards her partner while both lean in intimately. The woman's facial features are classic, with a smooth complexion and delicate features. Her hair is styled elegantly, pulled up with curls framing her face. She is wearing a necklace of round beads and an off-shoulder garment adorned with floral patterns. The man's expression is attentive, with curly hair and strong features. His arm wraps around the woman's shoulder. The background features draped fabric, adding a romantic atmosphere to the scene, with fine lines and shading that give depth to the composition.
creator: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jan Nicquet
title: Jan Nicquet
assistive_text: This image shows an upper-body portrait of a man looking directly at the viewer. His head is turned slightly to his left with a serious expression. He has a full mustache and goatee, short, neatly combed back hair, and wears elaborate clothing typical of the late 16th century, including a large ruff collar, detailed doublet, and flowing cape. His right hand holds a small object. To the right is an ornate coat of arms with scrollwork and an animal motif, possibly an eagle. The background has a lined pattern, and below the portrait is an inscription in calligraphic script.
creator: Hendrik Goltzius
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hieronymus Scholiers
title: Hieronymus Scholiers
assistive_text: The image displays a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is positioned at a slight angle, turning his head to gaze outward. His facial features include a high forehead, arched eyebrows, a pointed nose, and a short beard and mustache. His hair is short and wavy. He is dressed in a high-necked garment with a prominent frilled collar and puffed sleeves, typical of formal attire from the period depicted. There is no visible jewelry, but the buttons of his garment are visible. The background consists of an oval frame with the Latin text "Bene agere et nil timere," along with other inscriptions indicating his age as "30" and the year as "1583." The artwork is a finely detailed black and white illustration, likely an engraving.
creator: Hendrik Goltzius
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Winter
title: Winter
assistive_text: The engraving displays two individuals walking together, holding hands. One person is a woman wearing an elaborate dress and styled hair, looking towards her companion. The other person is a man in a cloak and hat with a feather, with long curly hair visible. A small dog is by their feet. Behind them are trees, buildings, people, and windmills in a rural setting. The sky has swirling clouds.
creator: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Self-Portrait at the Easel
title: Self-Portrait at the Easel
assistive_text: The image shows a person seated in profile facing left. It appears to be an older man with distinct facial features, like a prominent nose and high cheekbones. His short hair seems to show signs of aging. He is wearing a dark jacket with a visible white collar. The man's right hand is raised to sketch or write on a vertical surface. In the background, there is light cross-hatching shading. No jewelry or additional objects are noticeable.
creator: Francis Seymour Haden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Gerrit de Jong
title: Gerrit de Jong
assistive_text: The image shows an illustration of a man standing confidently. His left hand is on his hip and his right hand holds a decorative staff. He has short, curly hair, high cheekbones, and a sharp gaze. The man wears a detailed outfit with a high collar, patterned jacket, puffed trousers, a sash, tights, ornate shoes, and a sword at his hip. The background features a detailed landscape with plowed fields, sparse vegetation, and distant hills. There is text at the bottom in a script-style font.
creator: Hendrik Goltzius
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: St. Mary's College, St. David's
title: St. Mary's College, St. David's
assistive_text: The image shows historical ruins next to a waterway. The view is from a slightly elevated position, showing detailed stone structures and a large tower. A stream is in the foreground, reflecting the surroundings. The scene includes ancient walls, arches, and windows, with trees adding contrast. The artwork is mainly black and white, emphasizing fine details and creating a sense of history.
creator: F.L. Griggs
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Stevenage
title: Stevenage
assistive_text: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a flock of sheep being herded along a dirt path. The sheep are shown grazing or moving forward, while a lone shepherd leads them. The path is lined with lush trees, and the horizon line is low with a clearing in the distance. The sky above contains wispy clouds. The artwork is done in black ink on a pale background, creating a serene rural ambiance.
creator: F.L. Griggs
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Quien lo creyera! (Who Would Have Thought It!)
title: Quien lo creyera! (Who Would Have Thought It!)
assistive_text: This is a painting depicting two figures in a struggle with bear-like creatures in a dark environment. The figures seem distressed, and the creatures appear threatening. The shading and lines create a sense of tension, contributing to the overall atmosphere of horror and despair.
creator: Francisco Goya
medium: etching, burnished aquatint, and burin on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Asta su abuelo (And So Was His Grandfather)
title: Asta su abuelo (And So Was His Grandfather)
assistive_text: This print shows an anthropomorphic figure that looks like a donkey sitting upright and wearing the clothes of a human. The donkey sits sideways on a platform, facing the left, with its torso upright and legs balanced on a surface. The donkey has long ears that stand straight up and a snout featuring prominent nostrils and a slight smile. It wears a jacket with a high collar and trousers. The donkey is holding a large open book that rests on the platform in front of it, featuring images of donkeys on each visible page. There appear to be other, indistinct objects around it. The background is gray with a simple speckled pattern.
creator: Francisco Goya
medium: lift-ground aquatint and aquatint on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Y son fieras (And They Are Like Wild Beasts)
title: Y son fieras (And They Are Like Wild Beasts)
assistive_text: The image depicts a confrontation scene with several historical figures involved in a dramatic struggle. The monochrome composition intensifies the dramatic effect. Some figures are grounded, while others are in aggressive stances, emphasizing tension. The background is minimal, directing focus to the conflict.
creator: Francisco Goya
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Margarita de Austria
title: Margarita de Austria
assistive_text: The image shows a woman seated side-saddle on a horse. She holds the reins, has an oval face with slightly upward eyes, dark styled hair with ornaments, and wears an ornate gown. The background features a lightly sketched outdoor environment.
creator: Francisco Goya after Diego Velázquez
medium: etching and drypoint on heavy laid paper [first edition impression printed in the Calcografia in 1778-79]
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Breaking Up of the Agamemnon
title: Breaking Up of the Agamemnon
assistive_text: The image is an etching of a shipyard viewed from a low vantage point near the waterline. The harbor is depicted as busy and bustling. In the background, there are various city buildings, including a dome. A large ship with detailed rigging and an aged wooden hull is prominently featured on the right. The etching technique is evident through fine lines creating a textured sky. The color scheme is mainly black and sepia, typical of etchings. The scene includes other ships and a quay, providing depth and guiding the viewer's gaze through the image.
creator: Francis Seymour Haden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Gentleman of Fortune
title: A Gentleman of Fortune
assistive_text: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the waist up. He is slightly turned to his right, with his face directed towards the viewer, offering a subtle smile. The man's facial features include a well-defined nose, rounded cheeks, and a smooth complexion. His hair is not visible under a large hat adorned with an arrangement of ostrich feathers. He is dressed in historical attire, wearing a cloak over a shirt and scarf. His right hand is gesturing outward, holding a thin object between his thumb and forefinger. The background of the image is plain and unembellished.
creator: Herbert Johnson Harvey
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Chase House
title: The Chase House
assistive_text: The image shows a front view of a brick building with a central entrance, flanked by windows. The perspective is at eye level, capturing the building's base and the sidewalk. Linear brushstrokes detail the texture of the bricks and foliage. The monochromatic color palette uses shades of gray and black. In the foreground, a child stands near a fence, while two adults climb stairs leading to the entrance, where another person is visible. In the background, a tree's branches extend from the left side of the building.
creator: Childe Hassam
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Vßtribung Ade Eue (Expulsion of Adam and Eve)
title: Vßtribung Ade Eue (Expulsion of Adam and Eve)
assistive_text: This is a drawing featuring mythical elements. The image shows an angelic figure with wings in the sky atop a cloud holding a weapon. Below, two figures are running towards a skeletal figure with a scythe, standing among bare-branched trees. The style is similar to early Renaissance woodcuts or engravings, with bold lines and detailed designs reflecting movement and emotion in the composition.
creator: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Die Hertzoginn (The Duchess)
title: Die Hertzoginn (The Duchess)
assistive_text: The image shows a woman on a large canopied bed, depicted in profile from the waist up. She has curly hair and wears elaborate clothing with intricate patterns. A skeletal figure leans towards her, and a small dog is near her feet. The background includes a patterned drape, a window with lattice work, and an ornate column supporting the bed canopy.
creator: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jesus again before Caiaphas
title: Jesus again before Caiaphas
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of hooded figures in a medieval interior gathered around a figure seated on a throne. The composition features a series of arches in the background, including a round window and a columned inset. On the right, a highly adorned figure sits in a throne elevated by steps while various cloaked figures approach carrying staffs and other symbolic items. The drawing's details include flowing robes, ornate headgear, distinct architectural setting, and a gargoyle-like figure above. Intricate hatchings and fine lines offer depth and shadow, enhancing the scene's dramatic and formal atmosphere.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Washing of Hands
title: The Washing of Hands
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene with religious and historical elements. Classical architecture is depicted in the background, with figures in robes engaging in different activities in the foreground. Seated figures are shown reading or writing a document, while other figures stand nearby. One figure holds a cross, and others are in acts of supplication or carrying baskets. The drawing is detailed and intricate, suggesting a historical narrative, possibly related to religious or judicial themes from the past.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cardinal
title: Cardinal
assistive_text: This is a drawing featuring allegorical and symbolic elements. In the center, two figures interact; one is a robed and hatted figure handing over money or documents above a table with scrolls, while another standing figure leans forward possibly in conversation. The scene is bordered by columns with figures on top, including a skull and a crown. The bottom section shows various objects like scrolls, weapons, and a skull. The drawing employs intricate line work and shading techniques reminiscent of historical engravings. Gothic script at the bottom includes a Latin phrase.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Peddler
title: Peddler
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a skeleton assisting a man burdened with various items, within an ornate architectural frame featuring classical columns and figures. The skeleton is guiding the man, who carries his burdens on his back and is accompanied by a goat. The drawing includes a Latin inscription translating to "Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened." The style of the drawing may be influenced by esoteric and allegorical themes.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Waggoner
title: Waggoner
assistive_text: This is a drawing featuring a skeleton on an overturned cart with barrels, a fallen horse, and various figures within an intricate architectural border.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Katharine Furlegerin
title: Katharine Furlegerin
assistive_text: The image depicts a woman's upper body, focusing on her head, shoulders, and hands. She has her eyes closed and hands clasped in front of her. Her face appears calm with smooth skin and a soft expression. She has long, curly hair with a braid wrapped around her head. She is wearing a simple garment with a high neckline, and the background is a textured surface with subtle patterns. No jewelry or objects are visible in the image.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar after Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Speyer
title: Speyer
assistive_text: The image shows a landscape of Speyer from a slightly elevated viewpoint. Speyer Cathedral, "Der Thumb," is visible on the horizon with its towers. The artwork features detailed linework and shading. Ships with tall masts are seen on the left, near a small structure, possibly a crane or windlass. Figures and horse-drawn carts are present, with the river curving towards the city in the distance. A large tree is depicted on the right side. The color scheme is primarily black ink on paper, creating a classic impression. The composition is balanced, with architectural structures in the distance contrasting with the natural elements in the foreground.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Coblentz
title: Coblentz
assistive_text: The image shows a bird's eye view of a fortified town along a river. The horizon is near the top third of the image, with distant structures of a town named "Ehrenbreitstein" on a hill. The artwork uses detailed linework, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with black lines and varying sepia tones on a light background for contrast. A river labeled "Der Rhein" and "Die Mosell" with boats is in the foreground. The town's architecture and hill slopes are detailed, with "Cobolentz" inscribed on a wall. The background features intricate linework representing vegetation leading up to the town on the horizon.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Duren
title: Duren
assistive_text: The image displays a landscape featuring architectural structures and natural elements. The horizon is high in the picture, showcasing detailed views of buildings, trees, and figures. On the right, there is a large stone building or castle with turrets and a reflection in nearby water. Adjacent to it, on the left, are rows of trees and buildings with distinct gables. A road with walking figures runs through the middle. The sky is filled with fine, wispy clouds, reflecting the intricate style of the scene depicted with light, precise strokes suggesting a print or engraving. The monochromatic palette uses black ink on a pale surface.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Peace of Munster
title: The Peace of Munster
assistive_text: The image shows a front-facing view of a city square with a city hall building at the center. The horizon line aligns with the building's roof, with a sky above featuring soft clouds. The artwork displays intricate brushwork capturing architectural details and figures. The color palette is monochrome, using sepia or gray tones. People in period clothing gather in the square, facing the city hall. Tall buildings frame the city hall's facade, which includes sculptural elements and a large clock. The street appears to narrow in the distance, creating a sense of depth.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Albrecht Durer's Father
title: Albrecht Durer's Father
assistive_text: The image is an engraved portrait of a man's upper body. He faces forward with his head slightly turned to the right. The man has a serious expression, distinctive facial features, and medium-length wavy hair under a dark cap. He wears a dark garment under a loose, lighter robe, with folded hands. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background features a textured monochromatic pattern. At the top and bottom of the image, inscriptions provide information about the person and artwork.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar after Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Rustica Bohemica
title: Rustica Bohemica
assistive_text: The image shows a full-length depiction of a person standing upright. The individual is wearing a long, layered outfit that includes a cloak with fur or textured trimmings that falls to the ground. The person's face is visible, showing delicate features with a subtle expression, and their hair is mostly covered by a snug, conical hat. Wrapped around their neck is a soft, large scarf or shawl, adding to the layered appearance. Their clothing includes intricate designs near the bottom, suggesting a pattern or embroidery on a garment beneath the cloak. The person is holding an object clasped in front of their waist. The background is plain and unadorned. The words "Rustica Bohemica" are inscribed beneath the figure.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ciuis Pragensis Filia
title: Ciuis Pragensis Filia
assistive_text: The image shows a woman standing upright, facing slightly to the right. She has a composed expression with distinct features including a straight nose and subtle eyebrows. Her hair is styled back with a patterned headband. She is wearing a decorated robe with a ruffled collar, and a fur-trimmed outer garment. There are no visible accessories in her hands. The background is plain. Text is present above the woman's head and at the bottom of the image.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mulier Austriae Superioris
title: Mulier Austriae Superioris
assistive_text: The image shows a woman standing in a posed position. She faces forward with her hands delicately positioned in front of her body. Her facial features include a serene expression, with finely arched eyebrows and closed lips. Her hairstyle is neat, with her hair pulled back into a bun. She is dressed in period attire consisting of a long dress with an elaborate ruffled collar, a fur-lined cape, and a voluminous skirt. The gown drapes down to her feet, where pointed shoes are visible. There are no visible jewelry pieces or objects she is holding. The background is plain, and the image is bordered by a margin containing text at the bottom that reads "Mulier Austriæ superioris," along with small text indicating the artist and date.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mulier Augustana
title: Mulier Augustana
assistive_text: The image shows a full-length profile of a woman standing, facing to the right. She is depicted with delicate lines, showing a composed expression. She wears a large, wide-brimmed hat with a decorative band and bow. She is dressed in a richly detailed jacket with a high, pleated ruff around her neck and long sleeves. Her voluminous skirt extends to the floor in pleats, and she wears shoes. The background is simple with no other objects, and the illustration is labeled "Mulier Augustana" at the bottom.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mercatoris Hollandici Vxor
title: Mercatoris Hollandici Vxor
assistive_text: The image shows a full-body portrait of a woman labeled as "Marchants-wife of Holland." She stands upright with her body facing forward and her gaze slightly to her left. Her facial features include a neutral expression with pronounced eyes, a slightly upturned nose, and closed lips. She has a high forehead with tightly pulled back hair. She wears a detailed dress with a large ruffled collar, intricately designed sleeves, fitted bodice with buttons, and a long skirt. One hand holds a decorated purse or small bag, while the other rests at her waist. The background is plain, focusing attention on the woman's clothing and posture. The engraving is detailed, with inscriptions in Latin and English providing context to her identity and origin.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ciuis aut Mercatoris Antuerpiensis Vxor
title: Ciuis aut Mercatoris Antuerpiensis Vxor
assistive_text: The image shows a woman standing in a three-quarter pose, facing slightly to her left. She has a calm expression on her face, with features like a small nose and arched eyebrow. Her hair is wavy and extends past her shoulders, partially covered by a headpiece with a pom-pom. She wears a long dress with vertical stripes, a shawl-like garment, and holds a fur muff. Shoes are visible beneath her dress. The background is plain with script at the top and bottom.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Civis Coloniensis Filia
title: Civis Coloniensis Filia
assistive_text: The image depicts a woman standing in a slightly turned pose, facing the left. She has a calm expression with rounded cheeks and a straight nose. Her hair is covered by a coif or bonnet. She wears a long gown with a dark bodice and a lighter apron, a high-collar dress with puffed sleeves. She holds a piece of fabric in her left hand and her right hand is on her side. The woman wears simple footwear and no visible jewelry. The background is plain. The text "Civis Coloniensis Filia" is inscribed at the bottom, along with the artist's mark and date "W Kollars fecit 1643."
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Matrona Argentinensis Caenam Dni Accedens e des Nymphs)
title: Matrona Argentinensis Caenam Dni Accedens e des Nymphs)
assistive_text: The image shows a full-body portrait of a person standing upright. The person is facing slightly to the side, with hands resting near the waist. Their facial features include a serious expression, with a high, stiff ruff surrounding the neck, giving prominence to their face. They are wearing a rounded hat that is fitted closely to the head, obscuring the hair. The clothing consists of a long, heavy gown with full sleeves and a wide, layered collar. There is no visible jewelry, and no objects are being held. The background is plain and unadorned. The bottom of the image includes a signature and inscription in Latin text.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mulier Argentinensis
title: Mulier Argentinensis
assistive_text: The image shows a woman standing upright. She has a composed expression with a direct gaze. She wears a dress with intricate detailing, featuring a heavily gathered skirt, fitted bodice, and puffed sleeves. The woman's hair is styled under a structured headpiece. She stands with one hand over her abdomen and the other positioned near her chest. The background is plain with inscriptions in the upper and lower parts of the image.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mulier Bernensis
title: Mulier Bernensis
assistive_text: The image shows a woman standing. She has one hand on her abdomen and the other on her skirt. She is wearing a dark bodice and a long skirt with vertical stripes, along with a distinctive ruffled collar around her neck. Her hair is covered by a flat hat. The woman has a calm expression on her face. The background is plain and there is text on one side of the image.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Virgo Nuptialis Tiguriensis
title: Virgo Nuptialis Tiguriensis
assistive_text: The image depicts a woman standing with her hands clasped in front of her. She has an upright posture and a serene expression on her face, with delicately arched eyebrows and a faint smile. She has neatly styled hair and wears an elaborate headdress adorned with floral or lace patterns. The woman is dressed in a richly textured gown with a high collar, intricate lace details on the sleeves, and layers of ruffled fabric around her neck, creating a prominent collar. The gown is long and two-toned, with a lighter panel in the center decorated with chains. She wears a long chain necklace over the gown. The background is plain, and there are inscriptions in Old German script at the top and bottom of the image.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mulier Nobilis aut Generosa Gallica
title: Mulier Nobilis aut Generosa Gallica
assistive_text: The image is a portrait of a woman shown in full length. She is standing in a three-quarter profile, facing slightly to the left. Her facial features include a delicate, composed expression with eyes gazing forward and a slightly elongated face. Her hair is styled in loose waves, cascading down past her shoulders. She is dressed in an elegant gown with intricate patterns on the skirt and a full, dark, flowing cloak over her shoulder. The bodice is adorned with lace detailing and has short sleeves with similar lace trim. In her hands, she holds a closed fan delicately. She appears to wear no visible jewelry. The background of the image is plain, with no discernible details, placing full emphasis on the figure.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Matrona Parisiensis
title: Matrona Parisiensis
assistive_text: The image shows a woman standing in a poised manner. Her body is entirely visible, displaying her attire. She faces slightly to the right, with her hands clasped in front of her, covered by a cloak. Her facial features include round cheeks and a straight nose, with hair styled in a bob cut with a middle parting, reaching her shoulders. She wears a layered outfit consisting of a skirt, a cloak with wide sleeves, and a collar draping over her shoulders. The clothing appears to be rich in fabric with a textured design. The background is plain, emphasizing the woman and her attire. The figure lacks visible jewelry or objects, drawing attention to her facial expression and clothing. Below the woman is the inscription "Matrona Parisiensis," and additional artist's details are in the lower right corner.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mulier Diepana
title: Mulier Diepana
assistive_text: The image depicts a woman standing with her body slightly angled to the side. She has delicate facial features, narrow eyes, and a slight smile. Her hair is neatly pulled back. She is wearing a voluminous cloak with a textured collar, over a long pleated skirt that reaches the ground. Her hands are clasped in front of her, partially hidden by the cloak. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mulier Matrisana
title: Mulier Matrisana
assistive_text: The image shows a woman standing upright in full-length profile view. She is facing right with her hands folded in front of her torso. She has a distinct nose and closed lips. She wears a headscarf covering her hair, which is tied at the back and draped over her shoulders. Her outfit includes a patterned dress with horizontal stripes on the sleeves and a vertically striped apron-like garment with intricate geometric designs. She also wears long skirts and plain shoes. The background has a textured surface with faded writing at the top and bottom of the image.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Nobilis Mulier Anglica
title: Nobilis Mulier Anglica
assistive_text: The image shows a portrait of a woman in full-body profile facing right. She is holding a fan in her right hand at waist level. Her hair is styled elegantly with an elaborate bun, curls framing her face. She has delicate facial features with a serene expression. She wears an ornate gown with lace detail on the bodice and sleeves, and a flowing skirt. She also wears a choker or lace collar. The background is plain, with the inscription "Nobilis Mulier Anglica," the artist's details, and the year 1644 at the top.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar after Sir Anthony van Dyck
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Nobilis Mulier Anglicana
title: Nobilis Mulier Anglicana
assistive_text: The image shows a full-body illustration of an English noblewoman. She is standing upright, slightly turned towards her left, with her left arm extended in front of her. The woman's facial features include a slightly rounded face, a small chin, and an expressionless gaze towards the viewer. Her hair is curly and shoulder-length, with ringlets framing her face. She wears an intricate gown with a high collar, puffed sleeves, and lace details. She holds a small purse in her left hand that hangs down at her side. The background is plain. The engraving features detailed lines capturing the texture of her clothing and hair. The text "Nobilis Mulier Anglicana" at the bottom of the image identifies her as an English noblewoman.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mulier Nobilis aut Generosa Anglica
title: Mulier Nobilis aut Generosa Anglica
assistive_text: The image shows the full body of a woman standing in profile facing left. She has delicate facial features with a slightly pointed nose and her hair is styled in an updo with some curls falling down her neck. She wears a long, layered gown with puffed sleeves, wide cuffs, and a wide collar draping over her shoulders. The skirt is gathered at the back into a bustle. She is holding a decorative fan in her left hand. There are no visible jewelry or additional objects. The background is plain.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mulier Generosa Anglica
title: Mulier Generosa Anglica
assistive_text: The image shows a woman standing upright with a solemn expression. She has narrow eyes, a pointed nose, and wears a bonnet covering her hair. She is dressed in period-specific attire including a long gown, a shawl, and gloves. She holds a small object in her left hand by her side. The background is plain, emphasizing the woman. The text above and below the figure identifies her as an "English Gentlewoman" with "Mulier Generosa Anglica" at the bottom.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Civis Londinensis Filia
title: Civis Londinensis Filia
assistive_text: The image depicts a woman standing in profile, facing to her right. Her body is turned slightly, with her right arm bent and resting across her body.
