She wears a cap tied under her chin, framing her face. Her hair is visible peeking from under the cap in tight curls. She is dressed in a long gown with a light-colored apron over it, and a large, pointed collar covering her shoulders. Her sleeves are long and buttoned at the cuffs. The gown appears to be of a dark color with delicate detailing along the edges. There is no visible jewelry. The background is plain with a faint texture, and handwritten inscriptions at the top and bottom of the image read “Citizens daughter” and “Civis Londinensis Filia.”
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mulier Aulica Turca
title: Mulier Aulica Turca
assistive_text: The image shows a full-length portrait of a person standing upright. The individual is positioned with one hand on their hip and the other resting over their stomach. They have a composed expression on their face, characterized by defined facial features and a slightly upward gaze. They are wearing a headpiece and a long, intricately patterned dress with long sleeves cinched at the waist with a belt, and a large piece of fabric drapes around their shoulders and down their back. They are wearing pointed shoes with a raised heel and a large, ornate piece of jewelry around their neck. The background is a plain, light-toned canvas with minimal texture.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Spring
title: Spring
assistive_text: The image depicts a person from the waist up, facing forward with their upper body slightly turned to the left. The individual has curly hair falling around the shoulders, and is wearing elaborate clothing with lace and embroidery details. They hold a bouquet of flowers in one hand and gesture with the other. In the background, there is a large urn of flowers on a table beside the person, as well as architectural elements and a cloudy sky.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Man with Beard Looking Right (Hans Holbein?)
title: Man with Beard Looking Right (Hans Holbein?)
assistive_text: The image shows the upper half of a man's body in profile, turned slightly to the right. The man has a full, curly beard and a mustache, with a stern expression on his face. His eyes are looking off into the distance. He is wearing a hat, a detailed garment with a high collar, and a draped outer cloak. A hand is visible holding onto the cloak near his chest. The background is plain, with a monochrome backdrop. There is script in the upper left corner containing names and a date.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Summer: The Bathing Place
title: Summer: The Bathing Place
assistive_text: The image shows a riverside scene with buildings, trees, and a church steeple in the distance. The architectural details are intricately drawn in fine lines. The color scheme is primarily sepia. People can be seen swimming and boating in the water, with some small boats present. The riverbank is populated with figures, possibly socializing. In the background, there is a picturesque European town. The sky is depicted with thin lines and scattered clouds.
creator: Wenceslaus Hollar
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ornament with Foliage and Birds
title: Ornament with Foliage and Birds
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two figures surrounded by intricate floral designs and animals. The image features detailed swirling patterns that fill the frame with vines and flowers. Amongst these, birds can be seen perched on branches. Below, the two figures are depicted in period clothing, facing each other, framed by the floral backdrop. Animals, like a squirrel and a dog, can be spotted within the design. The entire composition is reminiscent of intricate 16th or 17th-century engravings or woodcuts, with a decorative border enclosing the imagery.
creator: Bartolomeus van Lochom after Hans Janssen
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Handle for Knife or Fork, Ornamented with Figures
title: Handle for Knife or Fork, Ornamented with Figures
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a decorative scabbard design. The ornate scabbard features intricate designs of nature, architecture, and classical figures. The top segment includes a small animal surrounded by floral scrollwork. Below it, a scene depicts figures in elaborate attire underneath an arched structure. Another section features a central classical figure holding scales. The lower portion is adorned with more scrollwork, flanked by symmetrical birds. The overall style is richly detailed and suggests a mix of allegorical and decorative motifs.
creator: Hans Janssen
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Zephyr
title: Zephyr
assistive_text: The image features two figures. The figure on the left is seated with a side view visible, extending from the head to the feet. This person appears to be sitting on the ground with one knee raised and an arm positioned near the head, surrounded by flowing drapery and grass. Their hair is styled with sticks or pins, and the features are faintly sketched, providing little detail on facial characteristics. They are wearing loose, flowing garments. The figure on the right is captured in motion, with most of their body visible, seemingly dancing or leaping with one leg raised. This person is depicted in partial profile and holds a cloth or veil as they move. Their hair is styled, possibly in a bun or bunch. The scene conveys a sense of movement and grace, set in an outdoor field with sketch lines suggesting grass and minimal background details. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held aside from the cloth. The background is simple and unadorned, primarily focused on the figures themselves.
creator: Troy Kinney
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Swallows
title: Swallows
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two dancers in a dynamic pose. The image shows two figures engaged in an expressive dance on grassy terrain. The technique includes fine linework and shading that suggest movement, fluidity, and spontaneity. The background is minimal, with light strokes hinting at clouds and birds in flight. The composition conveys grace and elegance with attention to the dancers' postures and expressions.
creator: Troy Kinney
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cover of the Fourth Yearbook of the Artist Group the Brucke
title: Cover of the Fourth Yearbook of the Artist Group the Brucke
assistive_text: The image shows a graphic artwork of part of a face, specifically the right side with the eye, cheek, and nose on a red background. The facial features are depicted in a bold, angular style typical of expressionist woodcut prints, with an emphasis on strong lines and contrast. The hair is abstract and cropped. The person appears unclothed. The background includes abstract shapes and figures, alongside text at the top and bottom reading "BRÜCKE 1909" and "Schmidt - Rottluff," with the initials "ELK" in the bottom right corner.
creator: Ernst Ludwig Kirchner
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Self-Portrait at the Table (Selbstbildnis am Tisch)
title: Self-Portrait at the Table (Selbstbildnis am Tisch)
assistive_text: This image shows a seated person at a table with the upper half of their body visible. The person is positioned at the table with their head slightly turned to the left. Their hair is short and close-cropped, and their facial expression is neutral. The person is wearing a striped shirt or garment with a high collar and long sleeves. Their hands are placed on the table, with one hand holding a utensil and the other resting next to a plate with some food visible. To the person's right, there is a tall, cylindrical lamp casting a glow over the scene, sitting on a small table. The background is dark and textured.
creator: Käthe Kollwitz
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Johann Aventinus (Johann Turmair)
title: Johann Aventinus (Johann Turmair)
assistive_text: This is an engraving of a man sitting with a calm expression, deep-set eyes, and a beard. He wears a cap and a long-sleeved gown, holding a quill pen and book in one hand. There is an inkwell nearby. Text is placed above and below the image.
creator: Hanns Lautensack
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Self-Portrait, 3rd plate
title: Self-Portrait, 3rd plate
assistive_text: The image is an etching depicting the upper half of a man facing slightly to the left. He has distinct facial features, including a beard, mustache, and short, wavy hair. The man's expression is neutral, with prominent, deeply set eyes. He wears a simple garment with visible buttons and the background features plain cross-hatching and line work for shadows and depth. The etching is signed "A. Legros" at the bottom right.
creator: Alphonse Legros
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Fagot-makers (Les faiseurs de fagots)
title: Fagot-makers (Les faiseurs de fagots)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of two figures gathering wood. The image shows a standing figure with a large bundle of sticks gathered in their arms, while another figure is bent over, seemingly engaged in cutting or gathering more wood with a tool. There is a gnarled, leafless tree in the background. The scene is captured with fine lines, conveying an atmosphere of hard labor and rustic existence in a countryside landscape. The drawing is subdued and monochromatic, highlighting the figures and their activity.
creator: Alphonse Legros
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Plague Victims of Rome (Les pestiferes de Rome)
title: Plague Victims of Rome (Les pestiferes de Rome)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a religious procession comforting the afflicted. The image shows a group of people gathered on a street. Some are seated or kneeling, while others stand. The scene appears to involve a religious or charitable act, possibly providing aid to the poor or sick. On the left side of the image, there are individuals who appear distressed, with one person lying on the ground and another holding a child. Towards the right, a person in religious attire is offering what seems to be a chalice. The procession includes people holding tall candles and a crucifix. The background consists of stone buildings and a rural village setting, with a small animal present in the bottom right. The drawing features detailed linework, creating texture and depth in both the figures and background elements.
creator: Alphonse Legros
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Choir in a Spanish Church (La choeur d'une eglise espagnole)
title: Choir in a Spanish Church (La choeur d'une eglise espagnole)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of musicians in an interior space. The scene shows a group of musicians playing and reading music. The central figure holds a larger stringed instrument, likely a bass, and sheet music is spread out before them. Other figures are focused on reading music from large books or participating in the music making, some possibly standing around an organ. The composition is rich with line work and crosshatching, creating a dark, atmospheric setting that reflects the intimate and concentrated nature of the musical gathering. Light and shadow emphasize depth and focus on the musicians and their expressions.
creator: Alphonse Legros
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sunrise (Un lever de soleil)
title: Sunrise (Un lever de soleil)
assistive_text: The image shows a landscape viewed slightly from above, with two people climbing among large boulders on the left-hand side. The horizon is obscured by tall rocks and the slope of the landscape. The scene is depicted in an etching style, with intricate lines creating a textured effect. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of brown. In the distance, rocky terrain continues towards the horizon, with detailed trees adding to the setting.
creator: Alphonse Legros
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Fagot-gatherer (Le fagotier)
title: Fagot-gatherer (Le fagotier)
assistive_text: The etching depicts an elderly person in a crouched, almost reclining position on the ground, with most of their body visible and turned to the left side of the frame. The person's head is covered with a cap, and they have a distinct, bushy beard. Their facial features are etched with meticulous detail, showcasing a prominent nose and a calm expression as they appear to be resting or observing something at ground level. The person is dressed in loose-fitting, simple garments. In the immediate surroundings, there is textured detail that suggests a rustic setting, with bundles that resemble hay or straw in the background. The overall background is composed of fine lines and shading, adding depth and a sense of environment to the scene.
creator: Alphonse Legros
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Siesta in the Country (Sieste dans la capagne)
title: Siesta in the Country (Sieste dans la capagne)
assistive_text: This print depicts a scene where a man is sleeping on the ground beneath low trees or bushes on the left side. Tall, slender trees are on the right side with branches reaching upward. Behind these bushes and trees, a landscape stretches into the distance, showing some low buildings and wide fields that extend towards the horizon. The sleeping man has a long white beard and mustache and appears to have light skin. He wears a light hat and a dark jacket and pants, and he is resting on his stomach with his head propped up on one hand. “
creator: Alphonse Legros
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Study for the Head of a Man (Etude de tete d'homme)
title: Study for the Head of a Man (Etude de tete d'homme)
assistive_text: The image shows a pencil or ink drawing of a man's head in profile, with detailed facial features. The man is facing right, with a bowed head, prominent nose, pronounced brow, deep-set eyes, wrinkles, unruly hair, and a beard. His expression is furrowed. The drawing suggests clothing with faint lines, and the background is plain.
creator: Alphonse Legros
medium: drypoint and etching? on light green paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Self-Portrait, 4th plate
title: Self-Portrait, 4th plate
assistive_text: This image is an etching of an elderly man's face in profile. The man has a contemplative expression, deep-set eyes, a broad nose, furrowed eyebrows, a long white beard, and full head of hair. He is wearing a dark garment covering up to his neck. The background has a textured pattern, and the portrait is done in an etching style.
creator: Alphonse Legros
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Study of Woman Praying
title: Study of Woman Praying
assistive_text: The image shows a sketch of a person from the waist up. The individual is in a three-quarter view, with their head turned to the right and looking upward. They have large eyes, a slightly upturned nose, and full lips. Their head is covered with a headscarf or veil. The person is wearing a garment that drapes around the shoulders, with folds indicating fabric texture. Their hands are raised and together in a gesture that may suggest prayer. A ring is visible on their left hand. The background is plain, consisting only of the paper.
creator: Alphonse Legros
medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Two Monks Seated in a Church
title: Two Monks Seated in a Church
assistive_text: The drawing depicts two men seated side by side. The man on the right has dark, curly hair and a beard, deep-set eyes, and a serious expression. He wears a long robe. The man on the left appears to be looking down at an object in his hand, which resembles a book. He has shorter curly hair and his facial features are less visible. He also wears a robe. The background is composed of shaded and hatched lines, emphasizing the two figures in the foreground.
creator: Alphonse Legros
medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Reapers
title: The Reapers
assistive_text: Three women are portrayed from the waist up, bent over while harvesting. The woman in the foreground is crouched low, with her body turned slightly to the side. She has a focused facial expression and her head is covered with a cloth. Her clothing is suitable for agricultural work. The woman is holding a bundle of grain or straw in one hand and a sickle in the other. Next to her, another woman, similarly dressed, leans into the task with a concentrated expression. In the background, a third woman is partly obscured, engaged in the same activity. The setting is a field during harvest time, with sheaves of cut grain on the ground. The pencil sketch bears the signature "A. Legros 1907" at the bottom left corner.
creator: Alphonse Legros
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Head of a Horse from the Parthenon
title: Head of a Horse from the Parthenon
assistive_text: This is a pencil sketch of a horse's head. The drawing shows the head from the neck up to the ears with a focus on the horse's profile. The horse is depicted with its mouth open in a relaxed manner, detailed with delicate pencil strokes. The sketch highlights the horse's eye, nostrils, and mane with fine lines for texture. The background is lightly shaded with no additional elements. In the upper right corner, the signature "A. Legros 1898" is inscribed.
creator: Alphonse Legros
medium: goldpoint with scraping on white commercially prepared paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Head of a Young Man
title: Head of a Young Man
assistive_text: The image is a detailed pencil drawing of a person's head and upper shoulders. The figure is slightly turned to one side with their gaze directed downward. The facial features include prominent cheekbones, a straight nose, and a soft expression. The person has short, neatly styled parted hair and a subtle mustache. There are no visible clothing details, only bare shoulders blending into the background. There are no visible jewelry or objects held. The background is a plain textured surface. An inscription or signature is visible at the top right corner.
creator: Alphonse Legros
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Milkmaid of Boulogne
title: The Milkmaid of Boulogne
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a person leading a donkey laden with goods. The image depicts a scene with a donkey walking to the left side while being guided by an individual dressed in layered clothing. The donkey is burdened with sacks or baskets that are strapped to its back. The lines and shading are subtle and detailed, capturing the texture of the clothing and fur. The figure and the donkey are positioned on a lightly sketched landscape with a few hints of foliage to the right, suggesting a rural setting. The drawing's simplicity and detail suggest a narrative moment, with a sense of movement and purpose conveyed through the lines.
creator: Alphonse Legros
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: After the Battle
title: After the Battle
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a skeletal figure on horseback wielding a spear amidst a chaotic scene. The scene depicts swirling lines and dark shadows, creating an intense atmosphere. The skeletal figure rides a horse caught in motion surrounded by other forms resembling human figures in distress or falling. The background is filled with flowing lines suggesting movement. This image conveys a sense of doom and destruction, characterized by the grim, skeletal figure dominating the scene.
creator: Alphonse Legros
medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite  on brown paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Centaur with Branches
title: Centaur with Branches
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a centaur resting against a tree in a forest landscape. The drawing depicts a centaur, which is half human and half horse, positioned reclining against a tree. The backdrop features a forested area with trees and detailed foliage. The composition is rich in texture, with fine lines that convey depth and detail.
creator: Alphonse Legros
medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Study of Woman's Head, Turned Right
title: Study of Woman's Head, Turned Right
assistive_text: The image shows a detailed drawing of a person's head and partial neck in a profile view. The facial features are delicately drawn, showing defined contours around the eyes, nose, and mouth. The person's face is turned slightly upwards with a slight upwards gaze. The hair is depicted with soft, curly lines indicating a full head of hair. The drawing does not include clothing details. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is a plain, neutral tone to highlight the person's features.
creator: Alphonse Legros
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Two Studies of Hands
title: Two Studies of Hands
assistive_text: The image shows a pencil sketch of two pairs of hands. One pair is positioned in a prayer-like gesture with interlocked fingers, palms facing inward. The other pair is holding a book, one hand slightly overlapping the pages while the other supports the book from underneath. The hands are detailed and shaded, with no visible facial features or clothing other than cuffs around the wrists. The background is plain, emphasizing the focus on the hands.
creator: Alphonse Legros
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Head of a Bald Man with a Beard
title: Head of a Bald Man with a Beard
assistive_text: The image shows a portrait of an older man. He is facing slightly to the side, with his head turned and his gaze directed upwards. The man has well-defined facial features, including prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and a furrowed brow. His hair is thin and recedes significantly, blending into a full, long beard. The man is wearing what appears to be a robe or a loose garment. The background is textured and monochrome. There are no visible items, jewelry, or objects around him.
creator: Alphonse Legros
medium: pen and brown ink with yellow and brown wash over graphite on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: In the Deluged Marsh - The Shepherd (Au marais inonde - Le berger)
title: In the Deluged Marsh - The Shepherd (Au marais inonde - Le berger)
assistive_text: The image shows a riverside scene captured from a slight elevation. The horizon is high, featuring distant trees and a softly sketched sky. Two boats, one with a figure steering, are near the viewer. A small flock of sheep is huddled near another boat, and a woman and child stand on the bank. The detailed etching style depicts trees, figures, and landscape with precision. The monochromatic color palette of sepia and black creates a timeless and serene ambiance. In the background, a man heads towards a house surrounded by trees. The composition is serene and balanced, offering a glimpse of peaceful countryside life.
creator: Auguste Lepère
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jewish Quarters in Amsterdam
title: Jewish Quarters in Amsterdam
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a crowd scene in a residential street. The scene includes various figures gathered in front of a row of buildings, with some figures interacting on steps leading to the entrances of these structures. The architecture is simple and linear, featuring multiple windows and a slightly skewed perspective that gives the impression of bustling urban life. The drawing employs fine, detailed line work to capture the nuances of facial expressions and clothing textures. In the background, more figures are depicted, suggesting a busy, populated environment. The presence of figures on balconies and close to the windows adds depth to the scene and conveys a sense of community within this urban setting.
creator: Auguste Lepère
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: American Quarries, near Paris (Carrieres d'Amerique, pres Paris)
title: American Quarries, near Paris (Carrieres d'Amerique, pres Paris)
assistive_text: The image shows a countryside landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is positioned about a third up from the bottom of the image, with a distant cluster of buildings and hills against the sky. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing clouds and terrain. Closest to us are two figures seated beside a rustic fence, engaged in conversation, and another figure rests on the slope to the right. Beyond them, rolling hills stretch into the distance, with groups of sheep. The sky features radiating lines suggesting sunlight breaking through clouds, adding contrast. The color palette is monochromatic with warm sepia tones.
creator: Auguste Lepère
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Corpus Christi Procession at Nantes (Procession de la Fete Dieu a Nantes)
title: Corpus Christi Procession at Nantes (Procession de la Fete Dieu a Nantes)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a religious procession in front of a cathedral. The scene includes a group of clergy and attendants wearing detailed robes, holding liturgical objects. The setting is an elaborately detailed gothic cathedral facade with arched doorways and decorative stonework. Banners and festoons adorn the area, adding to the festive atmosphere. The composition features a dense gathering of figures, creating a sense of movement and pageantry against the backdrop of the cathedral.
creator: Auguste Lepère
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Parliament at 9 o'Clock in the Evening - London (Le parlement a 9 heures du soir - Londres)
title: Parliament at 9 o'Clock in the Evening - London (Le parlement a 9 heures du soir - Londres)
assistive_text: The image shows the Palace of Westminster and Big Ben from street level. The street is busy with people and horse-drawn carriages. The clock tower and the structure of the Palace of Westminster are visible. The Big Ben clock displays the time. The sky has swirling clouds painted with loose brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily in shades of gray and black. The dark figures in the street contrast with the illuminated windows of the building and street lamps. The scene suggests an overcast evening or night. In the distance, the architectural details of the Gothic structure are visible.
creator: Auguste Lepère
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Captivity
title: The Captivity
assistive_text: This is a drawing showing a group of armored figures confronting a robed individual in a landscape with barren trees and hills. In the foreground, two figures are depicted in a position showing an action or altercation, with additional characters standing in the background with weapons. The central image is surrounded by an ornate circular frame with detailed borders featuring floral and foliate motifs and small figures.
creator: Lucas van Leyden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Baptism of Christ in the Jordan
title: The Baptism of Christ in the Jordan
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered near a body of water in a forested landscape. The scene depicts individuals clothed in long, flowing robes and garments, gathered around a central figure who appears to be kneeling in water, surrounded by rock formations. The composition is dense with details, providing an intricate display of textures in the folds of clothing and the bark of trees. The landscape in the background features trees, rolling hills, and structures resembling human dwellings. The drawing is detailed with attention to linework, capturing a moment in an evocative setting.
creator: Lucas van Leyden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Triumph of Mordecai
title: The Triumph of Mordecai
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a procession of figures. The figures are depicted in ornate attire, with one riding a horse. Various figures are shown in different poses, such as kneeling or holding staffs. The background shows an architectural structure with high archways and mountains in the distance. The drawing is detailed, displaying textures of fabric, armor, and natural elements.
creator: Lucas van Leyden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ Crowned with Thorns
title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a dramatic scene. The drawing shows a gathering of individuals, with one central figure seated with a crown of thorns. The figures around him appear to be interacting with this central figure. The individuals are dressed in historical clothing with detailed textures and styles. The line work captures fabric folds and facial expressions. The scene is set in an interior space with pillars and an arched background.
creator: Lucas van Leyden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Virgin and Child on the Crescent
title: The Virgin and Child on the Crescent
assistive_text: The image shows a woman standing and holding a baby. The woman is facing forward with her head slightly tilted towards the child. She has delicate facial features, long flowing hair, and a serene expression. She is dressed in a long draped garment and holds an ornate scepter. The baby is wrapped in a similar cloth. In the background, there are radiant lines emanating from the woman.
creator: Lucas van Leyden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Virgin in the Niche
title: The Virgin in the Niche
assistive_text: The image shows a woman holding a child. The woman is standing in a side profile and looking at the child. She has a serene expression and wears a headdress. The child has soft curls and looks up at the woman. The woman's clothing is long and flowing with intricate folds. A halo-like illumination frames them from behind. The background has cross-hatched lines creating a textured effect.
creator: Lucas van Leyden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Abraham Repudiating Hagar
title: Abraham Repudiating Hagar
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an older man, a woman, a child, and a small dog standing in a rocky landscape. The drawing is detailed and likely created using etching or engraving techniques. The older man is on the left, wearing a robe and holding a staff. The woman holds a jug, the child looks out, and the dog sniffs the ground. In the background, there are trees, rocks, and buildings. The drawing is monochromatic, emphasizing line work and shading for texture and detail.
creator: Lucas van Leyden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Two Couples in the Forest
title: The Two Couples in the Forest
assistive_text: The image shows four people almost in full-body. They are positioned closely together, with three of them walking while one appears to be standing nearby. The central figure is a woman with intricate, plaited hair adorned with a headpiece. She is wearing a detailed, long-sleeved dress with layers and embroidery. Beside her, a man with long, unkempt hair is walking and pointing. He is wearing a tunic and hose. To the left, another woman stands in profile with her hair covered by a headdress and wrapped in multiple layers of clothes. Behind her, another man with a hat and long cloak is present. They are surrounded by a natural setting, with trees and foliage in the background. The scene is depicted in detailed linework typical of historical engravings, with rich textures in clothing and natural elements.
creator: Lucas van Leyden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Old Woman with Grapes
title: The Old Woman with Grapes
assistive_text: The image shows an elderly person depicted from just below the shoulders and up, facing slightly to the left. The individual has pronounced facial features, with a broad nose and a serious expression. Their hair is not visible, as it is covered by a turban-like headpiece adorned with a layered, ruffled design. They are wearing layered clothing that includes a robe with a decorative collar, fastened with a round button. The person is holding a cluster of grapes delicately with both hands. The background consists of a finely detailed, textured pattern.
creator: Lucas van Leyden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Mouth of Truth
title: The Mouth of Truth
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of people in historical attire gathered around an animal. The illustration has intricate linework showing an assembly of figures with one person kneeling towards a large creature. The surrounding figures have varied poses, some gesturing while others seem contemplative. The background features stylized mountains. The scene appears to be set in a historical or narrative context rich in detail, depicting a moment possibly relating to ceremony or significance.
creator: Lucas van Leyden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Joshua, David, Judas Maccabees
title: Joshua, David, Judas Maccabees
assistive_text: The image shows three ornately dressed figures on horseback, accompanied by banners with inscriptions. The scene depicts a procession emphasizing detail and intricacy in attire and horse decorations. Each figure is adorned with elaborate feathered helmets and armor, while the horses wear decorated caparisons. The style reflects early woodcut techniques, with bold lines and careful attention to linear details that give volume and texture to the figures and horses.
creator: Lucas van Leyden
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Abraham Entertaining the Angels [verso]
title: Abraham Entertaining the Angels [verso]
assistive_text: This is a painting of a rural scene with multiple figures and animals. The composition features a group of individuals engaged in interaction in the foreground near a structure, while in the background, there is a pastoral landscape of hills, trees, and several shepherds tending to flocks of sheep by a stream or road. The figures are depicted in traditional garments with one kneeling. The artwork uses a monochromatic palette with shades of grey to create contrasts and highlights. This is in the style of a Renaissance artist, reminiscent of detailed narrative compositions seen in works by Pieter Bruegel the Elder or other artists of the time who focused on human activity and landscapes.
creator: German 16th Century
medium: pen and brush and black ink with brush and gray ink and gray wash heightened with white on gray prepared paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Animal Legend (Tierlegende)
title: Animal Legend (Tierlegende)
assistive_text: The image features a series of intricate and flowing lines in an abstract composition. These lines suggest the presence of several animals, including what resembles a rabbit, a rodent-like creature, and an antelope with long, curved horns. Additionally, there are elements that may be reminiscent of vegetation, with leafy and organic motifs. The interconnected abstracted elements create a dynamic and intertwined scene.
creator: Franz Marc
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Entombment with Three Birds
title: The Entombment with Three Birds
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a rocky landscape where a group of individuals appear to be involved in an activity around a carved rock chamber or cave. The foreground shows a detailed depiction of a rugged terrain with jagged rock formations and sparse vegetation, including a couple of slender trees that rise between the rocks. The central focus is on a scene surrounding the rock chamber, which is open and appears to be of significance. The background features a series of crosses and an expansive sky scattered with clouds and birds. The style of the drawing is meticulous, capturing the textures of the rocky environment and the somber tone of the gathering.
creator: Giovanni Antonio da Brescia, after Andrea Mantegna
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Virgin and Child
title: The Virgin and Child
assistive_text: The image shows a woman and a baby from the waist up. The woman is seated and gently holding the baby against her chest. Her facial expression is serene with closed eyes. She is wearing robes and her hair is covered. The baby appears relaxed in her arms, with curly hair and a round face. The background is a simple textured area.
creator: Andrea Mantegna
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Children Harvesting Grapes
title: Children Harvesting Grapes
assistive_text: This is a drawing of cherubic figures engaged in activities with baskets of fruit and a goat. The figures are depicted in a dynamic composition, interacting with each other in a playful and idyllic atmosphere. The details in the drawing add depth and texture to the piece.
creator: Master IB after Raphael
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ornament with Fantastic Satyr and Dolphins
title: Ornament with Fantastic Satyr and Dolphins
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an ornamental design with a mythical figure and decorative acanthus pattern. The central figure is a bearded man with curly hair emerging from intertwined scrolls and leaves. The figure's arms are extended outward, harmonizing with the artwork's curves. Two serpentine creatures or fish-like forms flank the central figure, contributing to the symmetry. The design is detailed with shading and line work for texture.
creator: Master IB
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Bagpipe Player with His Lover
title: Bagpipe Player with His Lover
assistive_text: This is an image of a seated meeting in a natural setting. Two figures are seated under a tree, talking. One figure holds a musical instrument resembling a bagpipe, and the other holds a large sack or pitcher. The scene is set against foliage and grass, hinting at an outdoor location. The lines and shading show texture in the clothing and facial features. The style is detailed and traditional.
creator: Master IB
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sol (The Sun)
title: Sol (The Sun)
assistive_text: The image shows a figure seen from behind, standing upright. The person has a muscular build, a full beard, curly hair, and wears an elaborate sun-themed headpiece. They are dressed in a draped garment, holding a staff and resting their other hand on an oval shield with a lion's face. The background includes lined details, a tree, and foliage. There is text "SOL" at the top right corner and an inscribed box with numbers at the top left.
creator: Master IB
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Pilate Washing His Hands
title: Pilate Washing His Hands
assistive_text: The image shows a group of figures in an architectural setting. The figures are dressed in historical attire and gathered in a structured setting with intricate architectural details. One figure is seated beside a basin, surrounded by elaborate patterns and symbolic representations. The composition features detailed lines and patterns, emphasizing the clothing garments and expressions of the figures. The architectural elements include columns and arches adorned with ornamental designs. The drawing uses high-contrast black and white to highlight depth and intricacies.
creator: Master S
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Lot and His Daughters
title: Lot and His Daughters
assistive_text: The image depicts a circular scene with three people dressed in medieval attire. In the foreground, two seated figures are shown from head to their legs. The man has a beard, wearing a multi-layered garment and a hat. The woman beside him has braided hair and a detailed dress. Standing beside them is a woman seen from head to toe, with her hair styled back and wearing an elaborate dress with ornamental sleeves, while holding a ladle over a basin. Jewelry is visible on the seated woman. The background shows a landscape with a body of water, a sailing ship, a burning city with tall towers and flames. An animal resembling a dog and a large decorated jug are seen in the foreground.
creator: Master S
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ornament with a Cupid, a Satyr,  and Grotesque Figures
title: Ornament with a Cupid, a Satyr,  and Grotesque Figures
assistive_text: The image features intricate lines and curving shapes forming a complex abstract composition. There is a symmetrical figure at the top with wings and a head resembling a human with dual horns. Below, a central figure blends human and animal features, such as a goat, surrounded by leafy embellishments resembling twisting vines. Among the organic forms are other abstract figures resembling fantastical beasts and cherub-like entities. The pattern suggests a tapestry of mythical figures and natural elements woven together in a dense, decorative artwork.
creator: Master of the Horse Heads
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hercules and Cacus
title: Hercules and Cacus
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a combat scene. The image features a figure on top of a centaur, holding a large bone or club above their head. The centaur seems distressed. The background has diagonal lines hinting at movement. At the bottom, there is a shield with a lion's face and a dagger lying on the ground.
creator: Master of 1515
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Titre des eaux-fortes sur Paris (Title Page to the Set of Etchings of Paris)
title: Titre des eaux-fortes sur Paris (Title Page to the Set of Etchings of Paris)
assistive_text: The image is a drawing of a book cover. The cover features large text reading "Eaux-Fortes sur Paris par C. Meryon," accompanied by the date "MDCCCLII". The background is textured blue, with the text printed in black with a shadowy effect. The border is uneven, with an etched or engraved embellishment at the top in the shape of a spiral. The design and typography suggest an old, historical style. The cover gives a sense of antiquity and classical artistry, being both administrative and decorative.
creator: Charles Meryon
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: L'abside de Notre-Dame de Paris (The Apse of the Cathedral of Notre-Dame, Paris)
title: L'abside de Notre-Dame de Paris (The Apse of the Cathedral of Notre-Dame, Paris)
assistive_text: The image is an etching depicting a view from the bank of a river, looking toward Notre Dame Cathedral. Two towers of Notre Dame stand out, dominating the scene. The horizon is near the middle of the image, lined with buildings. The etching shows detailed buildings, natural elements, and clouds in the sky. Closest to us, figures are seen on a sandy riverbank next to a horse-drawn cart, with boats in the water nearby. The color palette is monochromatic in brown and black.
creator: Charles Meryon
medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Tourelle, Rue de l'École de Médecine, 22, Paris (House with a Turret, No. 22, Street of the School of Medecine, Paris)
title: Tourelle, Rue de l'École de Médecine, 22, Paris (House with a Turret, No. 22, Street of the School of Medecine, Paris)
assistive_text: The image depicts a street scene with intricate buildings lining a narrow passage. Figures are seen on the street, along with a horse-drawn cart. Surreal figures float in the sky above, contrasting with the detailed architectural elements. The monochromatic color palette adds depth to the composition.
creator: Charles Meryon
medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Bain-froid chevrier, dit "de l'École" (Chevrier's Cold-Bath Establishment, Sometimes called the "School-Baths")
title: Bain-froid chevrier, dit "de l'École" (Chevrier's Cold-Bath Establishment, Sometimes called the "School-Baths")
assistive_text: The image shows a view from an elevated position, looking down at a canal or waterway with stone walls on one side and buildings on the other. The horizon is in the upper third of the composition, with buildings on an embankment. The artwork is composed of intricate cross-hatching creating texture on the buildings and clouds. The color scheme is sepia, emphasizing the detailed lines. A wooden platform crosses the water where people and boats are visible. In the background, there are more buildings and signs, including one for a bathing establishment. The skyline merges with the cloudy sky, with faint bird silhouettes.
creator: Charles Meryon
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Loi lunaire, 1er planche ("Lunar" Law, 1st plate)
title: La Loi lunaire, 1er planche ("Lunar" Law, 1st plate)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a document enclosed in a decorative border. The central focus is a handwritten text enclosed within an ornamental frame, featuring towers at each side which culminate in stylized flaming torches. At the top, there are cloud-like designs with two diagonal lines converging towards the center. At the bottom, the words "Loi Sunaire" are written above a decorative element featuring a burning flame atop a small platform with three legs, surrounded by rays. The border includes decorative details such as stars and a bird-like figure at the base. The style is characterized by intricate line work and symbolic imagery.
creator: Charles Meryon
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Rébus: "Béranger ne fut véritablement fort, car il n'eut jamais la clef des champs" (Rebus: "Beranger was not really strong, for he never had the key of the fields")
title: Rébus: "Béranger ne fut véritablement fort, car il n'eut jamais la clef des champs" (Rebus: "Beranger was not really strong, for he never had the key of the fields")
assistive_text: This is a drawing of various objects and scenes along with some text. The central elements of the drawing include a bird standing on a patch of ground and a column of poetry comparing the bird to an influential figure. Below that, several sketched images are arranged in a vertical sequence, including wooden posts, a table set with a cloth bearing the text "RESTAURATEUR EN RENOM DU PALAIS ROYAL," and a star-shaped fort labeled "PAYS DES POULARDS." A barrel with the label "PIÈCE DE SALAISON," a solitary figure next to a tree, and various contraptions also populate the image. The bottom portion of the drawing contains a set of arrangements reminiscent of a telescope or a surveying tool alongside a list mentioning various types of chants, including "CHANTS RUSTIQUES ET MARITIMES" and "MARSEILLAISE." The names "VIRGILE" and "HOMERE" are inscribed.
creator: Charles Meryon
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Couverture du "Voyage à la nouvelle Zélande" (Cover for the Set of Etchings Entitled "A Voyage to New Zealand")
title: Couverture du "Voyage à la nouvelle Zélande" (Cover for the Set of Etchings Entitled "A Voyage to New Zealand")
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a title page for a historical maritime voyage. The image contains intricate line drawings that form an elaborate border around the text. The central text details a voyage to New Zealand, specifically an expedition entitled "Voyage à la Nouvelle Zélande," accomplished between the years 1842 and 1846 onboard the Navire Rhin. The text also mentions command under Captain A. Bérard. The surrounding border includes nautical and exploratory themes, such as depictions of native plant leaves, a fish, and nautical equipment. There is also a strong sense of design symmetry in the illustrated border, which features stylized flora and fauna and includes a date marked as 1866. The paper has a vintage appearance consistent with the historical context of the document's content.
creator: Charles Meryon
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Plan du Combat de Sinope (Plan of the Battle of Sinope)
title: Plan du Combat de Sinope (Plan of the Battle of Sinope)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a historical chart or map of a maritime battle or event near a coastal town labeled "Sinope." The drawing shows a detailed map of a coastal area with several ships marked in the water, positioned at various distances from the shore. The coastline is outlined with distinct bends, and the city of Sinope is depicted with rectangles and polygons, possibly indicating buildings or fortifications. Next to the city are markings representing ruins and a labeled area potentially showing a lake or inland water body. Alongside the map are labels and notes in French, listing ships identified by letters such as A, B, C, etc., with associated notes on their types or states. A compass rose is included for navigational reference, and depth lines illustrated by dashed lines show changes in seabed depth.
creator: Charles Meryon
medium: etching with watercolor additions on Van Gelder laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ancienne habitation à Bourges, dite "La Maison du Musicien" (An Old House at Bourges, Sometimes Called the "Musician's House")
title: Ancienne habitation à Bourges, dite "La Maison du Musicien" (An Old House at Bourges, Sometimes Called the "Musician's House")
assistive_text: The image depicts a street scene with an old building featuring a steep, thatched roof running diagonally across. The horizon is not visible, but chimneys and rooftops provide upward movement. The style uses fine, precise lines typical of etching capturing architectural details and textures. The color palette is sepia tones. Barrels and goods are displayed in the foreground with a seated shopkeeper. Figures are engaged in conversation further down the street, leading the eye toward rooftops and smoke rising from a chimney under a sky with dispersed cloud patterns.
creator: Charles Meryon
medium: etching with graphite additions on wove Japanese paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hieronymus Alexander, Archbishop of Brindisi
title: Hieronymus Alexander, Archbishop of Brindisi
assistive_text: The image shows the upper body of a person seated in a three-quarter view, looking slightly to their left. The individual is depicted with a serious expression, featuring prominent eyes and a slightly pointed nose, wearing a cap that covers most of their hair. They are dressed in a traditional garment resembling a cape or cloak, fastened with buttons down the front. Their left arm is bent, resting on the back of a chair, while their right hand holds a book and points to a specific location on it. A ring is visible on their right hand. In the background, a ledge holds a few closed books and a framed item with a simple geometric design on the front.
creator: Agostino dei Musi
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Pope Paul III
title: Pope Paul III
assistive_text: The image is an engraving showing the upper half of a man's body. The man is left-facing with a downturned gaze. His facial features include a prominent nose, deep-set eye, and furrowed brow. He has a beard and hair covered by a cap or helmet. He wears a robe or cloak with textured folds. The background is shaded with cross-hatched lines. At the bottom, there is an inscription in a classical style that reads, "PAVLVS·III·PONT·MAX" with Roman numerals and letters for historical context.
creator: Agostino dei Musi
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Couple at a Table (Paar am Tisch)
title: Couple at a Table (Paar am Tisch)
assistive_text: The image displays a stylized portrayal of more than half of a person's body, focusing on their upper body and head. The person is shown in a seated position, with their body slightly turned and leaning over a table. Their facial features are depicted with exaggerated lines and angles, conveying a sense of sharpness in expression, and their hair appears dark and is rendered in loose, bold strokes. The person is unclothed and sitting with one arm resting on the table. There is a wine glass also depicted, and another face in the background. The background is filled with abstract, dark brush strokes that give a sense of depth and contrast to the bright yellow and black coloring of the image.
creator: Otto Mueller
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jerome Franck
title: Jerome Franck
assistive_text: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man. He is positioned facing forward with a neutral expression. The man has curly hair, a short beard, and a mustache. He is wearing period clothing with a high ruffled collar and a buttoned garment. The background is plain, and the portrait is framed by a polygonal frame. Below the portrait is an inscription with the name "Hiérôme Franque Peintre du Roy".
creator: Jean Morin, after Jerome Franken
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Shepherd with a Platerspiel
title: Shepherd with a Platerspiel
assistive_text: The image depicts a figure playing a flute while kneeling. Detailed vegetation is closest to us, with a herd of sheep gathered under a large tree. A stone structure with a window and hilly terrain leading to mountains are in the background. Wispy clouds can be seen in the sky. The artwork is monochrome with cross-hatching and line work for depth and texture.
creator: Benedetto Montagna
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Fontaine de la Régénération sur les débris de la Bastille, le 10 Aout 1793
title: La Fontaine de la Régénération sur les débris de la Bastille, le 10 Aout 1793
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a large gathering in front of a statue. The composition features a multitude of figures gathered around a raised platform supporting a prominent statue. The statue represents a seated figure. Surrounding the statue, numerous trees contribute to the setting. Architectural elements in the background suggest a historical or cultural location for the event depicted. The foreground is densely populated with figures in various poses, indicating dynamic movement and engagement with the scene.
creator: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Charles Monnet
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ouverture des Etats-Généraux à Versailles, le 5 mars 1789
title: Ouverture des Etats-Généraux à Versailles, le 5 mars 1789
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene in an opulent hall with columns, detailed ceilings decorated with oval medallions and floral patterns. Symmetrically placed marble columns support an entablature leading to a throne-like area. Numerous figures in formal attire are gathered in rows, engaged in an event or ceremony directed at a stage with a raised platform. The perspective adds depth, emphasizing the spacious and elaborate interior.
creator: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Charles Monnet
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Pompe funèbre en l'honneur des Martyrs de la journée du 10, dans le Jardin National le 26 Aout 1792
title: Pompe funèbre en l'honneur des Martyrs de la journée du 10, dans le Jardin National le 26 Aout 1792
assistive_text: The image shows a public gathering with a low horizon line near the bottom third of the composition. The horizon is marked by a grand architectural structure with domed towers. A crowd of people is gathered, dressed in period attire. They are focused towards a central event where smoke and a pyramid-shaped structure can be seen. The artwork features detailed line work with hatching and cross-hatching, typical of an engraving technique. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by varying shades of black, white, and gray. Large, swirling clouds fill the sky above the gathering.
creator: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Charles Monnet
