The man has a high forehead, a long nose, and a small mustache. His hair is wavy and falls around his chin. He wears a formal garment with a large collar and buttons down the front. There is a circular frame around the portrait with an inscription along its border and a coat of arms below. The background of the print has a fine, crosshatched pattern.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Guy Chamillard
title: Guy Chamillard
assistive_text: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to his right, with curly, shoulder-length hair framing his face. His features include a prominent nose, high forehead, and a somewhat serious expression. He wears a dark garment with a white lace collar. Surrounding him is an oval frame with Latin text around it, and below the oval is a decorative emblem or coat of arms. The background is plain.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Henri-Auguste, Comte de Brienne
title: Henri-Auguste, Comte de Brienne
assistive_text: The image is a portrait engraving of a man. He is centered within an oval frame adorned with oak leaves and ribbons. He is facing slightly left, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a gentle expression, a prominent nose, and long, slightly wavy hair falling to his shoulders. He is wearing a dark cloak with a high collar and a white collar underneath. There is a decorative sash or ribbon diagonally across his chest, with a star-shaped insignia on his left shoulder. The background has delicate cross-hatching, contrasting with the ornamental frame. Below the portrait is a coat of arms with two lions and other heraldic elements in a symmetrical design.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Madame Bouthillier
title: Madame Bouthillier
assistive_text: The image shows a waist-up portrait of a woman facing the viewer. She is slightly turned to her right, has a solemn expression, and wavy hair falling around her cheeks. She wears a small cap and clothing with noticeable texture. The woman is framed in an ornate oval frame with leaf and ribbon designs. The background includes an architectural element with a heraldic shield and decorative embellishments underneath the frame.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Victor Bouthillier
title: Victor Bouthillier
assistive_text: The image depicts an engraving of a man's upper body facing slightly to the left with his head turned toward the viewer. The man has curly, medium-length hair, a prominent nose, and a slight smile. He is wearing religious attire, including a large collar, a robe, and a clerical cap. A cross on a chain hangs around his neck. In the background, there is an ornate frame holding the portrait, surrounded by draped fabric and various ecclesiastical symbols, such as a mitre, a cross-staff, books, and religious insignia. The setting conveys a formal and religious atmosphere, emphasizing the man's clerical authority.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cardinal de Bouillon
title: Cardinal de Bouillon
assistive_text: The image shows a portrait of a man facing forward with his head slightly tilted to his left. He has wavy shoulder-length hair, a smooth complexion, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a rounded nose, and a faint smile. He wears a historical garment with a white collar and textured fabric over his shoulders. There are no visible accessories. The background is a dark oval, encircled by an ornate border with inscriptions.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Pierre Bouchu
title: Pierre Bouchu
assistive_text: The image depicts a man in formal clergy attire seated with a calm expression. His face is visible, turned slightly towards the viewer, with short hair that closely follows the shape of his head. He wears a high-collared garment and a cross pendant around his neck. The portrait is encased within an oval frame with script around it, set against a background of delicately engraved lines.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Gilles Boileau
title: Gilles Boileau
assistive_text: The image shows a portrait of a man from the shoulders up. The man is facing forward with a slight turn to his right. He has a serious expression, a prominent nose, and a mustache. He has curly, shoulder-length hair and appears to be wearing a cap. The man is dressed in a dark garment with detailed embroidery and a large, white collar tied at the neck. The background is simple and monochrome, enclosed within an oval frame.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Marc Bochart
title: Marc Bochart
assistive_text: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest upwards. He is facing slightly to the side with a calm expression. He has distinct facial features including a mustache, beard, nose, and cheekbones. His hair is short and combed back. The man wears a garment with a high collar adorned with lace or embroidery. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The portrait is set in an oval frame within a detailed line work background. Below the oval frame is a decorative emblem with cherubic figures and a shield with a heart-like symbol. The background is composed of fine lines adding texture.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Francoise Blanchart
title: Francoise Blanchart
assistive_text: The image features a classical portrait of a man shown from the chest up. He is posed facing the right and his gaze is slightly towards the viewer. The man has a composed expression with distinct facial features including a straight nose, full lips, and gentle gaze. His hair is neatly cut and appears gray or white. He is wearing a formal robe with a pleated texture and a cross pendant around his neck. The background is a dark oval shape and the image is bordered by an ornate oval frame with inscriptions in a classical style.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Louis-Dominique de Bailleul
title: Louis-Dominique de Bailleul
assistive_text: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a person in an oval frame. The person is turned slightly to the right, looking forward with a neutral expression. They have long, curly hair reaching their shoulders and wear a voluminous cloak with a draped collar. The background has an oval pattern with Latin text encircling the portrait. Below, a decorative crest with heraldic symbols is located at the bottom of the frame.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Claude Auvry
title: Claude Auvry
assistive_text: The image is a portrait of a man. He is positioned slightly turned to his left but looking directly at the viewer, with facial features including a prominent nose, a trimmed mustache, and gentle smile lines. He has wavy, medium-length hair. The man is wearing a clerical robe with a broad white collar and a skullcap on his head. He has a chain with a large cross pendant around his neck. The portrait is framed within an oval border with inscriptions in Latin. The background has a subtle pattern, contrasting with the detailed engraving of the man. The bottom of the frame features a coat of arms.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Simon Dreux d'Aubray
title: Simon Dreux d'Aubray
assistive_text: The image shows the upper body of a man facing the viewer with a composed expression. He has a mustache, a small goatee, and long wavy hair reaching his shoulders. He wears a dark robe or jacket with a broad, square collar over a buttoned shirt with detailed textures. The man is not wearing visible jewelry, and the attire suggests formality. The portrait is encased in an oval frame with decorative lines, below which is an emblem featuring a coat of arms with three clovers and ornate flourishes. The background features simple vertical lines, creating a classic and elegant setting.
creator: Robert Nanteuil
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Rue Pirouette aux halles, Paris (Pirouette Street, Near the Markets, Paris)
title: La Rue Pirouette aux halles, Paris (Pirouette Street, Near the Markets, Paris)
assistive_text: The image displays a street scene viewed from an elevated point. The street is narrow and busy, lined with tall buildings. The horizon is high, obscured by the towering buildings on each side. The fine lines of the etching show detailed textures and shadows on the building facades. The color scheme is sepia, creating a classic look. People are shown in motion, shops with signs are visible, and individuals interact within the scene. The street structures frame the scene, guiding the viewer's gaze. The sky above the rooftops includes clouds and a few birds.
creator: Charles Meryon
medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La salle des pas-perdus à l'ancien Palais-de-Justice, Paris (The Antechamber of the Palace of Justice, Paris)
title: La salle des pas-perdus à l'ancien Palais-de-Justice, Paris (The Antechamber of the Palace of Justice, Paris)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an architectural interior. The image depicts the interior of a large vaulted structure with rows of columns dividing the space into two expansive aisles. These aisles are topped with a series of semi-circular arches supported by tall, slender pillars, giving the ceiling the appearance of vaulted domes. The walls are adorned with statues fitted into niches, while large arched windows run along the upper part of the walls, allowing natural light to enter. Numerous figures at the ground level suggest a bustling atmosphere. The detailed perspective emphasizes the grandeur and the complex geometric patterns of the ceiling and support beams.
creator: Charles Meryon
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Abraham and Isaac on Their Way to Mount Moriah
title: Abraham and Isaac on Their Way to Mount Moriah
assistive_text: The image shows a group of figures traveling along a path. The horizon is obscured by dense foliage, with two trees in the background. The figures are walking, with one leading a pack donkey carrying wood. The illustration is detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching creating texture and depth. The color palette is primarily black and white, emphasizing the details, light, and shadows in the scene.
creator: Peregrino da Cesena
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Horatius Cocles
title: Horatius Cocles
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a historical battle scene. It depicts a group of armored warriors engaged in combat on a narrow wooden bridge or platform over a body of water. The figures are shown in dynamic poses, brandishing swords and shields. Some warriors wear helmets with plumage. Below the bridge, two figures are shown in the water. The overall tone of the image is intense and action-packed, conveying a moment of ancient warfare and struggle. The rich detail in the etching work emphasizes the movement and tension of the scene.
creator: Italian 18th or 19th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mucius Scaevola
title: Mucius Scaevola
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene with various figures and horses. The drawing shows a composition of multiple figures gathered around a seated figure. The central figure is surrounded by attendants and guards. The scene unfolds under the night sky with a crescent moon. The drawing displays intricate detailing in the attire and decorations. A sleeping figure lies near the base of the seated structure, adding to the complexity of the narrative. The overall style suggests a dramatic, possibly historical or mythical, narrative full of symbolism and character interaction.
creator: Italian 18th or 19th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Sleeping Shepherd; Early Morning
title: The Sleeping Shepherd; Early Morning
assistive_text: Through the arched, vine-covered trellis, we see a pastoral scene. A figure is reclining against a rustic structure covered with climbing plants with yellow flowers. In the background, there is a flock of sheep and two cows being led by a figure. The sky displays muted purples and pinks, transitioning into evening, while the grass and foliage are depicted in rich greens and browns. The brushwork combines fine details for plants and figures with broader strokes for the sky and landscape, creating a harmonious composition.
creator: Samuel Palmer
medium: etching, hand-colored with watercolor and opaque white with gold highlights
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Pharisees Wish to Stone Christ
title: The Pharisees Wish to Stone Christ
assistive_text: The image shows five figures depicted from head to toe. The central figure on the left wears a long robe and a tall hat, gesturing towards the figure on the right. The central figure has a prominent beard and a serious expression. The other figures on the left vary in gestures and attire. The figure on the far right stands slightly apart from the group, facing them. This figure has lengthy hair and a beard, with a halo of light around the head. The figure wears a long robe and gestures towards the other figures. The background contains a tall rectangular structure with an arched entrance, and the ground is covered with small dots. Two small symbols and the number "15" are printed at the top of the image.
creator: Georg Pencz
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Wife of Georg Pencz
title: Wife of Georg Pencz
assistive_text: The image displays a portrait of a person from the waist up. The individual has a stern facial expression, high cheekbones, a slightly furrowed brow, and deep-set eyes. Their hair is pulled back tightly and appears short or tucked under a covering. The person is wearing a garment with a high collar featuring ornate buttons or clasps and an overgarment draping over the shoulders. The background is a simple, textured pattern. There are horizontal lines encircling the portrait and some text inscribed at the top, with small initials or marks to the side.
creator: After Georg Pencz
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Brasserie, Au Lion Rouge
title: Brasserie, Au Lion Rouge
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an outdoor café scene in front of a building. The image depicts several tables and chairs arranged outside a café or brasserie, adorned with floral elements. The building's exterior has elaborate architectural detailing, including signage that reads "LION ROUGE" and "BRASSERIE UM". Figures are seated at tables, engaged in conversation or relaxing, creating a lively atmosphere. The shading and line work are intricate, adding movement to the scene. The drawing includes decorative architectural elements on the right side, suggesting grandeur. It captures the social life of a café in a detailed manner.
creator: Joseph Pennell
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Square, Independence Square, Philadelphia
title: The Square, Independence Square, Philadelphia
assistive_text: The image shows a scene with a building featuring a clock tower. Tall trees frame the structure, under a sky with obscured horizon. The painting style is detailed with brushstrokes creating a textured look. The color scheme is monochromatic in browns and sepia tones, giving an aged feel. Figures and steps add depth to the composition, guiding the viewer's gaze towards the distant building. The setting appears as a nostalgic urban scene with natural surroundings.
creator: Joseph Pennell
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hallway to Bed Room, Stenton
title: Hallway to Bed Room, Stenton
assistive_text: The image features a doorway leading into a room, a dresser on the right, and a mirror above the dresser showing a partial reflection of the room. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of gray, black, and white. Positioned centrally, the doorway opens to reveal a bed with patterned linens visible in the background and further accentuated by curtain patterns. To the right of the doorway, the dresser spans vertically with a mirror perched above, reflecting an abstract view of the room. To the left side of the image, wall details and an additional smaller piece of furniture can be seen along the hallway leading into the room.
creator: Joseph Pennell
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Book-Room at Dr. Wister's
title: Book-Room at Dr. Wister's
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a room that resembles a cozy library or study. The room is filled with floor-to-ceiling shelves packed with books, and there is a door or opening to another space with more bookshelves. To the left, a table or desk is visible, stacked with books and writing materials, including a vase with flowers. On the wall, there are framed artworks or photographs, and a large globe sits on a shelf. The drawing conveys a scholarly or intellectual ambiance, with detailed line work suggesting depth.
creator: Joseph Pennell
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Doorway, Wyck
title: Doorway, Wyck
assistive_text: The image displays an open structure with double doors leading to a series of openings inside, creating depth and perspective. Greenery is seen through the final opening. Loose, sketchy brushstrokes depict fine line work, including details in the doors and lattice supporting plants. The color palette is monochrome, with black or dark gray lines on a light background. Foliage and sunlight textures are visible. The entrance is bordered by climbing plants, partially obscuring the walls, with an interior space and glimpses of a garden visible beyond the doors.
creator: Joseph Pennell
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Girard Trust Company
title: The Girard Trust Company
assistive_text: The image depicts an urban environment with city buildings seen from a street level. The composition features various architectural details framing the scene, with a central building having a classical look, including a domed roof and grand entrance. Surrounding skyscrapers are also prominently displayed. The artwork utilizes sketch-like brushstrokes with heavy textures and shading to convey depth and architectural intricacies. The color palette consists of varying intensities of black, gray, and white, emphasizing light and shadow. The scene includes numerous figures in motion or gathered in the foreground, adding dynamism to the overall composition.
creator: Joseph Pennell
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Five O'Clock
title: Five O'Clock
assistive_text: The image depicts a bird's eye view of an industrial landscape. The horizon is in the upper portion of the image, featuring factory buildings with tall smokestacks releasing smoke into a detailed sky. The scene is created with pencil strokes in a monochromatic black and white palette. People are visible walking uphill towards the center among rows of shanty-style rooftops. The factories in the distance dominate the view, contributing to the industrial atmosphere.
creator: Joseph Pennell
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Little Fete, Athens
title: The Little Fete, Athens
assistive_text: The image shows a black and white illustration of a landscape with natural and architectural elements. People are gathered around rock fragments with trees nearby. Arches blend with the scene, leading to a cliff with the Acropolis and ancient columns silhouetted against the sky. The brushstrokes are sketch-like, with textured shading defining forms and shadows. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing light and shadow for depth and contrast.
creator: Joseph Pennell
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Taking the Big Gun Away
title: Taking the Big Gun Away
assistive_text: This grayscale print depicts two massive cranes with intricate beams and cables in front of a sky full of dramatic clouds. Railway tracks run across the ground, converging in the distance. In between the cranes is a large object with a long barrel set on wheels. The silhouettes of small people are visible around the cranes, and in the distant background are shapes that could be boats or buildings.
creator: Joseph Pennell
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Road to the White City, No.II
title: Road to the White City, No.II
assistive_text: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a rugged, mountainous landscape. The horizon is not distinctly visible, with focus on the towering rock formations and valleys. The brushstrokes are reminiscent of pointillism, creating intricate textures and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying shades of black and off-white to create contrast and depth. In the distance, the landscape rises and falls with the natural forms of the rocks.
creator: Joseph Pennell
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Aegina, The Black Forest
title: Aegina, The Black Forest
assistive_text: The image shows a classical ruin with large stone columns, some intact and others broken. The background features the sea meeting the sky, with coastal mountains in the distance. The artwork uses bold and varied brushstrokes or charcoal lines to depict the scene, emphasizing the ruggedness of the stone. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on shades of black, gray, and white to highlight the historic structures. In the distance, hills and the sea are visible, framed by a lightly clouded sky.
creator: Joseph Pennell
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Young Girl at the Keyboard
title: Young Girl at the Keyboard
assistive_text: The image depicts a young woman shown from the waist up, seated and slightly angled to the side with her head turned towards the viewer. Her features are delicately drawn, with a gentle expression and prominent eyes. Her hair is styled back with a decorative ribbon or headpiece. She wears a cloak over a dress with gathered sleeves and intricate drapery. She is holding an open book on her lap with her left hand, and her right hand is resting on it. The background is minimal, and the drawing style features soft lines and gentle shading.
creator: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Jan de Bray (formerly Gerrit Dou)
medium: chalk manner with roulette printed from two plates in gray and red ink on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Village with Pond
title: Village with Pond
assistive_text: The image is a sepia-toned print depicting a bustling village scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the composition, with a church spire rising into the sky. Buildings with thatched roofs and wood-plank structures are spread throughout the scene, and trees are also present. Close to the viewer, there are logs, a wooden barrel, patches of grass, and ducks swimming in a waterway. Villagers are shown engaging in various activities, such as riding horses, tending to carts, and conversing. In the distance, intricate linework is visible on the trees and buildings. The scene has a warm, monochromatic palette.
creator: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Allart van Everdingen
medium: aquatint with some roulette work and burnishing printed in red-brown ink on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Portrait of a Seated Man
title: Portrait of a Seated Man
assistive_text: The image depicts a man seated from the waist up, facing slightly to his left. He has high cheekbones, almond-shaped eyes, a moustache, and a goatee. His hair is styled with soft curls falling around his ears. He is wearing a formal outfit with a voluminous garment, large cuffs, and a wide white collar. His right hand rests at his waist, and the garment has buttons down the front. The background shows a heavy drapery on the right side, with the brim of a hat nearby.
creator: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Johannes Kornlein (printmaker), after Cornelis Visscher
medium: mezzotint with some burnishing printed in black ink on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Beggar with a Stick, Walking to the Left
title: Beggar with a Stick, Walking to the Left
assistive_text: This image shows a side view of a person walking with a staff. The individual is slightly hunched, stepping forward. Their facial features include a prominent nose and a contemplative expression. The person wears a pointed hat, a cloak or overcoat with folds, loose pants, and low shoes. The background features abstract lines resembling foliage.
creator: Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Circumcision: Small Plate
title: The Circumcision: Small Plate
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a glowing central figure. The scene is highly detailed, rendered in intricate line work, depicting a cloaked figure standing with a staff, overseeing a group. The central figure appears illuminated, enveloped in a warm aura. The characters are draped in textured robes, exchanging attentive, solemn gazes. The background features arches, with light appearing to radiate from the central figure, creating depths and shadows around the group. Every detail is carefully etched, conveying a sense of reverence and narrative depth.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Presentation in the Temple with the Angel: Small Plate
title: The Presentation in the Temple with the Angel: Small Plate
assistive_text: This image shows a scene with numerous figures. In the center, a person in a long robe, visible from the side and nearly full-length, stands amidst a group. The person is leaning slightly forward, with one hand extended, amidst others, some of whom are kneeling or bending. Their facial features are finely etched, giving a sense of depth and expression, and the individual wears a head covering. Another figure near them has elaborate headwear. The surrounding individuals, varying in age and appearance, are depicted in detailed robes and outfits, rich with folds. Some figures seem to gesture or interact with one another, creating a dynamic composition. An angelic figure, distinguished by wings, appears amidst the assembly. The scene is set against a backdrop of intricate architectural elements, with a large curtain draped open and others in the distance engaged in conversation or observing the scene. The detailing suggests the setting could be an ancient or mythological venue, with a strong sense of texture and spatial arrangement lending depth to the depicted gathering.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Beggar Man and Beggar Woman Conversing
title: Beggar Man and Beggar Woman Conversing
assistive_text: The image shows two individuals depicted in a sketch style, both visible from head to toe. They are positioned closely together, leaning forward towards one another, each supporting themselves with a cane. The person on the left is slightly taller, with a drawn expression on their face, prominent cheekbones, and wearing a hat that covers their hair. The clothing appears oversized and ragged, with a loose tunic and pants, and they have large, worn shoes. The individual on the right also has a drawn face with noticeable features and wears a hat with drooping sides. Their similar ragged clothing consists of a long coat or dress that reaches to their legs, which are partially visible. There is no visible jewelry or objects other than the canes they’re holding. The background is plain and lacks details, emphasizing the two figures as the focal point of the image.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sheet of Studies including Head of the Artist, a Beggar Couple, Heads of an Old Man and Old Woman
title: Sheet of Studies including Head of the Artist, a Beggar Couple, Heads of an Old Man and Old Woman
assistive_text: The image shows a partial etching of a person's face and shoulders, positioned in the upper half of the composition, with the head slightly turned to the viewer's right. The face features curly hair that extends outward, partially shadowing one of the eyes, and a soft expression with faint outlines and shading. The individual wears a wide-brimmed hat which casts shadows across the face. Below the main portrait are sketch-like figures, loosely drawn, suggesting other possible figure studies or incomplete works, with lines crossing and intersecting without definitive features. The background is an unfilled, light-toned space that highlights the etched lines without any detailed context or scenery.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Cavalry Fight
title: A Cavalry Fight
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an equestrian scene. The drawing features a central figure on a galloping horse. The horse's head is turned upward, and its muscular form is accentuated by the intricate line work. To the left, there is another figure in a defensive pose. The scene is filled with swirling lines and shadows, indicating action and movement, with a tangle of weapons and shields suggesting an atmosphere of conflict. The expressive line work adds a sense of urgency and chaos to the composition.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Artist's Mother Seated, in an Oriental Headdress
title: The Artist's Mother Seated, in an Oriental Headdress
assistive_text: The image shows an elderly woman from the waist up, seated in a side profile position facing to the right. She has aged features, including wrinkles, a pointed nose, and neutral expression. Her hair is covered with a cap or scarf, and she wears a textured garment. One hand is on her lap, with no visible jewelry. The background is plain.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Bearded Man, in a Furred Oriental Cap and Robe: the Artist's Father
title: Bearded Man, in a Furred Oriental Cap and Robe: the Artist's Father
assistive_text: The image shows the upper half of a man's body. His shoulders are turned slightly to the side while his face is directed towards the viewer. The man has a beard and a stern expression. He is wearing a large, furry hat that covers the top of his head, with his hair visible around his temples. He is dressed in clothing with a fur-lined collar. The background is plain, focusing on the subject. The artwork is in monochrome, featuring shading and cross-hatching for texture.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Old Man with Beard, Fur Cap, and Velvet Cloak
title: Old Man with Beard, Fur Cap, and Velvet Cloak
assistive_text: The image shows a half-length portrait of an elderly man seated with his body slightly turned towards the viewer. His head is facing forward, displaying a full beard and a serene facial expression with a slightly furrowed brow. His hair, mostly hidden beneath a large, fur-like hat, appears to be bushy and unkempt. The man is dressed in a loose, heavy, fur-lined coat, which covers his shoulders and arms, enveloping him in warmth. One hand rests on top of the other, visible from the coat's opening. In the background, there is a subtle, textured surface devoid of significant detail, focusing all attention on the subject.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Ship of Fortune
title: The Ship of Fortune
assistive_text: This is a drawing featuring a classical figure on horseback near the shore with ships in the background. The artwork depicts a congregation of people, with a central focus on the regal figure on the horse. On the left side, there is a crowd gathered near an ornate architectural structure. The right side shows a boat filled with people, with a figure standing at the prow, guiding the vessel with a firmly hoisted sail. There is a sense of movement and activity throughout, from the figures in animated poses to the rigged sails of the ships in the distance. The line work is intricate and expressive.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jan Cornelisz. Sylvius
title: Jan Cornelisz. Sylvius
assistive_text: The image shows a man seated, facing slightly to his right. His body is positioned behind a table or desk, and his hands are clasped together on the tabletop, resting on an open book. The man's face is aged, with a prominent, full beard and a receding hairline. His facial expression is serene. He wears a dark coat with a large, frilled white collar peeking out and a closely fitted cap on his head. The background is a textured, cross-hatched design. The focus is entirely on the man and the objects in front of him.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Great Jewish Bride
title: The Great Jewish Bride
assistive_text: This print shows a partial view of a woman seen from the waist up. She is positioned facing slightly to the left, with pale skin and long, flowing hair that is spread out down her shoulder and arms. She has high cheekbones, round eyes, and thin lips in a neutral expression. She appears to be wearing a long white garment with a high neck. The bottom half of the print is blank, with a few of the woman's curls reaching down into the blank space. The background in the upper half of the print is a textured surface, possibly a wall, with what look like tall columns on the right. The background of the print is beige paper.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
medium: etching, with some drypoint and burin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Presentation in the Temple: Oblong Print
title: The Presentation in the Temple: Oblong Print
assistive_text: The image shows a gathering of people in an interior setting. Several individuals are standing, clustered around a central figure kneeling and presenting a swaddled child. The central person has a beard and long robe, kneeling on the ground, focused on the child. Other individuals in the scene have distinct facial features, with headpieces and various facial hair styles among the men. The clothing is elaborate, with flowing robes and detailed textures. Many figures appear to be observing or gesturing towards the child. An animal, potentially a dog, sits in the lower-left corner. Overhead, a bird-like figure surrounded by a radiant light is depicted near the top center. The background suggests an interior space with heavy shadows, creating a sense of depth, while the architecture is defined by archways or curved surfaces.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Old Man with a Divided Fur Cap
title: Old Man with a Divided Fur Cap
assistive_text: The image depicts an older man shown from the waist up. He is seated and facing slightly to the side. His facial features are etched with care, showing a large, full beard and bushy eyebrows beneath a wide-brimmed fur hat. His hair is long and wavy, falling to his shoulders. He is wearing a cloak draped around his shoulders with a loose-fitting garment beneath. His right hand is partially visible, resting on his chest. The background is plain, with some sketch-like shading, and above the man's left shoulder, "Rembrandt" is inscribed along with a date that appears to be 1630.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cornelis Claesz Anslo
title: Cornelis Claesz Anslo
assistive_text: The image shows an upper body portrait of a seated person at a table. The individual is leaning forward with arms resting on the surface. They have a full beard, mustache, prominent nose, and deep-set eyes. Their hair is covered by a wide-brimmed hat. The person wears a garment with fur trim and a large collar. Several large, open books are on the table, and they hold a quill pen in one hand, potentially writing or referencing the pages. The background is a textured plain wall, and the scene appears to be drawn or etched onto a flat surface.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Clement de Jonghe
title: Clement de Jonghe
assistive_text: This print shows a person seated on a chair, depicted from their knees up. The individual is seated facing forward, with one arm resting on the chair's arm and the other hand resting on their lap. They have a long nose, deep-set eyes, and a thin mouth that appears to be in a slight smile. They have chin-length hair with a broad-brimmed hat partially covering it. The person is a wearing buttoned garment with a collar and a large cape over their shoulders. The background is gray, with some thin cross-hatched lines.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
medium: etching, drypoint and burin on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Medea, or the Marriage of Jason and Creusa
title: Medea, or the Marriage of Jason and Creusa
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a grand architectural interior with a gathering of figures. The scene is intricately detailed, depicting numerous figures gathered in a richly adorned architectural setting. The composition is dominated by towering arches and columns that draw the eye upwards. The left side of the drawing features a group of figures standing in a cluster, and on the right, a figure is seated on an elevated platform and approached by two other figures dressed in elaborate attire. Light and shadow are used effectively, especially in the folds of the drapery and the textures of the stone and fabric, adding depth to the scene.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on European (white) paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Self-Portrait Etching at a Window
title: Self-Portrait Etching at a Window
assistive_text: The image shows a man seated and viewed from the waist up. He has a round face with prominent cheekbones, a mustache, and small, deep-set eyes. His head is covered by a wide-brimmed hat. He wears a dark coat and holds a paper or book, with his hand appearing engaged in writing or reviewing it. The setting appears to be indoors near a large window on the left side, showing an outdoor view. The background is dark with contrasting lighter tones of the window and the textural details of his clothing.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Peter and John Healing the Cripple at the Gate of the Temple
title: Peter and John Healing the Cripple at the Gate of the Temple
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an architectural setting with a central figure approaching or interacting with a seated figure. The drawing displays intricate details of a classical architectural space featuring large columns and possibly a rotunda in the background. There are multiple other figures in the scene, some observing and others engaged in various activities. In the foreground, a draped figure appears to be addressing or extending something to a seated figure holding a bowl. The use of shading and fine lines creates a rich texture and depth, emphasizing the voluminous drapery of the figures and the grandeur of the architectural backdrop. The figures in the background, along a curved path, suggest a procession or gathering.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jacob Haaringh (Young Haaringh) (Pieter Haaringh)
title: Jacob Haaringh (Young Haaringh) (Pieter Haaringh)
assistive_text: The image displays an illustration of a person from the waist up, seated and slightly turned towards their right. Their left hand rests on an unseen surface while their right hand is partially visible on their lap. The person has a serious expression with deep-set eyes, prominent eyebrows, a shadowed nose, and closely set lips. Their shoulder-length hair is wavy and light-colored. They are wearing a dark, buttoned garment with a white collar and cuffs, and holding a hat across their lap. The background is dark with an indistinct window on the right featuring ornate, vertical mullions allowing light into the dimly lit space.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Lieven Willemsz van Coppenol: the Smaller Plate
title: Lieven Willemsz van Coppenol: the Smaller Plate
assistive_text: The image depicts two individuals captured from the waist up. The central figure is seated at a desk, turned slightly toward the viewer with papers in front of him, and he is using a quill in his right hand. This individual has a round face with a mustache and short, straight hair, and a small cap rests on his head. He wears a dark garment with a lighter inner shirt and prominent buttons. To his right stands a younger person with a curious expression, looking toward the seated figure. The child has longer hair and wears a dark top with a white collar. Surrounding the two figures is an interior setting featuring a window to the man's left, through which light filters, casting shadows. A candle and a drafting square are visible on the desk. On the wall behind them is artwork or religious imagery and architectural details, lending a sense of depth and ambiance to the space.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Self-Portrait (?) with Plumed Cap and Lowered Sabre
title: Self-Portrait (?) with Plumed Cap and Lowered Sabre
assistive_text: This image is a portrait of a person shown from the chest upwards. The individual faces forward with a direct gaze. They have distinct facial features with a mustache and beard. The person has long, curly hair that falls to their shoulders and wears a feathered hat. They are dressed in a dark garment with decorative elements. There is no visible jewelry. The background is plain and shaded, with circular lines suggesting an oval framing. The artist's signature and the date "1643" are inscribed on the right side of the image.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ before Pilate: Large Plate
title: Christ before Pilate: Large Plate
assistive_text: The image shows multiple individuals engaged in an interaction. At the center is a man with a crown on his head. Surrounding him are others dressed in elaborate robes and headdresses, some kneeling or gesturing. One individual is seated on a chair with an outstretched arm. Many wear period-specific hats and gesture toward various elements. The background includes architectural details like walls, arches, and a column with a statue.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Shepherd and His Family
title: The Shepherd and His Family
assistive_text: The image displays a pastoral scene depicting a shepherd with a broad hat, standing and leaning on a staff, alongside another individual who is seated. Nearby, a small flock of sheep is resting. In the background, the land rises into hills with a few visible buildings against the horizon. The sky is softly depicted with a few light clouds. The etching technique shows detailed textures in the foliage and clothing through delicate, fine lines. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily featuring dark brown, black, and pale tan tones.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Card Player
title: The Card Player
assistive_text: The image displays an etching of a person's upper body in a seated pose. The individual has a tired, lined face with closed eyes, a straight nose, and loose lips. They have long, unkempt hair under a hat, and wear a loose garment with flowing sleeves. The person holds a paper or document with both hands. The background consists of dense, hatched lines for contrast.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Three Oriental Figures (Jacob and Laban?)
title: Three Oriental Figures (Jacob and Laban?)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with figures and a dog. There are three figures in elaborate robes, one bending slightly towards another. The backdrop includes architectural elements like an archway and columns framing a doorway. A small dog is standing between the figures, and there is an ornate canopy with foliage in the background. The lines are finely drawn, capturing details of the clothing and architecture, typical of classic etching techniques.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Bust of an African Woman
title: Bust of an African Woman
assistive_text: The image displays a bust-length etching of a person in profile view. The individual is depicted seated, facing slightly right. The artwork details facial features like full lips, a prominent forehead, and eyes that are partially hidden. The person's hair is styled back with some falling behind, potentially secured with a braided or band-like accessory. They wear a garment with fabric folds and possible decorative elements at the neckline. The background is minimally detailed with shading or textural lines, emphasizing the subject.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ Returning from the Temple with His Parents
title: Christ Returning from the Temple with His Parents
assistive_text: The image features three figures standing in a landscape setting. On the left, a woman is slightly bending forward, holding the hand of a young boy in the center. She is wearing a headscarf and a long robe. The young boy looks towards the man on his other side. The man on the right is wearing a brimmed hat and a long coat, holding a walking stick. A small dog is at their feet. The background shows hills and rock formations.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ Seated Disputing with the Doctors
title: Christ Seated Disputing with the Doctors
assistive_text: The image shows a group of people gathered together in an enclosed space. The central figure is seated and looking towards a young child standing next to them. The individuals have various facial features, with some having beards and different head coverings. Their facial expressions indicate interaction, but specific details are unclear. They are dressed in loose, long-sleeved garments, with some wearing hats or wraps on their heads. The scene is depicted in a sketch-like style with detailed linework showing their clothing folds and positions. The background features textured walls, and there are no other distinct elements to identify the setting.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Star of the Kings: a Night Piece
title: The Star of the Kings: a Night Piece
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a candlelit scene in a dark interior with a prominent star. The image is composed of intricate line work and shading, depicting a group gathered closely around a table, illuminated by a single bright light source which appears to be a star or candle. The use of contrast between the dark background and the light foreground emphasizes the centered illumination. This is in the style of Rembrandt, characterized by the play of light and shadow and the texture achieved through etching techniques. The figure arrangements and their interplay with the light contribute to the mysterious and contemplative mood of the scene.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
medium: etching, with a few touches of drypoint
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Landscape with a Cow
title: Landscape with a Cow
assistive_text: The image shows a landscape with structures and natural surroundings. The horizon is in the center, with hills and fields in the distance. Below the horizon are outlines of more landscape details. The artwork uses fine etching lines for texture, emphasizing buildings and trees. The color palette is sepia and gray. Closest to us is a body of water reflecting surrounding textures, leading to buildings and trees on the left. The background fades into the distance with less detail.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Canal with a Large Boat and Bridge
title: Canal with a Large Boat and Bridge
assistive_text: The image depicts a wooden boat on the edge of a river or canal, pointing towards the water. Across the water, a landscape with trees, a tower, and an obelisk is visible under an overcast sky. The etching features fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth, typical of Rembrandt's style. The color scheme is monochromatic, with dark ink on light tan paper. Trees on the right frame the scene, enhancing the portrayal of nature.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jews in the Synagogue
title: Jews in the Synagogue
assistive_text: The image shows a group of people clustered together in an outdoor setting, depicted in a monochrome etching style. In the foreground, two men are engaged in a conversation. They are depicted from head to toe, with their bodies turned slightly towards each other. One man leans on a cane and has a long, pointed hat. They both wear long, flowing robes and large headgear made of fabric. Their facial features are detailed, showing bearded faces and expressive gestures, with one man holding his hand near his face. To the right, two more figures are standing, similarly robed and engaged in conversation, with one of them also wearing a tall, pointed hat. In the background, there are additional figures: one man is seated on a stone bench, also wearing robes and head wraps, and further back, more figures can be seen partially obscured by the darkness of the arch behind them. The background includes a large archway or doorway, creating a deep shadow that contrasts with the brighter foreground. The scene suggests a gathering or discussion taking place outside.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Three Heads of Women, One Lightly Etched
title: Three Heads of Women, One Lightly Etched
assistive_text: The image presents a detailed sketch featuring three bust portraits within a single frame. The uppermost portrait shows a person with their hand resting on their head in a contemplative pose. They have wavy hair falling around their face. Below and to the right, another person’s face is depicted in profile, with closed eyes and a gentle expression. The third portrait in the lower left is more lightly sketched. The background is a plain, textured surface.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Three Heads of Women, One Asleep
title: Three Heads of Women, One Asleep
assistive_text: The image is a sketch showing three individuals, each depicted from the shoulders up. The upper left figure is in a profile position, facing left, with a hand resting on their cheek, and wearing a textured hat. The upper right individual is shown from a slightly angled front view, wearing a loose cap with a textured rim, which partially covers their forehead. Their facial features are soft, with noticeable cheeks. The lower figure is positioned in three-quarter view, wearing a cap as well, with closed eyes and a relaxed expression. Their attire appears to have a frilled collar. The background is plain, displaying the texture of the paper, with the artist's signature and the year "1657" written at the top.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Young Man in a Velvet Cap (Petrus Sylvius?)

He has slightly parted lips and a contemplative expression, with defined facial features including a straight nose and sharp cheekbones. His hair appears to be medium length and wavy, peeking out from beneath a large, soft hat. The man is dressed in a voluminous coat and a decorative scarf drapes loosely around his neck. The background is plain with minimal detail, emphasizing the figure. To the left, there is an indistinct outline. The top left corner bears the signature "Rembrandt" followed by the date "1637."

name: Abraham Casting Out Hagar and Ishmael

In the foreground, a child in a patterned dress and cap walks towards the man, holding what appears to be a bow. A small dog is at the left, near steps leading to an entrance framed by an archway with climbing plants. The background features a stone courtyard with trees, sculptures, balustrades, and a partially visible building.

One holds a swaddled baby, while the other wears a hat with fur-like details. The background resembles a rustic room with textured walls and wooden beams.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Bald Old Man with a Short Beard in Profile

His hair is depicted as slightly unruly and balding, with a distinct fringe. He is wearing a robe or garment with a textured collar. The drawing style includes fine lines and textured, cross-hatched areas for shadow and depth. The background is plain and minimalist, emphasizing the focus on the character.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Tribute Money
title: The Tribute Money

One central figure is slightly raised above the others and seems to be the focus of attention. The other figures appear engaged, with postures that indicate listening or conversing. The artwork uses strong contrasts of light and dark through crosshatching techniques to add depth and focus.

name: Christ at Emmaus: the Smaller Plate
title: Christ at Emmaus: the Smaller Plate

He faces the man in the middle, who is bald with a long beard and is leaning forward with his chin resting on his hand. The man on the left has a beard and a tall hat, looking towards the central figure. They wear robes with flowing designs. A draped curtain serves as a backdrop, and a dog stands near the table at the bottom right. Fine lines detail the scene, with the signature "Rembrandt f. 1654" visible at the bottom.

name: Self-Portrait with Raised Sabre

name: Corfe Castle: Effect of Sunshine after Rain

name: Retreat at Waterloo
title: Retreat at Waterloo
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a battlefield scene during the Battle of Waterloo. The image depicts a densely populated landscape filled with lines of soldiers, artillery pieces, and horses amidst the chaos of battle. The composition presents a bustling scene of military activity with heavy smoke and gunfire in the background. The drawing is highly detailed, capturing the tumultuous atmosphere of the battlefield, with scattered debris and fallen figures accentuating the aftermath of conflict. The use of monochrome tones adds a somber and historical quality to the depiction.
creator: Auguste Raffet
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Nocturnal Review
title: Nocturnal Review

The composition depicts the soldiers charging forward with determined movement. The setting includes a large sun in the background, casting a revealing glow over the scene. The detailed etching technique captures the intensity of the battlefield.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

title: Et il avait dans sa main droit sept etoiles, et de sa bouch sortait une epee aigue a deux tranchants (And he had in his right hand seven stars; and out of his mouth went a sharp two-edged sword)
