La Chimere: Moi,Je suis legere et joyeuse (The Sphinx: "My gaze, which nothing can deflect, passes through the things and remains fixed on an inaccessible horizon." The Chimera: "I am weightless and joyful")
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a sphinx and a chimera. The drawing depicts two mythical creatures against a textured background. On the left side, the sphinx is presented in a traditional manner, with a human face and shoulders adorned with a headdress, connecting to the body of a lion. On the right, the chimera is depicted as a dark figure with a lion's head, a goat's head emerging from its back, and a serpent's tail. The detailed rendering of the creatures contrasts with the artist's more abstract background, which is filled with lines and shading. The overall composition conveys an encounter between the ancient mythological beings.
creator: Odilon Redon
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Ronde
title: La Ronde
assistive_text: The image displays swirling lines and softly etched shapes that form an abstract depiction. The scene features human-like figures that appear to be interacting or dancing. In the background, lines converge to create abstracted hills or mountains with a suggestion of a structural form resembling a sail or tower.
creator: Auguste Rodin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Antonin Proust
title: Antonin Proust
assistive_text: The sketch shows a profile view of a man's head and neck. His head is turned to the right with his gaze forward. Features include a prominent nose, well-defined forehead, deep-set eyes, full beard, and long, neatly styled hair slicked back. The drawing does not include any clothing or surrounding objects, only focusing on his facial features and hair. The background is a simple light-colored surface.
creator: Auguste Rodin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Henri Becque
title: Henri Becque
assistive_text: The image is an etching that features three overlapping views of a man's head and shoulders. The man has strong facial features including pronounced cheekbones, a straight nose, and a prominent jawline. His hair is styled in a classic, swept-back manner. The etching shows the man with an intense gaze, and the play of shadow and light over his face is detailed with intricate linear work. He is wearing a high-collared garment. The background features swirling lines. The bottom right corner of the image features a dedication or signature: "à Monsieur Cardon amitié Rodin."
creator: Auguste Rodin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ornament Panel: Mars, God of Battles
title: Ornament Panel: Mars, God of Battles
assistive_text: This print shows an intricate symmetrical design featuring mythological figures, animals, and ornamental motifs. There is a central vertical axis around which various elements and figures are symmetrically arranged, and the page is entirely filled with designs. At the top, there is a seated figure holding two standards on either side of a Latin inscription, flanked by people with wings and others standing next to rearing horses. The middle section continues with similarly detailed adornments including classical motifs like vases, garlands, animal heads, and small cherubic figures. The lower section features what looks like a large fountain with three faces at the center, all arranged together. On either side of these faces, two people appear to be tied up. Above the faces are the letters N and R. In the bottom right and left corners, people with horns appear to ride strange dragon-like creatures with human faces.
creator: Nicoletto da Modena
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Roman Warrior
title: Roman Warrior
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a warrior on horseback in an architectural setting. The scene features a heavily armored warrior, adorned with a detailed helmet, riding a rearing horse. Behind the warrior is an elaborate background with architectural columns and gothic arches, along with a tree with gnarled branches. The horse is depicted in a dynamic posture, raising its legs. Various pieces of armor and ornamental details, such as shields and armor, are scattered on the ground. To the right, there is a niche with a classical statue. The drawing includes fine lines and hatching, contributing to the depth and texture of the scene.
creator: Nicoletto da Modena
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Portrait of Dr. Bilderbeck Gomess
title: Portrait of Dr. Bilderbeck Gomess
assistive_text: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a person's body in profile view, facing the left side. The person is seated and appears to be sitting upright. The facial features are delicately sketched with a soft, contemplative expression. The hair is dark and wavy, parted at the side, and styled neatly. The person is wearing a high-collared garment, possibly a coat or cape, without any visible buttons or embellishments. There are no visible items of jewelry or objects being held by the person. The background is plain with subtle textures.
creator: Théodore Roussel
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Une Apache
title: Une Apache
assistive_text: The image shows a close-up portrait of a seated individual from the chest upwards. The person is slightly turned to the left, with their head angled downwards, casting a shadow across their face. Their features include dark, expressive eyes and a closed-lipped expression. The shoulder-length, wavy hair is dark and merges with the background. The person wears a light-colored garment and is set against a dark, textured background. The style appears to be an etching or print, with shading and lines adding depth to the portrait.
creator: Théodore Roussel
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Baby
title: A Baby
assistive_text: The image is a sketch of a child's face. The upper body is suggested by faint clothing lines. The child is facing slightly left with a gentle expression. The child is wearing a bonnet or head covering. The clothing appears warm with suggested collar lines. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain.
creator: Théodore Roussel
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Parson's Green, Afternoon, End of Winter, The Duke's Head
title: Parson's Green, Afternoon, End of Winter, The Duke's Head
assistive_text: The image depicts a street scene with a central building, benches, a fence, and trees. The central building appears to have intricate architectural details. The scene includes people, horse-drawn carriages, and clouds in the sky. The artwork is created using detailed etching techniques with fine lines, providing texture. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of sepia or light brown, giving an aged look.
creator: Théodore Roussel
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Head of Girl Leaning on Her Hand
title: Head of Girl Leaning on Her Hand
assistive_text: The image shows a sketch of a woman's head and partial upper body. The woman has her head slightly tilted downward and turned to the side. Her face is softly drawn with closed eyes, a small nose, and a subtle smile. She has dark, wavy hair falling around her face and shoulders. The woman appears to be wearing a simple garment. The background is textured with marks and details, and there are inscriptions on the drawing, including the artist's signature at the bottom.
creator: Théodore Roussel
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Bank Holiday, Corner of Beaufort Street, Chelsea
title: Bank Holiday, Corner of Beaufort Street, Chelsea
assistive_text: The image displays a street scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The artwork depicts a sidewalk with various figures walking. The horizon is not visible, focusing on the bustling scene. The painting features fine and linear brushstrokes giving it a sketch-like appearance. The simple color palette consists of cool blue tones against a light background, creating a light atmosphere. People are walking on the sidewalk, while others are further away, some in conversation. Leafy trees and buildings are depicted on both sides with light and airy strokes, adding an impressionistic quality to the scene.
creator: Théodore Roussel
medium: etching in green on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Street, Chelsea Embankment
title: The Street, Chelsea Embankment
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a street scene with storefronts and a horse-drawn cart. The image features a lively street corner with buildings adorned with signs. One sign reads “NEWS of the WORLD.” The architecture includes windows and awnings over the sidewalk. In front of the buildings, a horse is harnessed to a cart on the bustling street. Abstract, sketch-like human figures suggest movement and interaction. The upper portion of the drawing includes outlines of leaves and branches, contrasting the urban setting. The art's free-flowing lines and lack of rigid structure create a spontaneous and energetic quality.
creator: Théodore Roussel
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ Healing the Lame [verso]
title: Christ Healing the Lame [verso]
assistive_text: This is a drawing featuring a congregation gathered around a lectern in an architectural setting. The drawing depicts a central figure standing at a lectern, apparently addressing an assembly. The figure is barefoot and has a halo iconograph. The scene is set within an architectural environment with arches and columns. The figures display varied poses and gestures, suggesting engrossed attention or lively discourse. The use of shading and intricate lines adds texture and detail to the garments and faces of the figures, enhancing the dramatic atmosphere of the scene.
creator: German 16th Century
medium: pen and black ink with brush and gray ink and  gray wash heightened with white on gray prepared paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Three Oaks
title: The Three Oaks
assistive_text: The image is an etching of a natural landscape scene. The viewpoint provides an even perspective across the scene, displaying various details. The image shows a dense canopy tree in the center surrounded by smaller trees and shrubs. Fine lines illustrate the texture of bark, leaves, and grass. A fallen branch or log lies on the ground among long grass. In the background, a body of water reflects the surrounding flora. The sky has horizontal lines and wispy clouds, with a small bird in flight. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white for contrast and depth.
creator: Jacob van Ruisdael
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Woodland Scene with a Waterfall
title: Woodland Scene with a Waterfall
assistive_text: The image shows a landscape with a descending path on the left where two figures walk with a dog. Rocky terrain and trees frame the scene, leading towards a distant town on the horizon with a bridge, buildings, and ships at a port. The cityscape is set against the skyline, with fine lines and meticulous etching capturing natural and architectural details. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of grey and black defining form and texture. The sky has dynamic cloud formations.
creator: Aegidius Sadeler II after Roelandt Savery
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Woodland Scene with Two Hunters and a Dog to the Left
title: Woodland Scene with Two Hunters and a Dog to the Left
assistive_text: The image depicts a woodland scene with a slightly elevated vantage point. In the distance, there is a structure nestled among trees. The horizon is low and obscured by foliage and a slope. The artwork shows detailed, fine lines of trees, grass, and structures, resembling engravings. The color palette is monochromatic, using various shades of brown and gray. Two figures and a dog are in the left foreground, with trees framing the scene. In the background, birds are flying in the sky.
creator: Aegidius Sadeler II after Roelandt Savery
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ Taken Prisoner
title: Christ Taken Prisoner
assistive_text: This is a drawing of armed figures in intense interaction within a detailed natural and architectural backdrop. The figures are muscular and wield weapons such as swords and spears, conveying movement and tension. They have expressive faces and dynamic poses. In the background, there are rolling hills and a building atop a hill. The artwork showcases strong contrasts and bold lines, typical of Renaissance woodcut prints, emphasizing detail and expression. The use of light and shadow enhances the drama of the scene.
creator: Hans Leonard Schäufelein
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Kingston Bank, No.2
title: Kingston Bank, No.2
assistive_text: The image shows a riverside scene with people on the river bank and a sailboat on the water. The horizon, marked by trees and a small settlement, is positioned in the upper third of the image. Figures on the left are engaged in various activities, including gathering water. On the right, a sailboat with figures on board floats on the water. The brushstrokes are smooth, creating a realistic texture. The sepia-toned palette adds a warm atmosphere. Light and shadow are used to create depth and highlight the human activities and serene setting.
creator: Frank Short, after Joseph Mallord William Turner
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Timber Raft on the Rhine
title: The Timber Raft on the Rhine
assistive_text: The image shows a calm body of water with a faint silhouette of land on the horizon. There is a dark form resembling a structure or rock formation near the viewer, with some shadowy figures nearby. The sky has dramatic swirling clouds, creating a moody atmosphere. The brushstrokes are soft, blending the elements in the sky and water. A subtle reflection is visible on the water's surface. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of gray.
creator: Frank Short, after Joseph Mallord William Turner
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Moonlight on a River
title: Moonlight on a River
assistive_text: The image shows a view of a body of water with a low horizon in the center. A tall silhouette, possibly a water tower or chimney, is prominent on the horizon. There are indistinct architectural forms to the right, potentially part of a bridge. The style features loose brushstrokes blending the scene elements, creating an ethereal quality. The color palette is limited to sepia tones. On the left, there are shadowy figures near a boat on the water. The cloudy sky fills the top, with a luminous full moon partly obscured by clouds, reflecting in the water and contributing to the somber mood.
creator: Frank Short, after Joseph Mallord William Turner
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Court Rules
title: The Court Rules
assistive_text: The image shows a half-body portrait of a person seated at a table. The individual faces slightly to the side, with a focused expression. They have short, wavy hair and wear formal attire with a bow tie. The person holds a pair of glasses in one hand resting on an open book on the table. The background is plain with a shadow cast behind the person.
creator: Dwight Case Sturges
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Violinist
title: The Violinist
assistive_text: The image shows a person in a three-quarter view, from the upper torso up, with a portion of their left leg visible. The person is seated and slightly turned towards the left while facing the camera directly, as they appear to be holding a violin in their left hand and a bow in their right hand. The person's facial features are detailed, with a slightly furrowed brow, prominent cheekbones, and a focused expression. Their hair is dark, combed back, and has a slightly wavy texture. The person is wearing a dark jacket over a white shirt with a bow tie. In the background, there is a music stand with a sheet of music on it, and there are lines indicating panels or walls.
creator: Dwight Case Sturges
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mother
title: Mother
assistive_text: The image shows an elderly woman seated at a table, with her head slightly bowed and gazing at an open book in one hand while holding eyeglasses in the other. She has gray hair styled in a bun and wears round spectacles, with a lined face and a neutral expression. She is dressed in a dark dress with a high collar and a brooch at the neckline. Behind her, there is a wooden chair and a framed circular portrait of George Washington on the wall. The background features a sketched floral pattern.
creator: Dwight Case Sturges
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sophia Western, Fieldings Tom Jones
title: Sophia Western, Fieldings Tom Jones
assistive_text: The image depicts a woman shown from the waist up. She is positioned leaning slightly forward with her arms resting on a surface, and her hands are gently clasped together. The woman has a delicate facial expression, with soft features and slightly arched eyebrows, and her lips form a subtle smile. Her hair is styled in loose curls, and she is wearing a wide-brimmed hat adorned with a ribbon that frames her face. Her attire consists of a dress with a fitted bodice, decorated with ruffles around the neckline, and a scarf draped around her shoulders. She is wearing earrings. The background is dark, which highlights her illuminated figure.
creator: John Raphael Smith after John Hoppner
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: In the Rain: Mother and Children (Sous la pluie: La mere et les enfants)
title: In the Rain: Mother and Children (Sous la pluie: La mere et les enfants)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of figures walking against the wind. The image depicts three figures on the left struggling to move forward as they battle against a strong wind. The figures appear determined and resilient, their clothes and hair flowing backward. The background shows a simple, abstract landscape of swirling lines. This minimalistic style focuses on the movement and struggle against the elements.
creator: Théophile Alexandre Steinlen
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Waiting (En attendant)
title: Waiting (En attendant)
assistive_text: Several people are depicted from the waist up, gathered around a large pot. A woman is pouring soup from a ladle into a bowl held by a young girl in front of her. The woman has her hair tied up and wears a cap or headscarf and a dress with a prominent collar. The young girl is in profile, holding a bowl with both hands, with dark hair falling to her shoulders. Beside her, a small boy looks up towards the pot, wearing a cap and a dark coat. An elderly man with a bald head and bushy beard stands to the left, holding a dish close to his chest and looking towards the woman serving the soup. The background is crowded with other individuals, outlined in monochrome, creating a somber and communal atmosphere. An inscription, "en attendant!", is in the upper left corner, and the artist's signature, “Steinlen,” is visible in the bottom right corner.
creator: Théophile Alexandre Steinlen
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Soldiers on Leave - Night Scene (Permissionnaires - Effet de Nuit)
title: Soldiers on Leave - Night Scene (Permissionnaires - Effet de Nuit)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of several figures gathered together in conversation. The drawing shows a group of individuals dressed in heavy coats and carrying backpacks. They are standing closely together, possibly engaged in discussion. In the background, shadowy figures and buildings are visible. On the left side, there are several smaller sketches of faces. The use of cross-hatching and strong contour lines give the work a dynamic appearance. This drawing is in the style of Théophile Steinlen.
creator: Théophile Alexandre Steinlen
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Misery and Splendor (Misere et splendeur)
title: Misery and Splendor (Misere et splendeur)
assistive_text: The image shows a group of figures gathered on a terrace or similar elevated platform. In the background, there is a grand building with windows and ornate details, suggesting a cityscape beyond. The artwork uses a charcoal or pencil technique to create a textured and softly rendered image in varying shades of black, grey, and cream. The color palette is monochromatic, giving the image a vintage appearance.
creator: Théophile Alexandre Steinlen
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Thunder Storm (Temps d'orage)
title: Thunder Storm (Temps d'orage)
assistive_text: The image shows a landscape with a low, ground-level perspective, leading the viewer's gaze across an open plain towards the horizon. The horizon is positioned lower in the image, with trees and a structure nearby. The painting features dynamic brushstrokes creating movement in the sky, with cross-hatching and line work. Dramatic clouds fill the sky, with beams of light breaking through. A solitary figure walks along a path, adding a sense of movement. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black, white, and gray creating a somber atmosphere.
creator: Théophile Alexandre Steinlen
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: From the Sixth Floor
title: From the Sixth Floor
assistive_text: The image depicts an elevated urban street scene at night. The buildings and trees can be seen in the distance under a dark sky. The brushstrokes are soft and blurred, creating a nocturnal atmosphere. The color palette is dark with occasional warm accents. A figure in blue clothing is leaning out next to a railing where a cat sits. Pedestrians and a horse-drawn carriage are visible on the dimly lit streets below.
creator: Théophile Alexandre Steinlen
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: To the Village
title: To the Village
assistive_text: The image shows a man standing with one leg slightly bent against a surface. He has a beard and mustache, and his head is slightly tilted to the right with his eyes looking forward. The man is wearing a suit, including a light-colored jacket, dark trousers, and a light shirt with a cravat. He is also wearing a tall top hat and a cummerbund around his waist. A dog is sitting beside him with its ears perked. In the background, there is a street scene depicted in black and white, showing a pathway lined with trees and buildings, with silhouetted figures in the distance.
creator: Théophile Alexandre Steinlen
medium: collage of pen and black ink, graphite and blue and red crayon on two overlapped sheets of paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Rafle
title: La Rafle
assistive_text: This is an illustration of a group scene with various figures lined up near a small building or vehicle. The composition includes people dressed in period clothing standing in line. One person in a black and red uniform stands aside with a neutral expression. The style hints at a historical setting, with clean lines and soft colors showing everyday life. The background shows urban architecture and additional figures in a queue, suggesting a busy environment typical of a past era.
creator: Théophile Alexandre Steinlen
medium: brush and black ink and colored crayon
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Andreas Rivetus
title: Andreas Rivetus
assistive_text: The image is a three-quarters view of a man's upper body in an oval frame. The man is facing slightly to his left but gazes directly at the viewer. He has a prominent nose, full lips, and a well-defined chin with a closely trimmed goatee. His eyebrows are arched and his expression is serious. His hair is curly and reaches just above his ears, and he wears a dark skullcap on his head. The man is dressed in traditional attire with a dark robe featuring an ornate button panel and wide, white collar. There are no visible objects or jewelry. The background of the oval frame contains text in Latin. Around the oval, there is a heavy border with decorative text. Below the image, there is additional neatly inscribed text. The overall aesthetic suggests a formal, historical portrait engraving.
creator: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Dubordieu
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: David Nuyts
title: David Nuyts
assistive_text: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man, depicting him from the chest upwards. He is positioned facing slightly towards the right with his gaze directed towards the viewer. The man has notable facial features with a long, narrow face, an aquiline nose, and a neatly styled mustache and short goatee. His hair is closely cropped around his head and is graying. He is wearing a large, elaborate ruff collar and a dark, buttoned garment with a subtle vertical pattern on the chest. The background consists of a solid dark texture, typical of engraved portraits. The engraving also includes decorative script and text below the portrait.
creator: Jonas Suyderhoff
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Theodorus Wikenburg
title: Theodorus Wikenburg
assistive_text: This print shows the upper half of a man's body, seated in a three-quarter position with his chest turned to the left and his face looking towards us with a neutral expression. He has pale skin, high cheekbones, short hair, and a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. The man is dressed in a dark robe with a high white collar and buttons, and he is wearing a small cap on his head. His right hand is resting on his chest in the folds of his garment. The background is plain and gray, and the man casts a shadow on the left. Below the portrait, there is a decorative band with an inscription.
creator: Jonas Suyderhoff after Frans Hals
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Franciscus Plante
title: Franciscus Plante
assistive_text: The image shows a man in a seated or slightly turned position, facing forward. The man has a mustache and a small goatee, with wavy, shoulder-length hair parted in the middle. He wears a dark coat with a wide, white collar featuring a detailed lace pattern and a large button under the collar. The man's facial expression is calm, and his gaze is directed towards the viewer. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain and textured, with an elaborate inscription at the bottom containing a series of text lines in a decorative script. The text includes the name "Franciscus Plante" prominently displayed, along with additional information in smaller text.
creator: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Dircksz Santvoort
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Frederick Spanheim
title: Frederick Spanheim

He is wearing a dark robe with a wide white collar tied with a ribbon at the neck, and a draped mantle over his shoulders. The background has a textured pattern and there is Latin text above and below the portrait.
creator: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Dubordieu
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Julius Beyma
title: Julius Beyma

He has a long, sharply trimmed beard and mustache, with deep-set eyes and a serious expression. He wears a dark, round hat, a large, elaborately folded ruff around his neck, a dark jacket with a fur collar, and a garment buttoned up the front. There are no visible jewelry. The background has a crosshatched pattern within a decorated oval frame with text.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Eleazer Swalmius
title: Eleazer Swalmius
assistive_text: The image shows an older man seated with a three-quarter view of his body visible. He is sitting with one arm resting on a chair arm and the other hand placed on his chest. The man's face features a full beard and mustache, and he has closely cropped hair with visible thinning on top. His expression is calm, and he is gazing directly at the viewer. The man is wearing a fur-lined garment, likely a coat, which drapes around him. The background is plain with linear shading, and a small part of a wall or a frame is visible, suggesting an indoor setting. There is script positioned at the bottom of the image.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Emperor Ferdinand III
title: Emperor Ferdinand III
assistive_text: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the chest up, positioned directly facing the viewer. He has a composed expression, with finely detailed facial features including a prominent mustache and small goatee. His hair is medium-length, dark, and wavy, framing his face and extending slightly past his ears. He is wearing an ornate garment adorned with intricate patterns and a large, elaborately designed lace collar. The surroundings of the portrait are richly decorated with symbolic and intricate imagery, including ornate patterns, grapevines, and cherubic figures at the bottom. Birds are depicted in the upper corners. The background is a tapestry of fine detail that frames and emphasizes the central figure, creating an impression of opulence and regality.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hendrick de Keyser
title: Hendrick de Keyser

The man has a serious expression with prominent facial features, curly hair, a full beard, and a mustache. He is dressed in period clothing, and the frame is intricately decorated. Text inscriptions surround the frame and are below the portrait, likely providing information about the subject.
creator: Jonas Suyderhoff after Thomas de Keyser
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Adriaen Heereboord
title: Adriaen Heereboord

He has a broad forehead, arched eyebrows, a prominent nose, a small moustache, dark curly hair that falls to about ear length, and is wearing a dark coat buttoned up the front with a large white collar. The man is surrounded by an ornate oval frame with text along its inner edge, and the background has a textured pattern with no distinct objects or scenery. There are inscriptions and text beneath the oval in a classical font.
creator: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Dubordieu
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Flight with Joseph in the Foreground
title: The Flight with Joseph in the Foreground
assistive_text: The image depicts a scene with figures and a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated position. The horizon is low, intersecting with a distant ridge and a town or village in the background. The etching style features fine lines and intricate detailing in clothing, trees, and animals. The color palette is black and white, enhancing the depth and texture of the scene. Sheep are being herded on a path, followed by figures on donkeys, possibly a family. Trees frame the scene on the right.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Angelica and Medoro
title: Angelica and Medoro

One figure appears to be reclining while the other leans over. The artist has employed a monochromatic palette, with variations in line weight and shading providing depth to the characters. Details such as clothing folds and the expression of the figures are marked with finesse. The position of the figures suggests a narrative interaction, with one seemingly supporting or aiding the other. The background is sketched with minimalistic lines.

medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black  chalk on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Pembury Mill, Kent
title: Pembury Mill, Kent
assistive_text: The image shows a mill with a waterwheel as the focal point. The scene includes walls, trees, a waterwheel with lush foliage, and birds perched on a birdhouse. The illustration has intricate details showcasing wood textures, leaves, and birds. The color palette features sepia tones. In the background, a man works inside the mill, and another man tends to a horse-drawn cart. A dog is also present in the scene.

credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Dunstanborough Castle
title: Dunstanborough Castle
assistive_text: This drawing is black and white, with a yellowed tinted hue. The horizon takes up about half of the drawing with a single color with slightly shaded streaks mixed in towards the top. Closer to us, there is a lagoon of water, broken by ripples and harsher waves. Protruding, jagged rocks slope upwards on the beachside. Following the path of the rocks in the bottom right corner, a protruding line of barrier rocks progresses into the distance. This points to a loosely defined house in the middle left of the painting, slightly covered by a rolling hill and some tall bushes. On the bold ridge of rocks, nine sheep graze and congregate, with two shapes that could be more sheep or rocks. Beyond, a large castle fades in the distance, looming over the house and ridge of rocks. The castle rests on a rolling hill with a dozen sheep sparsely populating the hill. The castle appears broken down with deteriorating walls, sharp ledges, and cracks flowing down the wall. Within the small, broken walls, there is a tower, made of a similar substance to the castle. A flag flies on top of the tower while overlooking a ledge on the left side of the painting. On the right side of the painting, the castle walls trail off towards the other side of the rocky coast.
creator: Joseph Mallord William Turner and Charles Turner
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Morpeth
title: Morpeth
assistive_text: The image shows a street scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint. A castle-like structure is visible in the distance near the top of the image, with rolling hills and trees further away. The painting features detailed architecture and textures, typical of 19th-century urban landscapes. The color scheme is mainly sepia. In the foreground, there is a stone path lined with buildings and people going about their daily activities. One woman is leading a horse, while others are engaged in various tasks. A person is working on scaffolding attached to a building. Further back, individuals are gathered around a stall, showing the liveliness of the town.

name: Windmill and Lock

The scene is captured from a slightly elevated point of view within an engraving format.

name: Water Mill

In the foreground, a couple is seated on the ground, embraced, with a dog lying nearby. name: Peasant Couple in a Doorway

She wears a white headscarf covering her hair and is dressed in a simple dress with long sleeves. On the left and partially behind her is a man who is mostly in shadow. He has high cheekbones and deep-set eyes and is also smiling. He is wearing a dark coat and a wide-brimmed hat that sits at an angle on his head. He reaches one hand around the woman, placing it near her breast, and she has one hand on his wrist. The area behind the two people is black, but on the right leafy vines crawl down the side of the archway, and a lattice-like window is partially visible.

medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper

name: Two Peasant Women Conversing on a Village Street

Both women have their heads covered with scarves, and their facial features are drawn with detailed lines, suggesting age with noticeable wrinkles. Their hair is not visible due to the head coverings. They are dressed in long coats and skirts, typical of an older, traditional style of clothing. There seem to be no visible jewelry items on either woman, and each holds a shawl or cloak wrapped around themselves. The setting is an outdoor street scene with trees and buildings as a backdrop. There are additional figures in the background, contributing to the rustic and communal feel of the scene. The area looks cobblestoned and quaint with a rural ambiance.

medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

One individual appears to be actively involved with the animal, while others stand by. The background reveals a thatched roof building with visible wooden beams and windows, and a large tree arching overhead. The drawing captures a moment of everyday rural activity with intricate line work and shading.

medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper

name: Man Paying the Landlady at an Inn

The walls are adorned with shelves holding items such as pottery and utensils. In the foreground, two figures are engaged in an interaction near the entrance, while a group of four can be seen in the background around a table. The lines and textures capture the details of the room's architecture and furnishings, reflecting a scene from everyday life in an earlier time period.

medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper

name: Robert Burns

Opposite them, a group in 17th-century colonial clothing suggests a discussion between the two parties. In the background are colonial-style houses, tall trees, and ships anchored by the shoreline. name: Ernest Renan
title: Ernest Renan
assistive_text: The image depicts a drawing of a man seated from about the waist up. He is slightly turned towards the viewer with a serious expression. The man has distinctive facial features, long, untidy hair, and is dressed in a dark suit and collared shirt. The setting around him shows a shelf with books and papers, as well as a detailed clock. The background consists of various linear patterns and textures, implying a cluttered study or office space.
creator: Anders Zorn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Waltz
title: The Waltz
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a dance scene. The image shows intricate line work and cross-hatching to depict a social gathering, capturing movement on a dance floor. Two figures in mid-dance are at the center, with dynamic lines suggesting motion and grace. The background is crowded with other figures, all blending into each other in a swirl of movement and fabric, creating a bustling atmosphere. Lines of varying density create contrast, depicting light and shadow for depth and form.
creator: Anders Zorn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ceres Changing Ascalaphus into a Bird of Evil Omen
title: Ceres Changing Ascalaphus into a Bird of Evil Omen
assistive_text: This is an image of mythological figures interacting with a fantastical bird-like creature. A humanoid figure in a flowing robe and headdress reaches towards a large bird with pronounced wings and a fierce expression. The bird sits atop a cloud-like formation, while another figure, nestled among similar cloud patterns, observes. The scene is filled with details in the drapery, feathers, and ornate background elements.
creator: Paolo Farinati
medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white on blue laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: God Enthroned Surrounded by Saints
title: God Enthroned Surrounded by Saints
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a celestial scene with figures in the clouds. The image portrays a grand assembly of figures gathered among voluminous clouds in a vast, ethereal sky. At the center, a prominent figure is seated on a cloud, surrounded by a divine or majestic aura. The surrounding figures appear to be in positions of gestural communication, some holding musical instruments or offering gestures of praise or worship. The overall composition is dynamic, with swirling clouds and figures arranged in a circular motion, creating a sense of movement and harmony. The use of sepia tones adds an antiquated, serene quality to the piece.
creator: Giovanni Battista Trotti
medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash  over black chalk (graphite?) on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Coronation of the Emperor
title: Coronation of the Emperor
assistive_text: The image shows multiple figures participating in a ceremonial event. Most figures are standing in a crowded scene. A central figure is kneeling in front of another individual, who seems to be presenting or anointing them with a crown. The ceremonial event is under a canopy held by attendants. The figures are dressed in historical attire, with detailed garments and cloaks. Many have beards and curly hair, common for the period style depicted. Some wear caps or headwear denoting status. Other figures are present around the central scene, extending to a larger gathering in the background, suggesting a town square setting. Buildings with balconies filled with onlookers and a clock tower contribute to the historical ambiance. The illustration uses ink to showcase intricate details of the people and architecture.
creator: after Maarten de Vos
medium: pen and brown ink over graphite and touches of black crayon on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Last Judgment
title: The Last Judgment
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a celestial gathering with figures in a heavenly setting. The scene depicts an assembly with numerous figures. Some figures are kneeling or gesturing upwards. The upper part of the composition shows seated figures that appear to be observing. The drawing is detailed with flowing robes and dynamic postures, conveying movement and mysticism. The use of light and shade is achieved through delicate line work and subtle washes.
creator: Giovanni Battista della Rovere
medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Meeting of San Carlo Borromeo and San Filippo Neri
title: The Meeting of San Carlo Borromeo and San Filippo Neri
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a gathering of figures. The artwork shows a group of figures positioned in a scene that could be seen as a discussion or meeting. The figures are wearing long robes, some holding staffs topped with small crosses. Architectural elements such as grand buildings with columns and decorative facades are present. The landscape in the background features rolling hills. The drawing uses brown ink washes and linework to create depth and shadow and is signed by the artist in the corner.
creator: Italian 17th Century
medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Two Nudes
title: Two Nudes
assistive_text: The image depicts a study of two male figures showing their back and waist up, focusing on the muscular anatomy. Both figures have broad shoulders and defined muscular backs, with detailed attention given to the curvature and tension of the muscles. They are in seated positions, slightly turned to the side. The drawing does not show their heads in full detail, but some facial features such as the outline of the jaw and part of the ear can be seen. The hair is suggested by flowing lines. The sketch is rendered in a reddish-brown medium on a textured, light background, possibly paper. The background is plain, and there are visible stains and marks on the paper.
creator: Italian 17th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Birth Scene
title: Birth Scene
assistive_text: The drawing depicts a group of figures gathered around a scene. The image shows a tent with an interior scene where a reclining figure is attended to by others. Outside the tent, various figures in flowing robes stand in groups, with some gesturing or holding objects. There is a sense of movement and interaction among the figures, suggesting a narrative or event unfolding. The drawing utilizes a combination of linework and shading to convey depth and emotion, evoking a composition reminiscent of Renaissance or Baroque styles.
creator: Giulio Benso
medium: brush and brown and blue ink with black chalk, heightened with white opaque watercolor, on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Joseph and His Brother in Egypt [verso]
title: Joseph and His Brother in Egypt [verso]
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a historical scene with architectural elements and figures engaged in dynamic interaction. The composition features numerous figures gathered around a central figure wearing a crown. The figures are depicted in various poses that imply movement and interaction, with some appearing in gestures of supplication, conversation, or presentation. The background includes architectural elements such as arches, pillars, and buildings. The use of delicate ink and wash emphasizes the details in the faces and garments of the figures.
creator: Italian 17th Century
medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over red chalk on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hans Sebald Beham
title: Hans Sebald Beham
assistive_text: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a man, primarily focusing on his head and shoulders. The man is depicted in a frontal position with his head turned slightly to one side. He has a full, curly beard and mustache, with hair that appears thick and curly, spreading out from under a soft, rounded hat with fabric folds. His facial features include a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a wise expression. He is wearing a garment with a broad, dark collar that suggests a cloak or robe. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held by the man. The background of the image is plain and unadorned, with some text below the portrait that reads "HANS SEBALD BOEHM" followed by "Beham."
creator: Alfred von Franck
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Forsmarck
title: Forsmarck
assistive_text: The image is a detailed line drawing of a pastoral scene with a wide perspective. The scene includes a house, trees, figures in period clothing, a dog, a horse-drawn carriage, grazing animals, and people engaged in various activities. The drawing is done in delicate, fine line work on off-white paper, creating a monochrome effect that emphasizes form and detail. The composition also includes trees and distant architecture, enhancing the pastoral tranquility of the scene.
creator: Elias Martin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Endpaper with Animals
title: Endpaper with Animals
assistive_text: This is a drawing of various animals arranged in a grid. The artwork features twenty-four unique animals, each sitting within their own rectangular section outlined in white against a muted purple background. Each animal is drawn with a bold style, almost like a woodcut, giving them a quaint and stylized appearance. The animals include lions, elephants, camels, and other creatures, each depicted with minimal details and a focus on simpler forms. The overall layout suggests a catalog or educational chart displaying different animal species. Each section contains the animal along with some simple natural elements like flora or a landscape. The line work and stylistic choices evoke a sense of vintage or folk art aesthetics. At the bottom of the image, the words "MAISCH © NURNBERG" are inscribed.
creator: Johann Maisch
medium: woodcut in silver on lavender paper [restrike]
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Endpaper with Birds
title: Endpaper with Birds
assistive_text: This is a drawing of various birds. The drawing features numerous bird silhouettes in a single shade of light green against a tan-colored background. The birds are shown in various poses, including flying, perched, or standing. The border of the drawing is outlined by a thin line enclosing the bird motifs. The paper shows signs of age with visible creases and tears at the edges. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of traditional and folk art, focusing on pattern and form.
creator: German 18th Century
medium: woodcut; brocade endpaper in gold on pale rose prepared paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Endpaper with Four Circus (?) Scenes
title: Endpaper with Four Circus (?) Scenes
assistive_text: This is a painting of a series of engraved narrative scenes. The artwork comprises four separate scenes, each intricately detailed and depicted in gold against a deep blue background. The upper left scene shows a group of figures in a hierarchical arrangement. The upper right scene presents figures gathered around a table engaged in conversation. The lower left scene features a group with one person pointing. The lower right panel shows figures congregated around a structure. The piece suggests themes of social interaction and storytelling and is in the style of traditional Renaissance narrative art.
creator: German 18th Century
medium: woodcut in gold metallic ink on hand-washed blue paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Endpaper with Scenes of the Trades
title: Endpaper with Scenes of the Trades
assistive_text: This is a painting of historical scenes set against a deep blue background. The artwork features numerous small, detailed vignettes in warm hues against the blue. Each scene is enclosed, creating a grid-like pattern across the canvas. In each vignette, figures are engaging in various activities, representing narratives. The style resembles that of textile patterns or historically significant visual storytelling mediums. The scenes are packed close together, showcasing a wealth of detail and reflecting different aspects of daily life or historical events. The style is reminiscent of an anonymous folk or historical illustrator emphasizing storytelling through detailed miniatures.
creator: Paul Reimund
medium: woodcut printed in gold metallic ink on hand-washed blue paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Lear and Cordelia
title: Lear and Cordelia
assistive_text: The image shows two figures captured from the upper body. One figure on the left is in profile, facing towards the figure on the right. This figure has long hair and a beard, while the figure on the right appears to be looking at the first figure. She has long hair and seems to be holding a veil or shawl over her head and shoulders. Both figures are dressed in flowing garments, with the details of the clothing unclear due to the artistic style. The background consists of fine, horizontal lines, and there are no visible jewelry or objects. The art style and stippling give the image an etched appearance. Below the figures, there is cursive writing indicating attribution as "Drawn and engraved by W.B."
creator: Thomas Butts, Jr. after William Blake
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mrs. Q.
title: Mrs. Q.
assistive_text: The image shows a seated woman with short, curly hair, wearing a white dress with a green ribbon tied at the waist. She has delicate features and a calm expression. One hand rests on her knee, while the other touches the ground beside her. In the background, there is a landscape with buildings, trees, and foliage.
creator: William Blake after François Huet
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Canterbury Pilgrims
title: The Canterbury Pilgrims
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a group of horse riders and accompanying people on a journey. The drawing features intricately detailed figures, each on horseback, moving in a single file parade-like formation from left to right. The riders appear adorned in varying costumes typical of a historical or medieval setting. The architectural backdrop on the left side includes gothic-style buildings, also enriched with intricate carvings and expands into a vast rural landscape stretching towards the horizon on the right. The drawing's outline and composition focus on the conveyance of an epic journey, emphasized by the labeling at the bottom, "Chaucer’s Canterbury Pilgrims." The artwork's fine linework and shading techniques contribute to its storytelling and artistic depth.
creator: William Blake
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Ghost of Samuel Appearing to Saul
title: The Ghost of Samuel Appearing to Saul
assistive_text: This is a painting featuring a group of people. The central person is a man wearing a long robe with long hair and a beard that goes down to his thighs. His skin, hair, and clothes are almost completely white, and his index fingers on both hands are pointing downwards. Surrounding this person on either side are two other people in dramatic poses. On the left, a kneeling person dressed in red reaches upwards with open hands. To the right, another huddled person wearing blue has one arm over their face and their other arm extending backwards; their long orange hair stands on end around their head, and their face is in an expression of shock and fear. Behind the person on the left side are two other faces that appear indistinct and are without visible bodies. These two faces look towards the central person, and their mouths are open. The people stand or kneel on a gray surface, and the background is a blend of black, gray, and dark blue,
creator: William Blake
medium: pen and ink with watercolor over graphite
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Great Red Dragon and the Woman Clothed with the Sun
title: The Great Red Dragon and the Woman Clothed with the Sun
assistive_text: A winged woman, painted with tones of pale and butter yellow, kneels on a rock and looks up at a winged, horned creature with steel-gray skin and a curling tail flying above her in this vertical, graphite and watercolor work on paper. The woman, her body facing us, takes up most of the bottom half of the composition, and the winged creature the top half. The woman’s long blond hair flies up around her upturned face like stylized rays of sunlight. Her arms are spread wide, wrists flexed so her palms face out, and her pale, apricot-colored wings curve up over her shoulders and tuck behind her in a heart shape. She rests on a crescent moon with the tips pointing upward, which, in turn, rests on a gray, squared rock. Mirroring her pose but flying so his body faces downward as his feet point away from us, the creature above the woman has a muscular, humanoid physique. His long tail curls to our left in three loops, and is shaded with pale maroon red. Ram’s horns curve up from inside a golden crown encircling the top of his head, which faces us. Upon closer inspection, several faces, drawn with graphite and filled with nickel-gray watercolor, are connected around the creature's neck and also look down in profile onto the woman. The profiles overlap and some of the heads have moss-green, curling horns. The tips of the flying creature's outstretched fingers and arms nearly touch the sides of the paper and his light, rose-colored bat-like wings extend off both sides and the top of the composition. The background behind the pair is dark gray with white zigzagging lines to the left and right of the woman. Faces also emerge from the ground, looking up from the lower right corner. The artist signed his initials in black paint near the lower left: “WB.”
creator: William Blake
medium: pen and gray ink with watercolor over graphite
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Wat Tyler's Daughter
title: Wat Tyler's Daughter
assistive_text: The image is a pencil sketch of a person's head and shoulders. The person is facing slightly to the left, with their head turned to the side and tilted upwards. The facial features are soft and rounded, with large eyes, a small nose, and a subtle smile. The hair is styled in an elaborate updo with waves and curls. The clothing is suggested by a faint line at the shoulders, and there are no visible accessories. The background is plain.
creator: William Blake
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: An Ascending Spiral of Figures [recto]
title: An Ascending Spiral of Figures [recto]
assistive_text: The image shows a sketch of a seated figure in an upright position on a chair or throne. The figure has long hair, subtle facial features with closed eyes, and a serene expression. They are wearing a flowing garment that extends to the ground, with their hands positioned outward from the body. The sketch is drawn with soft pencil lines on a plain background, emphasizing the figure in the composition.
creator: William Blake
medium: graphite on two joined sheets of laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Job and His Family Restored to Prosperity
title: Job and His Family Restored to Prosperity
assistive_text: This is a painting of a group of figures and sheep under a tree in the style of William Blake. The image features a collection of figures arranged in an arc, each holding musical instruments like harps, lyres, and trumpets. The figures are painted in flowing robes, suggesting a harmonious gathering. The scene includes sleeping sheep in the foreground, and the night sky above with a crescent moon and a single star. The painting uses muted, watercolor-like tones.
creator: William Blake
medium: pen and ink with watercolor over graphite
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Simon Lord Lovat
title: Simon Lord Lovat
assistive_text: The image shows an elderly man sitting on a chair, with his body visible from head to knees. He is positioned slightly turned to his right, with his hands resting on his waist. The man has curly hair, a prominent chin, high-arched eyebrows, and a wide smile. He is wearing a long coat, knee-length breeches, and stockings. Surrounding him are an ornate chair, a wooden writing table with a book open and a quill in an ink pot. The background consists of parallel lines, highlighting the figure.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: France Watching
title: France Watching
assistive_text: This is a minimalist drawing of a cloaked figure standing on a rocky cliff. The scene is rendered in soft black and gray tones on paper. The figure, draped in flowing garments, appears to gaze out into a vast landscape dominated by the sky. The drawing uses brushstrokes to convey texture and an atmospheric effect suggesting contemplation or solitude. The surroundings are sketch-like with few details, emphasizing the silhouette and mood. Light and shadow create depth and a sense of vastness beyond the figure's sight.
creator: Jean-Louis Forain
medium: brush and gray and black ink on wove paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Bust of a Balding Man
title: Bust of a Balding Man
assistive_text: The image shows the head and upper part of the shoulders of an older man. His facial features include prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, a high forehead, and a furrowed brow. His hair is thin and receding, with some curls and sparse strands on top and around the sides and back. The man's expression is neutral, and he has a few visible wrinkles and textured skin. He is dressed in a simple garment with a loose collar and a small tie detail at the neck. There is no jewelry or objects visible. The background is plain with a linear pattern of horizontal lines. The image appears to be a woodcut or engraving style with a stark black and white contrast.
creator: Jan Lievens
medium: chiaroscuro woodcut with light brown tone block
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Philippe le Roy, Lord of Ravels
title: Philippe le Roy, Lord of Ravels
assistive_text: The image displays a portrait sketch of an individual from the shoulders up. The person is positioned slightly turned to the left, gazing directly forward. The individual has wavy hair falling to the collar, with facial features such as arched brows, deep-set eyes, a mustache, and a pointed chin with a small beard. The person wears what seems to be a cloak with a decorative pattern on the shoulders. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the portrait. There is no visible jewelry or other objects.
creator: Sir Anthony van Dyck
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: La Torre di Malghera
title: La Torre di Malghera
assistive_text: The image shows a landscape with a waterway and a structure-filled shoreline. The horizon is below the midpoint, with a line of distant hills meeting the sky. A tall tower is on the right, with smaller buildings to the left. The style is detailed engraving. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on light paper. There are boats in the water, people on a raft-like vessel, and individuals wading near the shore. A small dock is visible on the left.
creator: Canaletto
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Horses Exercising
title: Horses Exercising
assistive_text: This is a drawing of horses exercising with a rider. Two horses adorned with checkered blankets are guided by a rider. They are trotting in a space with brick walls in the background and a flat surface underfoot. The shading and texture add realism to the scene. The lines suggest movement and vitality. The rider is depicted in horse riding attire.
creator: Théodore Gericault
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Rinaldo, Astride Baiardo, Flies Off in Pursuit of Angelica
title: Rinaldo, Astride Baiardo, Flies Off in Pursuit of Angelica
assistive_text: This is a monochrome drawing of a flying figure on a horse over a landscape. The top left shows a celestial or mythological figure gesturing energetically downwards. Below, a mounted rider on a rearing horse charges through the air. The landscape consists of rough, jagged forms suggestive of rocky terrain or mountains, with swirling foliage or clouds around the horse and rider. The composition conveys movement and drama, emphasized by light and shadow contrasts.
creator: Jean-Honoré Fragonard
medium: black chalk with brown wash and touches of pen andbrown ink on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cupid carrying a fowl accompanied by a dog, and another cupid playing a trumpet
title: Cupid carrying a fowl accompanied by a dog, and another cupid playing a trumpet
assistive_text: The drawing shows two cherubs in a landscape. The cherubs are depicted in a pastoral scene, with one holding a small bird and the other playing a flute-like instrument. A small dog is present between them. The background includes a tree, hills, and flowing lines indicating water. The texture and shading add depth to the image, creating a serene setting.
creator: Maso Finiguerra
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hope
title: Hope
assistive_text: The image depicts a person standing in profile, facing right. The individual has folded arms, delicate facial features, and medium-length hair. They are wearing a long, flowing garment with a textured appearance. In the background, there is a decorative ribbon-like element with writing. The setting is minimalistic.
creator: Attributed to Francesco Francia
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Allegory of Fortitude (?)
title: Allegory of Fortitude (?)
assistive_text: The image features a mix of shapes and lines, such as vertical columns, circular domes, and detailed figures. The composition includes statuesque figures and architectural elements resembling a classical cityscape. There is a central spiraled column and a dome structure similar to ancient Roman architecture. A figure on horseback is in front, while a reclining figure beside a lion-like creature is present. There are towering columns and elaborate facades reminiscent of ancient temples or monuments. The overall composition blends the structural and symbolic elements, creating an abstract interpretation of a mythological or historical scene.
creator: Master of 1515
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cottages and Barn beside a Road
title: Cottages and Barn beside a Road
assistive_text: The image shows a landscape with a thatched-roof building to the right. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky with soft clouds. Surrounding the building are trees, a fence, and subtle brushstrokes adding texture. The color palette consists of sepia tones. In the distance to the left, faint structures can be seen on the horizon. The land close by has gentle brush marks, with a small body of water reflecting light.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The States General of France (Les Etats Generaux de France)
title: The States General of France (Les Etats Generaux de France)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a ceremonial hall. The scene shows a grand, ornately decorated hall with a high, vaulted ceiling adorned with intricate patterns and two large crests. The composition is symmetrical with a central aisle flanked by rows of figures in lavish attire. The hall leads towards a focal area in the distance where more elaborately dressed figures are gathered. The architectural elements include decorative columns, archways, and detailed ornamental work. The ceiling features depictions of allegorical figures amidst clouds. The overall tone is one of splendor and formality.
creator: Jan Ziarnko
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Elephant
title: Elephant
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an elephant with a fortified tower on its back. The image depicts an elephant with exaggerated features like large curving tusks and a pronounced trunk. The elephant bears a howdah resembling a small castle tower atop its back, complete with crenellations and a figure peering out of the top. The texture of the elephant's skin is suggested with fine crosshatch lines. The drawing employs a monochromatic palette, focusing on line and shading to convey form.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Archangel Gabriel
title: The Archangel Gabriel
assistive_text: The image shows a person standing gracefully with weight on one leg, curly hair, a crown of leaves, serene expression, and softly outlined eyes. They wear a robe with draped folds, hold a staff, gesture towards a scroll on the staff, and have wings. The background is plain.
creator: Martin Schongauer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Virgin in the Clouds
title: The Virgin in the Clouds
assistive_text: The image depicts a person from the waist up, sitting with arms crossed over their chest. The person has a simple, outlined face with a slightly somber expression, draped in layers of clothing - a blue robe with a lighter inner garment and a headdress covering their hair completely. The clothing is ornate and patterned with red and blue accents, possibly resembling traditional religious attire. No visible jewelry, accessories, or objects are held. A halo surrounds the person's head, suggesting religious importance. The background is plain, with abstract blue swirls on a golden-brown canvas.
creator: German 15th Century or Attributed to Master of the Housebook
medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, red, orange, and gold
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Virgin and Child with the Cat and Snake
title: The Virgin and Child with the Cat and Snake
assistive_text: This print shows a seated woman holding a small child in her arms. She is leaning slightly forward, the child's face pressed to her face. The woman's facial features are hard to identify against the crosshatching gray lines on her skin, but it seems as if her eyes are closed, and her hair is covered with a cloth or headscarf. She wears a long, simple dress with sleeves. The child's body is mostly obscured by the woman's arms, but its face is turned towards us, and it appears to be smiling slightly. On the left, a cat or similar animal is seated on a cushion or ledge. Behind the woman is a window, and the room is cluttered with other furniture including a chair, an open chest, and what may be a fireplace in the bottom right corner. Outside the window, a man is visible, with short hair and a beard. He appears to be looking into the room. Curtains hang down on the walls, and stairs lead downward in the bottom left corner. A halo-like circle seems to surround the head of the woman, and rays of light radiate from her. Upon closer inspection, a snake is visible emerging from the skirts of the woman, its tongue outstretched.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Three Trees
title: The Three Trees
assistive_text: Printed with deep, black shadows and swirling or straight lines on cream-white paper, three trees stand on a grassy bank alongside a body of water, probably a river or canal, in this horizontal etching, engraving, and drypoint. The grassy bank reaches almost two-thirds of the way across the composition from the right edge. At least two people, a horse-drawn wagon or carriage filled with more people, and a town, all minuscule in scale, are tucked under or beyond the trees. The face of the bank directly opposite us is dark in shadow, and the details of plants and the waterline are hard to make out. The bank tapers down so the distant horizon, which comes about a third of the way up the composition, stretches across the left half of the print. One person sits and one stands, fishing, by the water in the lower left corner. People work and cows stand or lie in the flat field beyond the water. Buildings and windmills created with a few strokes of the burin or etching needle are tiny in the far distance. The deeply shaded three trees are outlined starkly against the white sky. Dark clouds pour across the top of the sheet and enter along the left edge, and diagonal lines across the top left corner suggests falling rain. The artist signed and dated the print among grasses in the lower left corner of the printed image: “Rembrandt f. 1643.”
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
medium: etching with drypoint and engraving on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Allegory of War and Peace
title: Allegory of War and Peace
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene depicting a landscape with various activities and objects. The image is divided into two panels. On the left panel, there are figures gathered near a table with plates, a cup, and a kettle, surrounded by foliage and a detailed tree. The right panel features figures engaging in tasks, with animals present. In the background are structures resembling buildings and castles on a hilly landscape. The scene conveys a sense of busy activity, possibly symbolic or narrative, reflecting themes found in medieval imagery. The woodcut style suggests an era of medieval allegory with detailed linearity and symbolism in daily life settings.
creator: German 15th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Queen Katherine's Dream
title: Queen Katherine's Dream
assistive_text: This is a drawing featuring small, floating people ascending in a spiral, with one woman in the center, looking up at them. She is reclining on a couch or bed, and has her arms raised. She wears a pale blue dress and a white cloth over her long hair. The swirling figures emerge from the ground and rise upwards, creating a dynamic movement. They appear to be dancing, some holding instruments or baskets. Two of them appear to place a crown on the central woman. At the left and right edges of the bed are two seated figures who both appear to sleep in their chairs. On the left is a man with long white hair and a long white beard who wears a teal robe, and on the right is another woman who wears a yellow-green dress and has dark hair. Both of these people have their heads resting in their hands, with their elbows on the arms of their chair. The women and the floating people have blue-white skin, and the man on the left has pale peach skin.

assistive_text: We look up through an opening surrounded by a stone ledge, with clusters of people and clouds swirling into a blue sky up and away from us in this vertical, rectangular painting. From a distance, the scene looks like a complete illusion but up close, the people, clouds, and architecture are sketchily painted. The ledge running around the opening has a gold, oval medallion at each corner. Appearing to be carved from white stone, two bearded men with long hair recline against each medallion, flanking them to each side in front of large shells that curve up over the people and frames them. A few architectural structures extend up into the sky, including a pointed obelisk in the lower left corner, a pair of columns at the upper right, and what seems to be the mast of a ship at the top left. Most of the people have pale skin but some have more tan complexions, and a few, including those wearing feather headdresses near the upper left corner, have brown skin. The people wear windswept robes of pale, butter yellow, robin’s egg blue, rose pink, and ivory. The eye may drawn to a few vignettes, such as the man holding a rearing, chestnut-brown horse on the illusionistic ledge near the lower right, a nun wearing a white robe and holding a cross above him in the clouds, and, farthest away, a crowned person sitting on a throne.
creator: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Madonna and Child with Five Angels
title: Madonna and Child with Five Angels
assistive_text: A woman holding a baby sits on a throne in front of a cloth held up by five winged angels in this vertical painting. The woman, baby, and angels all have pale skin tinged with gray, long, straight noses, narrow mouths, almond-shaped eyes, and gold halos. The woman sits with her knees and shoulders squared to us. She looks at us with light brown eyes, and her head tips slightly to the right, toward the baby. A white veil drapes over her head and shoulders, and she wears a slate-blue dress under a teal-green robe, which is lined with pale, spring green. Gold lines densely spaced across the dress and robe suggest folds and wrinkles. She supports the baby’s bottom with her left hand, to our right. He sits upright with his knees and body angled to our left. He reaches up with his right hand, to our left, to touch the woman’s veil, and the other hand rests on an oversized cricket in his lap. He wears a transparent white garment edged with gold and a marigold yellow and coral orange cloth wrapped across his lap over bare feet. His features are small in a round face. He has brown hair, and his hairline is high. The cloth behind the pair is patterned with gray, brick red, and gold. Two angels hold up each long side and one holds up the top. The angels all look in or down. They have brown hair, and wings and robes in shades of golden yellow, pale peach, and celestial blue. The throne has a blocky seat, and the base projects in a semicircle against the navy-blue floor. There are lion finials at the front of each arm. The background is gilded with a leafy pattern in gleaming gold. The upper corners and some areas along the edges are damaged.
creator: Giovanni Baronzio
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Gentleman
title: A Gentleman
assistive_text: The sculpture is a male bust with realistic facial details, short combed hair, and a calm expression. The material used is a brown earthy tone resembling terracotta or ceramic. The figure is dressed in a formal garment with smooth lines and gentle folds.
creator: Florentine 15th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Rinaldo della Luna
title: Rinaldo della Luna
assistive_text: The sculpture is a bust of a young man with distinct facial features, including a serene expression and short curly hair. It is crafted from a brown material with gold tones, suggesting it is bronze or terracotta with a patina finish. The subject wears a pleated garment, and the bust sits on a blue and gold base with a decorative border. The sculpture is life-sized, extending from the head to just below the shoulders. It conveys a poised and dignified presence, positioned at eye-height with a viewer.
creator: after Mino da Fiesole
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Giovanni Capponi
title: Giovanni Capponi
assistive_text: The sculpture is a bust of a man with a beard and a serious expression. His hair is intricately carved in waves, matching the beard's texture. He wears a draped garment that hints at a robe or cloak, with clear folds over the shoulders for added depth. Made of white marble with natural veining, it has a realistic finish. The bust is placed on a simple, rounded base with decorative features. Life-sized and at eye level, viewers can closely observe the details and craftsmanship.
creator: Attributed to Giovanni Battista Caccini
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Christ Child (?)
title: The Christ Child (?)
assistive_text: The sculpture depicts the bust of a young child with heavily lidded eyes, thin lips, and chubby cheeks, their face in a neutral expression. The child has short, wavy hair, one prominent curl falling onto their forehead. The child's gaze is directed towards us. They are wearing a draping garment with a wide neckline. The sculpture is made of smooth, light-colored material.
creator: Desiderio da Settignano
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Duchesse de Nemours
title: Duchesse de Nemours
assistive_text: The image shows a seated woman from the knees up. She has one arm resting on an intricately carved armrest and the other arm on her lap. Her facial expression is gentle with a slight smile, and she has a prominent nose and full cheeks. Her hair is styled in soft curls and partially covered by a dark, lace-edged bonnet. She wears voluminous, luxurious clothing with lace trim at the cuffs, and a large draped shawl around her shoulders. The backdrop includes draped fabric, with a partially visible column with tassels on the right-hand side.
creator: Pierre Drevet after Hyacinthe Rigaud
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Mother of Pearl and Silver: The Andalusian
title: Mother of Pearl and Silver: The Andalusian
assistive_text: A woman stands with her back to us wearing a silver and black gown as she turns to look to our right in profile in this vertical portrait painting. We look slightly down onto the woman, and her features are painted with blended brushstrokes, making some details indistinct. She has pale, peachy skin, a straight nose, a strong chin, and her pink lips are closed. Black bangs brush the temple we can see, and her hair is pulled up into a bun high on the back of her head. Her black bodice has elbow-length, ruffled silver sleeves, which seem to be overlaid with translucent black material gathered in tiers. More gauzy black material covers her upper back to a high, black collar. A pearl-white bow at her lower back is nearly the width of her waist. The silver fabric of her long skirt drapes to and on the floor in a short train in deep folds. The woman’s right arm hangs by her side, and she holds what might be a piece of black fabric. A baseboard angles in a shallow diagonal down to our right across her hips. The wall above is smoky mauve-purple and below is charcoal gray. The shape of a butterfly within a darker oval is on the wall just to our right of the woman’s wrist.
creator: James McNeill Whistler
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Symphony in White, No. 1: The White Girl
title: Symphony in White, No. 1: The White Girl
