assistive_text: A young woman with pale, peachy skin, wearing a long, flowing white dress, stands in front of a white curtain in this vertical portrait painting. Her auburn-red hair cascades down over and behind her shoulders. She looks to our left with green eyes, and her pink, full lips are closed. Her dress has puffed shoulders above a white-on-white striped pattern on the long sleeves. She stands on an animal pelt; it is not clear whether it is a wolf or a bear. The pelt spans the width of the painting and overlaps a blue patterned carpet. The animal’s mouth gapes to show sharp teeth. Its glassy eyes are wide open, and it seems to look at us. The edges of the animal skin are red. The woman holds a white lily by her side in her left hand, while yellow and purple flowers lie scattered on the pelt.
creator: James McNeill Whistler
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Portrait of a Man
title: Portrait of a Man
assistive_text: Shown from the chest up, a pale-skinned, clean-shaven man wearing a cloth wrapped around his head looks at us in this vertical painting. The man’s shoulders are angled to our right, but he turns his round face to us to gaze out of the corners of his blue eyes under furrowed brows. His head tips slightly to our right, and his pink lips are parted. He has a rounded nose, full checks, and a slight double chin. The cloth wrapped around his head is white striped with pale blue. He wears a coral-orange and white neckerchief tied in a knot at his throat and a slate-blue collarless jacket. The background is pale, asparagus-green near his face and deepens to moss green at the edges. There are some white or light blue streaks and spots where paint has been lost or damaged.
creator: Follower of Jean Siméon Chardin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Healing of the Paralytic
title: The Healing of the Paralytic
assistive_text: Against a landscape, a pale-skinned man walking hunched over as he carries a large bundle like pillows wrapped in a blanket on his back nearly fills this vertical painting. Close to us, the man walks to our right with his head down and his eyes closed or downcast under straight, furrowed brows. He has a wide, prominent nose, a brown beard, and close-cropped hair. With muscled forearms arms raised overhead, he clutches the forest-green cloth tied around the bundle, which has cloth with dark green stripes against cream white. The man wears a red, waist-length tunic over an ankle-length, bright white garment, which splits up the side to show his muscular legs and bare feet. He strides across a moss-green rock. On the far side of the rock on which he stands, to our left, a sand-brown path curves away from us to the wide, arched opening of a building. The structure has gray walls, possibly stone, with goldenrod-yellow paneling around the second story, and a red roof. At the arched opening, a couple dozen people, tiny in scale, gather around a person who stands and gestures with arm extended over a second person lying on a cloth. The four corners of the cloth are suspended by four ropes, barely visible, where the cloth had been lowered to the ground from above, presumably from the four people on the roof. The people in the crowd wear robes in mustard yellow, navy blue, plum purple, dark red, and white. Another building and a stone tower rise beyond the structure. To our right, the land dips down to the horizon line, which comes about a quarter of the way up the painting. People walk along the distant path that passes in front of a house at the foot of a steel-blue, rocky outcropping. A leafy tree grows where the road bends out of sight, and bands of white clouds stretch across the pale, muted turquoise sky.
creator: Netherlandish 16th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Still Life
title: Still Life
assistive_text: A blue and white porcelain bowl, fruit, wine glasses, and a woven rug are gathered on a tabletop in front of a black background in this vertical still life painting. Light strongly illuminates the objects, creating a stark contrast to the dark background. At the center of the composition, the porcelain bowl is tipped so its wide brim rests on the rug bunched on the tabletop to our left. The rug is painted with a pattern in earthy beige and chocolate brown, denim blue, bronze, and cream white. A piece of roughly textured orange fruit resembling a tiny pumpkin has a stem with a small white blossom growing from its top. The fruit sits in the bowl alongside a vivid yellow lemon that has been partially peeled. The top has been cut from the lemon to form a long strip that curls onto the table, and the pulp glistens in the light. Two peaches sitting in front of the bowl are painted with tones of silvery ivory and burnt orange. The handle of a utensil juts out from between the peaches and lemon peel. Two glasses and a slender carafe are arranged in a row behind the fruit and bowl. The glass to the left has a round bowl over a thick, columnar stem, and the tall, gently flaring glass carafe behind the orange fruit are both half-filled with pale gold liquid. A drinking glass with a wide, shallow, scalloped-edged cup is mostly hidden behind the porcelain bowl, to our right.
creator: Willem Kalf
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Behind the Scenes
title: Behind the Scenes
assistive_text: This painting shows two people. A woman is seen from the knees up in the center, standing partially in front of the man next to her, her body facing the left and her head turned back towards us. She has pale skin, dark eyebrows, and a thin red mouth in a slight smile. She seems to be looking downward. Her dark hair is styled behind her head with a pink flower. She wears a seafoam-green dress with thin straps, a wide, square neckline, a small waist, and a puffed skirt. She has a gold bracelet on one wrist and a brown belt around her thin waist. Her hands are clasped in front of her, resting on her skirt. A man is behind her on the right, wearing a black suit with a white shirt, black bow tie, and a top hat. He has light skin, prominent cheekbones, gray hair, a gray mustache, and a pointed gray beard. The background is divided by a vertical line; the right side behind the man is dark brown, while the left side is a colorful, abstract scene including greens, blues, reds, and pinks, giving the impression of a leafy garden. The woman stands in front of this dividing line.
creator: Jean-Louis Forain
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Job and His Daughters
title: Job and His Daughters
assistive_text: An old man with a long, white beard and flowing, white hair sits surrounded by three young women in a gold-toned room in this horizontal painting. The people all have dark dots for eyes and touches of pink on the cheeks of their otherwise parchment-white skin. At the center of the composition, the man holds his arms out straight to his sides, lifted slightly above shoulder level, with his index fingers pointing and his middle fingers touching his thumbs to make a ring with each hand. He looks down to our right under bushy, furrowed brows, and his beard falls to his lap. His cream-white robe falls to the floor over his legs, but the toes of one foot peek out from under the hem. Two young women with blond hair sit to either side of him, leaning against his legs and sides. The woman to our left wears a harvest-yellow, long-sleeved gown, and she holds her hands pressed to her upper chest. The woman to our right wears a muted, rose-pink gown. The third woman, in front of the man, sits with her back to us, hands palm-down on the floor to either side of her, and her face resting on the man’s knees. Her blond hair is partially held in a net at the base of her skull, and her slate-blue gown pools around her. The edges of a ruby-red seat curl to either side of the women flanking the man. On the upper half of the wall opposite us, a roundel is flanked by a square panel to each side. We can barely make out the forms of some people in the monochromatic, caramel-brown sections. The floor is loosely patterned with muted red, black, royal blue, and butter yellow. Upon closer inspection, we find that the surface of the painting is cracked throughout.
creator: William Blake
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Eel Gatherers
title: The Eel Gatherers
assistive_text: Four people wearing earthy brown gather near a stream that runs through a lush forest carpeted and filled with moss, pine, and sage green trees and undergrowth, interlaced with thin, willowy tree trunks in this horizontal landscape painting. The forest fills the composition and the scene is dominated with tones of green, even in the reflections in the water. The stream runs from the lower right corner into the distance near the right side of the canvas. The trees and undergrowth are painted with blended brushstrokes, giving the scene a soft and hazy glow. Near the lower left corner, a woman kneels and helps a baby take a step toward a young girl, who approaches the pair with something gathered and held up in her apron. A boy climbs a tree nearby. A fifth person appears after close inspection, standing in and bending over the stream in the distance to our right. The scene is diffusely lit, with only a few bright spots in the canopy of the trees to suggest sunlight and sky beyond.
creator: Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot
credit_line: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. P.H.B. Frelinghuysen in memory of her father and mother, Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Amos Lawrence
title: Amos Lawrence
assistive_text: The image shows a man seated on a chair with one arm on the chair's armrest and the other on a table covered with a red cloth. He has fair skin, sideburns, and a smile, and wears a red cap, a patterned robe with a paisley design, dark trousers, white socks, and black slippers with floral embroidery. The background includes red drapery, a column, and a hint of a pale sky.
creator: Chester Harding
credit_line: Given in memory of the Rt. Rev. William Lawrence by his children
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Title Page for "Le Sourire" (Titre du Sourire)
title: Title Page for "Le Sourire" (Titre du Sourire)
assistive_text: The image features curving and jagged lines forming distinct shapes such as a person wrapped in cloth, a bull, and a bird. To the left, the text "Les Souitine" is intertwined with swirls, while on the right, faces with mask-like features are visible. The design shows bold contrast between light and shadow, resembling a carved or scratched appearance of woodcut prints.
creator: Paul Gauguin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Nave Nave Fenua (Delightful Land)
title: Nave Nave Fenua (Delightful Land)
assistive_text: The image shows a standing figure in full view, facing slightly sideways with their head turned towards the viewer. The person has long dark hair falling over their shoulders and a flower in their hair, standing among plants and foliage. The figure is holding a stem with heart-shaped leaves, and the background features abstract wave-like patterns and a border with geometric shapes and carvings on the left. At the top, there is text saying "NAVENAVE FENUA."
creator: Paul Gauguin
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Macbeth V (The Vision of Lady Macbeth)
title: Macbeth V (The Vision of Lady Macbeth)
assistive_text: The image depicts intricate swirling lines converging around a central figure, surrounded by other humanoid shapes. Some shapes resemble ethereal figures or spiritual apparitions. In the lower portion, there is a silhouette resembling a reclining human form. The abstract composition invites contemplation of the relationships between the figures.
creator: Wilhelm Lehmbruck
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Jan Asselijn
title: Jan Asselijn
assistive_text: The image is an etching of a man seated with his left arm resting on a table. He has a long face, elongated nose and lips, and long, curly hair falling to his shoulders. The man wears a wide-brimmed hat, and his clothing includes a collar and puffy sleeves. Books and papers are stacked on the table beside him. The background consists of blank walls.
creator: Rembrandt van Rijn
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Fantastic Vases
title: Fantastic Vases
assistive_text: The image displays a series of ornate vases with intricate designs and floral arrangements. The sketch is monochromatic, featuring shades of black and off-white. The vases vary in size and decoration. The left vase has intertwined swans, the central one has a goat head and rope-like decorations, and the right vase features human figures. Each vase is detailed with various patterns and motifs, situated closely together on a horizontal plane.
creator: Stefano Della Bella
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Celtes Surrounded by Greek and Roman Gods
title: Celtes Surrounded by Greek and Roman Gods
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a complex allegorical scene with various mythological figures and symbols. The image is divided into panels, each containing detailed depictions of classical deities and mythical characters. In the central panel, there is a seated figure engaged in writing, surrounded by scrolls and books. Above, an owl flies across with Latin inscriptions. Surrounding this central scene are various figures including Minerva, Mars, Venus, Hercules, Mercury, Apollo, and Bacchus, each with distinguishing attributes. The image illustrates themes of art, poetry, music, and mythology in a style reminiscent of Renaissance artistry, though no single artist or style is indicated. The composition suggests a celebration or dedication of artistic and heroic virtues, framed with Latin phrases and an ornate border.
creator: Hans Süss von Kulmbach
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Gulielmus Hogarth
title: Gulielmus Hogarth
assistive_text: The image depicts an engraving of a seated man facing slightly to the right with his body turned slightly to the left. The man has prominent facial features, including large eyes, a prominent nose, and a closed mouth. He wears a fur hat, a dark coat, and a buttoned shirt with a white collar. A pug dog sits beside him, facing the viewer. Objects like books, an artist's palette, brushes, and a cloth are scattered around them. In the background is a draped curtain, and at the bottom is the inscription "Gulielmus Hogarth."
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Marriage a la Mode: pl.4
title: Marriage a la Mode: pl.4
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a room with several figures engaged in various activities. The scene includes detailed furnishings and artwork on the walls, people in 18th-century attire interacting, luxurious drapery, a vanity with a mirror, and numerous objects on the floor. The figures are seated on chairs and sofas, engaged in conversation and displaying expressive gestures. The walls are adorned with paintings, and the furniture is intricately designed.
creator: Simon Francois Ravenet I after William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Marriage a la Mode: pl.5
title: Marriage a la Mode: pl.5
assistive_text: The image shows a room with several individuals in a dramatic scene. A man is depicted leaning back with his arms outstretched. A woman is kneeling on the floor, looking distressed. A uniformed servant is holding a lantern, and another person in night attire appears startled. In the background, a figure is climbing out of a window. The room features an ornate bed, a table with a candle, scattered items like a sword and clothes, and decorative walls.
creator: Simon Francois Ravenet I after William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Polling
title: The Polling
assistive_text: This is a painting of a bustling scene at a polling station. The image shows a crowded gathering of people voting within a wooden structure, while others wait outside. Some are engaged in conversations. In the background, there is a village with a church and a stone bridge over a river. The detailed composition includes a canopy overhead with flags. The style is reminiscent of William Hogarth, known for his detailed and satirical depictions of daily life.
creator: William Hogarth and Francois Morellon de La Cave
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Harlot's Progress: pl.1
title: A Harlot's Progress: pl.1
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an urban street scene. The illustration features various individuals and activities. The scene depicts a city street with attention to architecture and historical attire. In the foreground, a woman in a bonnet and gown is talking to another similarly dressed woman. A man on horseback is holding a letter and appears to be communicating with a group of seated figures inside a covered cart or stagecoach. Architectural elements, such as a bell and a stone facade, are present. A barrel and square packages or crates are in the bottom right corner. Additional figures are in the background, one looking out from a doorway. The drawing captures a lively depiction of urban life.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Rake's Progress: pl.1
title: A Rake's Progress: pl.1
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a cluttered room filled with various objects and activities. The scene is set in an indoor environment and includes a cabinet with household items on the left side, a fireplace surrounded by cooking pots and tools, and a mantelpiece with a painting and other objects. People are engaged in various activities, such as adjusting the ceiling and measuring something with a compass. The room is richly decorated, reflecting a chaotic yet lively atmosphere.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Rake's Progress: pl.2
title: A Rake's Progress: pl.2
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene in a room filled with artwork and music. The detailed interior portrays a group of people engaged in various activities. In the foreground, a man is seated at a keyboard instrument, while a group of people surrounding him is interacting. The room's walls are adorned with framed paintings, adding to the opulence of the environment. The scene conveys a sense of 18th-century elegance and decadence, with rich clothing and elaborate wigs suggesting wealth and sophistication. Each figure in the scene is active, contributing to the lively atmosphere of the gathering.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Rake's Progress: pl.4
title: A Rake's Progress: pl.4
assistive_text: This is an illustration of a busy street scene. Various characters are interacting. In the center, a group surrounds a fallen individual. On the left, a well-dressed figure watches. Buildings are in the background under a stormy sky with lightning. A person on a ladder is pouring a liquid. Another person is searching through a box. Objects and a sleeping figure are on the ground. The drawing includes detailed clothing and expressions, depicting societal tensions.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Rake's Progress: pl.6
title: A Rake's Progress: pl.6
assistive_text: The image depicts a scene within a room with several men engaged in different activities. Most of the men are shown from the waist up. They are seated or standing around tables, raising their arms, holding objects, such as a lantern or a piece of paper. The men have a variety of expressions and hairstyles typical of the period, with many wearing wigs or styled hair. They are dressed in historical clothing like suits with long coats, waistcoats, and knee-length socks detailed with buttons and lace. Some wear hats, including tricorn styles. The men hold various objects like a pen, a lantern, cards, and possible gambling counters. The room has sconces on the walls, a man with a staff in the background, and a caged area that may be a service counter. A dog is also present in the scene.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Second Stage of Cruelty
title: The Second Stage of Cruelty
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a busy street scene showing instances of animal cruelty. A horse has fallen while pulling a cart, being beaten by one figure and observed by another. Nearby, sheep seem agitated as a figure with a weapon adds to the unrest. In the background, chaos ensues with animals running wild and people acting recklessly. The street's architecture serves as a frame for the scene, illustrating disorderly life. The drawing includes detailed and whimsical yet grim elements hinting at satirical commentary.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cruelty in Perfection
title: Cruelty in Perfection
assistive_text: This is a drawing of multiple figures gathered around a building and a person on the ground. The setting is outdoors at night, with a clock tower in the background displaying the time as 1:05. Some figures are holding objects, such as pitchforks and lanterns. A paper, a lantern, and a chest are on the ground. A crescent moon and an owl are visible in the sky. The title "CRUELTY IN PERFECTION" is written at the top.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Noon
title: Noon
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a busy street scene at noon. Various activities are shown outside a church and nearby buildings. Individuals are talking, eating, and moving around a table in front of a shop. The scene features a diverse group of characters and detailed architecture, including tall buildings and a church steeple in the background. The clothing, expressions, and body language of the figures reflect social realism. The drawing depicts everyday life with humor and criticism of societal behavior.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Industrious 'Prentice performing the Dutyof a Christian
title: The Industrious 'Prentice performing the Dutyof a Christian
assistive_text: The image depicts the upper half of several individuals in a church-like setting. A young apprentice and a woman are in focus in the foreground. The young man stands in a wooden pew with a book in his hands. His facial features are detailed with a concentrated expression, shoulder-length curly hair, and formal 18th-century attire. The woman wears a bonnet and a patterned dress, holding a book. The background includes a church interior with high vaulted ceilings, arches, and a large organ, with people seated or listening to a service.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Industrious 'Prentice a Favorite, and entrusted by his Master
title: The Industrious 'Prentice a Favorite, and entrusted by his Master
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a workshop scene. The image shows a workshop interior with an apprentice, workers at spinning wheels, a man at large rolls of fabric, and a cat on the ground. The apprentice is standing with a book talking to another figure, and there is a biblical reference inset at the bottom.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Industrious 'Prentice out of his Time, and Married to his Master's Daughter
title: The Industrious 'Prentice out of his Time, and Married to his Master's Daughter
assistive_text: The image depicts a busy urban street scene with a group of musicians on the left, playing instruments. On the right, individuals converse by the entrance of a building. Architectural details include columns and ornate signboards. A small dog looks at a figure holding a document.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Idle 'Prentice betray'd by his Whore, & taken in a Night Cellar with his Accomplice
title: The Idle 'Prentice betray'd by his Whore, & taken in a Night Cellar with his Accomplice
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene in a night cellar where a betrayal takes place. The image features figures inside a dimly lit tavern-like environment. The central focus is on a person engaged in a discussion or deal, while another person behind them is preoccupied with items on a table. To their side, by a doorway, two other figures interact; one appears to be accusing or confronting the other. In the background, a fireplace provides light, contrasting with the dark corners of the room. Bystanders observe the events. The etching shows detailed patterns and shading to emphasize the atmosphere. The text around the image suggests a moral narrative.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Industrious 'Prentice Alderman of London,the Idle one brought before him & impea ch'd by his Accomplice
title: The Industrious 'Prentice Alderman of London,the Idle one brought before him & impea ch'd by his Accomplice
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene set in the 18th century. The figures in the drawing are engaged in various activities, likely related to a trial or legal proceedings. The characters are wearing period clothing such as frock coats, wigs, and ornate shoes. In the foreground, a seated figure is dressed in a long coat and tricorn hat, possibly a judge or magistrate. A desk with documents is nearby, suggesting clerical or legal work. In the background, individuals are gathered around a bench or table. The scene is detailed with architectural elements such as columns. The composition is dynamic with a linear quality typical of engravings from that time period.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Gate of Calais, or The Roast Beef of Old England
title: The Gate of Calais, or The Roast Beef of Old England
assistive_text: This is a painting of a scene at an old city gate with various characters engaged in different activities. The image depicts a group of figures in a historical setting with an archway, coats of arms, and a portcullis. To the left, there are people seated, holding meat and a drink. In the center, several figures are in conversation or confrontation, one holding a large cut of meat. To the right, a man is resting on the ground with a pot. The style is reminiscent of William Hogarth, known for moralistic and satirical themes. The image portrays a contrast between wealth and poverty with detailed characters and setting.
creator: William Hogarth and Charles Mosley
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Bruiser
title: The Bruiser
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a bear with a frothy mug and a dog below, surrounded by various items. The illustration depicts a bear holding a foamy tankard while emerging from an oval frame. The bear wears frilled clothing around its neck and is artistically anthropomorphized. Below the bear, there is a dog sitting obediently. The foreground contains a painter's palette and brushes, several books stacked upon one another, and a small tankard. The background features draped fabric. The image includes a poem underneath.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: England
title: England
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a scene portraying British soldiers and civilians. The illustration shows soldiers and civilians interacting with a caricatured figure. In the foreground, a soldier rests on a barrel, while others are gathered around a table with drinking vessels. The background features a sign for 'Duke of Cumberland' above a tavern entrance, with soldiers seen drilling in the distance. The elaborate costumes, exaggerated expressions, and narrative suggest a satirical tone, typical of this style of art.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hudibras and the Lawyer
title: Hudibras and the Lawyer
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an interior scene in an ornate library. There is a man gesturing to another man in a grand chair, while two other men are writing at a cluttered table. A statue with scales is next to the desk. Several women and two dogs are in the background. The walls are panelled and there are many books on high shelves.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Analysis of Beauty: pl.2
title: Analysis of Beauty: pl.2
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a dance taking place in an opulent interior space. The scene shows a large room with ornate walls adorned with portraits and illuminated by candle sconces. Elegantly dressed individuals are engaged in a formal dance. The central focus is a prominently dressed figure leading the dance with graceful movement, surrounded by others displaying joyful expressions and seeming immersed in the dance. The border of the drawing is decorated with various smaller illustrations resembling elements of an art study or catalog, including swirls, head and face profiles, different hat styles, and anatomical features like eyes, noses, or ears, all meticulously numbered for reference. The style suggests a detailed and organized approach, possibly with a satirical or educational intent, as it combines elements of social illustration and scientific analysis.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Credulity, Superstition, and Fanaticism
title: Credulity, Superstition, and Fanaticism
assistive_text: This is a drawing depicting a crowded room during a religious or spiritual gathering. A preacher is at the center of the scene, gesturing upwards and holding a small figure. Behind him, a demon and an angel are shown. The crowd below shows a range of reactions, from distress to enthusiasm or skepticism. The image is full of symbolism and exaggerated expressions. The style resembles that of William Hogarth, known for satirical engravings. The title at the bottom is "Credulity, Superstition, and Fanaticism. A Medley."
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Paul before Felix Burlesqued
title: Paul before Felix Burlesqued
assistive_text: This is a painting of a courtroom scene with various figures and symbolic imagery. The composition includes a figure at a podium speaking to a seated crowd, light streaming in from above, a judge-like figure on the left, and a small creature at the bottom. Various characters are present, such as wise men, archers, a woman with scales, and a figure with bound wings. In the background, there is a walled area with barrels and a person at a window. The painting has a satirical tone and features dramatic contrast and shadowing typical of the style of William Hogarth.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: John Wilkes Esq.
title: John Wilkes Esq.
assistive_text: The image shows a man seated, with one leg crossed over the other. He is leaning slightly forward and holding a long pole with a large item labeled "Liberty." The man has a smile on his face, a distinctive hairstyle with side curls typical of the 18th century, and is wearing a buttoned coat, waistcoat, knee breeches, and buckled shoes. Next to him on a table are papers and a box labeled "North Briton Number 45." The background has a simple, textured pattern, and the chair he is sitting on is ornate.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Columbus Breaking the Egg
title: Columbus Breaking the Egg
assistive_text: The image shows six individuals from the waist up gathered around a table. The individuals are sitting or leaning casually, engaging with each other. They have a variety of facial features and expressive expressions. They have mid-length to long hair with historical style clothing. The figures are dressed similarly, and there is a plate with what appears to be eggs on the table. A folded document or cloth is also visible. One man is gesturing towards the others. The background features a draped cloth and a fluted column.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Sleeping Congregation
title: The Sleeping Congregation
assistive_text: This is a drawing depicting a courtroom or lecture setting with various exaggerated characters. The image shows a figure in a high position looking through a magnifying glass at a book, wearing a large wig. Below them, another figure appears drowsy, holding spectacles. In the foreground, a woman holds a fan and a book titled "Hoyle," looking tired. The background shows a crowd, some sleeping and others wearing unusual hats. The architecture includes arched windows and columns. Above, on a ceiling, are cherub-like figures and an inscription. The drawing is filled with satirical and humorous details typical of 18th-century art.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cunicularii, or The Wise Men of Godliman in Consultation
title: Cunicularii, or The Wise Men of Godliman in Consultation
assistive_text: This monochrome illustration depicts a chaotic scene with several figures positioned around a bed. The central figure is a woman lying on the bed, partially covered with a sheet. She appears to be giving birth with the assistance of others around her. To her left, a seated woman dressed in a flowing gown supports her back, while to her right, a bearded man leans toward her, pulling on the sheet. In the background, two men dressed in 18th-century styled coats with long wigs observe the scene. A few more figures stand in the corner, partially inside a doorway. Scattered across the floor are multiple small, rabbit-like creatures. The setting is an enclosed room with curtains and a paneled ceiling, adding to the atmosphere of the scene.
creator: William Hogarth
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Kunz von der Rosen
title: Kunz von der Rosen
assistive_text: The image shows a man standing with his hands on his hips. He has a strong expression with thick, slightly curled hair under a decorated cap. He wears a quilted garment with a thorn-like pattern, patterned pants, and a belt holding a sword or dagger. The background features an engraved cloudy sky.
creator: Daniel Hopfer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Calavera of Francisco Madero, from Calavera Maderista
title: Calavera of Francisco Madero, from Calavera Maderista
assistive_text: Printed with black lines on cream-white paper, a skeleton carrying a bottle and wearing a hat, striped scarf, pants, and sandals walks to our left in this vertical etching. Filling the composition, the skeleton has a walrus handlebar mustache and a goatee. His straw hat has a wide brim and a pointed crown. His scarf drapes over his right shoulder, farther from us. The skeleton holds the scarf in his right hand and an oversized black bottle with a cork in his left hand. The bottle has lettering on the label to read “AGUAR” and “DE PAR.” A few vertical lines around his sandals suggest grass.
creator: José Guadalupe Posada
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Cartouche in the Form of a Flayed Tiger Supported by Centaurs
title: Cartouche in the Form of a Flayed Tiger Supported by Centaurs
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an ornate emblem featuring mythical creatures. It depicts two centaur-like creatures on either side of a central shield-like form adorned with flowing, ornate patterns resembling feathers or fur. Each creature has the upper body of a human and a lower body resembling that of a horse or goat. They are standing on their hind legs and appear to be holding up the central shield with their raised arms. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and textures.
creator: Stefano Della Bella
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ornamental Frieze with Letter L (Louis XIV)
title: Ornamental Frieze with Letter L (Louis XIV)
assistive_text: This is a drawing of ornate decorative elements featuring cherubs and mythical creatures. The central focus of this intricate etching is a symmetrical design where two cherubic figures face each other while holding a crowned emblem. Flanking the cherubs are elaborate swirling motifs that morph into figures resembling mythical creatures, each with a feminine human head and a scrollwork body akin to a lion or sphinx. The composition emphasizes fluid lines, dynamic curves, and an overall sense of motion.
creator: Stefano Della Bella
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Two Ornamental Bands with Head of a Lion and Woman
title: Two Ornamental Bands with Head of a Lion and Woman
assistive_text: This is a drawing of ornamental designs featuring animal motifs. The image is composed of intricate decorative patterns divided into two horizontal sections. The upper section features a lion's head at the center, surrounded by scrollwork and winged creatures. The lower section contains more scrollwork with mythical beasts depicted in a mirrored arrangement. The style is ornate with detailed line work emphasizing symmetry and ornamentation.
creator: Stefano Della Bella
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Two Ornamental Bands with Facing Heads of Lion and Eagle, and Two Rams
title: Two Ornamental Bands with Facing Heads of Lion and Eagle, and Two Rams
assistive_text: This is an image of two horizontal ornamental friezes with intricate designs. Both feature elaborate scrollwork and foliage motifs. The upper strip is adorned by a bold central lion's head surrounded by curling acanthus leaves and floral elements. The lower strip displays a similar acanthus and floral pattern, along with an elaborate goat or ram skull on one end. The overall style is indicative of baroque ornamental design, with a strong emphasis on naturalistic detail and dynamic movement within the decorative elements.
creator: Stefano Della Bella
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Three Ornamental Bands
title: Three Ornamental Bands
assistive_text: This is a drawing featuring ornate scenes involving animals and figures. The upper section of the image shows intricate scrollwork with leafy and floral motifs. In the center, a hound is chasing a hare between two winged figures merging with foliage. Below, a smaller panel depicts a scene with a dog or hound lunging at another animal, possibly a roe or boar, set amid stylized vegetation. The panels are rendered with meticulous detail, typical of Baroque ornamental prints integrating dynamic forms and elaborate floral designs.
creator: Stefano Della Bella
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Dolphins and Tritons
title: Dolphins and Tritons
assistive_text: The image shows two figures with human torsos and fish-like tails entwined with large sea creatures resembling serpents or whales, amidst swirling waters. The texture is detailed, with precise lines and shading. The figures are engaged with the animals, symbolizing themes of mythology and marine life.
creator: Stefano Della Bella
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ornamental Frieze with Eagle and Lion Engarlanded by Children
title: Ornamental Frieze with Eagle and Lion Engarlanded by Children
assistive_text: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative motif with mythological and animal elements. The work features a central long frieze adorned with intricate scrolling designs and flourishes, interwoven with fantastical creatures and natural elements. This includes a central eagle surrounded by garlands or foliage, two cherubim figures or mythological beings, and prominent lion features on either side. Below the frieze, there is a depiction of a classical figure with a raised arm, possibly mythological, interacting with an animal figure, and a separate sketch of a bearded head. The overall composition suggests a decorative purpose, possibly intended for architectural ornamentation or a similar artistic application. The style is characterized by detailed etching that emphasizes the dynamic flow and fluidity of the lines.
creator: Stefano Della Bella
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Prairie Titlark
title: Prairie Titlark
assistive_text: This is a painting of a bird perched on a rock surrounded by pink flowers and grass. The bird is depicted with brown plumage, a speckled chest, and a slender tail, standing upon the rocks. Surrounding the rock are delicate pink flowers and green blades of grass. The background is left blank. The text at the bottom indicates that this is identified as a Prairie Titlark, scientifically named Anthus Pipens. The work is intended to display the bird in a manner characteristic of naturalist documentation.
creator: Robert Havell, Jr. after John James Audubon
medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on J. Whatman paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Le haut d'un battant de porte (Birds Nailed to a Barn Door)
title: Le haut d'un battant de porte (Birds Nailed to a Barn Door)
assistive_text: The image features three birds and a bat arranged on a wooden surface. A crow with outstretched wings is on the left, an owl with wide-spread wings on the right, and a smaller hawk with folded wings at the center bottom. Above the hawk is a bat with extended wings. The colors in the image are primarily grayscale. The wooden surface has vertical planks, and a metal hinge detail is visible on the right side.
creator: Félix Bracquemond
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: David and Bathsheba
title: David and Bathsheba
assistive_text: This is a drawing depicting an allegorical scene. The composition includes architectural elements in the background such as a castle-like structure and trees. Foreground figures are engaged in various actions: one figure offers something on a tray to another seated figure, while a third plays a harp, accompanied by a bird. The artwork features intricate lines and cross-hatching, typical of Renaissance iconography, aiming to convey a narrative or symbolic theme.
creator: Allaert Claesz
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Big Cedar
title: The Big Cedar
assistive_text: The image shows a rural scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. A large tree dominates the right side of the image, with branches extending outward. A fence is in the foreground. A line of distant trees marks the horizon in the middle of the image. Beyond the tree and fence, a horse-drawn cart loaded with hay and a small farm building are visible. The artwork features fine and detailed brushwork capturing textures. The color palette is monochrome sepia.
creator: Childe Hassam
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Seated Magician with Other Figures beside an Altar
title: Seated Magician with Other Figures beside an Altar
assistive_text: The image depicts two men in a natural setting. The central figure is seated, with a full beard and hair covered by a cloth. He wears a tunic with ornamentation and a cloak. Next to him stands a second man, shirtless and holding a staff. There are objects around them - a large vase, an owl, and a cow skull. The background shows outdoor scenery with bare trees. The ground is uneven.
creator: Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Playing Cards
title: Playing Cards
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a set of playing cards with figures on horseback. The artwork consists of three individual frames, each depicting a horse and rider holding different objects: a club, a decorated disk, and a chalice. The riders are dressed in tunics, and the horses are adorned with minimalistic tack. The figures are outlined with simple lines against a plain background. Each card is framed by a rectangular border with slightly rounded corners, and the drawing is rendered on cream-colored paper with aged edges.
creator: Italian 15th Century
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Poesia (Poetry)
title: Poesia (Poetry)
assistive_text: The image depicts a figure playing a flute. The person is seated in a reclining position and shown from head to feet. They hold the flute to their lips, with their head turned slightly to the right. The person's facial features appear detailed, with calm eyes and a serene expression. They have long hair parted in the middle that flows down past their shoulders. The person wears a flowing robe with long sleeves, suggesting movement. Behind them is a decorated urn with a twisted stem and floral motifs. In the lower part of the image, a celestial globe decorated with stars is visible, in front of stylized hills. The scene is framed with a simple border.
creator: Master of the S-Series Tarocchi
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sketches of Grotesque Faces
title: Sketches of Grotesque Faces
assistive_text: This is a detailed drawing of various sketches and notes on a sheet of paper. The sketches include a hand, facial profiles, and architectural elements, along with handwritten cursive notes. Some of the sketches are lightly colored, especially around the hair of the faces. One face in the top right has long hair and a beard, looking upwards. There are annotations next to each drawing, possibly indicating names like "Sir Cecil Trafford" and "Cardinal Allen." The center of the paper shows what appears to be an architectural column or detail with accompanying text. In the bottom left corner, there are two overlapping faces with a startled expression. The overall composition suggests a page of studies or notes for a project related to architecture or history.
creator: George Cruikshank
medium: graphite with pink, blue, and brown wash on wove paper
credit_line: Gift of Dr. Clements C. Fry
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Satirical Sketches
title: Satirical Sketches
assistive_text: This is a drawing containing various doodles and caricatures. The page shows sketched figures and objects in ink. In the upper left, there is a caricature of a profile of a person's head. To the right, a devilish figure with horns is depicted holding a drinking vessel. Below, there is a figure holding scales in one hand and a bottle in the other. In the center, there is an angry or serious-faced figure. Below, there is a smaller figure next to a cylindrical object. Handwritten text reads "Beware of Polly-ticks" and "George Cruikshank his Book". A candle burning on a holder is drawn at the bottom of the page.
creator: George Cruikshank
medium: pen and brown ink and graphite
credit_line: Gift of Dr. Clements C. Fry
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Daughter of Men Becomes a Siren
title: The Daughter of Men Becomes a Siren
assistive_text: The image is a pencil sketch featuring multiple human figures. The sketch shows full-length body depictions of two standing figures and one figure lying down. The standing figures are drawn with arms raised, one on the left and one centrally placed. The left figure appears as if floating or in motion, with markings on the body, potentially scales or texture, and has a curly hairstyle. The central standing figure has a slight tilt suggesting movement or dance. The facial features are not detailed but imply an upward gaze. Both figures appear unclothed, their forms suggested with light lines. The lying figure is depicted in a reclined position. The background is plain and unmarked, emphasizing the sketched figures without distraction. No jewelry or objects are distinguished in the drawing. The artwork has a rough, ethereal quality typical of a preliminary sketch.
creator: William Blake
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Chester Dale
title: Chester Dale
assistive_text: This painting shows a man from the waist up, his body turned slightly to the right. He stands upright, looking at the viewer, holding a golf club or cane horizontally with both hands. The man has a neutral facial expression and a light complexion, a blond mustache, and neatly combed blond hair. He wears a white shirt under a pale yellow sweater and a brown coat, along with a red bow tie. He also has a long, multi-colored scarf draped over his shoulders with red and green stripes visible. The background is gray and becomes slightly lighter around the man's head and darker around the edges.
creator: George Bellows
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sibylla Phrygia
title: Sibylla Phrygia
assistive_text: The image shows a woman seated with her body slightly turned to the side while facing the viewer. She has a serene expression and long, wavy hair flowing from under a veil. The woman wears a long gown, holds a rod-like object in one hand, and rests the other hand on her lap. She wears a necklace with rounded elements around her neck. In the background, there is a large column and leafy plants near her feet.
creator: Paul Maupin, after Jacques Stella
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sibylla Europa
title: Sibylla Europa
assistive_text: The image shows a person from the thighs up, seated and slightly turned to the right. The face has soft features, full lips, and a direct gaze. The person has short, curly hair with a leafy band, wearing an intricately detailed robe with flowing sleeves and holding a sword in the right hand and a branch in the left hand. The background is plain with a hint of foliage to the right of the figure.
creator: Paul Maupin, after Jacques Stella
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sibylla Hellespontina
title: Sibylla Hellespontina
assistive_text: The image depicts a person sitting on a stone-like structure. The person is upright with one knee bent and raised, holding a branch with leaves in one hand and the other hand resting on their knee. The individual's facial features suggest age, with an intent gaze. They wear a head covering that drapes over their shoulders, a long robe with folds and patterns, and simple footwear. In the background is a stone column, scattered stones, and plant elements. Simple lines and shadows provide texture to the illustration.
creator: Paul Maupin, after Jacques Stella
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sibylla Cimmeria
title: Sibylla Cimmeria
assistive_text: The image shows a person sitting in a three-quarter view, looking left. They have a serene expression with detailed facial features and styled hair. The person wears flowing robes and holds a bouquet of flowers. In the background, there is an architectural element to the right and a cloud with emanating rays to the left. The image is rendered with fine line work.
creator: Paul Maupin, after Jacques Stella
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sibylla Libyca
title: Sibylla Libyca
assistive_text: The image shows a person seated, holding a book and a leafy branch. They wear a cloth headpiece and a flowing robe. Their eyes are closed and they have a serene expression. Foliage is visible in the background. A decorative wheel-like object is on the ground nearby. The illustration features detailed line work and shading.
creator: Paul Maupin, after Jacques Stella
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A New Love Song Only a Ha'Penny a Piece
title: A New Love Song Only a Ha'Penny a Piece
assistive_text: This is a painting of a street scene involving an exchange. The scene shows a group of figures engaging in a transaction. A woman is offering a sheet of music or lyrics to another figure. The figures are dressed in period clothing. A child and a dog are present. Architectural elements, like stone columns, suggest the location is a town or city square. This art style is reminiscent of Francis Wheatley.
creator: Anthony Cardon after Francis Wheatley
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Turnips and Carrots Ho
title: Turnips and Carrots Ho
assistive_text: The image depicts two women outdoors. The primary figure is a woman facing slightly left with long, wavy hair under a wide-brimmed hat. She wears a long skirt, blouse, pink jacket, and blue apron. She holds turnips and green leafy vegetables. Beside her, a donkey carries a basket with turnips and carrots. Another young woman stands behind the donkey wearing a blue dress and a hat. The background shows an architectural setting with steps, an archway leading into a building, and a partly cloudy sky.
creator: Thomas Gaugain after Francis Wheatley
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: New Mack'rel
title: New Mack'rel
assistive_text: Three women are standing in front of a doorway. The woman on the left is holding a tray with fish and has fair skin. She is wearing a dark hat, a cream long-sleeved dress under a brown shawl, a blue apron, and her hair is tucked under her hat. The woman in the middle is wearing a soft hat and a blue dress with a coral sash, and has long, dark hair. The woman on the right has light brown hair pulled back under a white cap, fair skin, and is wearing a white dress with brown sleeves and a blue apron tied around her waist. She is holding her hands on her hips. In the background, there is a wooden doorway, stone steps, a low metal fence, a plastered wall, a window covered with a red curtain, and a large wicker basket on the ground.
creator: Niccolò Schiavonetti after Francis Wheatley
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Fresh Gathered Peas, Young Hastings
title: Fresh Gathered Peas, Young Hastings
assistive_text: This is a painting of a scene with a cart and various individuals gathered around it. The image depicts a historical scene where activities involving selling or distributing goods are taking place. A woman is standing beside a wooden cart while a man fills it with herbs or leafy greens from a basket. Another figure stands on the cart, with a small child and a dog nearby. The setting appears to be outdoors and urban, with a tall architectural structure in the distance. The painting features muted colors and a soft focus, resembling the style of artists who captured everyday scenes from life in 18th or 19th-century Europe.
creator: Giovanni Vendramini after Francis Wheatley
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Hot Spice Ginger Bread Smoking Hot
title: Hot Spice Ginger Bread Smoking Hot
assistive_text: The image shows five individuals and a dog in an urban setting with stone columns in the background. A man in a red coat and gray trousers is holding a tray, a woman in light-colored clothing is holding something, and another woman wears a pink bonnet and shawl. A young boy in brown clothing is looking at the table, and a dog with a white and brown coat is standing nearby.
creator: Giovanni Vendramini after Francis Wheatley
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Capricci di varie battaglie (Title Page)
title: Capricci di varie battaglie (Title Page)
assistive_text: This is an image of a battle-themed scene with a banner inscribed "CAPRICCI DI VARIE BATTAGLIE di Gio Guglielmo Baur 1635." The drawing shows a mounted figure on horseback blowing a trumpet with a flag, alongside war implements like cannons and cannonballs in the foreground. Other figures in the background are raising flags and possibly preparing for battle. The image features strong lines, detailed shading, and a central focus on the large banner.
creator: Johann Wilhelm Baur
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Capricci di varie battaglie
title: Capricci di varie battaglie
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a battle scene. Mounted soldiers are engaged in combat, depicted in energetic lines. The movement of the horses and gestures of the figures suggest high tension and action. Smoke in the background indicates gunfire, adding to the sense of turmoil. The scene is detailed, with each figure and animal carefully rendered, enhancing the drama and intensity of the composition.
creator: Johann Wilhelm Baur
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Five Cupids Playing
title: Five Cupids Playing
assistive_text: This is a drawing of winged figures interacting with animals and each other. The image depicts winged, cherub-like figures engaged in various activities. One figure is riding a goat and holding its horns for balance, while another figure stands nearby, guiding the goat with a rope. In the foreground, a figure is kneeling and holding a stick while interacting with another figure seated on a platform. The seated figure appears to be holding an object resembling a dagger. The background has a textured pattern that may represent grass.
creator: Master F.B.
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Madonna and Child at a Fountain
title: Madonna and Child at a Fountain
assistive_text: The image shows a woman sitting with a child on her lap. The woman has a gentle expression and long hair, wearing a flowing robe. The child is facing her, reaching up with one hand. In the background are trees, hills, a building, and a fountain with a lion's head spouting water into a basin. The illustration is detailed, capturing textures and elements in the scene.
creator: Master MZ
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Veronica
title: Veronica
assistive_text: The image shows a person standing upright in the center, holding a cloth with an image of a face at its center. The person has delicate features, a calm expression, and a halo. They wear a headdress or cloak covering their hair and a flowing robe. The cloth displays a face with curly hair and a crown of thorns. The background features architectural elements with decorated arches and a patterned design.
creator: Master of 1565
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Flute Player
title: The Flute Player
assistive_text: The image depicts two figures, a man and a woman, seated beside each other within a circular frame. The woman's body is shown from the knees up and the man is shown from the waist up, leaning slightly forward. The woman has delicate facial features with a serene expression, and her hair is styled under a headdress. She is dressed in ornate clothing with elaborate patterns and a high collar, while the man wears a wide-brimmed hat and a fur-trimmed cloak over his shoulders. He holds a long staff or rod in his right hand and appears to have a short beard. The background features intricate designs resembling foliage and animals.
creator: Master WI
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Man of Sorrows with Hands Bound
title: The Man of Sorrows with Hands Bound
assistive_text: The image shows a man standing upright with his head slightly tilted to the side. His hands are crossed at his waist. He has a solemn expression on his face, with a full beard and curly hair falling to his shoulders. He wears a crown of thorns. His upper body is bare, revealing a muscular chest, while a draped garment covers the lower part of his body. Beside him is a gnarled, leafless tree to his right. The backdrop features a simple landscape with undulating terrain and distant hills, creating a desolate outdoor setting. To the left of the man, there is a faint sketch of landforms on the ground, with a small inscription at the top left corner of the image.
creator: Albrecht Dürer
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Turkish Horseman
title: A Turkish Horseman
assistive_text: The image shows a full-body profile of a person riding a horse. The individual is seated on the horse, facing away from the viewer, with the horse rearing up slightly. The person's facial features are not visible due to the position, but their hair is styled in waves, and they are wearing a turban with a plume. The clothing consists of a loose-fitting garment, possibly a robe or cloak, which is gathered around the waist with a belt. The horse is adorned with a saddle and harness. The rider carries a sword in a scabbard on their back, and a lance with a flag attached to it. The flag bears a crescent moon and star emblem. The background shows some grass and a few plants on the ground, with no other objects or structures visible.
creator: Attributed to Hans Springinklee
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Ruine de la partie Interieure d'une Basilique de Rome
title: Ruine de la partie Interieure d'une Basilique de Rome
assistive_text: This is a painting of a grand, classical architectural ruin with people gathered around a fire inside. The painting depicts an interior view of an ancient basilica, showcasing massive stone pillars and arches that draw the eye upward toward the ceiling, which features intricate, coffered designs. In the foreground, there are a number of large, wooden barrels and pieces of broken masonry. Smoke rises from a fire where a few figures sit, implying a camp or gathering in this ruined space. Natural light filters through openings in the structure, creating contrasts of light and shadow.
creator: Laurent Guyot after Hubert Robert
medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Vue de Thun du Cote du Midi
title: Vue de Thun du Cote du Midi
assistive_text: The image shows a scenic view of Thun with a perspective looking towards a medieval town. The horizon is high, showcasing the town's buildings and castle above the landscape. Delicate and precise brushstrokes highlight details in the architecture and foliage. A bridge crosses a calm body of water reflecting the structures and sky. Tree-lined banks lead to the town in the distance. The color palette is soft and harmonious, with muted pastels and earthy tones. The sky is pale blue with hints of pink and grey.
creator: Jean-François Janinet
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Christ Among the Doctors
title: Christ Among the Doctors
assistive_text: The image shows several figures gathered in an interior setting. A central figure, seated on a raised platform, is joined by a group of older individuals dressed in robes. The central figure has long, wavy hair and is wearing a robe-like garment. They have an open book on their lap, with one hand on a bookstand. Surrounding them are the older individuals, some seated or standing in attentive postures. A small table in front of them holds various objects, including a scroll and books. A dog is curled up on the tiled floor near the table. In the background, gothic architectural elements like arches and columns can be seen, with additional figures near a staircase leading to another room. The setting has a serene and scholarly atmosphere, with intricate patterns and detailed shading characteristic of engraved artwork.
creator: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Man and Woman Conversing in Front of an Inn
title: Man and Woman Conversing in Front of an Inn
assistive_text: The image shows two individuals engaged in conversation. One person is depicted from behind, wearing a bonnet and a dress with long sleeves. The other person is facing forward, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a cloak. The person on the right has slightly aged facial features and is holding a basket. The background includes trees, a small building, and a cloudy sky. The scene is illustrated with detailed lines and shading.
creator: Adriaen van Ostade
medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Man and Woman Conversing on a Busy Village Street
title: Man and Woman Conversing on a Busy Village Street
assistive_text: The image shows two full figures, a woman and a man, standing outdoors. The woman is carrying a basket and wearing a long dress, headscarf, and apron. The man is holding a long stick or walking stick and wearing a long coat and hat. The background includes a thatched roof cottage, a tree, a figure near a water feature, and a small dog. The scene is depicted with intricate lines and textures.
creator: Adriaen van Ostade
medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Stone with Three Sketches  (La pierre au trois croquis)
title: Stone with Three Sketches  (La pierre au trois croquis)
assistive_text: The image shows three abstract faces, each with their heads and upper torsos. The largest face is on the left, slightly tilted downward and to the side, with dark short hair and indistinct facial features. The second face is above it to the right, with lighter hair falling around the face. The third face, positioned further to the right, has a softer, fainter depiction with delicate facial expressions. There are no distinct clothing features, just shading and contours. The background is plain and light, emphasizing the soft pencil strokes forming the faces. There are no discernible objects or jewelry in the image.
creator: Auguste Renoir
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Inn Yard on Fire
title: The Inn Yard on Fire
assistive_text: This is a painting of an inn yard on fire. The scene depicts various characters in frantic activity, showing shock, panic, and urgency. The setting includes an inn with smoke and flames. People are climbing down ladders, grabbing possessions, or being carried. The composition includes disorder and humor, with people in different states of dress and animals adding to the chaos. The use of line work and watercolor creates a lively atmosphere. The style is influenced by Thomas Rowlandson's satirical and humorous depictions of daily life.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Disappointed Epicures
title: The Disappointed Epicures
assistive_text: This is a painting of a chaotic scene at a dinner gathering. In the room, there are men dressed in 18th-century attire standing around a table with a white tablecloth. The scene conveys a sense of chaos. One man near a door looks alarmed, covering his face, while a dog darts around the legs of another man who seems to have dropped a dish. A stream of light enters from the open door. There is an elaborate chandelier overhead and ornate decorations, including a large framed painting and a mirror on the walls. This is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson, known for his satirical and caricature-style artwork.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Grog on Board
title: Grog on Board
assistive_text: This painting depicts a scene in a room with barrels and figures engaging in eating or drinking. The figures are dressed in 18th-century attire, featuring hats, ruffled shirts, and elaborate dresses. The composition includes details such as a ceramic jug, a smoking pipe, and a dog lying on the floor. The figures appear animated, seemingly engaged in merriment or conversation. The style is similar to Thomas Rowlandson, known for his humorous and satirical depictions of everyday life.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
medium: etching, stipple, and aquatint with hand coloring on wove paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Kick-up at a Hazard Table
title: A Kick-up at a Hazard Table
assistive_text: The image shows an intense scenario at a gambling table. The scene features numerous animated figures in a room gathered around a table, some engaged in a brawl. The figures are drawn in an exaggerated style, depicting one holding a chair above their head and another pointing a pistol. Objects on the table include candles, coins, cards, and a fallen top hat. The room is crowded with figures dressed in 18th-century attire, such as tricorne hats and waistcoats. The background is simple, offering minimal detail. This painting captures the frenzy and disorder often associated with gambling disputes. The style is reminiscent of Thomas Rowlandson.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Times
title: The Times
assistive_text: This is a painting depicting allegorical figures engaged in a complex interaction. In the center, a person symbolizing a governing or royal figure is seated on a throne, gesturing outward with a dramatic pose. Flanking this central figure are various allegorical characters such as Liberty holding a pole with a "Liberty" hat and a figure resembling Justice holding scales and a sword. These figures are surrounded by objects and symbols like the British flag, a shield with a cross, and a lion, representing virtues and national identity like "Virtue," "Patriotism," "Public Safety," and the "Voice of the People." Other figures portray trade or commerce, as well as sinister characters suggesting rebellion and chaos. The composition features detailed linework and vivid colors, creating a satirical and political narrative reminiscent of caricature. This painting is in the style of James Gillray, a artist known for his satirical political art in the late 18th and early 19th centuries.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Poll
title: The Poll
assistive_text: This is a drawing of a seesaw with figures riding it in a public setting. The scene shows two elegantly dressed individuals in an exaggerated and whimsical manner, wearing 18th-century attire. One figure is airborne with arms outstretched, while others in vibrant clothing are seen either assisting or balancing on the seesaw. The background features a bustling crowd against a grand architectural setting, with expressions of surprise and amusement. The composition uses vivid colors and a caricatured style to emphasize playful dynamism and social interaction.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
medium: etching and stipple with hand coloring on wove paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Manager and Spouter
title: Manager and Spouter
assistive_text: This is a drawing of three figures in a room. One man in a pink coat gestures excitedly with his hat in his hand. A woman in a brown dress with blue stripes carries a tray with a teapot and cups. Another man is seated at a table looking towards them. The room includes a fireplace with a decorative mantelpiece, paintings on the wall, and a white animal resembling a cat sitting on the floor near the table. The color palette is muted, with delicate line work and watercolor shades.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Resurrection, or The Frighted Nurse
title: Resurrection, or The Frighted Nurse
assistive_text: There are two figures in an indoor scene. On the left, an older male is emerging from a vertically positioned rectangular box with a startled expression. On the right, a nurse is seated at a table, with a concerned expression. She leans forward with one arm on an open book and the other holding a candlestick. The background includes draped curtains, an ornate chair, a large window with leaded glass, and detailed moldings. Objects on the floor near the nurse include a teacup and a small blue bottle.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Bawd on Her Last Legs
title: A Bawd on Her Last Legs
assistive_text: The image shows three individuals: an elderly woman, a younger woman, and an older man. The elderly woman is seated in an armchair, with her full body visible, wearing a pink dress with puffed sleeves and a bonnet. Her facial expression is weary, eyes slightly closed, and she is resting her head back on the chair. The younger woman is standing beside the chair, her upper body visible, bending slightly forward toward the seated woman. She has loose curly blonde hair, adorned with a ribbon and a white bonnet. She wears a yellow dress with lace details and holds a lit candle on a brass holder. The older man is seated on the floor, his full body visible, leaning forward with closed eyes and holding his face. He is dressed in a light blue coat with white lace trimming and holds a hat and a walking stick. The scene is set against a textured, abstract background with muted tones of gray and green. The artist's signature and the date "1792" appear in the lower left corner, and below the image is the title "A Bawd on Her Last Legs."
creator: Thomas Rowlandson (artist); S W Fores (publisher)
medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint with hand coloring on laid paper
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Vauxhall Gardens
title: Vauxhall Gardens
assistive_text: This is a painting of an outdoor social gathering at Vauxhall Gardens. The scene features formally dressed individuals congregating under trees. In the left part, there is a two-tiered pavilion with arches and balustrades, where musicians are playing. A figure is on one of the balconies watching the crowd below, who are interacting, walking, and enjoying refreshments. Lanterns hang from the trees, illuminating the garden. This is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Rustic Courtship
title: Rustic Courtship
assistive_text: The image shows two people in a rustic outdoor setting. The man is standing with one hand on his head, facing the woman. He has a broad smile, shoulder-length dark hair, and is dressed in an earthy red coat, light blue waistcoat, yellow breeches, blue stockings, and black shoes. The woman is seated on a chair, spinning using a wheel in front of her. She has dark hair, wears a white bonnet, and a white dress with long sleeves. Surrounding them are a barrel, a broom against the wall, a tree with green foliage, a simple wooden house with a thatched roof, and an earthy ground with grassy patches.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Militia Meeting
title: A Militia Meeting
assistive_text: This is a painting of a group of men in an ornate room engaged in discussion and reviewing a large map. The scene depicts several men gathered around a table in a richly decorated interior. One man, seated in an armchair, is studying a map presented by an attendant who is rolling it out on the floor. The room is furnished with chairs, a table set with glassware, and the back wall is adorned with crossed swords and firearms above the fireplace. The atmosphere suggests a sense of deliberation or planning.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Bachelor
title: The Bachelor
assistive_text: The image shows three people and a dog. The central figure is a man seated in a large armchair. He is reclined back with a relaxed posture, hands clasped in front of him. He appears to be an older man with curly gray hair, dressed in a long robe. Nearby, another man with white hair styled in curls sits facing him in a chair, holding a pipe. A woman sits on the table, wearing a bonnet and dress, holding a bottle and a lazy bird ornament. A small black dog is seated on the floor next to them. The room they are in appears intimate, with a billowing blue curtain serving as a backdrop. A fireplace with kitchen utensils, framed papers on the mantle, and a cane or poker nearby are also visible.
creator: Samuel Alken after H. Wigstead
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Married Man
title: The Married Man
assistive_text: The image shows a domestic scene with four adults and two children. In the center, a man is seated in a chair with one leg crossed over the other engaging with a child on his lap. He has curled hair, a pronounced facial profile, and is dressed in a blue coat over a white shirt and trousers, holding a small object, possibly a glass. To his right, a woman leans over touching the child, wearing a blue dress with a light-colored apron and a cap on her head. Another woman is seated beside her, wearing a long, ornate dress with a shawl over her shoulders and holding another child on her lap. A lute rests against her chair, and an open window with curtains drawn back is visible behind her. A small table with a bottle, cup, and glass is in front of the man, and a dog sits on the floor looking up at him. The room contains ornate furnishings, a large picture on the wall, and architectural details like a fireplace mantel.
creator: Samuel Alken after H. Wigstead
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Lawyers Last Circuit
title: The Lawyers Last Circuit
assistive_text: This is a drawing of skeletons riding skeletal horses with a panic-stricken man. The image depicts four skeletons on horseback, galloping through a fiery landscape. One of the skeletons is holding a terrified man in black clothing, who is in mid-air as if being tossed from a horse. The drawing includes a signpost pointing "ROAD TO HELL". The sky is reddish-orange, adding to the dramatic atmosphere of the scene. The artwork is titled "THE LAWYERS LAST CIRCUIT," and includes a quote from Shakespeare's "Hamlet".
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Running
title: Running
assistive_text: This is a painting of a horse race in a countryside setting. The scene includes numerous horses and riders galloping towards the finish line. A crowd of spectators is depicted in the foreground, with some standing and others sitting or reclining on the grass, watching the race. There are carriages and horses close to the spectators. The background shows the countryside under a blue sky with clouds. The painting is detailed, showing the postures of the onlookers and the motion of the racing horses. This is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson.
creator: John Bluck after Thomas Rowlandson
medium: hand-colored etching and aquatint with blue wash
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Dressing for a Birthday
title: Dressing for a Birthday
assistive_text: This is a painting of a group of people preparing for a social event or performance. It is in the style of Thomas Rowlandson. The image shows a bustling interior with richly dressed figures engaged in various preparatory tasks. In the center, an individual is being fitted with a large gown, holding a bouquet of flowers, while others help adjust the attire. A mirror is prominently displayed, reflecting the scene, and there are accessories scattered around the floor. The expressions on the figures suggest a moment of satire or comedic intent, capturing a lively and chaotic atmosphere typical of Rowlandson's works.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: A Money Scrivener
title: A Money Scrivener
assistive_text: The image shows a man standing next to a table, leaning forward with one hand on an open book and the other hand on his chin. He wears a red cap with a feather, a blue coat with gold trim, a white shirt, pink knee breeches, and dark shoes. Beside him, a person in gray clothing and a white cap sits at the table working. On the floor are papers, and on the desk is a pot of quills. The background includes a leaded glass window, simple walls, and writing above.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The High-mettled Racer
title: The High-mettled Racer
assistive_text: This is a painting of a horse race scene featuring riders speeding across the scene, surrounded by a crowd of spectators. In the foreground, a rider in a yellow jacket is prominently featured on a white horse, with several other riders on brown horses racing beside him. The spectators, including some on foot and others in carriages, are energetically engaged. There is movement and liveliness, enhanced by the dynamic poses of the horses and the expressions of the crowd. The background features soft sky blues and muted earth tones, adding depth and contrast. This painting is in the style of James Gillray.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: The Enamoured Sportsman
title: The Enamoured Sportsman
assistive_text: The image shows two people, a man and a woman, with both their upper bodies in view and extending to their knees. The woman is seated at the base of a tree, facing slightly to her left, dressed in a pale blue gown with long sleeves and an ornate white lace collar. Her hair is blonde, long, and curly, with a bonnet tied with a pink ribbon. The man is kneeling beside her right side, wearing a coral pink coat with brass buttons and a white cravat, and his hair is light-colored with gentle curls. He looks up towards the woman, holding her hands. Gold bands are visible on each of her wrists. Behind them stands a horse with a brown coat, along with the wheel of a carriage and a tree trunk. The scene is framed by lush green foliage with a landscape visible in the distance under a blue sky.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Slugs in a Sawpit
title: Slugs in a Sawpit
assistive_text: This is a painting of two men facing each other in a saw-pit, engaged in a confrontation through a telescope-like device. The figure on the left wears a blue coat with gold trimming and a tricorne hat, while the figure on the right is in a red coat with a black hat. They appear to be scrutinizing each other through the shared object. The setting is a saw-pit with wood shavings, saws, and a ladder leading out. The expressions and postures of the figures convey a sense of absurdity and satire. In the background, a third figure peers over the edge of the pit. The painting features expressive lines and subtle coloring, typical of satirical work from the late 18th century. This follows the style of Thomas Rowlandson.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Sports of a Country Fair
title: Sports of a Country Fair
assistive_text: This is a painting of a scene at a country fair. The image shows a group of people in a commotion, with figures falling from a building onto a crowd below. A theater-style setting with a stairway is visible, and some figures are jumping down onto others. The building has a sign that reads "Cockburn's Company." A banner in the background indicates additional entertainment. The illustration uses bright colors and exaggerated expressions to emphasize the chaotic and humorous nature of the event. The style is reminiscent of George Cruikshank.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington

name: Insurable Cattle
title: Insurable Cattle
assistive_text: This is a painting of a group of animals and individuals gathered in front of a building with a sign. The scene depicts various animals including a white horse, several cows, sheep, and a dog in the foreground. The creatures face a line of men standing near the entrance to a building, where a sign reads "Dicky Gossip Cow Doctor and Agent to the Cattle Life Insurance Company Instituted 1809 Capital £500,000.” The men appear to be engaged in a discussion, observing the animals, with one of the individuals holding a document. The setting is whimsical, reminiscent of satirical illustrations from the early 19th century.
creator: Thomas Rowlandson
credit: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington
